items.d: Master programming by recreating your favorite technologies from scratch.
items.z: 本仓库提供从零构建各类技术的分步指南，涵盖操作系统、数据库、神经网络、3D渲染等20+领域。通过实践深入理解计算机底层原理与系统设计，支持C++、Python、Java等多种语言。适合开发者通过动手实践掌握核心技术，践行'不创造即不理解'的学习理念，是进阶编程能力的绝佳资源。
items.e: This repository offers comprehensive step-by-step guides for building various technologies from scratch, covering 20+ domains including operating systems, databases, neural networks, 3D renderers, blockchain, and augmented reality. It enables developers to deeply understand computer fundamentals and system design through hands-on implementation and practical coding exercises. The tutorials support multiple programming languages like C++, Python, Java, and JavaScript, accommodating different skill sets. Embodying Richard Feynman's philosophy 'What I cannot create, I do not understand', it serves as an exceptional educational resource for advancing programming expertise by recreating core technologies from first principles, making it ideal for intermediate to advanced developers seeking true mastery of computing systems.

items.d: A collective list of free APIs
items.z: Public APIs是一个由社区维护的免费API目录，汇集金融、天气、地理定位、电信等多领域公共接口。该项目通过人工审核机制确保API质量，为开发者提供免费、可直接集成的RESTful服务资源。作为开发者的API宝库，它简化了寻找可靠第三方服务的流程，支持快速原型开发和产品功能扩展，是集成外部服务的理想起点。
items.e: The Public APIs repository is a community-curated directory offering free RESTful APIs across diverse domains including finance, weather, geolocation, and telecommunications. Manually reviewed for quality, this collection serves as a valuable resource for developers seeking reliable third-party services without cost. It streamlines API discovery for rapid prototyping and product development, featuring categories like stock market data, IP geolocation, weather information, and phone validation. The project is maintained by both community contributors and APILayer, ensuring ongoing updates and a well-organized structure.

items.d: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
items.z: REA 是基于 MCP 协议的逆向工程智能体框架，支持原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集及网页的多平台分析。通过对接 Hopper、Ghidra、IDA 等专业工具，让 AI 智能体在本地完成代码审查与行为逆向，输出带证据链的结论，适用于竞品分析与安全研究。
items.e: REA is an MCP-based reverse engineering agent framework supporting multi-platform analysis of native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. It connects to Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA for local code inspection and behavioral reverse engineering with evidence-backed conclusions, ideal for competitive analysis and security research.

items.d: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
items.z: 这是一个社区驱动的开发者学习路线图项目，提供前端、后端、DevOps、AI工程师、数据科学等30+技术方向的交互式可视化学习路径。用户可点击节点查看详细内容，涵盖从入门到进阶的完整技能体系，帮助开发者清晰规划职业发展和技术成长方向。
items.e: This community-driven project offers interactive visual learning roadmaps for developers across 30+ technical domains including frontend, backend, DevOps, AI engineering, and data science. Users can click nodes to access detailed content, covering complete skill paths from beginner to advanced levels, helping developers clearly plan career development and technical growth.

items.d: A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
items.z: 这是一个全面的自托管开源软件目录，涵盖通信、存储、管理、媒体等数十个类别，提供替代SaaS的私有化部署方案。核心价值在于帮助用户实现数据主权、隐私保护和基础设施自主可控。项目持续维护，包含死链检查和活跃度监控，是自建服务器的终极参考指南。
items.e: A comprehensive directory of self-hostable open-source network services and web applications spanning communications, storage, management, media, and dozens of categories. It enables private deployment alternatives to SaaS, empowering data sovereignty, privacy protection, and infrastructure autonomy. Continuously maintained with automated dead link validation and project health monitoring, it serves as the definitive reference for building and maintaining a self-hosted server ecosystem.

items.d: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
items.z: 一套面向真实工程的AI智能体技能库，提供可组合的提示词模板，解决需求对齐、代码啰嗦、调试低效等痛点。支持任意大模型，集成GitHub/Linear，助力工程师高效协作而非vibe coding。
items.e: A collection of composable AI agent skills for real engineering, solving misalignment, verbosity, and debugging inefficiencies. Works with any model, integrates with GitHub/Linear, and helps engineers collaborate effectively beyond vibe coding.

items.d: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.z: ECC 是一个 AI 智能体性能优化系统，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等 AI 编程助手设计。系统提供技能管理、内存优化、安全扫描和研究优先开发框架，支持跨 harness 架构。从 Anthropic hackathon 胜出，经过 10+ 个月实战验证，支持 12+ 语言生态，可显著提升 AI 编程效率和质量。
items.e: ECC is a production-ready AI agent harness performance optimization system designed for Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants. It provides comprehensive capabilities including skills management, instincts, memory optimization, continuous learning, security scanning, and research-first development framework. Winner of Anthropic hackathon, battle-tested over 10+ months across 12+ language ecosystems with cross-harness architecture, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and code quality.

items.d: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
items.z: 本仓库提供CLAUDE.md配置文件，用于优化Claude Code的AI编程行为。基于Andrej Karpathy对LLM编码陷阱的观察，提炼出四条核心原则：思考后编码、优先简化、精准修改、目标驱动执行，解决错误假设、过度复杂化、随意修改无关代码等问题，显著提升AI生成代码的准确性和简洁性。
items.e: This repo provides a CLAUDE.md config file to optimize Claude Code's AI coding behavior. Distilled from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls, it implements four core principles: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, and Goal-Driven Execution to address wrong assumptions, overcomplication, and unintended edits, enhancing code accuracy and conciseness.

items.d: The open source coding agent.
items.z: OpenCode是开源AI编程代理，提供终端与桌面双界面。支持多平台安装（macOS/Windows/Linux），集成多种包管理器。具备活跃社区与持续更新，为开发者提供智能编码辅助。
items.e: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that delivers intelligent programming assistance through both terminal and desktop interfaces. It provides comprehensive multi-platform support for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with diverse installation options including npm, Homebrew, Scoop, Chocolatey, pacman, and direct shell scripts. The project maintains an active Discord community for real-time collaboration, offers beta desktop applications for enhanced user experience, ensures continuous updates, and respects XDG Base Directory Specification for flexible installation paths, providing developers with cutting-edge AI-powered coding capabilities across all development environments while maintaining high accessibility standards.

Preserves document structure—headings, lists, tables, links—with token-efficient output. Integrates OCR, speech transcription, YouTube processing, and MCP server for Claude/LLM integration. Stream-based processing eliminates temporary files; plugin architecture enables custom converters.

items.z: CS-Notes 是专为技术面试打造的全栈知识体系，系统整合算法（LeetCode、剑指Offer 题解）、操作系统、计算机网络、数据库原理、Java 核心技术（并发、JVM）及大规模系统设计等核心内容。以实战为导向，深度结合理论与实践，覆盖从基础到架构的完整技能树，是程序员求职面试的高效复习指南。
items.e: CS-Notes is a systematic knowledge repository specifically designed for technical interview preparation, encompassing core CS fundamentals including algorithms (LeetCode, 剑指Offer solutions), operating systems, computer networks, database principles, Java internals (concurrency, JVM, I/O), and large-scale system design. It bridges theory with hands-on practice through extensive coding problems and architectural case studies, offering a complete skill development path from basic concepts to advanced engineering architecture for software engineers.

items.d: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.

items.e: This repository delivers a production-ready AI agent team covering frontend, backend, mobile development, and more. Each agent features unique personality, specialized workflows, and measurable deliverables, compatible with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and other mainstream tools. By standardizing prompt engineering with automation scripts, it transforms generic AI assistants into domain-specialized virtual employees, enabling intelligent upgrades across the entire software development lifecycle.

items.d: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
items.z: Open WebUI是功能完备的自托管AI平台，无缝集成Ollama与OpenAI API，支持完全离线部署。内置RAG推理引擎和原生Python函数调用工具，提供细粒度用户权限管理、响应式界面及PWA移动应用。支持语音/视频通话、Markdown/LaTeX渲染，可通过插件系统扩展功能。提供Docker/Kubernetes部署方案，适用于企业级AI应用开发与私有化大模型部署场景。
items.e: Open WebUI is a comprehensive self-hosted AI platform that seamlessly integrates Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs with full offline deployment capability. Featuring a built-in RAG inference engine and native Python function calling tools, it offers granular user permissions, responsive design, and PWA mobile support. The platform enables voice/video calls, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, and extensible plugin architecture. Deployable via Docker/Kubernetes, it serves as an enterprise-grade solution for private LLM orchestration and AI application development requiring air-gapped security.

items.d: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io

items.e: CC Switch is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri 2 that unifies management of AI coding assistants including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It eliminates workflow fragmentation by centralizing API relay configurations and model switching in a single interface. The lightweight, secure app runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, streamlining AI-powered development and boosting developer productivity through consolidated tool management.

items.d: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.

items.e: UI UX Pro Max Skill is an AI-powered design intelligence tool that automatically generates professional design systems using 100 reasoning rules and 67 UI style libraries. Featuring a Python-based CLI, it analyzes project requirements and outputs customized UI/UX solutions—from hero-centric conversion patterns to soft UI evolution styles—enabling rapid creation of cohesive, production-ready design systems across web and mobile platforms while dramatically improving design efficiency, ensuring brand consistency, and reducing development iteration cycles.

items.d: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
items.z: Graphify 将任意代码库（含文档、SQL、PDF、图像、视频）转化为可查询知识图谱，作为 Claude Code、Cursor 等 17+ AI 编码助手的 /graphify 技能。本地 tree-sitter AST 确定性解析 36+ 语言代码，无 LLM 且数据不离机；每个边标注 EXTRACTED/INFERRED 确保透明。输出交互式 graph.html、GRAPH_REPORT.md 和 graph.json，支持路径查询、社区检测（Leiden），非向量存储。适用于新项目理解、PR 审查、团队 onboarding，大幅降低 AI token 消耗。
items.e: Graphify turns any codebase—including code, docs, SQL, configs, PDFs, images, and videos—into a queryable knowledge graph. It installs as a /graphify skill for 17+ AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Code is parsed locally and deterministically via tree-sitter AST across 36+ languages with no LLM or data leaving the machine. Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED for auditability. It outputs interactive graph.html, a report, and graph.json for path queries, community detection, and concept exploration instead of vector stores or grepping. Ideal for onboarding, codebase navigation, PR reviews, and grounding AI responses with significant token savings.

Built on Markdown-based prompt engineering, it enables automated enforcement of code quality standards across platforms including Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and GitHub Copilot.

items.d: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages
items.z: Taste-Skill 是一个开源反“slop”前端框架，专为AI智能体设计。通过可移植的SKILL.md技能文件，指导Cursor、Claude Code、Codex等代理生成优质界面，强化布局、排版、动效与间距，避免通用模板。该仓库提供多种风格技能（极简、粗犷等）、redesign审计、图像到代码流程，以及网页/移动端/品牌套件图像生成技能。支持npx skills add安装、可调设计参数（方差、动效、密度），兼容多框架与AI工具，助力打造高端非模板化前端。
items.e: Taste-Skill is an open-source anti-slop frontend framework for AI agents. It provides portable SKILL.md files that guide coding agents like Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex to generate premium interfaces with refined layout, typography, motion, and spacing instead of generic boilerplate. The repo includes style-specific skills, redesign audits, image-to-code pipelines, and image-generation skills for web/mobile/brand reference boards. Installable via npx skills add with adjustable dials (variance, motion, density), it works across frameworks and AI tools to deliver high-quality, non-templated frontends.

items.d: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
items.z: Paperclip 是一个开源的 AI 代理编排平台，用于构建"零人力公司"。它通过 Node.js 服务端和 React 管理界面，协调多个 AI 代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）协同完成商业目标。核心功能包括组织架构管理、预算控制、目标对齐和任务追踪，让管理者像使用任务管理器一样 overseeing 整个 AI 团队。平台支持任意能接收心跳信号的代理，提供统一仪表盘监控工作进展和成本，实现 24/7 自动化运营，同时保留人工审计和干预能力。
items.e: Paperclip is an open-source orchestration platform for building "zero-human companies." It coordinates teams of AI agents through a Node.js backend and React dashboard, enabling autonomous business operations. The platform provides organizational charts, budget governance, goal alignment, and cost tracking across multiple agents like Claude Code and Cursor. Supporting any agent that can receive heartbeats, it functions as a task manager for AI teams, allowing 24/7 autonomous execution with human oversight. Users can define business goals, assign AI roles, and monitor progress from a unified interface, with pre-built company templates coming soon.

items.d: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
items.z: Impeccable是为AI编码助手打造的UI设计增强系统，解决LLM生成界面同质化、缺乏专业性的问题。通过7大领域设计知识库（排版、色彩、动效等）、17个专用指令（/audit、/polish、/animate等）及反模式约束，显著提升AI设计输出质量。支持Cursor等IDE，提供从技术审查到视觉优化的全流程设计指导，让AI成为真正懂设计的前端协作伙伴。
items.e: Impeccable is a UI design enhancement system for AI coding assistants that addresses generic, low-quality LLM-generated interfaces. It provides 7 domain-specific design knowledge bases (typography, color, motion, etc.), 17 steering commands (/audit, /polish, /animate), and curated anti-patterns to significantly improve AI design output. Integrated with IDEs like Cursor, it offers end-to-end design guidance from technical auditing to visual optimization, transforming AI into a design-savvy frontend collaborator.

items.d: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
items.z: Agent-Reach 为 AI 智能体提供命令行式全网接入，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、B站、小红书等平台，自动处理认证与反爬，零 API 费用实现跨平台内容读取与搜索。
items.e: Agent-Reach is a CLI tool that equips AI agents with cross-platform internet access across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu. It automatically handles authentication, anti-bot measures, and data cleaning—zero API fees, one command to install.

items.d: The 1st Collaborative AI Design Agent Workspace. Local-first and open source. Create motion, prototypes, websites, apps, dashboards, presentations, images, and videos with your team and AI agents. Share work, exchange feedback, and iterate together in one workspace.
items.z: Open Design 是开源、本地优先的 Claude Design 替代品，支持 16+ AI 编码代理（Claude Code/Cursor/Gemini 等）。提供 31 种可组合技能和 72 个品牌级设计系统，可生成 Web/桌面/移动原型、幻灯片、图像和视频，支持 HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 导出。BYOK 模式确保数据自主，沙盒预览保障安全，是 Figma 的开源替代方案。
items.e: Open Design is an open-source, local-first alternative to Claude Design supporting 16+ AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, etc.). It offers 31 composable skills and 72 brand-grade design systems to generate web, desktop, and mobile prototypes, slides, images, and videos. Features include sandboxed preview, HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 export, and BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model for data sovereignty. A viable open-source replacement for Figma with multi-agent flexibility.

items.d: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
items.z: RuView利用商用WiFi的CSI信道状态信息，通过物理信号处理和机器学习实现穿墙人体感知。系统提供实时姿态估计(54K fps)、呼吸心率监测及毫秒级存在检测，无需摄像头或穿戴设备。基于Rust构建，支持ESP32-S3等低成本硬件，适用于智能安防、健康监护及灾难救援等隐私敏感场景。
items.e: RuView transforms commodity WiFi CSI signals into real-time human perception through physics-based signal processing and ML. It delivers 54K fps pose estimation, vital sign monitoring (breathing/heartbeat), and <1ms presence detection without cameras or wearables. Built in Rust with 1100+ tests, it supports ESP32-S3 and research NICs for through-wall sensing up to 5m. Ideal for privacy-preserving smart home, healthcare, security, and disaster response applications.

items.d: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
items.z: Scrapling 是一个自适应网页抓取框架，能够处理从单请求到大规模爬取的全场景需求。其核心亮点在于智能解析器可学习网站变化并自动重定位元素，内置绕过 Cloudflare 等反爬系统的能力，支持并发多会话爬取、自动代理轮换和暂停恢复功能。提供实时统计、CLI 和 MCP 服务器集成，是现代 Web 数据采集的高效解决方案。
items.e: Scrapling is an adaptive web scraping framework designed to handle everything from simple single requests to complex large-scale crawling operations. Its standout feature is an intelligent parser that learns from website changes and automatically relocates elements when pages update. The framework includes built-in anti-bot bypass capabilities that defeat systems like Cloudflare Turnstile out of the box. It enables concurrent multi-session crawling with automatic proxy rotation, pause/resume functionality, and real-time streaming statistics. With integrated CLI tools and an MCP server, Scrapling offers a powerful yet straightforward solution for modern web data extraction at any scale.

items.d: Programmer's guide about how to cook at home.
items.z: 专为程序员设计的开源烹饪指南，采用代码思维重构菜谱结构。每道菜都有精确的食材清单、标准化步骤和量化参数，如同编写程序般严谨。项目集成Docker部署、CI/CD自动化、PDF导出等工程化特性，并建立完整贡献体系。通过技术隐喻和结构化文档，将烹饪转化为可编程的确定性过程，降低程序员下厨门槛。
items.e: An open-source cooking guide specifically designed for programmers, reconstructing recipes with code-like thinking. Each dish features precise ingredient lists, standardized procedures, and quantified cooking parameters as rigorously as writing code. The project includes engineering features like Docker deployment, CI/CD automation, and PDF export, with a complete contribution system. Through technical metaphors and structured documentation, it transforms cooking into a programmable deterministic process, lowering the barrier for programmers to cook at home.

items.d: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
items.z: Ghidra是NSA开源的软件逆向工程框架，提供反汇编、反编译、图形化分析与脚本扩展能力，支持多平台、多处理器指令集。可用于恶意代码分析、漏洞挖掘与团队协作逆向，支持交互与自动化模式，并允许用Java/Python开发扩展，是高端可定制的SRE研究平台。
items.e: Ghidra is an open-source software reverse engineering framework by the NSA, offering disassembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting. It supports multiple platforms and processor architectures, enabling malware analysis, vulnerability research, and collaborative SRE in both interactive and automated modes, with extensibility via Java or Python.

items.d: The open-source CapCut alternative
items.z: OpenCut 是开源的 CapCut 替代品，提供 Web、桌面和移动端视频编辑。基于 Next.js 和 React 构建，采用 Zustand 状态管理与 TypeScript 类型安全。支持时间线多轨道编辑和实时预览，核心优势是隐私优先（视频本地处理）、无订阅费用和水印，为商业闭源编辑器提供强大替代方案。
items.e: OpenCut is a free, open-source alternative to CapCut that provides comprehensive video editing capabilities for web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Built on Next.js and React with Zustand state management, it delivers timeline-based multi-track editing with real-time preview. The project emphasizes privacy by processing videos entirely on-device, eliminating subscriptions and watermarks. Leveraging TypeScript, Bun, and Docker, OpenCut offers a streamlined development experience and a robust, privacy-first substitute for commercial video editing solutions.

items.d: real time face swap and one-click video deepfake with only a single image
items.z: Deep-Live-Cam 是一款实时换脸与深度伪造工具，仅需单张源图像即可实现一键视频换脸。核心技术包括实时面部捕捉、嘴部动作保留与多人脸映射，支持 Windows/Mac 平台。适用于内容创作、直播表演、影视娱乐及视频聊天等场景，内置内容审核机制确保合规使用，强调负责任的 AI 应用。
items.e: Deep-Live-Cam is a real-time face swap and deepfake tool that enables one-click video face replacement with just a single source image. Key technical features include real-time facial capture, mouth mask for natural lip movement preservation, and multi-face mapping for simultaneous subject processing. It supports Windows/Mac platforms and serves content creation, live streaming, film entertainment, and video chat applications. The software incorporates built-in content moderation to prevent misuse and promotes responsible AI usage through ethical guidelines and consent requirements.

items.d: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
items.z: Archify 是一款 AI 代理技能工具，能将自然语言描述转化为精美的架构图、工作流图、序列图、数据流图和生命周期图。生成自包含 HTML，支持暗/亮主题一键切换、剪贴板复制及最高 4 倍原生分辨率导出（PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG）。SVG 支持系统主题偏好。集成 Claude 等平台，无需设计技能，通过聊天指令迭代优化。核心价值是提升技术文档和可视化效率，适用于系统架构、DevOps 流程及数据管道等场景。
items.e: Archify is an agent skill for AI tools like Claude that generates high-quality architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from plain English text. It outputs self-contained HTML files featuring instant dark/light theme toggles, clipboard PNG copy, and native 4× resolution exports in PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG. SVGs include dual themes with media queries for automatic adaptation. Requiring no design expertise, it supports conversational refinements and is ideal for technical documentation, system design, CI/CD pipelines, and data engineering visualizations.

items.d: 24 Lessons, 12 Weeks, Get Started as a Web Developer
items.z: 微软官方出品的系统性Web开发入门课程，12周24节课涵盖HTML/CSS/JavaScript核心基础。采用项目驱动教学法，通过生态箱、浏览器扩展等实践项目强化学习效果。支持40+种语言自动化翻译，开源社区协作模式。适合零基础学习者、教育工作者及自学者快速掌握现代Web开发技能。
items.e: Microsoft's official 12-week web development curriculum designed for absolute beginners, featuring 24 comprehensive lessons covering HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals. Employs project-based learning methodology through practical projects including terrariums, browser extensions, and space games. Features automated multi-language translation support for 40+ languages via GitHub Actions. Open-source and community-driven with quizzes, discussions, and assignments. Perfect for aspiring developers, educators, and self-learners seeking structured, hands-on web development training.

items.d: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
items.z: Understand Anything 通过多智能体流水线分析代码库，结合 Tree-sitter 结构解析与 LLM 语义理解，构建文件、函数、类及依赖的交互式知识图谱。支持结构视图与业务领域视图切换，提供语义搜索、引导游览、影响分析和多语言支持。兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 编码工具，帮助开发者快速掌握大型代码库架构与业务逻辑，加速 onboarding 与代码探索。
items.e: Understand Anything uses a multi-agent pipeline combining tree-sitter parsing and LLMs to turn any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph of files, functions, classes, and dependencies. It offers structural and business domain views, semantic search, guided tours, and impact analysis. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and more, it helps developers quickly understand complex projects, aiding onboarding and AI-assisted coding.

items.d: Turn any PDF or image document into structured data for your AI. A powerful, lightweight OCR toolkit that bridges the gap between images/PDFs and LLMs. Supports 100+ languages.
items.z: PaddleOCR 是基于 PaddlePaddle 的工业级 OCR 工具包，支持 100+ 语言的多模态文档解析。核心亮点包括端到端 pipeline、轻量级部署、多硬件加速（CPU/GPU/XPU/NPU），以及专为 LLM 优化的结构化数据输出。适用于文档数字化、表单识别、票据处理等 AI 应用场景，提供从图像到结构化数据的无缝桥梁。
items.e: PaddleOCR is an industrial-grade OCR toolkit powered by PaddlePaddle, designed for high-performance document intelligence. It supports 100+ languages and multimodal inputs (images/PDFs), delivering end-to-end text detection, recognition, and structure analysis. Key technical advantages include lightweight deployment, multi-hardware acceleration (CPU/GPU/XPU/NPU), and LLM-optimized structured outputs. Ideal for document digitization, form processing, invoice extraction, and AI-driven data pipelines, it seamlessly converts unstructured visual content into machine-readable formats for downstream applications requiring precise text extraction and semantic understanding.

items.d: Official Crawl4AI Cloud: a hosted web scraping, extraction, and search API for AI agents. Free API key, 1,000 credits a month, no card. Fully open source: this repo is the Apache-2.0 crawler that powers it, and you can self-host it.
items.z: Crawl4AI 是一款开源的LLM友好型网页爬虫，专为RAG、AI代理和数据管道设计。它将网页转换为干净的Markdown格式，便于大语言模型处理。项目亮点包括：崩溃恢复机制支持长时间深度爬取；预取模式提升5-10倍URL发现速度；提供自托管平台，含企业级监控仪表板和REST API；采用浏览器池管理技术。拥有5万+星标社区验证，相比现有方案显著降低成本，支持完全本地化部署。
items.e: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler designed for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines. It converts web content into clean Markdown format optimized for language models. Key features include crash recovery for long-running deep crawls, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and a self-hosting platform with enterprise-grade monitoring dashboard, REST API, and WebSocket streaming. Battle-tested by a 50k+ star community, it offers a cost-effective alternative to paid solutions with full local deployment capabilities and smart browser pool management.

items.d: 📚 《从零开始构建智能体》——从零开始的智能体原理与实践教程
items.z: Datawhale 开源项目《从零开始构建智能体》提供系统性 AI Native Agent 开发教程，填补市场实践空白。内容涵盖智能体核心原理、经典范式（ReAct/Plan-and-Solve）、自研框架 HelloAgents、模型训练（SFT/GRPO）及多智能体实战案例。从理论到代码实现，帮助开发者从 LLM 使用者转型为智能体系统构建者。
items.e: Datawhale's 'Hello-Agents' delivers a comprehensive, hands-on tutorial for building AI Native Agents from first principles, filling the gap in systematic Agent development resources. The curriculum spans core architectures, classic paradigms (ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, Reflection), low-code platforms (Coze/Dify), mainstream frameworks (AutoGen/LangGraph), self-developed HelloAgents framework, model training (SFT/GRPO), and production-ready projects like intelligent travel assistants. Designed to transform LLM users into proficient Agent system architects through practical implementation.

items.d: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
items.z: DeerFlow 是字节跳动开源的超级智能体框架，通过协调子智能体、记忆系统和沙箱环境，处理分钟级到小时级的复杂研究与创作任务。其核心在于可扩展技能体系与上下文工程，支持长期记忆持久化与文件系统操作，为构建自主智能体应用提供生产级基础设施。
items.e: DeerFlow is an open-source SuperAgent harness by Bytedance that orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes to handle complex research, coding, and creative tasks spanning minutes to hours. Featuring extensible skills, context engineering, and long-term memory persistence, it provides production-grade infrastructure for building autonomous agent applications.

items.d: Course to get into Large Language Models (LLMs) with roadmaps and Colab notebooks.
items.z: 这是一个免费的LLM系统学习课程，提供从数学基础到工程实践的完整路线图。课程分为三部分：LLM基础、LLM科学家（模型构建与优化）和LLM工程师（应用开发与部署）。包含大量实用的Google Colab notebooks，涵盖模型微调、合并、量化、评估等实战技术，并配套自动化工具，适合想深入LLM领域的开发者。
items.e: This is a free, comprehensive LLM course offering structured learning paths from mathematical foundations to production deployment. The curriculum is divided into three parts: LLM Fundamentals, The LLM Scientist (focusing on building optimal models with cutting-edge techniques), and The LLM Engineer (covering application development and deployment). It provides extensive Google Colab notebooks for hands-on practice, including tools for fine-tuning, model merging, quantization, and automated evaluation. Based on the LLM Engineer's Handbook, it's designed for developers seeking practical LLM expertise.

items.d: simple terminal UI for git commands
items.z: lazygit 是用 Go 语言开发的终端 Git 客户端，为开发者提供简洁的交互式界面来执行 Git 命令。它通过可视化操作简化了提交、推送、分支管理等复杂流程，支持跨平台使用，显著提升版本控制效率，是开发者日常 Git 操作的效率利器。
items.e: lazygit is a lightweight terminal UI for Git commands, developed in Go language. It provides developers with an intuitive interactive interface to simplify complex Git workflows including committing, pushing, branch management, and conflict resolution. This cross-platform tool dramatically enhances version control efficiency by visualizing repository states and enabling keyboard-driven operations. Designed for developers seeking productivity in daily Git usage, lazygit reduces command memorization overhead and streamlines the development process.

items.d: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
items.z: Headroom 是 AI 智能体的上下文压缩层，能压缩工具输出、日志、RAG 块和文件，减少 60-95% 令牌并保持答案质量。提供 Python/TS 库、代理和 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude、Cursor 等集成。具备可逆 CCR 压缩、跨代理内存共享和失败学习等功能，支持 6 种算法，本地优先，显著提升 LLM 交互效率。
items.e: Headroom acts as the context optimization layer for LLM applications and AI agents. It compresses tool outputs, logs, RAG chunks, files, DB results, and more before they reach the model, achieving 60-95% token reduction while preserving 100% answer accuracy. Deployable as a Python or TypeScript library, transparent proxy, MCP server, or integrations with LangChain, Agno, Vercel AI SDK, and 100+ LLM providers. Key highlights include reversible CCR compression, smart content detection across formats, persistent hierarchical memory, failure learning that updates agent docs, image compression via ML, cache optimization, and six specialized algorithms. Local-first and multi-agent compatible, it drastically cuts costs and latency for LLM interactions.

items.d: Learn AI Engineering! Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
items.z: 《AI工程从零开始》是开源AI工程课程，含473课、20阶段、约320小时。从数学基础到多智能体系统与生产，覆盖Python等多语言。核心是每算法从原始数学手工构建，再用框架对比，每课产出提示、技能、代理或MCP服务器等可复用产物。填补工具使用与专业准备差距，帮助深入掌握AI internals，免费MIT许可，配网站与技能集成，适合开发者实战学习与构建系统。
items.e: AI Engineering from Scratch is a comprehensive open-source curriculum with 473 lessons across 20 phases (~320 hours). It spans math foundations to deep learning, transformers, LLMs built from scratch, agent engineering, multi-agent swarms, production, and ethics. Learners implement algorithms from raw math in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia before frameworks. Every lesson ships reusable artifacts: prompts, skills, agents, MCP servers. Emphasizes deep understanding over API calls. Free MIT license with website and agent skills for personalized paths.

items.d: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
items.z: Strix 是一款开源的 AI 安全代理工具，通过模拟真实黑客行为动态扫描应用漏洞。核心亮点包括：团队协作模式实现高效漏洞挖掘、生成可验证的 PoC 而非误报、提供一键自动修复方案，并支持 CI/CD 集成。适用于快速渗透测试、Bug 赏金自动化和应用安全测试，大幅提升安全测试效率。
items.e: Strix is an open-source AI-powered security agent that simulates real hackers to dynamically discover and validate application vulnerabilities. Key features include: collaborative agent teams for efficient scanning, real PoC generation eliminating false positives, one-click autofix capabilities, and seamless CI/CD integration. Ideal for rapid penetration testing, bug bounty automation, and application security testing, dramatically accelerating security remediation.

items.d: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
items.z: 该技能将编码代理转化为安全审计员，通过侦察、覆盖驱动狩猎、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录验证和中性报告六阶段，生成机器可读且经独立验证的安全发现，适用于代码库安全审计与漏洞挖掘。
items.e: This skill turns a coding agent into a security auditor, orchestrating six phases—reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting—to produce machine-readable, independently verified findings for codebase security audits and vulnerability discovery.

items.d: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ LLMs & VLMs (ACL 2024)
items.z: LlamaFactory是一个统一的大语言模型与多模态模型高效微调框架，支持100+预训练模型。提供零代码命令行工具和基于Gradio的Web UI，大幅降低微调门槛。该框架在ACL 2024发表，已被Amazon、NVIDIA、阿里云等企业采用，支持云端部署和本地训练，集成LoRA、QLoRA等高效微调技术，是学术界和工业界广泛使用的微调解决方案。
items.e: LlamaFactory is a unified framework for efficient fine-tuning of 100+ large language and vision-language models. It offers zero-code CLI and Gradio-powered Web UI, dramatically lowering the barrier to model customization. Published at ACL 2024 and adopted by industry leaders including Amazon, NVIDIA, and Aliyun, it supports both cloud deployment and local training. The framework integrates advanced parameter-efficient techniques like LoRA and QLoRA, making it a widely-used solution for streamlined model adaptation in academic and industrial settings.

items.d: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
items.z: 这是一个Claude Code插件，AI智能体技能，自动抓取过去30天内Reddit、X、YouTube等8大社交平台及网页内容，通过多信号质量排名算法和跨源收敛检测，生成基于真实引用的趋势摘要。支持对比模式分析技术选型，自动保存研究简报，帮助开发者快速掌握AI领域最新动态。
items.e: A Claude Code plugin that automatically researches topics across 8 social platforms including Reddit, X, YouTube, Bluesky, TikTok, Instagram, Hacker News, and Polymarket from the last 30 days. It employs multi-signal quality-ranked relevance scoring, cross-platform convergence detection, and composite ranking algorithms to synthesize grounded narratives with real citations. Features include comparative mode for side-by-side analysis, automatic saving of research briefings, smart subreddit discovery, and per-project configuration. Helps developers stay current with AI trends and community discussions.

items.d: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
items.z: 专为Claude Code、Codex、Pi等AI智能体打造的编辑级图表技能。输出纯自包含HTML+SVG，无阴影、无Mermaid粗糙样式，支持架构、流程、序列、Sankey、Wardley等数十种专业类型。可读取网站自动匹配品牌色与字体，默认静态输出，可选无障碍动画，并能重绘draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw源图。强调极简密度与焦点设计，让AI生成图表真正达到设计师水准。
items.e: Editorial diagram skill for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Agent Skills hosts. Produces self-contained HTML+SVG with no shadows or Mermaid-style clutter. Supports architecture, flowcharts, sequences, Sankey, Wardley maps and dozens more types. Auto-matches brand colors/fonts from your site in seconds. Static by default with optional accessible motion; redraws draw.io, Mermaid or Excalidraw sources. Delivers clean, designer-approved visuals with deliberate low density and focal accents.

items.d: Warp is an agentic development environment, born out of the terminal.
items.z: Warp 是一款诞生于终端的智能体开发环境，深度集成 AI 编码助手并支持 Claude Code 等第三方 CLI 智能体。其 Oz 系统可自动化处理开源项目的 issue 管理、PR 审查等协作流程，提供实时智能体会话追踪与贡献者仪表板。采用 AGPL 开源协议，重塑开发者与 AI 协同编程体验。
items.e: Warp is an agentic development environment born from the terminal, deeply integrating AI coding assistants and supporting third-party CLI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Its proprietary Oz system automates open-source project workflows including issue triage, PR reviews, spec writing, and community management. The platform provides real-time agent session tracking via build.warp.dev and comprehensive contributor dashboards. With OpenAI as founding sponsor and GPT-powered agentic workflows, Warp redefines developer-AI collaboration under AGPL open-source licensing while offering an MIT-licensed UI framework.

items.d: A light-weight and powerful meta-prompting, context engineering and spec-driven development system for Claude Code by TÂCHES.
items.z: 针对Claude Code的轻量级元提示与上下文工程系统，通过结构化提示管理和规范驱动开发流程，显著提升AI编程效率。核心价值在于将复杂提示工程标准化，优化大模型上下文窗口利用率，实现可复用的开发模式。适用于AI辅助开发场景，需注意项目已迁移至open-gsd/get-shit-done-redux。
items.e: GSD (Get Shit Done) is a lightweight meta-prompting and context engineering framework built exclusively for Claude Code, designed to maximize AI programming efficiency. It introduces structured prompt management and specification-driven development workflows that standardize complex prompt engineering tasks. The system optimizes LLM context window utilization through dynamic context orchestration and enables reusable development patterns with prompt versioning capabilities. By enforcing spec-based validation, it ensures consistent AI behavior and high-quality output. This powerful tool transforms chaotic AI-assisted development into a systematic, productive process, reducing prompt sprawl and context management overhead. Note: This repository is archived; active development continues at open-gsd/get-shit-done-redux.

items.d: The web framework for content-driven websites.
items.z: Astro 是内容驱动网站的 Web 框架，强调服务端渲染与轻量输出。通过岛屿架构实现交互优化，支持 React 等框架集成和 Markdown 内容集合。默认零 JavaScript，具备快速构建、视图过渡和多平台部署功能。适用于博客、文档站点等内容应用，提供卓越性能与灵活扩展性。
items.e: Astro is a web framework optimized for content-driven websites, delivering powerful developer experience alongside lightweight output. It uses server-first rendering and the islands architecture for selective interactivity and minimal JavaScript. Astro supports integrations with React, Vue, Svelte and other frameworks, along with Markdown content collections. Features include zero JS by default, view transitions, optimized images, and deployment adapters. It excels in building blogs, documentation sites, and marketing pages with fast builds and excellent performance.

items.d: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
items.z: Pake 是一款基于 Rust Tauri 的轻量级桌面应用打包工具，可将任意网页转化为独立原生应用。相比 Electron 应用体积缩小约 20 倍，仅 5MB 左右，内存占用更低且运行更快。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 三大平台，提供 CLI 命令行一键打包和在线构建服务。内置快捷键、沉浸式窗口、样式定制、广告过滤等功能，已预打包微信读书、Twitter、Grok、DeepSeek 等常用应用。
items.e: Pake is a lightweight desktop app packaging tool built with Rust Tauri that converts any webpage into a native standalone application. It reduces package size by approximately 20x compared to Electron (around 5MB), with faster performance and lower memory usage. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it offers one-command packaging via CLI and online building. Features include keyboard shortcuts, immersive windows, style customization, and ad removal. Pre-built packages are available for popular services like WeRead, Twitter, Grok, and DeepSeek.

items.d: The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI, VertexAI, vLLM, Nvidia NIM]
items.z: LiteLLM 是一个统一的大语言模型网关和 Python SDK，可将 100+ 种 LLM API 转换为 OpenAI 格式调用。提供代理服务器模式，集成成本追踪、负载均衡、安全护栏和日志监控等企业级功能。支持 Bedrock、Azure、Anthropic 等主流平台，简化多模型管理和切换，适用于需要统一 AI 接口、成本控制和生产级部署的场景。
items.e: LiteLLM is a unified LLM gateway and Python SDK that standardizes 100+ model APIs into OpenAI format. It offers proxy server mode with enterprise features including cost tracking, load balancing, guardrails, and logging. Supporting major platforms like Bedrock, Azure, and Anthropic, it simplifies multi-model management and switching for production deployments requiring unified AI interfaces and cost control.

items.d: Penpot: The open-source design platform for Product teams that need scalable collaboration.
items.z: Penpot 是开源的设计协作工具，支持设计师创建交互式原型与设计系统，开发者可直接获取生产就绪代码。基于 SVG/CSS 等开放标准实现设计与代码无缝衔接，2.0 版本新增 CSS Grid 布局、设计令牌和组件系统，显著提升产研协作效率。支持浏览器访问或自托管，适用于产品设计全流程。
items.e: Penpot is an open-source design collaboration tool enabling designers to create interactive prototypes and design systems while providing developers with production-ready code. Built on open standards like SVG and CSS, it bridges design and development seamlessly. The 2.0 release introduces CSS Grid layout, native design tokens, and a new components system, significantly enhancing cross-functional team collaboration. Available as a web app or self-hosted solution for end-to-end product design workflows.

items.d: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
items.z: 该仓库是一个专为AI编码代理设计的营销技能集合，以Markdown文件形式提供CRO、文案写作、SEO、数据分析和增长工程等专业工作流。基于Agent Skills规范构建，技能相互引用并以product-marketing为基础，提供产品、受众与定位上下文。适用于Claude Code、Cursor等工具，帮助技术营销者和创始人通过AI代理实现营销任务自动化与优化。
items.e: This repository delivers a curated collection of markdown-based skills for AI coding agents, specializing in CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. Built to the Agent Skills spec, skills interconnect with product-marketing as the foundational layer providing product, audience, and positioning context. It empowers technical marketers and founders using Claude Code, Cursor, and similar agents to automate and optimize marketing workflows efficiently.

items.d: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
items.z: CLI-Anything 通过自动化生成命令行接口，让任意软件 instantly 具备 AI 智能体原生调用能力。项目基于 Click 框架解析源码与 GUI，自动生成支持 JSON 结构化输出、撤销/重做和 REPL 的 CLI，无缝集成 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 AI 编程助手，解决了 AI 控制存量软件的最后一公里问题，实现确定性、可组合的智能体工作流。
items.e: CLI-Anything revolutionizes software interaction by auto-generating command-line interfaces that make any application instantly accessible to AI agents. Built on Python's Click framework, it analyzes source code and GUI structures to create composable CLIs with structured JSON output, undo/redo capabilities, and REPL modes. Seamlessly integrating with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding assistants, it bridges the critical gap between AI agents and legacy software, enabling deterministic, reliable agent-native workflows across diverse tools.

items.d: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/.
items.z: DeepTutor 是港大数据科学实验室推出的终身个性化智能辅导系统，基于大语言模型构建，提供 macOS 与 Windows 桌面应用。它支持多语言交互，通过个性化学习路径与持续反馈，帮助学生实现长期知识掌握与能力提升，是 AI 赋能教育领域的开源实践。
items.e: DeepTutor is a lifelong personalized tutoring system developed by HKUDS, powered by large language models. Available as cross-platform desktop apps for macOS and Windows, it supports multilingual interaction and delivers adaptive learning paths with continuous feedback, enabling students to achieve long-term knowledge mastery—an open-source practice in AI-driven education.

items.d: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
items.z: Voicebox 是一款开源本地AI语音工作室，提供语音克隆、多语言TTS和全局听写功能。支持7大引擎、23种语言，零样本克隆声音，具备后处理与表达性控制。完全离线运行保障隐私，集成故事编辑器与AI代理语音交互，是 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow 的开源替代方案。
items.e: Voicebox is an open-source, local-first AI voice studio that enables voice cloning from seconds of audio and speech generation in 23 languages across 7 TTS engines. It provides zero-shot voice cloning, expressive speech with paralinguistic tags, post-processing effects, and unlimited-length content creation. Key features include global dictation hotkeys, multi-track timeline editing for podcasts, and voice-enabled AI agent interaction via local LLM integration. Running entirely offline ensures complete privacy, making it a comprehensive free alternative to ElevenLabs and WisprFlow.

items.d: 《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》系列编程实践教程
items.z: 本教程源自上海交大课程，提供大模型全栈实践指南。涵盖微调部署、提示工程、知识编辑、数学推理、模型水印、越狱攻击等前沿主题。每个章节配套Jupyter Notebook脚本与课件，支持华为昇腾国产化平台。适合高校教学、学术研究与工业实践，助力快速掌握大模型开发与安全攻防技术。
items.e: This hands-on tutorial series, derived from Shanghai Jiao Tong University courses, offers comprehensive LLMs practical guidance. Covering fine-tuning, prompting, knowledge editing, math reasoning, model watermarking, and jailbreak attacks. Each chapter includes Jupyter notebooks and slides, supporting Huawei Ascend platform. Ideal for academic teaching, research, and industrial practice in LLM development and security.

items.d: Skills for Designers and Engineers.
items.z: emilkowalski/skills 仓库为设计工程师与 AI 智能体提供专业技能库，专注用户界面动画与设计决策优化。基于 Vercel 和 Linear 实战经验，技能帮助 AI 避免缓动函数错误、阴影选择不当等常见品味问题，包含 emil-design-eng 核心指导、动画审查、精确动画词汇及 Apple 流畅运动原则等模块。通过 skills.sh CLI 快速安装，为 AI 代理注入专家品味，是生成精美流畅界面的高效快捷方式。
items.e: The emilkowalski/skills repository delivers curated skills for design engineers and AI agents to build superior user interfaces with emphasis on animations and design decisions. Drawing from experience at Vercel and Linear, these skills equip agents with professional taste to avoid pitfalls like incorrect easing or suboptimal visual choices. Modules include emil-design-eng for core guidance, strict animation reviews, precise vocabulary, and Apple-inspired motion principles. Installable via the skills.sh CLI, it offers a shortcut to polished, expert-level UI outputs from AI agents.

items.d: Open-Source Frontier Voice AI
items.z: 微软开源的前沿语音AI框架，提供语音识别与合成两大核心能力。VibeVoice-ASR可单通道处理60分钟长音频，输出带说话人分离和时间戳的结构化转录，支持50+语言与vLLM加速。VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B支持流式文本转语音，具备多语言发音人。已集成Hugging Face Transformers，适用于语音输入法、会议转录等场景。
items.e: Microsoft's open-source frontier voice AI framework delivers two breakthrough models. VibeVoice-ASR handles 60-minute long-form audio in a single pass, generating structured transcriptions with speaker identification, timestamps, and content across 50+ languages, featuring vLLM acceleration and Hugging Face integration. VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B provides streaming text-to-speech with experimental multilingual voices. The framework enables voice-powered input methods, automated transcription, and real-time speech generation applications.

items.d: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers
items.z: 提供每日自动更新的公共 BitTorrent tracker 列表，涵盖 UDP、HTTP、HTTPS、WebSocket、i2p 和 Yggdrasil 等多种协议。包含域名与 IP 两种格式，通过自动化检测去重，优化 P2P 文件共享的连接效率与稳定性，适用于 BT 客户端配置及去中心化网络应用场景。
items.e: Daily automatically updated public BitTorrent tracker lists supporting multiple protocols including UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, i2p and Yggdrasil. Provides both domain and IP address formats, with automated deduplication to optimize P2P file sharing connectivity and stability for BT clients and decentralized network applications.

items.d: Breakthrough Method for Agile Ai Driven Development
items.z: BMad Method是开源AI驱动敏捷开发框架，通过12+专业AI智能体（PM、架构师、开发者、UX等）模拟真实团队协作。采用结构化工作流，基于敏捷实践实现规模自适应，从bug修复到企业系统自动调整规划深度。支持Party Mode多代理讨论、bmad-help智能指导、完整生命周期及Claude Code等AI IDE集成。提供模块扩展、技能架构和V6跨平台优化，强调AI作为专家协作者引导最佳思考，而非自主输出。适用于solo开发者至企业团队，100%免费开源。
items.e: BMad Method is an open-source AI-driven agile development framework featuring 12+ specialized AI agents (PM, Architect, Developer, UX, etc.) that act as expert collaborators in structured workflows. It is scale-adaptive, automatically adjusting planning depth from bug fixes to enterprise systems based on agile best practices. Key highlights include Party Mode for multi-agent collaboration, bmad-help guidance, full lifecycle coverage from ideation to deployment, and seamless integration with AI IDEs like Claude Code and Cursor. With modules for testing and more, plus V6 enhancements in cross-platform teams and skills architecture, it empowers superior results through guided AI partnership. 100% free and open-source.

items.d: Windows inside a Docker container.
items.z: dockur/windows 仓库提供 Docker 镜像，在容器内运行完整 Windows 操作系统。集成 ISO 自动下载、KVM 硬件加速和 Web 远程查看器，支持 Win11/10/服务器等多版本。通过 Docker Compose、CLI 或 Kubernetes 快速部署，适用于开发测试、遗留软件兼容、云原生 Windows 应用托管等场景。亮点包括全自动安装流程、硬件加速及多平台集成，极大简化 Windows 虚拟化部署。
items.e: The dockur/windows repository delivers a Docker image for running full Windows operating systems inside containers. It features automatic ISO downloading, KVM hardware acceleration, and a web-based viewer. Supporting Windows 11, 10, servers, and older versions, it enables quick deployment via Docker Compose, CLI, or Kubernetes. Ideal for development/testing, legacy software support, and containerized Windows apps in cloud or Linux environments. Highlights include fully automated setup, performance acceleration, and broad DevOps integration.

items.d: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.
items.z: Cherry Studio 是一款 AI 生产力桌面应用，集成智能聊天与自主代理能力，内置 300+ 专业助手。通过统一接口无缝接入 GPT-4、Claude 等前沿大模型，支持多语言交互与上下文感知，覆盖文档处理、代码生成、研究分析等场景，实现智能化升级并显著提升工作效率。
items.e: Cherry Studio is a comprehensive AI productivity desktop application that seamlessly integrates intelligent chat interfaces with autonomous agent capabilities, featuring over 300 specialized assistants for various domains. The platform provides unified access to leading large language models including GPT-4 and Claude, supports multilingual interactions with advanced context awareness, enables intelligent automation across document processing, code generation, and research analysis scenarios, and offers a user-friendly interface for both technical and non-technical users, significantly enhancing workplace productivity and operational efficiency through streamlined workflows.

items.d: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
items.z: Vercel Labs推出的AI代理浏览器自动化CLI工具，基于Rust构建提供毫秒级响应。核心亮点是通过无障碍树引用(@e1)实现AI友好的元素定位，支持点击、填充、截图等操作，为AI代理提供高效网页交互能力。
items.e: Rust CLI for AI browser automation with sub-millisecond speed. Features accessibility tree references (@e1) for AI-friendly element interaction, including clicks, form fills, and screenshots.

items.d: Run macOS VM in a Docker! Run near native OSX-KVM in Docker! X11 Forwarding! CI/CD for OS X Security Research! Docker mac Containers.
items.z: Docker-OSX通过KVM和OpenCore技术实现在Docker容器中运行接近原生性能的macOS虚拟机。支持X11图形转发和iPhone USB设备穿透，专为macOS安全研究（如iMessage漏洞分析）和自动化CI/CD流程设计，提供便携且隔离的测试环境，显著提升安全研究员的工作效率。
items.e: Docker-OSX leverages KVM and OpenCore to run near-native macOS virtual machines inside Docker containers. It features X11 GUI forwarding and iPhone USB passthrough, specifically designed for macOS security research (including iMessage analysis) and CI/CD automation. This solution provides security researchers with a portable, isolated, and reproducible testing environment for efficient vulnerability discovery.

items.d: Open-source AI gateway. Self-hosted LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible APIs, model routing, access control, usage tracking and cost accounting.
items.z: New API 是一款下一代 LLM 网关与 AI 资产管理系统，通过协议转换层将各类大模型统一为 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 兼容接口。提供集中式模型路由、分发与管理能力，支持个人与企业级部署，构建跨模型生态的标准化接入平面。
items.e: New API is a next-generation LLM gateway and AI asset management system that unifies diverse large language models through protocol conversion layers into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini-compatible interfaces. It provides centralized model routing, load balancing, and distribution management for both personal and enterprise deployments. Built with Go for high performance, the system acts as a standardized access plane for cross-model ecosystems, enabling seamless integration, governance, and observability of heterogeneous AI assets while maintaining strict API compatibility and enterprise-grade security.

items.d: We write your reusable computer vision tools. 💜
items.z: Supervision 是 Roboflow 的开源 Python 计算机视觉库，专注提供可复用 CV 工具。它通过 Detections 对象实现多模型输出统一处理，支持标注可视化、跟踪计数、数据集管理和基准测试。模型无关设计集成主流框架，亮点在于高度可定制工具与高效数据流程，适用于实时视频分析与应用开发场景。
items.e: Supervision is Roboflow's open-source Python library for computer vision, providing reusable tools for building CV applications. It features a unified Detections object for integrating outputs from models like Ultralytics and Transformers, along with customizable annotators, object tracking, zone counting, dataset conversion between YOLO/COCO/Pascal VOC, and performance benchmarking. Model-agnostic by design, it emphasizes efficient post-processing and cross-framework compatibility, enabling developers to focus on real-time video analysis and application development.

items.d: Fast, accurate & comprehensive text measurement & layout
items.z: Pretext 是一个纯 TypeScript 文本测量与布局引擎，通过绕过 DOM 测量彻底避免浏览器重排。它预计算文本分段和宽度，后续布局纯算术运算，支持多语言、RTL 和 emoji。适用于虚拟化列表、自定义布局、防止布局偏移及 AI 开发时的文本溢出验证，可渲染至 DOM/Canvas/SVG/SSR 多种环境。
items.e: Pretext is a pure TypeScript text measurement and layout engine that eliminates expensive browser reflow by bypassing DOM measurements entirely. It precomputes text segmentation and character widths, then performs subsequent layout through pure arithmetic operations, supporting multilingual text, RTL languages, and emojis. Perfect for virtualization, custom masonry layouts, preventing layout shift, and AI-assisted development text overflow checks. Renders seamlessly to DOM, Canvas, SVG, and server-side environments.

items.d: Qlib is an AI-oriented Quant investment platform that aims to use AI tech to empower Quant Research, from exploring ideas to implementing productions. Qlib supports diverse ML modeling paradigms, including supervised learning, market dynamics modeling, and RL, and is now equipped with https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent to automate R&D process.
items.z: Qlib是微软开源的AI驱动量化投资平台，旨在用AI技术赋能量化研究全流程。平台支持监督学习、强化学习等多种机器学习范式，并集成RD-Agent实现因子挖掘与模型优化的自动化研发。适用于从策略构思到生产部署的全场景，提供跨平台支持，助力量化投资智能化升级。
items.e: Qlib is Microsoft's open-source AI-powered quantitative investment platform designed to empower the entire quant research workflow with AI technology. The platform supports diverse ML paradigms including supervised learning, market dynamics modeling, and reinforcement learning. It integrates RD-Agent, an LLM-based autonomous framework that automates factor mining and model optimization. Suitable for scenarios ranging from strategy ideation to production deployment, Qlib offers cross-platform support and accelerates intelligent transformation in quantitative investing.

items.d: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
items.z: nanobot 是 HKUDS 开发的开源超轻量级 AI 智能体，核心设计精简且可读。它支持聊天通道、记忆管理和 MCP 协议，可无缝集成工具与工作流。内置 WebUI，提供跨轮次目标追踪和图像生成能力，支持多模型 fallback。从本地快速部署到长期运行的个性化智能体，适用于自动化任务和智能助手场景。
items.e: nanobot is an open-source, ultra-lightweight AI agent developed by HKUDS, featuring a minimalist and readable core design. It supports chat channels, memory management, and the MCP protocol for seamless tool and workflow integration. With a built-in WebUI, it offers cross-turn goal tracking and end-to-end image generation, along with multi-model fallback support. Designed for easy deployment from local setups to long-running personal agents, it is ideal for automation tasks and intelligent assistant applications.

items.d: 3,000+ reusable AI agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. AAS Core adds local catalog discovery, agent-owned selection and plan preview. CLI, MCP and plugins.
items.z: Agentic Awesome Skills 是一个可安装的 GitHub 库，汇集 1936+ 个 agentic skills，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手设计。提供 SKILL.md 结构化剧本、插件、捆绑包和工作流，支持编码、调试、测试、安全审查等任务。通过 npm 安装器实现多工具兼容，强化提示工程应用，提升 AI 代理上下文与输出质量，是社区驱动的 AI 开发自动化核心资源。
items.e: Agentic Awesome Skills is an installable GitHub library with 1,936+ reusable agentic skills for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It delivers structured SKILL.md playbooks, plugins, bundles, and workflows for coding, debugging, testing, and security tasks. Featuring an npm installer and multi-tool compatibility, it strengthens prompt engineering to improve AI agent context and outputs, serving as a community hub for AI-assisted development automation.

items.d: edgetunnel2 VLESS/Trojan/SS 多功能面板
items.z: edgetunnel 2.0 是基于 Cloudflare Workers/Pages 的边缘计算隧道管理方案，深度集成 VLESS 与 Trojan 协议。提供可视化后台面板，支持实时配置、日志监控与流量统计。内置自动订阅系统，兼容 Clash、Sing-box、Surge 等主流客户端。支持自定义 ProxyIP、链式代理及优选 API 加速，适配 Windows、Android、iOS、MacOS 及软路由固件，部署方式灵活高效。
items.e: edgetunnel 2.0 is a Cloudflare Workers/Pages-based edge computing tunnel solution with deep VLESS and Trojan protocol integration. It features a visual management panel for real-time configuration, log monitoring, and traffic statistics. The built-in subscription system auto-generates configurations compatible with Clash, Sing-box, Surge and other clients. Supporting custom ProxyIP, chain proxies, and optimized APIs, it accelerates performance across Windows, Android, iOS, macOS and router firmware with flexible deployment options.

items.d: An ultra-simplified explanation to design patterns
items.z: 本项目以极简方式解释软件设计模式，涵盖创建型、结构型、行为型三大类23种模式。通过生活化类比和PHP代码示例，将抽象概念具象化，帮助开发者快速理解并应用。核心价值在于降低学习门槛，提供实用指南而非理论堆砌，适合编程初学者和需要复习的开发者。
items.e: This project delivers ultra-simplified explanations of software design patterns, encompassing 23 fundamental patterns across creational, structural, and behavioral categories. Through intuitive real-world analogies and practical PHP code samples, it demystifies abstract concepts and makes them stick. The repository serves as an accessible learning resource that emphasizes practical application over theoretical complexity. Designed for programming beginners and experienced developers seeking quick reference, it provides clear guidelines for tackling recurring software design problems effectively.

items.d: OCR software, free and offline. 开源、免费的离线OCR软件。支持截屏/批量导入图片，PDF文档识别，排除水印/页眉页脚，扫描/生成二维码。内置多国语言库。
items.z: Umi-OCR 是一款开源、免费的离线 OCR 软件，支持 Windows 和 Linux 系统。核心功能包括截屏识别、批量图片/PDF 文档处理、二维码识别与生成，以及公式识别。其技术亮点在于内置高效离线引擎（支持 Rapid-OCR 和 PaddleOCR），提供排版解析和文本后处理（如排除水印/页眉页脚），并支持命令行与 HTTP 接口调用，满足高效、隐私安全的本地化文字识别需求。
items.e: Umi-OCR is a free, open-source offline OCR software for Windows and Linux. It offers screenshot OCR, batch image/PDF processing, QR code recognition/generation, and formula recognition. Key technical features include a built-in high-efficiency offline engine (supporting Rapid-OCR and PaddleOCR), layout analysis and text post-processing (e.g., excluding watermarks/headers/footers), and support for CLI and HTTP API integration, meeting the needs for efficient, privacy-preserving local text recognition.

items.d: GitNexus: The Zero-Server Code Intelligence Engine
items.z: GitNexus 是一个零服务器、纯客户端的代码智能引擎，可在浏览器中构建代码知识图谱。它通过分析代码库中的依赖关系、调用链和执行流，为 AI 代理提供深度架构视图，解决代码遗漏和依赖断裂问题。支持 CLI+MCP 模式连接 Cursor、Claude Code 等编辑器，也提供 Web UI 进行可视化探索。采用 KuzuDB 和 Tree-sitter 技术，内置 Graph RAG 智能体，让中小型模型也能获得大模型的架构理解能力，适用于代码审查、架构分析和 AI 辅助开发场景。
items.e: GitNexus is a zero-server, client-side code intelligence engine that builds knowledge graphs directly in the browser. It analyzes dependencies, call chains, and execution flows to provide AI agents with deep architectural visibility, preventing missed code and broken dependencies. The CLI+MCP mode integrates with editors like Cursor and Claude Code for daily development, while the Web UI enables visual exploration. Built on KuzuDB and Tree-sitter, it features a Graph RAG Agent that gives smaller models architectural clarity comparable to large models, ideal for code review and AI-assisted development.

items.d: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.
items.z: GitHubDaily 是一个运营近十年的开源项目策展平台，累计分享超10000个高质量开源项目。通过GitHub仓库、公众号、微博等多渠道，系统化推荐技术教程、开发者工具与行业资讯，核心价值在于从海量项目中筛选高价值内容，并按AI工具、开发工具等维度结构化整理，助力开发者拓展技术视野与提升编程能力。
items.e: GitHubDaily is a decade-old open source curation platform that has shared over 10,000 high-quality projects. Through multiple channels including GitHub, WeChat, and Twitter, it systematically recommends technical tutorials, developer tools, and industry insights. Its core value lies in filtering high-value content from massive repositories and organizing it into structured categories like AI tools and development utilities, helping developers expand technical horizons and enhance programming skills.

items.d: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base  Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
items.z: reverse-skill 是一个面向 AI 编码客户端的逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究技能路由包。它通过 AI 驱动的路由矩阵与 RULES.md，自动将 APK、二进制、JS 加密、CTF、固件等任务导向正确方法论和工具链。核心亮点包括按需自举工具链、自进化知识库，以及与 IDA Pro、Ghidra、Frida 等集成，避免盲目猜命令，实现经验复用。支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等客户端，多平台部署，显著提升安全研究效率。
items.e: reverse-skill is an AI-powered skill router pack for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research, designed for AI coding clients like Claude Code and Cursor. It automatically routes tasks involving APKs, binaries, JS encryption, CTF, and firmware to the correct methodologies and tools via a routing matrix and RULES.md. Highlights include on-demand toolchain bootstrapping, a self-evolving knowledge base, and integration with IDA Pro, Ghidra, and Frida. It prevents blind command guessing, enables experience reuse, and supports cross-platform deployments for efficient security workflows.

items.d: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
items.z: VoxCPM2是开源的Tokenizer-Free文本转语音系统，基于2B参数Diffusion自回归架构，训练于200万小时多语言数据。支持30种语言合成、自然语言驱动的声音创意设计、48kHz高保真声音克隆及实时流式生成。其端到端设计绕过离散标记化，实现更自然、更具表现力的语音合成，适用于多语言内容创作、个性化语音助手等场景。
items.e: VoxCPM2 is an open-source tokenizer-free Text-to-Speech system built on a 2B-parameter diffusion autoregressive architecture trained on over 2 million hours of multilingual speech data. It enables 30-language synthesis, natural language-based voice design, controllable voice cloning, and ultimate cloning with 48kHz studio-quality output. The end-to-end model bypasses discrete tokenization for highly natural and expressive speech generation, supporting real-time streaming with RTF as low as 0.13 via vLLM acceleration, ideal for creative content production and personalized voice applications.

items.d: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
items.z: OpenViking是专为AI Agent设计的开源上下文数据库，创新性地采用文件系统范式统一管理记忆、资源与技能，解决碎片化问题。核心亮点包括：L0/L1/L2分层加载大幅降低token成本；目录递归检索结合语义搜索提升精度；检索轨迹可视化打破RAG黑盒；自动会话管理实现上下文自演进。
items.e: OpenViking is an open-source context database designed for AI Agents. It unifies memory, resources, and skills via a filesystem paradigm. Key features include tiered loading (L0/L1/L2) to reduce token consumption, directory-recursive retrieval for improved precision, visualized retrieval trajectories for full observability, and automatic session management enabling self-evolving, adaptive context.

items.d: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs
items.z: 微软官方1-bit大模型推理框架，专为1.58-bit三元模型优化。基于llama.cpp构建，提供CPU/GPU无损快速推理，性能提升最高6.17倍，能耗降低82%。支持单CPU运行100B参数模型，速度达5-7 token/秒。采用查找表与并行内核技术，实现边缘设备高效部署，推动大模型本地化应用。
items.e: Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, optimized for 1.58-bit ternary models. Built on llama.cpp, it delivers lossless fast inference on CPU/GPU with up to 6.17x speedup and 82% energy reduction. Enables running 100B-parameter models on a single CPU at human reading speed (5-7 tokens/sec). Features optimized kernels using lookup table methodologies and parallel implementations with configurable tiling and embedding quantization. Empowers efficient edge deployment of large models, advancing local AI applications.

items.d: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
items.z: Lightpanda 是为 AI 和自动化设计的开源无头浏览器，内存占用仅为 Chrome 的 1/9，执行速度快 11 倍。支持 JavaScript 和主流自动化框架，适用于网页爬虫、AI 代理和测试场景。
items.e: Lightpanda is an open-source headless browser designed specifically for AI and automation tasks. It dramatically reduces memory usage by 9x compared to Chrome while delivering 11x faster execution speeds. The browser supports JavaScript execution and Web APIs, and maintains compatibility with popular automation frameworks like Playwright, Puppeteer, and chromedp through the Chrome DevTools Protocol, making it ideal for web scraping, AI agent training, and automated testing.

items.d: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
items.z: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提示词工程优化的 AI 应用工具，支持多模型集成与 MCP 协议。通过智能优化、对比测试和高级调试模式，显著提升 LLM 输出质量与稳定性。提供 Web、桌面、Chrome 插件及 Docker 多端部署，采用纯前端架构确保数据安全，适用于角色扮演、知识提取等场景。
items.e: Prompt Optimizer is a powerful AI application tool dedicated to prompt engineering optimization, supporting multi-model integration and MCP protocol compatibility. It significantly improves LLM output quality and stability through intelligent prompt refinement, real-time A/B testing, and advanced debugging features including context variables and function calling. The tool offers versatile deployment options—Web, desktop, Chrome extension, and Docker—with a pure frontend architecture that ensures data security by processing everything client-side. Perfect for scenarios like roleplay simulation, knowledge graph extraction, and creative writing collaboration.

items.d: An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.
items.z: Codewhale 是一款开源终端 AI 编程智能体，基于 Rust 构建，支持任意大模型（云端或本地）。它能自主读取项目、编辑文件、执行命令并自我校验，提供交互式 TUI、无头模式及 PR 审查等多种运行方式，适用于自动化代码修复与开发者效率提升。
items.e: Codewhale is an open-source terminal-based AI coding agent built in Rust, supporting any LLM provider (hosted or local). It autonomously reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and self-verifies results. Offers interactive TUI, headless CI mode, and PR review for developer productivity.

items.d: [EMNLP2025] LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.z: LightRAG是香港科技大学开源的检索增强生成框架，主打简洁与高效。该框架通过创新架构简化RAG实现复杂度，同时显著提升检索与生成速度。近期版本集成RAGAS评估体系和Langfuse追踪能力，支持大规模数据集高效处理，并增强知识图谱提取功能。适用于需要快速构建高质量RAG系统的AI应用场景。
items.e: LightRAG is a retrieval-augmented generation framework from HKUST, emphasizing simplicity and speed. It simplifies RAG implementation while significantly improving retrieval and generation performance through innovative architecture. Recent updates integrate RAGAS for evaluation and Langfuse for tracing, support efficient large-scale dataset processing, and enhance knowledge graph extraction capabilities. Designed for AI applications requiring rapid deployment of high-quality RAG systems with production-ready observability and scalability.

items.d: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
items.z: LinkSwift是一款基于JavaScript的网盘直链下载助手，支持百度、阿里、移动、天翼、迅雷、夸克、UC、123云盘等八大主流网盘。通过注入脚本解析页面请求，绕过客户端限制，直接获取文件下载地址，提升下载效率。适用于批量下载或高速下载，亮点为多网盘适配、持续更新、开源免费。
items.e: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based cloud drive direct link downloader supporting eight major cloud drives including Baidu, Aliyun, China Mobile, Tianyi, Xunlei, Quark, UC, and 123pan. By injecting scripts to parse page requests, it bypasses client restrictions and directly obtains file download URLs, improving download efficiency. Suitable for batch or high-speed downloads, featuring multi-drive compatibility, continuous updates, and open-source free.

items.d: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
items.z: PageIndex 是一个创新的向量无关、基于推理的 RAG 系统，专为专业长文档设计。它摒弃传统向量数据库和分块策略，通过构建层次化树形索引并模拟人类专家推理过程，实现上下文感知的智能检索。核心优势在于将相似度搜索升级为相关性推理，支持视觉基础 OCR 自由的工作流，并提供 MCP 集成，显著提升复杂文档的检索准确性与深度理解能力。
items.e: PageIndex is a vectorless, reasoning-based RAG framework designed for professional long documents. It replaces traditional vector databases and chunking with a hierarchical tree index, enabling LLMs to perform agentic, human-like retrieval through tree search reasoning. By prioritizing relevance over similarity, it supports OCR-free vision-based workflows and MCP integration, delivering superior accuracy for domain-intensive document analysis.

items.d: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 75 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
items.z: 该项目将Claude Code转变为完整的游戏开发工作室，包含48个专业化AI智能体、37个工作流程和8个自动化钩子。通过模拟真实游戏公司的三层管理架构（总监-部门主管-专员），为独立开发者提供结构化的团队协作体验。核心价值在于建立质量关卡、设计评审和标准化流程，确保从创意到发布的全程规范性，同时保持人类决策权。
items.e: This project transforms Claude Code into a complete game development studio with 48 specialized AI agents, 37 workflow commands, and 8 automation hooks. It mirrors real studio hierarchy across three tiers (Directors, Department Leads, Specialists) using Anthropic's Opus/Sonnet/Haiku models. The system provides structured team collaboration for solo developers, featuring quality gates, design reviews, and enforced coding standards. It maintains human decision-making while adding automated validation, sprint planning, and documentation generation throughout the development lifecycle from brainstorming to launch.

items.d: The open agent skills tool - npx skills
items.z: Vercel开源的AI智能体技能管理工具，支持54+主流编码助手。通过CLI一键安装GitHub/GitLab/本地技能包，支持项目级与全局部署，可精准指定目标智能体与技能，提供交互式与CI/CD友好模式。
items.e: Vercel's CLI for AI agent skills. Installs prompts across 54+ coding assistants from GitHub/GitLab/local. Supports project/global scope & CI/CD.

items.d: Playwright MCP server
items.z: Playwright MCP是微软推出的Model Context Protocol服务器，通过Playwright可访问性树为LLM提供浏览器自动化能力。它摒弃截图方案，采用结构化快照实现确定性操作，适用于探索性测试、自愈脚本和长周期自治工作流。相比CLI工具，MCP模式更适合需要持久状态和深度页面推理的智能体场景。
items.e: Playwright MCP is a Microsoft Model Context Protocol server that enables LLMs to automate browsers through Playwright's accessibility tree. It replaces screenshot-based approaches with structured snapshots for deterministic, vision-free interactions. Designed for exploratory automation, self-healing tests, and persistent autonomous workflows, it maintains continuous browser context at the cost of higher token usage. The server integrates seamlessly with MCP-compatible clients including VS Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Windsurf, providing a lightweight yet powerful bridge between language models and web automation with rich introspection capabilities.

items.d: The Open-Source Multimodal AI Agent Stack: Connecting Cutting-Edge AI Models and Agent Infra
items.z: UI-TARS-desktop是字节跳动开源的多模态AI智能体桌面应用，基于UI-TARS视觉模型实现GUI自动化操作。支持本地与远程计算机及浏览器控制，无缝集成MCP工具链，通过自然语言指令完成跨应用任务。提供CLI与Web UI双模式，具备流式响应、运行时调试和沙箱隔离等企业级特性，为生产力自动化提供端到端解决方案。
items.e: UI-TARS-desktop is ByteDance's open-source multimodal AI agent desktop application powered by the UI-TARS vision model for GUI automation. It enables local and remote control of computers and browsers through natural language commands, seamlessly integrating with MCP tools for human-like task completion. Offering both CLI and Web UI interfaces, it features streaming responses, runtime performance statistics, Event Stream Viewer for debugging, and AIO Sandbox isolation. This enterprise-ready stack delivers a complete end-to-end solution for automating productivity workflows across desktop and web environments.

items.d: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
items.z: Magpie 是跨平台本地网关，统一管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码智能体的模型配置。支持多供应商切换与配额耗尽自动故障转移，提供菜单栏、TUI、Web UI 及 CLI 界面，实现任意智能体与任意模型的灵活组合。
items.e: Magpie is a cross-platform local gateway that centralizes model configuration for multiple AI coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It supports multi-provider switching, automatic failover when quotas are exhausted, and provides menu bar, TUI, Web UI, and CLI interfaces. Developers can flexibly pair any agent with any model across macOS, Windows, Linux, Docker, and Termux environments. One unified app manages all agent configs, provider keys, and routing rules, ensuring seamless model switching without manual intervention or downtime.

items.d: A Python library for extracting structured information from unstructured text using LLMs with precise source grounding and interactive visualization.
items.z: LangExtract是Google开源的Python库，基于LLM实现非结构化文本的结构化信息抽取。核心亮点：精确溯源定位、支持长文档并行处理、交互式HTML可视化、兼容云/本地模型，通过few-shot示例定义领域任务，无需微调即可适配临床笔记、报告等多场景。
items.e: LangExtract is Google's open-source Python library for structured information extraction from unstructured text using LLMs. Key features: precise source grounding, long document optimization via parallel processing, interactive HTML visualization, flexible cloud/local model support, and domain adaptation through few-shot examples without fine-tuning.

items.d: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
items.z: Craft Anything 是一款纯 Rust 编写的开源逆向工程与 AI 克隆引擎。它能深入分析任意网站、应用或游戏的运行机制，借助真实检查工具研究原始实现，再让 AI 编码代理生成新项目，并自动比对结果、迭代优化，最终产出功能一致的替代版本。跨平台支持桌面与 Web。
items.e: Craft Anything is an open-source, clean-room engine written in pure Rust that reverse-engineers any website, app, or game. It studies the original with real inspection tools, has an AI coding agent build a new project, then checks the result against the original and iteratively refines it to produce a functionally equivalent clone. Cross-platform for desktop and web.

items.d: "Vibe-Trading: Your Personal Trading Agent"
items.z: Vibe-Trading 是港大开源的个人AI交易代理系统，通过单一命令赋予智能体完整交易能力。采用Python 3.11+与FastAPI后端、React 19前端，支持MCP协议实现模型交互。核心亮点包括Swarm集群容错恢复、影子账户模拟交易、Rich交互式CLI。提供API与MCP服务，支持实时任务协调与状态管理，为量化交易提供开箱即用的AI解决方案。
items.e: Vibe-Trading is HKU's open-source personal AI trading agent system that empowers agents with comprehensive trading capabilities through a single command. Built with Python 3.11+ and FastAPI backend, React 19 frontend, it supports MCP for model context interaction. Key features include Swarm cluster fault tolerance recovery, shadow account simulation, Rich interactive CLI, and automated operations. It provides API and MCP services, enabling real-time task coordination and state management for quantitative trading with out-of-the-box AI solutions.

items.d: [EMNLP 2025 Demo] PDF scientific paper translation with preserved formats - 基于 AI 完整保留排版的 PDF 文档全文双语翻译，支持 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等服务，提供 CLI/GUI/MCP/Docker/Zotero
items.z: PDFMathTranslate 是一款专注于科技文献的PDF翻译工具，核心优势在于完整保留原始排版。支持公式、图表、目录、注释等复杂元素的精准定位与翻译。集成Google、DeepL、Ollama、OpenAI等多引擎，提供CLI、GUI、Docker及Zotero插件等多种使用方式。适用于学术研究、论文阅读等场景，支持多语言互译，确保学术文档的专业性与可读性。
items.e: PDFMathTranslate is a specialized PDF translation tool for scientific documents that preserves original layouts with high fidelity. It accurately handles complex elements including formulas, charts, tables of contents, and annotations. The tool integrates multiple translation backends such as Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI, offering flexible deployment via CLI, GUI, Docker, and Zotero plugins. Designed for academic research and paper reading, it supports multilingual translation while maintaining the professional quality and readability of scholarly documents.

items.d: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
items.z: 该工具将技术书籍PDF等文档转化为Claude Code技能。通过生成SKILL.md、章节文件、术语表、模式和速查表，实现无幻觉的精准引用与学习。按需加载章节优化资源。应用场景包括技术学习、工作参考和知识管理。技术亮点是多格式支持和结构化知识集成到AI工作流。
items.e: book-to-skill transforms technical books and documents such as PDFs and EPUBs into structured Claude Code skills. It creates a SKILL.md with core mental models and chapter index, plus on-demand chapter files, glossary, patterns, and cheatsheet. This setup allows accurate, hallucination-free referencing and studying directly in Claude workflows. Ideal for technical professionals who want to retain and apply book knowledge on the job without searching PDFs or relying on potentially inaccurate AI responses. Key advantages include support for various formats, efficient token management via lazy loading, and seamless integration as a custom skill.

items.d: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
items.z: QwenPaw是自主可控的个人AI助手，支持本地或云端部署确保数据隐私。提供日程管理、PDF/Office文档处理、新闻摘要等内置技能，支持自定义扩展。具备多智能体协作能力，可创建独立代理处理不同任务。跨平台连接多种聊天应用，技能决定功能边界，无供应商锁定风险。
items.e: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant under your control, deployable locally or in the cloud to ensure data privacy. It features built-in skills including scheduling, PDF/Office document processing, and news digests, with support for custom extensions. Enables multi-agent collaboration by creating independent agents for different tasks. Connects across multiple chat platforms with extensible capabilities and no vendor lock-in.

items.d: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
items.z: 腾讯开源的WeKnora是LLM驱动的文档智能框架，基于RAG范式实现深度文档理解与语义检索。采用模块化架构，支持多模态预处理、父-子分块、智能检索与重排序，可处理复杂异构文档。集成Milvus向量数据库，提供上下文感知的高质量问答，适用于企业知识库、智能客服等场景。
items.e: WeKnora, Tencent's open-source LLM-powered framework, enables deep document understanding and semantic retrieval via RAG paradigm. Its modular architecture supports multimodal preprocessing, hierarchical parent-child chunking, intelligent retrieval, and reranking for complex heterogeneous documents. Integrated with Milvus vector database, it delivers context-aware answers for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent customer service.

items.d: 100+ open-source clones of popular sites like Airbnb, Amazon, Instagram, Netflix, Tiktok, Spotify, Whatsapp, Youtube etc. See source code, demo links, tech stack, github stars.
items.z: Clone Wars是一个GitHub开源仓库，收录100多个流行网站和应用的开源克隆与替代项目，包括Airbnb、Instagram、Netflix、Spotify等。提供源码、演示链接、技术栈及星标数据，专为学习设计。分带教程的克隆表和普通克隆/替代表，展示React、Next.js、Firebase、Django等多种技术栈。核心价值是curated学习资源，帮助开发者通过实际项目掌握全栈开发、构建作品集并探索开源替代方案。
items.e: Clone Wars is a curated GitHub repository featuring 100+ open-source clones and alternatives to popular sites like Airbnb, Instagram, Netflix, and Spotify. It includes source code links, demos, tech stacks, and star counts for learning web development. Divided into a tutorials table for guided full-stack projects and a clones/alternatives table distinguishing UI clones from functional alternatives. Showcasing technologies such as React, Next.js, Firebase, and more, it enables developers to explore implementations of popular features, enhance skills through practical examples, and find open-source substitutes. Perfect for self-learners and portfolio building.

items.d: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
items.z: Recordly 是一款开源跨平台的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为产品演示、教程视频等场景设计。其核心亮点在于自动化后期处理：智能缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头叠加和样式化边框，无需专业剪辑即可生成 polished 视频。采用原生捕获技术（ScreenCaptureKit/WGC）保证性能，支持扩展插件，实现录制到编辑的一体化工作流。
items.e: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor designed for product demos, tutorials, and walkthroughs. It automates post-production with AI-powered zoom suggestions, cursor polish, dynamic webcam overlays, and styled frames—eliminating manual editing. Built on native capture backends (ScreenCaptureKit/WGC) for performance, it features an extensible plugin system and seamless record-to-edit workflow.

items.d: Virtual machines for iOS and macOS
items.z: UTM 是一款基于 QEMU 的 iOS 和 macOS 全系统虚拟化工具，支持 x86_64、ARM64、RISC-V 等 30 多种处理器架构。它提供 JIT 加速版本和无需越狱的 SE 解释器版本，可在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上运行 Windows、Linux 等操作系统。利用 Hypervisor 和 Virtualization 框架实现硬件加速，是移动设备和桌面端的强大虚拟化解决方案。
items.e: UTM is a full-featured system emulator and virtual machine host for iOS and macOS, built on QEMU. It supports 30+ processor architectures including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V, enabling users to run Windows, Linux, and other operating systems on iPhones, iPads, and Macs. The platform offers JIT-based acceleration for optimal performance and a special SE (Slow Edition) using threaded interpretation that requires no jailbreak. With native frontends leveraging latest Apple APIs and hardware acceleration via Hypervisor.framework and Virtualization.framework, UTM delivers a powerful cross-platform virtualization solution for both mobile and desktop environments.

items.d: The headless browser for AI agents and web scraping
items.z: Obscura是用Rust编写的轻量级无头浏览器，专为AI智能体和网页爬虫设计。它内置V8引擎执行真实JavaScript，支持Chrome DevTools Protocol，完全兼容Puppeteer/Playwright API。相比Chrome，内存占用仅30MB（降低85%），启动瞬时，内置反检测功能，是自动化任务的理想选择。
