items.e: Obscura is a lightweight headless browser engine written in Rust, purpose-built for AI agents and large-scale web scraping applications. It executes real JavaScript through the V8 engine, fully supports Chrome DevTools Protocol, and serves as a drop-in replacement for both Puppeteer and Playwright. Compared to traditional headless Chrome, Obscura reduces memory usage by 85% to just 30MB, achieves instant startup, and features built-in anti-detection mechanisms. This combination of performance, compatibility, and stealth makes it ideal for scalable browser automation tasks.

items.d: A Programmer’s Guide to Longevity | Helping everyone live a longer, healthier, happier life. Available in 8 languages.
items.z: 本指南专为程序员设计，基于全因死亡率（ACM）学术证据，提供量化延寿策略。核心通过优化饮食（如蔬果、坚果摄入降低27% ACM）、运动（挥拍运动降47% ACM）及生活习惯（7小时睡眠），目标降低66.67% ACM并增加20年预期寿命。亮点在于结构化输入-输出框架及争议数据处理，直击久坐职业健康痛点。
items.e: Tailored for programmers, this guide leverages all-cause mortality (ACM) research to deliver quantified longevity strategies. Key actions include dietary optimization (e.g., fruits/nuts reducing ACM by 27%), racket sports (47% ACM reduction), and sleep management (7-hour optimum), targeting 66.67% ACM decrease and ~20-year lifespan gain. Unique for its input-output framework and evidence-based controversy analysis, addressing sedentary occupational health risks.

items.d: Prompt as Code | GPT Image 2 / 2.5 提示词与案例库，530+ 个案例、20+ 套工业级模板与可复用 Skills，新增 2.5 同提示词对比专区，附完整提示词与生成记录，持续更新。
items.z: 该仓库是GPT-Image2的Prompt as Code工业级提示词引擎与模板库，逆向工程506+案例，涵盖UI、Poster、产品等13类场景，提炼20+工业模板与Agent Skills。配套网站支持提示浏览、复制、筛选与测试生成，助力专业AI图像生成与自动化工作流，持续更新。
items.e: The awesome-gpt-image-2 repository provides an industrial-grade Prompt as Code engine and template library for GPT-Image2. It features over 506 reverse-engineered cases across 13 categories including UI, posters, products, and photography, plus 20+ industrial templates and Agent Skills. A companion website enables browsing, copying prompts, filtering by style or scene, and testing generations. Designed for professional AI image generation, automation workflows, and agent integration with ongoing updates.

items.d: Uncensored Open-source alternative to AI video platforms — Free AI image & video generation studio with 800+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.
items.z: 开源AI媒体生成工作室，集成200+先进模型（Flux、Sora、Kling等），提供无过滤的图像视频创作环境。支持自托管与跨平台桌面应用，通过AI编码代理实现提示→生成→编辑→合成的全流程自动化，是商业AI平台的开源替代方案。
items.e: Open-source AI media generation studio integrating 200+ state-of-the-art models (Flux, Sora, Kling) for unfiltered image/video creation. Features self-hosting, cross-platform desktop apps, and AI agent automation for end-to-end media pipeline orchestration. MIT-licensed alternative to commercial platforms.

items.d: 📚 从零开始构建大模型
items.z: Datawhale推出的Happy-LLM是系统性大语言模型学习教程，从NLP基础到Transformer架构层层深入，手把手教你实现LLaMA2模型并完成预训练、微调全流程。项目结合理论与实践，覆盖RAG、Agent等前沿应用，为零基础学习者提供从原理理解到动手实战的完整路径，真正掌握大模型开发核心技能。
items.e: Happy-LLM by Datawhale is a comprehensive tutorial that demystifies large language models from the ground up. Starting with NLP fundamentals and Transformer architecture, it provides hands-on guidance to implement LLaMA2 and execute the complete training workflow—from pre-training to fine-tuning with LoRA/QLoRA. The project bridges theory and practice, covering cutting-edge applications including RAG and Agent development, equipping learners with essential skills to build and deploy LLMs independently.

items.d: Free, local plugin that keeps tool output out of your coding agent's context window. Sandbox and SQLite FTS5 search, 99% fewer bytes in context. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OMP, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and 4 more agents. Zero telemetry.
items.z: Context Mode 是面向 AI 编码代理的上下文优化工具。作为 MCP 服务器，它通过沙箱工具输出实现 98% 上下文减少，支持 15 个平台集成。利用 SQLite 追踪会话并以 FTS5/BM25 检索关键信息，倡导代码执行范式处理数据。集成 Claude、Cursor 等 IDE，已获微软、谷歌团队采用。
items.e: Context Mode optimizes context windows for AI coding agents as an MCP server. It sandboxes tool outputs for 98% reduction, e.g., 315KB to 5.4KB. SQLite with FTS5 and BM25 ensures session continuity by indexing and retrieving relevant events on compaction. 'Think in code' via ctx_* tools lets agents script data processing instead of loading raw data. Supports 15 platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot via plugins and hooks. Adopted by Microsoft, Google, Meta teams.

items.d: Nuclei is a fast, customizable vulnerability scanner powered by the global security community and built on a simple YAML-based DSL, enabling collaboration to tackle trending vulnerabilities on the internet. It helps you find vulnerabilities in your applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations.
items.z: Nuclei是基于YAML模板的高性能漏洞扫描器，由全球安全社区驱动。支持自定义真实场景检测，覆盖应用、API、网络、DNS及云配置，通过模拟步骤实现零误报，超快并行扫描并易于集成CI/CD，快速应对新兴漏洞。
items.e: Nuclei is a high-performance vulnerability scanner powered by YAML templates and the global security community. It enables custom real-world detection with zero false positives, supports multi-protocol scanning of apps, APIs, networks, DNS and cloud configs, and integrates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines.

items.d: Stealth Chromium that passes every bot detection test. Drop-in Playwright replacement with source-level fingerprint patches. 50+ tests passed.
items.z: CloakBrowser 是一款源码级深度改造的隐身 Chromium 浏览器，通过 58 个 C++ 补丁从底层消除自动化指纹，完美绕过 Cloudflare Turnstile、reCAPTCHA v3 等 30+ 机器人检测系统。无缝兼容 Playwright/Puppeteer API，一行代码替换，内置类人行为模拟，为网页爬虫、数据采集和自动化测试提供终极反检测解决方案。
items.e: CloakBrowser is a stealth Chromium browser with 58 source-level C++ patches that fundamentally eliminate automation fingerprints. It achieves a 0.9 reCAPTCHA v3 score and passes 30+ bot detection tests including Cloudflare Turnstile and FingerprintJS. Offering seamless Playwright/Puppeteer API compatibility with one-line code replacement, built-in human-like behavior simulation, and automatic binary updates, it delivers the ultimate anti-detection solution for web scraping, data collection, and automation tasks.

items.d: An evolving how-to guide for securing a Linux server.
items.z: 这个仓库提供全面的 Linux 服务器安全加固实践指南，涵盖 SSH 密钥与 2FA 认证、UFW 防火墙配置、Fail2Ban/CrowdSec 入侵防御、AIDE 文件完整性监控等核心模块。通过 Ansible Playbooks 实现自动化部署，结合纵深防御理念，为系统管理员和 DevOps 提供从基础加固到持续审计的一站式安全解决方案。
items.e: This repository delivers a comprehensive, continuously updated guide for Linux server security hardening with actionable implementations. It systematically covers SSH hardening with key-based authentication and two-factor authentication, network security via UFW firewall and PSAD intrusion detection, application-layer protection using Fail2Ban and CrowdSec, and continuous monitoring through AIDE file integrity checks, Lynis auditing, and OSSEC HIDS. The guide emphasizes defense-in-depth strategies and provides production-ready Ansible Playbooks for automated deployment, making it an essential resource for system administrators, DevOps engineers, and security professionals seeking to implement robust server security from fundamentals to advanced threat detection.

items.d: An LLM-powered knowledge curation system that researches a topic and generates a full-length report with citations.
items.z: STORM是斯坦福开发的LLM驱动知识整理系统，通过两阶段流程自动生成带引用的维基百科式长文。其核心技术是多视角提问机制，引导LLM提出深度研究问题，结合互联网检索与向量搜索构建知识大纲，再生成完整报告。Co-STORM扩展支持人机协作，已服务超7万用户，支持GPT-4o等模型及Bing/You.com检索，提供Python包与Streamlit界面。
items.e: STORM is a Stanford-developed LLM-powered knowledge curation system that automatically generates full-length, cited Wikipedia-style articles through a two-stage pipeline. Its core innovation is perspective-guided question asking that enables deep research, combined with internet retrieval and vector search to build topic outlines before article generation. The enhanced Co-STORM supports human-AI collaboration. Serving over 70,000 users, it integrates GPT-4o, Bing/You.com search, and offers a Python package with Streamlit UI for research assistance and knowledge exploration.

items.d: Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
items.z: supermemory 是一个高性能、可扩展的AI记忆引擎，定位为用户的'第二大脑'。核心亮点在于支持MCP协议，可无缝集成Claude、Cursor等AI工具，实现智能记忆检索与对话。支持URL、PDF、文本等多格式内容导入，提供浏览器插件和Raycast扩展。采用API优先设计，既可作为个人知识管理平台，也能通过开发者控制台集成到企业工作流，支持自托管部署。
items.e: Supermemory is a high-performance, scalable AI memory engine positioned as your 'second brain.' Its core strength lies in MCP protocol integration, enabling seamless connectivity with AI tools like Claude and Cursor for intelligent memory retrieval and chat. It supports multi-format content import (URLs, PDFs, text) via browser extensions and Raycast. API-first design allows both personal knowledge management and enterprise workflow integration through its developer console, with self-hosting options available.

items.d: Edit videos with coding agents
items.z: video-use 是开源视频编辑技能，让编码智能体（Claude Code等）通过自然语言完成剪辑。用户投放原始素材后对话即可输出final.mp4，自动去除语气词与静音、色彩分级、字幕烧录、动画叠加与自我评估。核心以ElevenLabs词级转录+按需视觉合成驱动LLM精准决策，结合ffmpeg渲染，支持会话记忆，无需传统时间线工具。
items.e: video-use is an open-source skill that lets coding agents (Claude Code etc.) edit videos via natural language. Drop raw footage, chat, and get final.mp4: auto-cuts fillers/dead space, color grades, burns subtitles, generates overlays, and self-evaluates. LLM reasons from ElevenLabs word-level transcripts plus on-demand visual composites, rendered via ffmpeg, with session memory—no timelines or menus needed.

items.d: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
items.z: Astryx 是 Meta 开源的设计系统，基于 React 19 与 StyleX，提供 150+ 无障碍组件、主题定制、暗黑模式及 CLI 工具。其开放内部结构支持任意层级组合与源码抽取，样式无锁定，可无缝对接 Tailwind 等方案，并专为人类开发者与 AI 智能体协同构建而优化。
items.e: Astryx is an open-source design system from Meta, built on React 19 and StyleX, offering 150+ accessible components, theming, dark mode, and a CLI. Its open internals allow composition at any level and source ejection, with no styling lock-in, enabling seamless integration with Tailwind and other CSS approaches, designed for both human developers and AI agents.

items.d: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
items.z: OpenCLI 是一款将任意网站转换为命令行接口的自动化工具，核心在于让 AI 智能体通过已登录的浏览器操作网页（导航、填表、点击、数据提取）。内置 Bilibili、知乎等适配器，通过浏览器扩展与本地守护进程实现安全交互，支持自定义命令扩展，并集成本地工具与 Electron 应用，实现高效自动化与 AI 驱动交互。
items.e: OpenCLI is an automation tool that converts any website into a command-line interface (CLI), enabling AI agents to operate websites via a logged-in browser for navigation, form filling, clicking, and data extraction. It provides built-in adapters for platforms like Bilibili and Zhihu, a browser extension with a local daemon, and allows custom command extensions. It also integrates local tools and Electron apps, serving as a versatile hub for human and AI-driven automation workflows.

items.d: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
items.z: TencentDB Agent Memory 为 AI Agent 提供完全本地的长期记忆解决方案，采用 4 层渐进式管道（L0 Conversation→L1 Atom→L2 Scenario→L3 Persona）实现符号化短期记忆与分层长期记忆。拒绝平铺向量存储，通过 Mermaid 符号图与异构存储（DB+Markdown）实现渐进披露与全 traceable 召回。集成 OpenClaw/Hermes 后，Token 消耗最高降 61.38%，任务通过率相对提升 51.52%，PersonaMem 准确率从 48% 升至 76%。适用于长程 Agent 任务与个性化体验，零外部 API 依赖。
items.e: TencentDB Agent Memory delivers fully local long-term memory for AI Agents via a 4-tier progressive pipeline (L0 Conversation → L1 Atom → L2 Scenario → L3 Persona), combining symbolic short-term memory with layered long-term memory. It rejects flat vector storage, using Mermaid symbol graphs and heterogeneous storage (DB + Markdown) for progressive disclosure and full traceability. When integrated with OpenClaw/Hermes, it cuts token usage by up to 61.38%, boosts task success by up to 51.52% relatively, and raises PersonaMem accuracy from 48% to 76%. Ideal for long-horizon agent tasks and personalization, with zero external API dependencies.

items.d: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
items.z: Karakeep 是一款自托管的书签管理工具，支持链接、笔记、图片和 PDF 的收藏。核心亮点包括 AI 自动标签与摘要（支持 ChatGPT 和本地 Ollama 模型）、全文搜索、OCR 文字识别，以及完整的网页与视频归档功能。提供浏览器插件、iOS/Android 应用，并可通过 RSS 自动抓取。基于 NextJS 和 tRPC 构建，注重隐私与数据自主，适合数字资料囤积者。
items.e: Karakeep is a self-hostable bookmark manager designed for digital hoarders to collect links, notes, images, and PDFs. It leverages AI for automatic tagging and summarization, supporting both ChatGPT and local Ollama models. The app provides full-text search, OCR for image text extraction, and complete web/video archiving using monolith and yt-dlp. Available on web, mobile (iOS/Android), and browsers via extensions, it includes RSS auto-hoarding, REST API, and SSO. Built with NextJS, Drizzle ORM, and tRPC, it emphasizes privacy and data sovereignty.

items.d: 🚀 AI 全自动短视频引擎 | AI Fully Automated Short Video Engine
items.z: Pixelle-Video是一款AI全自动短视频引擎。输入主题后自动完成文案撰写、AI配图视频生成、语音合成与视频合成。支持多种AI模型及ComfyUI集成，提供数字人口播和动作迁移功能。零门槛模块化设计，适用于内容创作和营销场景。
items.e: Pixelle-Video is an AI fully automated short video engine. Simply input a theme, and it auto-generates scripts, AI visuals, voice narration, BGM, and the complete video. It integrates LLMs, TTS, image/video gen models via direct APIs or ComfyUI/RunningHub, with modules for digital humans, image-to-video, and action transfer. Modular design offers zero-threshold creation, perfect for content marketing and social media videos without any editing expertise. The web interface provides easy template and model selection for customized outputs.

items.d: PDF Parser for AI-ready data. Automate PDF accessibility. Open-source.
items.z: OpenDataLoader PDF 是开源 PDF 解析器，专注 AI 就绪数据提取与 PDF 无障碍自动化。支持 PDF 转 Markdown、带边界框 JSON 和 HTML，基准测试整体准确率 0.907、表格 0.928 排名第一。采用确定性本地模式 + 混合 AI/OCR 模式，处理多栏、扫描文档、复杂表格。提供 Python/Node.js/Java SDK，首创开源端到端自动标记生成 Tagged PDF，支持 PDF/UA 合规。适用于 RAG/LLM 管道与无障碍合规场景。
items.e: OpenDataLoader PDF is an open-source PDF parser focused on AI-ready data extraction and PDF accessibility automation. It converts PDFs to Markdown, JSON with bounding boxes, and HTML, ranking #1 in benchmarks with 0.907 overall and 0.928 table accuracy. Features deterministic local mode plus hybrid AI/OCR for multi-column layouts, scanned docs, and complex tables. Offers Python, Node.js, and Java SDKs; first open-source end-to-end auto-tagging to Tagged PDF for PDF/UA compliance. Ideal for RAG/LLM pipelines and accessibility remediation.

items.d: AI-agent Skill for generating polished HTML slide decks: editorial magazine and Swiss layouts, image prompts, social covers, and a WebGL/low-power presentation runtime.
items.z: 为AI Agent提供高质量HTML PPT生成能力，内置电子杂志与瑞士国际主义双视觉系统，支持单文件横向翻页演示、多平台封面生成及Codex配图流程。解决AI生成PPT的视觉质量控制难题，适用于个人风格演讲、产品发布及方法论展示，输出无需构建、可直接打开的HTML文件。
items.e: An AI Agent skill for generating polished HTML slide decks with dual visual systems: editorial magazine and Swiss internationalist styles. Enables single-file horizontal presentations, multi-platform social covers, and Codex-integrated image generation. Solves visual quality control for AI-generated slides, ideal for personal talks, product launches, and methodology showcases with zero-build delivery.

items.d: Huashu Design 3.0 · 在 agent 里打一句话，拿回能交付的设计：网页 / App 原型 / 可编辑 PPTX / 动画 / 信息图 · 六个候选挑三个方向 · 84 种带样张的风格库 · 越用越懂你的外观账本与设计体检 · HTML-native design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & any agent
items.z: 华数设计是一款HTML原生的AI设计技能，可将文本描述直接转化为可交付的生产级设计稿。支持Claude Code等主流AI编程助手，3-30分钟内生成可点击的App原型、演讲幻灯片、60秒动画及信息图。核心亮点包括：20种内置设计哲学与5维评审体系确保专业品质；Motion Design引擎支持时间轴动画与MP4/GIF导出；HTML幻灯片可转为可编辑PPTX；Tweaks面板实现参数化实时调整。无需Figma插件，纯文本交互，输出印刷级排版与跨平台HTML文件。
items.e: Huashu Design is an HTML-native AI design skill that transforms text prompts into production-ready deliverables within 3-30 minutes. Compatible with Claude Code and other AI agents, it generates clickable App prototypes, presentation slides, motion graphics, and infographics. Key features include: 20 built-in design philosophies with 5-dimension expert review system; Motion Design engine supporting timeline animation and MP4/GIF export; HTML slides convertible to editable PPTX; Tweaks panel for parametric adjustments. No Figma plugins needed—pure text interface delivers print-quality layouts and cross-platform HTML output.

items.d: 最好用的 V2Ray 一键安装脚本 & 管理脚本
items.z: 233boy/v2ray 是一款专注于 V2Ray 自动化部署与管理的 Shell 脚本工具。通过极简命令行交互，实现一键安装、配置管理与协议切换，大幅降低 V2Ray 使用门槛。核心亮点包括多协议支持（VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks）、自动化 TLS 证书申请、多配置并行运行及动态端口管理。适用于快速搭建科学上网代理服务器，满足隐私保护与网络访问需求。
items.e: 233boy/v2ray is a Shell script tool focused on automated deployment and management of V2Ray. It simplifies complex configurations through minimal command-line interactions, enabling one-click installation, configuration management, and protocol switching. Key features include multi-protocol support (VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks), automated TLS certificate provisioning, concurrent multi-configuration operation, and dynamic port management. Ideal for rapidly deploying scientific上网 proxy servers for privacy protection and network access needs.

items.d: Maple Mono: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font icons for IDE and terminal, fine-grained customization options. 带连字和控制台图标的圆角等宽字体，中英文宽度完美2:1，细粒度的自定义选项
items.z: Maple Mono 是一款开源等宽字体，专为提升代码阅读体验设计。核心亮点包括圆角美学、智能连字和完整的 Nerd-Font 图标支持。其独特的中英文 2:1 宽度对齐技术，在多语言混排和 Markdown 表格中实现完美视觉对齐。V7 版本采用可变字体技术，支持无级字重调节和细粒度特性控制，适配各类 IDE 和终端环境。
items.e: Maple Mono is an open-source monospace font designed to enhance coding workflow. Key features include rounded corners, smart ligatures, and comprehensive Nerd-Font icon integration. Its unique 2:1 Chinese-English width alignment ensures perfect visual harmony in multilingual code and Markdown tables. The V7 remake introduces variable font technology with infinite weight control and granular customization options, optimized for IDEs and terminals.

items.d: JavaScript in-page GUI agent. Control web interfaces with natural language.
items.z: 阿里巴巴Page Agent是一个创新的页内JavaScript GUI代理框架，通过自然语言直接控制Web界面。其核心亮点在于纯前端实现，无需浏览器扩展或后端服务，基于文本化DOM操作避免截图和OCR依赖。支持接入任意LLM，提供人机协同UI，适用于SaaS智能助手、ERP/CRM表单自动填充、无障碍访问及多页面自动化场景。
items.e: Alibaba Page Agent is an innovative in-page JavaScript GUI agent framework that controls web interfaces via natural language. Its key advantages include pure frontend implementation without browser extensions or backend services, direct DOM manipulation avoiding screenshots and OCR. It supports integration with any LLM, offers human-in-the-loop UI, and is ideal for SaaS AI copilots, smart form filling in ERP/CRM systems, accessibility enhancements, and cross-page automation.

items.d: 🗃 Open source self-hosted web archiving. Takes URLs/browser history/bookmarks/Pocket/Pinboard/etc., saves HTML, JS, PDFs, media, and more...
items.z: ArchiveBox 是一款开源自托管网页存档工具，支持从浏览器书签、历史记录、Pocket、Pinboard 等多源导入 URL，完整保存 HTML、JS、PDF、媒体文件等内容。采用标准化格式（WARC、SQLite、JSON）确保数据长期可读，提供 CLI、REST API 和 Webhook 集成能力。适用于个人知识管理、企业证据保全及数字资产备份，支持 Docker 快速部署。
items.e: ArchiveBox is an open-source self-hosted web archiving solution that preserves web content from URLs, browser history, bookmarks, Pocket, Pinboard, and more. It captures comprehensive snapshots including HTML, JavaScript, PDFs, and media files in standardized formats (WARC, SQLite, JSON) ensuring long-term accessibility. The tool offers CLI, REST API, and webhook integrations for automation, with Docker support for easy deployment. Ideal for personal knowledge management, legal evidence preservation, and social media backup, it gives users full control over their archived data.

items.d: A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents. DESIGN.md gives agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system.
items.z: DESIGN.md 是 Google Labs 开源的视觉身份描述格式规范，专为编码代理设计。通过 YAML 前置元数据定义设计令牌（颜色、排版、间距等），结合 Markdown 散文阐述设计理念，提供持久结构化的设计系统理解。核心价值确保 AI 生成 UI 的一致性与准确性。适用于 AI 辅助前端开发、设计系统跨工具迁移场景。技术亮点融合机器可读令牌与人类可读说明，支持 lint 校验 WCAG 对比、版本 diff 等工具。
items.e: DESIGN.md is a Google Labs open-sourced format specification for describing visual identities to coding agents. It combines YAML front matter for machine-readable design tokens (colors, typography, spacing) with Markdown prose explaining the rationale. This provides agents with a persistent, structured understanding of design systems for consistent UI generation. Ideal for AI-assisted frontend development and design system portability. Key highlights include WCAG contrast linting, version diffing, token references, and the hybrid machine-human readable format.

items.d: 🔥 Clone and recreate any website as a modern React app in seconds
items.z: Open Lovable 是 Firecrawl 团队开源的 AI 驱动 React 应用生成器。通过对话式交互，用户可快速克隆并重构任意网站为现代化 React 应用。核心集成 Firecrawl 网页抓取、多 LLM 提供商（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq）及 Vercel/E2B 沙盒环境，实现从 URL 到可运行代码的秒级生成，支持快速迭代与实时预览，适用于原型设计与网站迁移。
items.e: Open Lovable is an open-source AI-powered React app generator by the Firecrawl team. It enables instant cloning and modernization of any website into React applications through conversational AI interaction. The project integrates Firecrawl for web scraping, multiple LLM providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq), and sandbox environments (Vercel/E2B) to transform URLs into runnable code within seconds, supporting rapid prototyping and website migration with real-time preview capabilities.

items.d: A modern ebook manager and reader with sync and backup capacities for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and Web
items.z: Koodo Reader 是一款开源的跨平台电子书阅读管理工具，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 及 Web 全平台。核心亮点包括：支持 EPUB、PDF、MOBI 等 15+ 格式，集成 OneDrive、Google Drive 等 10+ 云存储实现数据同步，内置 AI 词典翻译与文本朗读功能，提供丰富的阅读自定义选项，是个人数字阅读管理的理想解决方案。
items.e: Koodo Reader is an open-source, cross-platform ebook management and reading application supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web. Key features include: compatibility with 15+ formats including EPUB, PDF, and MOBI; seamless synchronization via 10+ cloud services like OneDrive and Google Drive; integrated AI-powered dictionary, translation and text-to-speech; extensive customization for fonts, themes and layouts. It provides a comprehensive solution for personal digital reading management across all devices.

items.d: The most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library
items.z: FingerprintJS是最先进的免费开源浏览器指纹识别库，通过客户端查询浏览器属性计算哈希访客标识符。与Cookie不同，它在隐身模式和清除数据后仍保持一致。适用于访客识别、欺诈检测和Web分析等场景。技术亮点包括npm/CDN简单安装、MIT许可、高兼容性和React支持。提供演示展示持久性，但准确性低于商业版且易被欺骗。
items.e: FingerprintJS is the most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library. It generates a unique hashed visitor identifier by querying browser attributes on the client-side. Unlike cookies, the fingerprint remains consistent in incognito mode and after clearing browser data. It is ideal for visitor identification, fraud detection, and analytics in web applications. Key highlights include easy installation via npm or CDN, MIT license, high compatibility, and React support. A demo is available to showcase its persistence. However, it has lower accuracy than commercial versions and is vulnerable to spoofing.

items.d: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
items.z: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源平价替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、反向链接、站点审计及 AI 可见性等核心 SEO 工作流。通过 MCP 服务器和可复用技能实现与 Claude 等 AI 智能体的深度集成，支持 Docker 或 Cloudflare 自托管，用户自带 DataForSEO API 密钥实现按需付费。界面简洁现代，聚焦高效工作流，适合个人、团队及 AI 驱动的 SEO 策略定制与控制。
items.e: OpenSEO is an open-source, pay-as-you-go alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, delivering essential SEO workflows including keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlinks, site audits, and AI visibility. It features deep AI agent integration via MCP server and customizable skills for tools like Claude, with self-hosting options (Docker or Cloudflare) and BYO DataForSEO API key for usage-based costs. The modern, focused UI empowers individuals, teams, and AI-powered SEO strategies with full control and customization.

items.d: PM Skills Marketplace: 100+ agentic skills, commands, and plugins — from discovery to strategy, execution, launch, and growth.
items.z: PM Skills Marketplace是产品管理AI技能市场，提供68个PM技能和42个链式工作流，覆盖9个插件。它将Teresa Torres、Marty Cagan等专家框架编码为结构化流程，支持Claude等AI助手的发现、策略、执行到增长全生命周期。通过/discover等命令链式调用技能，实现假设映射、PRD撰写等严谨任务，提升产品决策质量，而非仅生成文本。兼容多AI工具，安装便捷。
items.e: PM Skills Marketplace delivers 68 PM skills and 42 chained workflows across 9 plugins for AI assistants like Claude. It encodes proven frameworks from experts such as Teresa Torres and Marty Cagan into structured processes covering discovery, strategy, execution, launch, and growth. Commands like /discover chain skills for assumption mapping, PRD writing, and metrics definition. Designed for Claude Code and Cowork with broad compatibility, it provides rigorous, decision-focused workflows instead of generic text, enhancing product outcomes through embedded PM expertise.

items.d: Huly — All-in-One Project Management Platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion)
items.z: Huly Platform 是开源一体化项目管理平台，替代 Jira、Linear 等工具。提供 Chat、CRM、HRM、ATS 等模块化应用，支持自托管与 API 驱动开发。基于 Node.js 全栈框架，采用 Docker 容器化部署，加速企业级业务应用构建，实现多团队协作与流程自动化。
items.e: Huly Platform is an open-source all-in-one project management solution that replaces Jira, Linear, Slack, and Notion. It provides modular applications including Chat, CRM, HRM, and ATS with self-hosting capability. Built on a Node.js full-stack framework using Docker containerization, it accelerates enterprise business application development through API-driven integration and automated workflows for team collaboration.

items.d: Symphony turns project work into isolated, autonomous implementation runs, allowing teams to manage work instead of supervising coding agents.
items.z: Symphony 是 OpenAI 推出的 AI 编程自动化框架，将项目任务转化为独立自主的实现运行。系统监控项目管理工具（如 Linear），自动调度 AI 代理完成编码、测试、代码审查和 PR 合并，并提供 CI 状态、复杂度分析和操作视频作为工作证明。核心价值在于让工程师从监督编码代理中解放，转向高层次工作管理，适用于采用 harness engineering 的工程团队。
items.e: Symphony is an AI-powered automation framework from OpenAI that transforms project work into isolated, autonomous implementation runs. The system monitors project management tools like Linear, automatically spawning AI agents to handle coding, testing, code review, and PR merging. It provides proof of work including CI status, complexity analysis, and walkthrough videos. The core value proposition enables engineers to manage work at a higher level rather than supervising coding agents directly, targeting teams that have adopted harness engineering practices. This engineering preview is designed for testing in trusted environments.

items.d: A privacy-first app that strips AI watermarks from content you own.
items.z: 隐私优先的开源工具，作为Agent技能与纯标准库Python HTTP服务，精准剥离多厂商AI溯源水印（Unicode隐形字符、统计token标记、C2PA/EXIF等元数据）。支持文本、图像、文档、音视频等格式，专为用户自有内容的隐私卫生设计，兼容Claude/Gemini/OpenAI及开源LLM，零依赖核心运行。
items.e: Privacy-first open-source tool combining an agent skill with a pure-stdlib Python HTTP service to strip multi-vendor AI provenance watermarks from text and files you own. Handles invisible Unicode, statistical token marks, and C2PA/EXIF/XMP metadata across images, docs, audio/video. Supports Claude, Gemini, OpenAI and open LLMs with zero-dependency core.

items.d: :rocket: The Ultimate Image Uploader for Efficient Creators. Supports Obsidian, Typora, VS Code etc. and 60+ image hosting services  (S3, GitHub, Cloudflare R2, Imgur, Aliyun OSS...). Paste, upload, done.
items.z: PicGo是专为创作者设计的终极图片上传工具，无缝集成Obsidian、VS Code、Typora等主流编辑器。支持60+图床服务（GitHub、阿里云OSS、S3等），通过拖拽/粘贴/快捷键实现秒传并自动复制链接。独创插件系统可扩展支持Cloudflare R2等新兴存储，彻底消除写作中的上下文切换，让创作者专注内容生产。
items.e: PicGo is the ultimate image uploader for efficient creators, seamlessly integrating with Obsidian, VS Code, Typora and other editors. Supporting 60+ image hosts (GitHub, Alibaba Cloud OSS, AWS S3), it enables instant uploads via drag-and-drop/clipboard/hotkeys with auto-copied links. Its extensible plugin system adds support for Cloudflare R2 and more, eliminating context switching to maximize creative focus.

items.d: Lightweight server monitoring with historical data, docker stats, and alerts.
items.z: Beszel 是一款基于 PocketBase 的轻量级服务器监控平台，采用 hub-agent 架构。它提供 Docker 容器资源统计、历史数据追踪和自定义告警功能，支持多用户管理、OAuth 认证与自动备份。相比主流方案资源占用更低，具备友好 Web 界面，开箱即用，适合个人及小型团队监控物理服务器、虚拟机和容器化环境。
items.e: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform built on PocketBase using a hub-agent architecture. It tracks Docker container metrics, historical data, and configurable alerts while supporting multi-user management, OAuth authentication, and automatic backups. With significantly lower resource consumption than leading solutions and an intuitive web interface, it's ideal for individuals and small teams monitoring physical servers, VMs, and containerized environments.

items.d: Open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz PLFM phased array RADAR system
items.z: AERIS-10是一款开源低成本10.5GHz相控阵雷达系统，提供3km和20km两种探测距离版本。系统采用脉冲线性调频(PLFM)技术，支持±45°电子波束扫描，集成FPGA实现脉冲压缩、多普勒处理、MTI和CFAR等先进信号处理。模块化设计包含电源管理、频率合成和射频主板，搭载Python GUI地图界面和GPS/IMU实时校正。面向无人机开发、科研教育和雷达爱好者，提供完整的硬件原理图、PCB布局和开源软件，旨在降低相控阵雷达技术门槛。
items.e: AERIS-10 is an open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz phased array radar system with 3km and 20km range variants. It features Pulse Linear Frequency Modulation (PLFM) and ±45° electronic beam steering. The FPGA handles advanced signal processing including pulse compression, Doppler FFT, MTI, and CFAR. Its modular architecture comprises power management, frequency synthesis, and RF main boards, complemented by a Python GUI with map integration and GPS/IMU support. Designed for drone developers, researchers, and radar enthusiasts, it provides complete schematics and software to democratize phased array radar technology.

items.d: What are the principles we can use to build LLM-powered software that is actually good enough to put in the hands of production customers?
items.z: 12-Factor Agents 提出构建生产级LLM应用的12项核心原则，受经典12要素应用启发。针对当前AI智能体框架在生产环境中的不足，强调将软件工程最佳实践应用于LLM开发，而非简单提示词+工具循环。核心亮点包括上下文工程自主权、小型专注智能体设计，为开发可靠、可维护的面向客户AI应用提供系统性指导。
items.e: 12-Factor Agents introduces 12 core principles for building production-ready LLM applications, inspired by the classic 12-factor app methodology. Addressing gaps in existing AI agent frameworks, it emphasizes applying software engineering best practices to LLM development rather than simplistic prompt-tool loops. Key highlights include owning your context window and designing small, focused agents. This guide provides systematic guidance for developing reliable, maintainable customer-facing AI applications that go beyond experimental prototypes to deliver real production value.

items.d: Readest is a modern, feature-rich ebook reader designed for avid readers offering seamless cross-platform access, powerful tools, and an intuitive interface to elevate your reading experience.
items.z: Readest 是一款基于 Next.js 16 和 Tauri v2 构建的开源电子书阅读器，覆盖桌面、移动及 Web 全平台。支持 EPUB/MOBI/AZW3 等主流格式，提供分屏并行阅读、代码语法高亮、全文检索与智能笔记等深度功能，专为追求沉浸式体验的深度阅读者打造。
items.e: Readest is a modern, open-source ebook reader engineered for immersive reading experiences. Leveraging Next.js 16 and Tauri v2, it delivers native performance across macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and web platforms. Supporting EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, TXT, and experimental PDF formats, it features split-screen parallel reading, code syntax highlighting, full-text search, dictionary lookup, and comprehensive annotation tools. Built as a sophisticated rewrite of Foliate, Readest combines powerful library management with customizable reading settings to serve avid readers and technical professionals.

items.d: The official source code repository for the calibre ebook manager
items.z: calibre 是一款功能全面的电子书管理工具，支持主流格式查看、转换、编辑与编目。其核心优势在于强大的格式转换引擎、跨平台兼容性（Linux/Windows/macOS）、设备同步能力，以及自动抓取元数据和将新闻转换为电子书的功能，是构建个人数字图书馆的理想解决方案。
items.e: calibre is a comprehensive e-book management suite offering viewing, conversion, editing, and cataloging across major formats. Key strengths include a powerful conversion engine, cross-platform support (Linux/Windows/macOS), device synchronization, automated metadata fetching, and news-to-ebook conversion capabilities, making it ideal for personal digital library management.

items.d: 解决Cursor在免费订阅期间出现以下提示的问题:  Your request has been blocked as our system has detected suspicious activity / You've reached your trial request limit.  /  Too many free trial accounts used on this machine.
items.z: go-cursor-help是一款用于重置Cursor AI IDE免费试用状态的工具，专门解决因系统检测异常活动、达到试用请求限制或设备关联过多试用账号而导致的阻断问题。通过自动化机制绕过Cursor的试用验证，使开发者能够持续使用AI编程功能。该仓库同时提供付费Cursor Pro账号及7天通行证等订阅服务，形成工具+账号的完整解决方案。
items.e: go-cursor-help is a tool designed to reset the free trial status of Cursor AI IDE, specifically addressing block issues caused by suspicious activity detection, trial request limits, or excessive trial accounts on a single machine. It automates bypassing Cursor's trial verification, enabling developers to continuously access AI programming features. The repository also offers paid Cursor Pro accounts and 7-day passes, providing a complete tool-and-account solution.

items.d: An open-source RAG-based tool for chatting with your documents.
items.z: kotaemon 是一款开源的 RAG（检索增强生成）文档对话工具，提供简洁易用的 Web UI。支持 OpenAI、Azure、Cohere 等云端 LLM API 及 Ollama、llama-cpp 本地模型，基于 Gradio 构建可高度定制的界面。既适合非技术用户快速搭建文档问答系统，也为开发者提供灵活的 RAG 管道框架，支持 Docker 部署和 Colab 一键运行。
items.e: Kotaemon is an open-source RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) document chat tool that provides a clean, minimalistic, and highly customizable Gradio UI. It supports diverse LLM backends—both cloud APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Cohere) and local models (Ollama, llama-cpp-python). Designed for dual audiences, it enables non-technical users to deploy document QA systems effortlessly via Docker or Colab, while offering developers a modular framework to build, extend, and fine-tune RAG pipelines with minimal coding effort.

items.d: Open-source 3D architecture software for AECO, scan-to-BIM. Agent-friendly, browser-first, MCP, CLI.
items.z: 基于 Web 的 3D 建筑编辑器，提供浏览器内专业级 BIM 编辑能力。采用 React Three Fiber + WebGPU 实现高性能渲染，Turborepo  monorepo 架构分离核心逻辑与渲染层，Zustand 分层状态管理配合 IndexedDB 持久化与 Zundo 撤销重做，支持建筑模型的节点化数据管理与实时空间查询。
items.e: A web-based 3D building editor delivering professional BIM capabilities in-browser. Built on React Three Fiber + WebGPU for high-performance rendering, Turborepo monorepo architecture separates core logic from rendering, with layered Zustand state management, IndexedDB persistence, and Zundo undo/redo. Enables node-based building data management and real-time spatial queries.

items.d: A maintained, feature-rich and performance oriented, neofetch like system information tool.
items.z: Fastfetch 是一款用 C 语言编写的高性能系统信息展示工具，作为 neofetch 的现代替代品，专注于性能与可定制性。它支持 Linux、macOS、Windows、Android 等十余种操作系统，提供美观的视觉输出与丰富的配置选项。适用于开发者、系统管理员在终端快速获取并展示系统详情，支持多种包管理器一键安装，社区活跃且持续维护更新。
items.e: Fastfetch is a high-performance system information tool written in C, designed as a modern, maintained alternative to neofetch with emphasis on performance and customizability. It supports over 10 operating systems including Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and various BSD variants, delivering visually appealing output with extensive configuration options. Ideal for developers and sysadmins to display system details in terminals, it offers easy installation via major package managers and maintains active community development with regular updates.

items.d: 🥢像老乡鸡🐔那样做饭。已添加2026年发布的《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告 2.0中新出现的菜品。主要部分于2024年完工，非老乡鸡官方仓库。文字来自《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》，并做归纳、编辑与整理。CookLikeHOC.
items.z: 将老乡鸡标准化菜谱开源化，基于《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》整理，提供可复制的家庭烹饪指南。技术亮点包括Docker容器化部署、AI手绘图解流程、网页端交互界面。核心价值在于中餐标准化与规模化烹饪方案的平民化，适合家庭烹饪爱好者与餐饮技术研究者。
items.e: This repository open-sources standardized recipes from Laoxiangji, compiled from their traceability reports to provide replicable home cooking guides. Technical highlights include Docker containerization, AI-generated hand-drawn illustrations, and a web interface. It democratizes Chinese restaurant-standardized cooking methods for home cooks and culinary tech enthusiasts.

items.d: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
items.z: RooCode是VS Code扩展，提供多模式AI开发团队。支持代码生成、架构设计、调试、文档编写等全流程任务，集成MCP服务器实现工具扩展，通过自然语言指令驱动AI代理完成编程工作。
items.e: RooCode is a VS Code extension that embeds a complete AI-powered development team directly in your code editor. It provides specialized modes including Code for everyday tasks, Architect for system design, Ask for explanations, Debug for issue tracing, and customizable modes for team workflows. The extension integrates with MCP servers for extensible tooling and enables natural language-driven code generation, refactoring, debugging, documentation writing, and task automation.

items.d: A curated collection of fun and creative examples generated with Nano Banana & Nano Banana Pro🍌, Gemini-2.5-flash-image based model. We also release Nano-consistent-150K openly to support the community's development of image generation and unified models(click to website to see our blog)
items.z: 本仓库是 Nano Banana 模型的创意图像案例库，基于 Gemini-2.5-flash-image 架构。精选 30+ 跨领域应用实例，涵盖艺术创作、设计工作流到商业内容生成。核心贡献是开源 Nano-consistent-150K 数据集，通过单人物 35+ 种编辑变体实现严格身份一致性，支持交错数据构建，为图像生成与统一模型开发提供高质量基准。
items.e: This repository showcases Nano Banana model's creative image generation capabilities, powered by Gemini-2.5-flash-image. It curates 30+ cross-domain applications from artistic creation to design workflows. The key contribution is the open-sourced Nano-consistent-150K dataset, which enforces character identity consistency through 35+ editing variations per subject, enabling interleaved data construction for image generation and unified model development.

items.d: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
items.z: 该仓库提供1,324个健身动作的综合数据集，每个动作包含动画GIF、180×180缩略图、身体部位/器械/目标肌肉/肌群元数据，以及9种语言的分步指导说明。作为LogPress AI健身追踪应用的底层数据，支持健身应用开发、运动识别推荐的机器学习项目、健康研究及教育原型。亮点包括结构化JSON文件与验证模式、纯客户端交互浏览器（搜索筛选多语言详情）、开发者工具（多数据库SQL生成、API示例及LLM后端提示），媒体按Gym visual许可使用。
items.e: This repository delivers a ready-to-use dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises, each with animated GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, metadata on body parts, equipment, targets and muscle groups, plus step-by-step instructions in 9 languages. It powers the LogPress AI-assisted workout tracker and supports fitness app development, ML exercise recognition/recommendation, health research, and education. Highlights include validated JSON with schema, client-side interactive browser with search/filters/multilingual details, and developer tools offering DB SQL generators, API examples across languages, and LLM prompts for backend generation. Media licensed from Gym visual.

items.d: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
items.z: Modern Web Guidance 是 Google Chrome 团队支持的 AI 编码代理技能，提供 SKILL.md 文件与 CLI 工具，将现代 Web 平台专家知识、最佳实践和 API 模式直接注入 AI 代理上下文。帮助代理采用高性能、可访问、安全的原生 API 替代过时方案，覆盖 102 项现代特性及 128 个真实用例，支持 Cursor、Claude 等工具集成，提升 Web 应用开发质量与效率。
items.e: Modern Web Guidance, supported by the Google Chrome team, is an agent skill (SKILL.md) with a CLI that injects web platform expertise, best practices, and modern API patterns into AI coding agents. It guides agents to use high-performance, accessible, and secure native APIs instead of legacy patterns, covering 102 modern features and 128 real-world use cases across UX, CSS, performance, accessibility, and built-in AI. It integrates with tools like Cursor, Claude, and Gemini for better web development.

items.d: Automate browser based workflows with AI
items.z: Skyvern 是基于 LLM 和计算机视觉的智能浏览器自动化平台，提供 Playwright 兼容 SDK 和无代码工作流构建器。通过视觉理解替代 XPath 定位，支持未知网站自动化、布局变更自适应，实现跨站点工作流批量执行，显著提升自动化鲁棒性。
items.e: Skyvern automates browsers using LLMs and vision. Playwright SDK replaces XPath with visual understanding for resilient cross-site workflows.

items.d: Humanizer 的汉化版本，Claude Code Skills，旨在消除文本中 AI 生成的痕迹。
items.z: Humanizer-zh 是 Humanizer 的中文汉化版本，专为 Claude Code 打造的技能，用于识别并消除文本中的 AI 生成痕迹。该工具基于维基百科的 AI 写作特征指南，可检测 24 种 AI 写作模式，涵盖内容、语言、风格和表达四大类。通过自然语言重写，将机械的 AI 文本转化为流畅、真实的人类表达，适用于营销文案、学术摘要和博客文章等场景，显著提升中文内容的人性化程度。
items.e: Humanizer-zh is a Chinese localization of the Humanizer tool, designed as a Claude Code Skill to detect and eliminate AI-generated traces from text. Based on Wikipedia's AI writing patterns guide, it identifies 24 distinct AI writing patterns across content, language, style, and communication categories. The tool rewrites mechanical AI output into natural, human-like Chinese text, making it ideal for marketing copy, academic abstracts, and blog posts. It specifically addresses Chinese linguistic nuances while preserving core meaning and appropriate tone, significantly enhancing the authenticity of AI-generated content.

items.z: Vibe Coding指南是AI结对编程的实战手册，通过自然语言交互让开发者专注创意而非实现细节。项目提供多语言支持的完整工作流，涵盖从构思到部署的全链路最佳实践，助力开发者构建AI驱动的高效编程范式。
items.e: Vibe Coding Guide is a practical handbook for AI pair programming, enabling developers to focus on creativity through natural language interaction. It offers a complete workflow with multilingual support, covering end-to-end best practices from ideation to deployment for building AI-driven development paradigms.

items.d: Why is this running? Trace any process, port, container, or file back to what started it - CLI + TUI.
items.z: witr是一款跨平台系统诊断工具，专为回答“为什么在运行”而生。它通过CLI或交互式TUI，一键追溯任意进程、端口、容器或文件的完整启动因果链，覆盖systemd、Docker、PM2等监督层，输出人类可读报告或JSON，补全传统ps/lsof工具的因果盲区，助力运维与排障。
items.e: witr is a cross-platform diagnostic CLI+TUI tool that answers “Why is this running?”. It traces any process, port, container or file back to its full startup causality chain—including supervisors like systemd, Docker and PM2—delivering human-readable output or machine-readable JSON in one command, filling the gap left by traditional tools like ps and lsof.

items.d: Open-source gym & body-weight tracker, now in the App Store (iPhone + Apple Watch) and as an Android APK. Plan routines, log workouts, see which muscles are trained, import from Strong/Hevy/FitNotes. Self-host it or use it on the phone alone.
items.z: openGym 是一款自托管健身与体重追踪应用，支持训练计划、组数记录、肌肉疲劳分析、跨设备同步与 Passkey 登录。数据完全由用户掌控，支持从 FitNotes/Strong/Hevy 导入，提供 Android APK 与 Web 端，是隐私优先的开源健身管理方案。
items.e: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker that lets you plan weekly routines, log every set including supersets, warm-ups, and cardio, and visualize which muscles are trained, fatigued, or detrained. It supports cross-device sync, passkey login, and data import from FitNotes, Strong, and Hevy. Your data stays on your own server, giving you full ownership and privacy. Available as a web app and Android APK, it's a privacy-first, open-source alternative to commercial fitness subscriptions, with stats dashboards featuring heatmaps, charts, and personal records.

items.d: A self hosted virtual browser that runs in docker and uses WebRTC.
items.z: Neko 是一款基于 Docker 的自托管虚拟浏览器，通过 WebRTC 实现低延迟桌面流传输。它提供安全隔离的浏览器环境，支持多用户同时访问，适用于隐私保护、团队协作和社交娱乐（如在线观影派对）。项目解决了传统共享方式（如 Discord）的崩溃问题，为远程互动提供稳定解决方案。
items.e: Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser running in Docker, streaming desktop via WebRTC. It offers a secure, isolated browsing environment with multi-user access, ideal for privacy protection, team collaboration, and social entertainment (e.g., watch parties). Designed to overcome instability of traditional sharing tools like Discord, it provides a stable, low-latency solution for remote interaction.

items.d: Elegant reading of real-time and hottest news
items.z: NewsNow 是一款优雅的实时热门新闻阅读器，聚合多源热点资讯，采用自适应抓取与缓存机制优化资源并防封禁，支持 GitHub 登录同步与 MCP 服务，提供极简 UI，易于部署于 Cloudflare、Vercel 或 Docker。
items.e: NewsNow is an elegant real-time trending news reader that aggregates multi-source hot topics with adaptive scraping and caching to optimize resources and avoid bans. It supports GitHub OAuth sync, MCP server, clean UI, and easy deployment on Cloudflare, Vercel, or Docker.

items.d: 健康学习到150岁 - 人体系统调优不完全指南
items.z: 本仓库基于斯坦福神经科学教授Andrew Huberman的同行评审研究，提供一套系统化的人体系统优化方案。核心是通过调控生物钟、间歇性禁食、科学运动和营养补充等零成本干预手段，像调优软件一样优化睡眠、代谢和认知功能。内容涵盖光疗调节昼夜节律、禁食机制促进细胞自噬、精准运动时机选择等实证方法，旨在实现健康寿命延长和工作学习表现提升。
items.e: This repository presents a systematic human system optimization framework based on peer-reviewed neuroscience research from Stanford Professor Andrew Huberman. It provides evidence-based, zero-cost interventions to optimize sleep, metabolism, and cognitive performance by treating the human body as a tunable system. Key methodologies include circadian rhythm regulation through light exposure, intermittent fasting for cellular autophagy, precision exercise timing, and targeted nutrition. The guide aims to extend healthspan and enhance daily performance through scientifically-validated practices rather than commercialized wellness trends.

items.d: AI video skill for Claude Code & Codex — cinematic, editable product promos with Remotion: 124 shot recipe cards, 150 motion previews, beat sync, sound design, Motion Workbench & JianYing (CapCut CN) export.
items.z: 生成失败
items.e: Generation failed

items.d: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。
items.z: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，采用增量编译模式构建自组织知识库，颠覆传统RAG每次查询重检索的机制。核心亮点包括：双阶段思维链文档摄入、多模态图像理解、四信号知识图谱、Louvain社区发现，以及本地API支持AI智能体调用。实现文档自动结构化为可追溯、可探索的互联知识网络。
items.e: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that incrementally builds a persistent, self-organizing knowledge base from documents—compiling knowledge once instead of re-deriving on every query like traditional RAG. Key features include two-step Chain-of-Thought ingestion, multimodal image understanding, 4-signal knowledge graph, Louvain community detection, and local API for AI agent integration. Automatically transforms documents into interconnected, explorable knowledge networks with source traceability.

items.d: macOS inside a Docker container.
items.z: 该项目通过Docker容器化技术结合KVM硬件加速，在非Apple硬件上实现macOS虚拟化。提供Web管理界面，支持macOS 11-15版本自动部署与灵活资源配置（存储/CPU/内存）。适用于iOS/macOS应用开发测试、CI/CD流水线及跨平台开发环境，为开发者提供无需Apple硬件的macOS虚拟化解决方案。
items.e: This project enables macOS virtualization on non-Apple hardware through Docker containerization with KVM hardware acceleration. It features web-based management, automated deployment of macOS versions 11-15 (Big Sur to Sequoia), and flexible configuration of storage, CPU, and RAM resources. Supporting Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and GitHub Codespaces deployment, it is ideal for iOS/macOS app development testing, CI/CD pipelines, and cross-platform development environments, providing developers with a convenient, production-ready macOS virtualization solution without Apple hardware requirements.

items.d: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model. Token-efficient image-to-3D.
items.z: img2threejs 是一个面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude）的开源技能，可将单张参考图像重建为代码生成的程序化 Three.js 3D 模型。它采用多阶段雕刻管道、严格质量门控、细节清单和代理视觉审查，确保比例、材质、细节高保真；Python 脚本处理验证与状态管理，实现令牌高效，输出为动画就绪的 TypeScript 代码（含枢轴、插槽），支持硬表面对象与角色。适用于网页 3D 应用、游戏道具与交互体验，重建方式为代码而非网格或摄影测量。
items.e: img2threejs is an open-source skill for AI coding agents (e.g., Claude) that reconstructs a single reference image into a code-only, procedural Three.js 3D model. It uses a multi-stage sculpting pipeline with strict quality gates, detail inventory, and agent-vision reviews for high-fidelity proportions, materials, and details. Python stdlib scripts handle validation and state for token efficiency, with the LLM focused on judgment. Outputs are animation-ready TypeScript factories from primitives and shaders, supporting hard-surface objects and characters. Ideal for web 3D apps, game props, and interactive experiences via code reconstruction rather than meshes.

items.d: 🆓免费的 ChatGPT 镜像网站列表，持续更新。List of free ChatGPT mirror sites, continuously updated.
items.z: 该仓库持续维护312个免费ChatGPT镜像站点列表，提供无需登录或低门槛访问GPT-4、Claude等AI模型的途径。收录网站涵盖完全免费、有免费额度等多种类型，并附带替代方案与自建指南，为开发者、研究人员及普通用户提供便捷的AI工具导航服务。
items.e: This repository maintains a continuously updated list of 312 free ChatGPT mirror sites, offering developers, researchers, and general users easy access to AI models like GPT-4, Claude, and DeepSeek without login or low barriers. It categorizes sites by free tiers, login requirements, and model support, while providing alternatives, self-hosting guides, prompt engineering resources, and developer tools for convenient AI tool discovery and implementation.

items.d: A full-featured, hackable Next.js AI chatbot built by Vercel
items.z: Vercel开源的全功能AI聊天机器人模板，基于Next.js 14 App Router与React Server Components构建。集成Vercel AI SDK提供统一LLM API，默认支持xAI，可无缝切换OpenAI等提供商。采用shadcn/ui组件与Tailwind CSS样式，数据持久化依托Neon Serverless Postgres和Vercel Blob存储，内置Auth.js认证。支持一键部署至Vercel，为开发者提供开箱即用的可扩展聊天应用解决方案。
items.e: Vercel's open-source, full-featured AI chatbot template built with Next.js 14 App Router and React Server Components. Powered by Vercel AI SDK for unified LLM API access, defaulting to xAI while supporting seamless integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. Features shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS, data persistence via Neon Serverless Postgres and Vercel Blob storage, and Auth.js authentication. Enables developers to quickly build and deploy hackable chatbot applications with one-click Vercel deployment.

items.d: Dism++ Multi-language Support & BUG Report
items.z: 该仓库是Dism++的多语言本地化资源库，为这款Windows系统优化工具提供16种语言的翻译文件，涵盖应用界面与官方网站。包含Data.xml系统清理规则配置及崩溃统计后台，默认开发语言为简体中文，由全球译者协作维护各语言版本的质量与准确性。
items.e: This repository hosts multilingual localization resources for Dism++, a Windows system optimization utility. It provides translation files for 16+ languages covering both the application interface and official website. The project includes Data.xml with system cleanup rules and a crash statistics backend. Default development language is Simplified Chinese, maintained through global translator collaboration to ensure localization quality across all language versions.

items.d: 【编程随想】收藏的电子书清单（多个学科，含下载链接）
items.z: 该仓库是'编程随想'博主整理的跨学科电子书库，涵盖政治、技术等多个领域。核心亮点在于采用Resilio Sync P2P技术实现去中心化分发，支持免翻墙自动同步，规避审查与流量限制。提供PDF/EPUB/MOBI等全格式支持，并附带详细的阅读技术指南，构建了一个抗审查的数字知识分发体系。
items.e: This repository hosts cross-disciplinary e-books curated by 'ProgramThink', covering politics, technology, and more. Its core innovation leverages Resilio Sync P2P technology for decentralized distribution, enabling censorship-resistant, auto-syncing downloads without VPN. It provides comprehensive format support (PDF/EPUB/MOBI) and detailed technical guides, forming a robust anti-censorship digital knowledge dissemination system.

items.d: Fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction. Intelligently detects scanned vs text-based PDFs to enable smart routing decisions.
items.z: Firecrawl出品的高性能Rust库，智能识别PDF类型（文本/扫描/混合），自动跳过54%无需OCR的文档。200ms内完成文本提取、多列布局识别、表格检测，输出结构化Markdown。纯Rust实现，比OCR方案快数个量级，适合大规模PDF处理场景。
items.e: A high-performance Rust library by Firecrawl that intelligently classifies PDFs (text-based/scanned/mixed) to bypass OCR for ~54% of documents. Processes text extraction, multi-column layouts, and table detection in under 200ms, outputting structured Markdown. Pure Rust implementation delivers orders of magnitude faster performance than OCR-based solutions, ideal for large-scale PDF processing.

items.d: ⛰️ LifeOS — The AI-powered Life Operating System that helps you hill climb to wherever you're going.
items.z: danielmiessler/LifeOS（Personal_AI_Infrastructure/PAI）是开源Agentic AI基础设施，定位为Life Operating System。它以Claude为核心构建个性化数字助手，深度捕获用户Telos、目标、知识与偏好；采用文本/Markdown文件系统作为上下文（无RAG）、自定义七阶段Algorithm驱动当前到理想状态转变，并集成Pulse仪表盘、技能系统与自改进循环。基于TypeScript与Bun构建，强调人类优先与上下文支架，适用于个人生产力、目标管理与全生命周期优化。
items.e: danielmiessler/LifeOS (Personal_AI_Infrastructure/PAI) is an open-source agentic AI infrastructure functioning as a Life Operating System. It builds a personalized Digital Assistant powered by Claude that deeply captures user Telos, goals, knowledge, and preferences. Key features include text/Markdown filesystem as context (no RAG), a custom 7-phase Algorithm for current-to-ideal state progression, Pulse dashboard, skills system, and self-improvement loops. Built with TypeScript and Bun on Claude Code, it prioritizes humans and context scaffolding for personal productivity, goal achievement, and holistic life optimization.

items.d: Translate the video from one language to another and embed dubbing & subtitles.
items.z: pyVideoTrans 是一款开源视频翻译工具，提供从语音识别、字幕翻译、AI配音到音视频合成的完整自动化流程。支持本地与云端多种 ASR、LLM 和 TTS 模型，集成 F5-TTS 等语音克隆技术，可区分多角色配音。具备交互式编辑、命令行操作及跨平台部署能力，适用于内容创作者与开发者实现高效视频本地化。
items.e: pyVideoTrans is a powerful open-source video translation toolkit that automates the entire pipeline from speech recognition to AI dubbing and subtitle embedding. It integrates local and cloud APIs for ASR, LLM translation, and TTS, featuring voice cloning (F5-TTS, CosyVoice), multi-role speaker diarization, and interactive proofreading. Supports both GUI and CLI operation across Windows, macOS, and Linux, enabling efficient batch processing and video localization for content creators and developers.

items.d: SimpleX - the first messaging network operating without user identifiers of any kind - 100% private by design! iOS, Android and desktop apps 📱!
items.z: SimpleX Chat是首个无任何用户标识符的消息平台，100%隐私设计，保护消息内容及元数据（通话对象与时间）。采用SMP协议通过单向匿名队列实现去中心化通信，支持用户自建服务器。具备双棘轮E2EE加密、多层防护、带外密钥交换、群组通话等功能。提供iOS、Android、桌面及CLI跨平台应用，适用于隐私敏感用户防范监控与垃圾信息场景。技术亮点包括便携加密存储和Tor支持。
items.e: SimpleX is the first messaging network operating without any user identifiers whatsoever, providing 100% privacy by design through protection of both message content and metadata. Built on the SimpleX Messaging Protocol (SMP), it uses unidirectional queues with pairwise anonymous addresses for decentralized, server-relayed communication where anyone can host servers. It features double-ratchet end-to-end encryption augmented with additional layers, out-of-band key exchange via links or QR codes, support for encrypted groups, calls, files, and optional Tor access. Cross-platform apps for iOS, Android, desktop, and terminal CLI enable portable encrypted data storage. Ideal for users prioritizing metadata privacy and spam resistance in secure communications.

items.d: The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC 🦬
items.z: Yaak 是一款隐私优先的跨平台桌面 API 客户端，全面支持 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket、SSE 和 gRPC 协议。基于 Tauri 框架构建，后端采用 Rust 实现高性能与安全性，前端使用 React 提供流畅交互。通过社区许可模式运营，为开发者提供直观、高效的 API 调试与管理解决方案。
items.e: Yaak is a privacy-first cross-platform desktop API client supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, and gRPC protocols. Built on Tauri framework with Rust backend and React frontend, it delivers high-performance API debugging experience. Community-funded through license purchases, it offers intuitive interface for developers to organize, test, and manage APIs efficiently.

items.d: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome, logged in as you. One prompt to set up. Open source, MIT.
items.z: Browser Harness 是一个自愈式浏览器控制框架，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直连真实浏览器，让 LLM 自主完成任意网页任务。其核心创新在于动态生成缺失的辅助代码并持续学习优化，每次运行都自我改进。提供可复用的领域技能系统，支持从 LinkedIn 营销到电商下单等复杂自动化场景，架构精简仅千行代码。
items.e: Browser Harness is a self-healing browser automation framework that connects LLMs directly to real browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Its core innovation lies in dynamically generating missing helper code during execution and continuously learning from each run. The framework features a reusable domain skills system for complex tasks like LinkedIn outreach and e-commerce ordering. With a minimal architecture of ~1k lines, it enables autonomous web task completion without predefined scripts, representing a new paradigm in LLM-driven browser automation.

items.d: SkillOpt is a text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents through trajectory-driven edits, validation-gated updates, and deployable best_skill.md artifacts.
items.z: SkillOpt是微软的文本空间优化器，为冻结LLM代理训练可复用自然语言技能。通过轨迹驱动编辑、验证门控更新，模拟神经网络训练（epochs、mini-batch、学习率），不修改模型权重，输出best_skill.md。支持SearchQA、ALFWorld等多基准，适用于自进化代理技能场景。技术亮点包括轨迹分析、迭代优化与可复用部署。
items.e: SkillOpt is a Microsoft text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents. It uses trajectory-driven edits, reflection, bounded updates, and held-out validation gates, mirroring neural network training with epochs, minibatches, learning rates, and gates—but entirely in text space without weight changes. It produces deployable best_skill.md artifacts and shows strong gains across benchmarks like SearchQA, ALFWorld, DocVQA, and others. Ideal for self-evolving, transferable agent skills in QA, tool-use, math, and embodied tasks.

items.d: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
items.z: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎基于倪海夏《天纪》体系，提供完整排盘算法、四化系统、1100+格局知识库及古籍原文。核心亮点是51.8万条命盘样本数据（5.5GB），可用于AI模型微调和RAG检索。技术栈采用TypeScript与Next.js 14，支持移动端适配，助力传统文化数字化与命理研究。
items.e: This open-source Ziwei Dou Shu astrology engine implements Ni Haixia's "Tian Ji" system, featuring complete charting algorithms, four transformations, 1100+ pattern knowledge base, and classical texts. It provides 518,000 chart samples (5.5GB) for AI model fine-tuning and RAG retrieval. Built with TypeScript and Next.js 14, it enables traditional metaphysics research, AI training data generation, and digital divination applications with modern web technologies, including mobile adaptation and theme switching.

items.d: The absolute trainer to light up AI agents.
items.z: Agent Lightning是微软开源的AI智能体训练框架，核心卖点是几乎无需代码变更即可优化任意智能体。它支持LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI等主流框架，甚至纯Python OpenAI代码。框架采用强化学习、自动提示优化等算法，可针对性地优化多智能体系统中的单个或多个智能体，显著提升智能体性能。
items.e: Agent Lightning is Microsoft's open-source AI agent training framework that optimizes agents with minimal code changes. It supports any agent framework including LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or even raw Python OpenAI code. The framework employs reinforcement learning, automatic prompt optimization, and supervised fine-tuning to selectively enhance individual or multiple agents within multi-agent systems. Its key innovation lies in framework-agnostic compatibility and zero-code optimization, enabling developers to rapidly improve agent performance without rebuilding existing implementations.

items.d: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
items.z: Maxun 是一款开源无代码网页数据平台，可将任意网站转化为结构化 API。它提供四大机器人类型：Extract（支持录制和 AI 自然语言提取）、Scrape（整页转 Markdown/HTML）、Crawl（全站爬取）和 Search（自动化搜索）。平台通过模拟真实用户行为，实现从简单到复杂的自动化数据采集，适用于 AI 工作流、竞品监控和商业智能等场景。
items.e: Maxun is an open-source no-code web data platform that transforms any website into structured APIs. It offers four robot types: Extract (with Recorder and AI natural language modes), Scrape (full-page to Markdown/HTML), Crawl (entire site crawling), and Search (automated web searches). By emulating real user behavior, it enables automated data collection workflows for AI pipelines, competitive intelligence, and business analytics.

items.d: Get started with building Fullstack Agents using Gemini 2.5 and LangGraph
items.z: 基于Gemini 2.5和LangGraph的全栈研究型智能体快速启动模板。前端采用React，后端使用LangGraph构建具备反思能力的AI代理，可动态生成搜索词、执行网页检索、识别知识缺口并迭代优化，最终生成带引用的权威答案。提供完整的开发热重载流程，是构建生产级研究增强对话AI的典范参考架构。
items.e: Fullstack research agent quickstart template integrating React frontend with LangGraph backend, powered by Gemini 2.5. The agent implements reflective reasoning to dynamically generate search queries, perform web research via Google Search API, identify knowledge gaps, and iteratively refine its approach until producing comprehensive, cited answers. Includes hot-reloading development workflow and CLI example, serving as a production-ready reference for building sophisticated research-augmented conversational AI systems.

items.d: FastAPI Best Practices and Conventions we used at our startup
items.z: 初创公司生产环境沉淀的 FastAPI 开发规范，提供领域驱动的项目结构、Pydantic 深度使用策略、异步依赖注入优化方案，以及数据库约定、测试策略等实战指南。专为中大型单体应用设计，帮助团队建立一致、可扩展的 API 开发体系，规避架构陷阱。
items.e: Production-tested FastAPI development conventions from a startup, offering domain-driven project structure, in-depth Pydantic usage strategies, async dependency injection optimization, and practical guidelines for database conventions and testing. Designed for medium-to-large monolithic applications, it helps teams build consistent, scalable API systems while avoiding architectural pitfalls.

items.d: Simple and easy to use DDNS. Support Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Dnspod, Cloudflare, Callback, Huawei Cloud, Baidu Cloud, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Namecheap, NameSilo...
items.z: ddns-go 是一款用Go开发的轻量级动态域名解析工具，支持阿里云、腾讯云、Cloudflare等20余家主流DNS服务商。可自动检测公网IPv4/IPv6地址变化并实时同步至域名记录，适用于家庭宽带、小型服务器等动态IP场景。提供Web管理界面、Docker部署方案及系统服务化运行能力，支持多平台、多架构与Webhook通知。
items.e: ddns-go is a lightweight Dynamic DNS client built with Golang, supporting 20+ major DNS providers like Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Cloudflare and more. It automatically detects public IPv4/IPv6 address changes and synchronizes them to domain records in real-time, perfect for home broadband, small servers and IoT devices with dynamic IPs. The tool offers a user-friendly web interface, Docker deployment, system service integration, multi-platform compatibility (Windows/macOS/Linux, ARM/x86/RISC-V) and customizable webhook notifications.

items.d: A vector index built on TurboQuant, written in Rust with Python bindings
items.z: turbovec 是基于 Google TurboQuant 算法的 Rust 向量索引库，提供 Python 绑定。无需训练即可在线摄入向量，将 1000 万 float32 向量从 31GB 压缩至 4GB，搜索速度媲美或超越 FAISS。支持 SIMD 优化内核、搜索时内核过滤、稳定 ID 及 O(1) 删除，专为隐私敏感、低内存、低延迟的 RAG 场景设计，支持 LangChain 等框架无缝集成，实现完全本地化向量搜索。
items.e: turbovec is a Rust vector index with Python bindings built on Google's TurboQuant algorithm. It enables training-free online ingestion, compressing a 10M float32 vector corpus from 31GB to 4GB while matching or exceeding FAISS search speeds via SIMD kernels. Features include in-kernel filtering for hybrid retrieval, stable IDs with O(1) deletes, and persistence. Ideal for privacy-focused, memory-efficient, low-latency RAG, with drop-in integrations for LangChain, LlamaIndex, and others for fully local vector search.

items.d: Admin Dashboard UI built with Shadcn and Vite.
items.z: satnaing/shadcn-admin 是基于 Shadcn UI 和 Vite 构建的企业级管理后台 UI 组件库。提供 10+ 预置页面、响应式布局、亮暗主题切换及完善的 RTL 语言支持，深度优化可访问性。通过自定义 Shadcn 组件与 TanStack Router 集成，为开发者提供可直接复用的生产级界面解决方案，显著加速后台系统开发。
items.e: satnaing/shadcn-admin is a production-grade admin dashboard UI library built with Shadcn UI and Vite. It features 10+ pre-built pages, responsive layouts, light/dark themes, comprehensive RTL support, and deep accessibility optimization. By customizing Shadcn components and integrating TanStack Router, it delivers reusable, enterprise-ready UI solutions that dramatically accelerate backend development.

items.d: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
items.z: Sure 是一款开源个人理财与财富管理应用，由社区维护的 Maybe Finance 分支发展而来。支持 Docker 自托管，提供浏览器、macOS 桌面、移动端、API 及 LLM 代理等多种客户端，内置 AI 助手解答财务问题，帮助用户全面掌控现金流、净资产与消费支出。
items.e: Sure is an open-source personal finance and wealth management app, a community-maintained fork of Maybe Finance. It supports Docker self-hosting and offers multiple clients including browser, macOS desktop, mobile, API, and LLM agents. An AI assistant answers financial questions, helping users track cashflow, net worth, and spending.

items.d: A lightweight, lightning-fast, in-process vector database
items.z: Zvec 是阿里巴巴开源的轻量级进程内向量数据库，基于内部验证的 Proxima 搜索引擎构建。它提供毫秒级十亿向量相似性检索，支持密集/稀疏向量与混合查询，无需独立服务即可直接嵌入应用。适用于推荐系统、语义搜索等场景，具备生产级性能、低延迟与极简部署的核心优势。
items.e: Zvec is a lightweight, open-source in-process vector database developed by Alibaba, powered by the battle-tested Proxima search engine. It provides millisecond-level similarity search for billions of vectors, natively supporting dense and sparse embeddings with hybrid search combining semantic and structured filters. As an embeddable library, it requires no standalone server and runs directly within applications. Ideal for recommendation systems, semantic search, and edge AI scenarios, Zvec delivers production-grade performance, low latency, and effortless deployment across platforms from cloud servers to edge devices.

items.d: 简简单单的看直播
items.z: Simple Live 是基于 Flutter 3.38 和 Dart 开发的跨平台直播聚合应用，支持虎牙、斗鱼、B站、抖音四大平台。项目采用 core+app+tv 模块化架构，覆盖 Android/iOS/Windows/macOS/Linux/TV 全终端，集成弹幕系统。作为开源学习项目，展示直播协议解析与 Flutter 全平台开发实践。
items.e: Simple Live is a cross-platform live streaming aggregation application developed with Flutter 3.38 and Dart language. It integrates mainstream platforms including Huya, Douyu, Bilibili, and TikTok, providing a unified viewing experience. The project adopts a modular architecture with separate core library, console, mobile app, and TV client, supporting Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android TV. Key features include real-time danmaku display and multi-platform synchronization. As an educational open-source project, it showcases practical implementations of live streaming protocol parsing and Flutter's full-platform development capabilities.

items.d: Self-hosted, plugin-based server management.
items.z: Termix是一款开源自托管的Web服务器管理平台，为系统管理员提供一体化运维解决方案。核心功能包括：全功能SSH终端（支持分屏与标签页）、SSH隧道管理（自动重连与健康监测）、远程文件管理（支持代码/媒体编辑与Sudo权限）、Docker容器管控及服务器监控（CPU/内存/磁盘/防火墙）。采用React+Tailwind构建现代化响应式界面，支持RBAC权限体系、OIDC/2FA认证与SQLite数据库加密，是Termius的开源免费替代方案。
items.e: Termix is an open-source, self-hosted web platform for comprehensive server infrastructure management. It provides a full-featured SSH terminal with split-screen and tab support, automated SSH tunneling with health monitoring, and a remote file manager with sudo privileges. The platform integrates Docker container management, real-time server monitoring (CPU/memory/disk/network/firewall), and RBAC-based team collaboration. Built with React and Tailwind CSS, it features OIDC/2FA authentication, encrypted SQLite storage, and automatic SSL setup, serving as a free, all-in-one alternative to commercial solutions like Termius.

items.d: 一站式原生AI PPT生成应用，几分钟内生成一套幻灯片; 支持上传任意模板图片，上传任意素材&智能解析，一句话/大纲/页面描述自动生成PPT，口头修改指定区域、一键导出可编辑ppt、视频等 - An AI-native slides generator based on nano banana/gpt-image🏞️
items.z: 基于 nano banana pro 的 AI 原生 PPT 生成器，实现真正的'Vibe PPT'。支持一句话/大纲生成、自然语言修改、智能素材解析与自定义模板，突破传统工具同质化限制。一键导出可编辑 PPTX/PDF，适用于职场提案、教学课件、学生作业等场景，大幅降低专业演示文稿制作门槛。
items.e: An AI-native PPT generator built on nano banana pro, pioneering the 'Vibe PPT' concept. It enables creation via natural language prompts, outlines, or page descriptions, with intelligent material parsing and custom template support. Features vocal modification, one-click editable PPTX/PDF export, breaking traditional tools' homogeneity. Ideal for business proposals, educational content, and student projects, democratizing professional presentation design.

items.d: Structured Outputs
items.z: Outlines 是一款专为 LLM 提供结构化输出的 Python 库。它在生成阶段直接施加约束，确保输出严格符合 Pydantic 模型、枚举或特定类型，无需后处理解析。兼容 OpenAI、Ollama、vLLM 等任意模型，集成简便且提供商无关。核心亮点包括类型系统驱动的约束生成、跨模型一致性及 100% 有效输出保障。适用于客户支持分类、电商产品归类、事件解析、函数调用等生产场景，被 NVIDIA、Hugging Face 等采用，提升 AI 应用可靠性与自动化水平。
items.e: Outlines is a Python library for generating structured outputs from LLMs by enforcing constraints during generation. It supports any model provider including OpenAI, Ollama, vLLM, and Transformers, with simple integration via Pydantic models, literals, or enums. This ensures 100% valid outputs like JSON without post-processing. Key features include provider independence, type-system philosophy mirroring Python, and guaranteed compliance. Ideal for customer support triage, e-commerce categorization, event parsing, and function calling. Trusted by NVIDIA, Cohere, and Hugging Face for reliable production AI systems.

items.d: A web client for its own Xray-based core with global transparent proxy on Linux, Windows and macOS.
items.z: v2rayA 是一款基于 V2Ray 内核的跨平台代理客户端，提供直观的 Web 图形界面。支持 VMess、VLESS、SS、SSR、Trojan、Tuic 和 Juicity 等主流协议，可在 Linux 实现全局透明代理，Windows/macOS 支持系统代理。项目支持 Docker、路由器、NAS 等多种部署方式，所有用户数据本地存储，适合需要安全便捷网络访问的场景。
items.e: v2rayA is a cross-platform proxy client based on V2Ray core with an intuitive Web GUI. It supports major protocols including VMess, VLESS, SS, SSR, Trojan, Tuic and Juicity, offering global transparent proxy on Linux and system proxy on Windows/macOS. Deployable via Docker, routers, NAS and multiple package managers, it stores all user data locally, ideal for secure and convenient network access.

items.d: Chinese copywriting guidelines for better written communication／中文文案排版指北
items.z: 该仓库提供全面的中文文案排版规范，系统性地统一中英文、数字间的空格规则，规范标点符号使用、全半角字符标准，以及专有名词正确大小写。旨在降低团队协作沟通成本，提升内容质量和网站专业气质。包含丰富实用示例和争议性案例讨论，并集成pangu.js等自动化工具实现规则检查。适用于网站、文档、UI界面等所有中文内容创作场景，是开发者、设计师和内容创作者的标准化必备参考指南。
items.e: This repository provides comprehensive Chinese copywriting and typesetting guidelines, standardizing spacing between Chinese/English characters and numbers, proper punctuation usage, and correct capitalization. It aims to reduce team communication costs and enhance content quality. Includes practical examples, controversial edge cases, and integrates automation tools like pangu.js for rule enforcement. Essential for developers, designers, and content creators working with Chinese language content across websites, documentation, and UI interfaces.

items.d: 📻Free and open-sourced terminal/ssh/sftp/ftp/telnet/serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice client(Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, HarmonyOS, iOS)
items.z: electerm 是一款开源的跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，集成 SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/串口/RDP/VNC 等多种协议。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux（含 ARM64），提供全局热键、透明窗口、背景图片等特性。内置 AI 助手（DeepSeek/OpenAI）与 MCP 协议支持，实现命令建议与工具集成。通过 Zmodem/Trzsz 实现文件传输，并可将配置同步至 GitHub/Gitee Gist，是开发者管理远程服务器的全能工具。
items.e: electerm is an open-source, cross-platform terminal and remote connection client that consolidates SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC, and Spice protocols into a single application. Built on Electron, it supports Windows, macOS, and Linux (including ARM64 architectures). Key features include global hotkeys for instant access, transparent windows, terminal background images, and integrated AI assistants (DeepSeek, OpenAI) via MCP protocol for command suggestions and script generation. It facilitates file transfers through Zmodem and Trzsz, supports SSH tunneling and proxy configurations, and allows synchronization of bookmarks and settings to GitHub/Gitee Gist, making it a versatile tool for developers and system administrators managing remote infrastructure.

items.d: A powerful tool for creating datasets for LLM fine-tuning 、RAG and Eval
items.z: Easy Dataset 是一款专为大语言模型训练设计的数据集构建工具。它支持 PDF、Markdown、DOCX 等格式的智能解析与切分，可自动生成高质量问答对、多轮对话及图像问答数据集。内置领域标签树、数据清洗和增强功能，适用于微调、RAG 和评估场景。1.7.0 版本新增评估系统。
items.e: Easy Dataset is a specialized tool for building LLM training datasets. It intelligently parses and chunks documents in PDF, Markdown, DOCX, TXT, and EPUB formats, automatically generating high-quality QA pairs, multi-turn dialogues, and visual QA datasets. Features include domain label trees, data cleaning/augmentation, and support for fine-tuning, RAG, and evaluation scenarios. Version 1.7.0 introduces a comprehensive evaluation system with multi-dimensional assessment and human blind testing capabilities for domain-specific model validation, post-fine-tuning evaluation, and RAG recall rate assessment tasks in production environments.

items.d: The most powerful local music generation model that outperforms almost all commercial alternatives, supporting Mac, AMD, Intel, and CUDA devices.
items.z: ACE-Step 1.5 是开源音乐生成基础模型，采用语言模型与扩散Transformer混合架构，通过内在强化学习实现商业级音质。支持50+语言歌词生成与1000+音乐风格，可在4GB显存设备本地运行，A100上生成速度达2秒/首。提供音频编辑、人声转伴奏等创作工具，赋能音乐制作人与内容创作者。
items.e: ACE-Step 1.5 is an open-source music foundation model featuring a hybrid LM-DiT architecture with intrinsic reinforcement learning, delivering commercial-grade audio quality on consumer hardware (<4GB VRAM). It generates full songs in under 2 seconds on A100, supports 50+ languages and 1000+ musical styles, and offers versatile editing tools including vocal-to-BGM conversion and multi-track generation. The model enables lightweight personalization through LoRA training with minimal data, revolutionizing AI-assisted music creation for producers and content creators.

items.d: Plan, run and supervise fleets of agents from task to merged PR. Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) + iPhone & Android apps.  Supports Claude Code, Codex & 35+ coding agents.
items.z: Agent Orchestrator 是一款跨平台桌面应用，用于统一编排和监督多个编码 AI 智能体（支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 25+ 工具）。每个任务独立分配智能体、隔离工作区和 Git 分支，通过实时看板追踪 PR、CI 和评审全流程，实现从规划到合并的自动化协作开发。
items.e: Agent Orchestrator is a cross-platform desktop workspace for orchestrating and supervising teams of coding AI agents from planning to merge. It supports 25+ agent harnesses including Claude Code and Codex. Each task gets its own agent, isolated workspace, and dedicated Git branch. A live Kanban board tracks workers, pull requests, CI runs, and code reviews in real time. A local daemon monitors agent activity and source-control state, providing a unified project view instead of disconnected terminals and branches. It enables efficient parallel development across multiple coding agents.

items.d: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
items.z: waoowaoo是首家工业级全流程AI影视生产平台，通过AI Agent实现小说到视频的全自动改编。支持剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜制作、AI配音等好莱坞标准工作流，基于Next.js全栈框架与Docker容器化部署，为短剧和漫画视频创作提供可控、高效的生产解决方案。
items.e: waoowaoo is the industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film and video production. It automates the entire workflow from novel text to finished videos, featuring AI script analysis, character/scene generation, storyboard production, and multi-voice synthesis following Hollywood-standard pipelines. Built on Next.js 15 full-stack framework with Docker containerization, MySQL database, and Redis queue system, it delivers an industrial-grade solution for short drama and manga video creation, enabling scalable, efficient, and consistent content generation for professional creators.

items.d: Fully autonomous & self-evolving research from idea to paper. Chat an Idea. Get a Paper. 🦞
items.z: AutoResearchClaw 是一个全自动化学术研究流水线，可将单一研究想法转化为会议级论文。系统采用23阶段流程，集成 arXiv 和 Semantic Scholar 真实文献检索、硬件感知的代码实验（GPU/MPS/CPU 自动检测）、多智能体同行评审（CodeAgent、BenchmarkAgent、FigureAgent）以及 NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR 的 LaTeX 模板生成。通过4层引用验证和AI-slop检测确保学术严谨性，无需人工干预即可完成从构思到论文的全流程。
items.e: AutoResearchClaw is a fully autonomous 23-stage research pipeline that transforms a single idea into a conference-ready academic paper. It integrates real literature search from arXiv and Semantic Scholar, hardware-aware sandboxed experiments with automatic GPU/MPS/CPU detection, multi-agent peer review (CodeAgent, BenchmarkAgent, FigureAgent), and generates LaTeX papers using NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR templates. The system ensures academic rigor through 4-layer citation integrity verification and AI-slop detection, delivering complete papers with verified BibTeX references without human intervention.

items.d: 📡 Your own AI-powered news radar. Generates daily briefings in English & Chinese. | 用 AI 构建你专属的新闻雷达
items.z: AI驱动的新闻聚合雷达，自动抓取Hacker News、Reddit、RSS等多源资讯，通过Claude/GPT等模型进行去重、评分与摘要，生成个性化双语日报。支持自定义源、阈值与Feishu/邮件推送，保留人工筛选层，高效过滤信息噪音。
items.e: Horizon is an AI-powered news radar that automatically aggregates content from Hacker News, Reddit, RSS, Telegram, Twitter/X, and GitHub releases. It uses Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or Ollama models to deduplicate, score (0-10), summarize, and enrich stories with background context and community discussions. The tool generates personalized bilingual daily briefings delivered via Feishu, email, or web, featuring customizable sources, thresholds, and human-in-the-loop curation to filter noise while preserving trusted content.

items.d: Practice your rust skill hardly
items.z: Rust By Practice是专为Rust学习者设计的在线交互式练习手册，通过大量从易到难的示例、练习与实践项目，覆盖异步、并发、标准库、数据结构和算法等全方面知识。每题均可在线编辑运行并提供完整解答，旨在填补理论学习与真实项目落地之间的鸿沟，帮助快速上手Rust实战。
items.e: Rust By Practice is an interactive online exercise book designed for Rust learners. It offers extensive examples, challenges and projects covering async/await, concurrency, standard libraries, data structures and algorithms. Exercises can be edited and run online with full solutions, bridging the gap between learning and real-world project readiness with progressive difficulty levels.

items.d: Self-evolving agent: grows skill tree from 3.3K-line seed, achieving full system control with 6x less token consumption
items.z: GenericAgent是一个极简的自进化智能体框架，仅3K行核心代码，通过9个原子工具实现系统级控制（浏览器、终端、文件系统等）。它自动将任务执行路径固化为技能，形成个人技能树，支持多模型与跨平台，上下文窗口小于30K，显著降低token消耗与幻觉，提升任务成功率。
items.e: GenericAgent is a minimal self-evolving autonomous agent framework with only ~3K lines of core code. Through 9 atomic tools, it grants LLMs system-level control over browsers, terminals, filesystems, and more. It automatically crystallizes task execution paths into reusable skills, forming a personal skill tree. Supporting multiple models and cross-platform, it uses a <30K context window, reducing token consumption and hallucinations.

items.d: 一键DD/重装脚本 (One-click reinstall OS on VPS)
items.z: 该脚本为 VPS 提供一键重装解决方案，支持 19 种 Linux 发行版与 Windows 官方原版 ISO 互转。采用分区表 ID 识别硬盘确保操作安全，智能配置动静态网络适配 /32、纯 IPv6 等特殊环境，内存占用低于官方 netboot，兼容 BIOS/EFI 及 ARM 架构，所有资源实时从官方源获取。
items.e: This script provides a one-click OS reinstall solution for VPS, supporting 19 Linux distributions and Windows official ISO cross-installation between Linux and Windows systems. It uses partition table ID to identify disks ensuring operation safety, intelligently configures static/dynamic networking for special environments like /32, pure IPv6, and IPv4/IPv6 on different NICs. Optimized for low-resource VPS with minimal memory footprint, it supports BIOS/EFI and ARM architectures, sourcing all resources directly from official mirrors in real-time without custom packages.

items.d: AI that sees your screen, listens to your conversations and tells you what to do
items.z: Omi是开源的AI第二大脑，实时捕捉屏幕与对话内容，自动生成转录、摘要及行动项。跨平台支持macOS、iOS、Android及可穿戴设备，采用Swift/Rust/Flutter技术栈，集成Deepgram语音识别与LLM大模型，构建具备长期记忆的智能助手，已获30万+专业人士信赖。
items.e: Omi is an open-source AI second brain that captures screen content and conversations in real-time, automatically generating transcripts, summaries, and action items. Built with Swift/Rust/Flutter for cross-platform support across desktop, mobile, and wearables, it integrates Deepgram speech recognition and LLMs to create a memory-capable AI assistant. The system processes audio via GPU-accelerated VAD and diarization, storing data in Firestore with Redis caching. Trusted by 300,000+ professionals, it offers a chat interface that remembers all user interactions.

items.d: The open-source Claude Motion & CapCut alternative. Turn a reference video into editable motion graphics with your brand kit. Export MP4s for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok. A full-stack agentic video studio with 300+ Motion.md guides and support for 22 agents, including Claude Code, Codex, DSH, and WorkBuddy.
items.z: OpenMotion 是首个全栈智能体视频生成器，支持上传参考视频或粘贴链接，通过 HTML 编码视频，用自有品牌素材重新创作。内置 Motion.md 格式描述镜头顺序与转场，支持 BYOA/BYOK，集成图像、视频、音乐和语音生成。
items.e: OpenMotion is the first full-stack agentic video generator. Upload a reference video or paste a social link to recreate it with your own brand kit. Code video with HTML, edit timing in Studio, and render MP4. Features Motion.md format for shot order, timing, and transitions.
