Supports BYOA/BYOK with 22 local agents and built-in models for images, video, music, and voice.

items.d: Removes 20+ patterns of AI slop from any piece of writing.
items.z: No AI Slop 是一个专为 Claude、Codex 等 AI 助手设计的全局技能，通过 20+ 模式规则移除写作中的 AI 痕迹，如二元对比、虚伪洞见、专家归因、戏剧化碎片等，同时强化主动语态、具体表述和清晰结构。支持草稿编辑（最小修改+变更说明）和 AI 风格检测两种模式，自带 eval.md 自检机制，适用于内容创作、营销文案和 AI 输出润色场景，帮助产出更自然、专业的人类化文本。
items.e: No AI Slop is a prompt-based skill for AI harnesses like Claude Code and Codex that detects and removes 20+ patterns of AI-generated writing clichés, including binary contrasts, weasel attributions, faux-insights, and dramatic fragmentation. It enforces active voice, concrete details, and clear structure while providing minimal edits with change summaries or detailed slop detection. Self-evaluated via eval.md, it excels at refining AI-assisted drafts into authentic, high-quality prose for content creation and editing workflows.

items.d: AutoHotkey - macro-creation and automation-oriented scripting utility for Windows.
items.z: AutoHotkey是Windows平台开源自动化脚本工具，专注于宏创建与重复任务自动化。采用自定义脚本语言，提供强大的热键定义、快捷键重映射及GUI自动化能力。基于C++开发，支持Visual Studio编译，兼容Unicode/ANSI。v2版本持续更新，v1由社区维护，支持Windows XP至11系统，是提升工作效率的利器。
items.e: AutoHotkey is a powerful open-source automation scripting tool for Windows, specializing in macro creation and repetitive task automation. It features a custom scripting language with robust hotkey definition capabilities, enabling keyboard shortcut remapping, automated operations, and GUI scripting. Developed in C++, it supports compilation via Visual Studio and VS Code, with Unicode/ANSI compatibility. The actively maintained v2 branch coexists with community-supported v1, supporting Windows XP through 11. It's an essential utility for enhancing productivity through automation.

items.d: Gradio WebUI for creators and developers, featuring key TTS (Edge-TTS, kokoro) and zero-shot Voice Cloning (E2 & F5-TTS, CosyVoice), with Whisper audio processing, YouTube download, Demucs vocal isolation, and multilingual translation.
items.z: Voice-Pro是集YouTube视频下载、人声分离、语音识别、多语言翻译与TTS于一体的AI音频创作平台。基于Gradio构建，集成Whisper、F5-TTS、CosyVoice等前沿模型，支持零样本语音克隆与高质量配音，为创作者提供一站式多语言内容本地化解决方案，显著提升跨语言内容生产效率。
items.e: Voice-Pro is an all-in-one AI audio creation platform that seamlessly integrates YouTube video downloading, vocal isolation, speech recognition, multilingual translation and text-to-speech capabilities. Built on Gradio with cutting-edge models including Whisper, F5-TTS, E2-TTS and CosyVoice, it enables zero-shot voice cloning and professional-grade dubbing. The platform provides creators and developers with a comprehensive solution for multilingual content localization, significantly enhancing cross-lingual content production efficiency.

items.d: The all-in-one, open-source backend platform for agentic coding. InsForge gives your coding agent database, auth, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway to ship full-stack apps end-to-end.
items.z: InsForge 是专为 AI 编程代理打造的**开源一体化后端平台**，提供数据库、认证、存储、计算、托管及 AI 网关等全栈能力。通过 **MCP Server** 和 **CLI+Skills** 双模式，让 AI 代理能像资深后端工程师一样操作资源，实现应用开发、部署、调试的端到端自动化，极大提升 AI 编程效率与质量。
items.e: InsForge is an **open-source, all-in-one backend platform** purpose-built for agentic coding. It equips AI coding agents with comprehensive capabilities including database, authentication, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway. Through dual interfaces of **MCP Server** (self-hosted/cloud) and **CLI+Skills** (cloud-only), agents can operate backend resources like professional engineers, enabling **end-to-end automation** of full-stack application development, deployment, and debugging, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and quality.

items.d: 中文小黑怪诞正文配图生成 Skill | 16:9 白底手绘 | 少量红橙蓝批注 | Codex Skill
items.z: Codex Skill，专为中文文章生成16:9白底手绘怪诞正文配图。以“小黑”IP为核心角色参与动作，提炼认知锚点转化为流程、状态或隐喻图，配少量红橙蓝中文批注，适合知识内容与方法论插图，强调记忆点而非信息图。
items.e: A Codex Skill that turns Chinese articles into 16:9 white-background hand-drawn surreal illustrations. Centered on the “Xiaohei” character actively performing key actions, it visualizes cognitive anchors as processes, states or metaphors with sparse red-orange-blue annotations, ideal for knowledge and methodology content.

items.d: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
items.z: NoteGen是一款轻量级(25MB)跨平台Markdown笔记应用，深度融合AI智能能力，原生支持RAG检索增强与MCP协议，能够智能桥接碎片化记录与结构化写作，实现知识高效组织与管理。
items.e: Lightweight (25MB) cross-platform Markdown note app with AI, RAG and MCP support for intelligent knowledge organization.

items.d: Make changes to FMHY
items.z: FMHY 是一个社区驱动的免费资源聚合平台，汇集互联网海量免费资源链接索引。项目采用 GitHub 协作模式，提供网站、JSON API 和 Markdown 多格式访问，支持实时更新与备份。核心价值在于为开发者、研究人员和普通用户提供一站式免费资源发现服务，通过开放协作机制确保资源时效性与多样性，是数字资源领域的'开源目录'典范。
items.e: FMHY is a community-driven free resources aggregation platform that indexes vast free content across the internet. Leveraging GitHub collaboration, it offers multi-format access via website, JSON API, and Markdown exports with real-time updates and backups. The project serves as a one-stop discovery hub for developers, researchers, and general users seeking free tools and media. Its open contribution model ensures resource diversity and timeliness, establishing a paradigm of 'open-source directory' in digital resources.

items.d: Pocket Flow: Codebase to Tutorial
items.z: 这是一个基于 Pocket Flow 框架的 AI 代码库分析项目，能自动爬取 GitHub 仓库并构建知识库，通过识别核心抽象和交互关系，将复杂代码转化为适合新手的可视化教程。项目已生成 AutoGen、FastAPI、LangGraph 等热门框架的教程，并在 Hacker News 获得 900+ 赞。提供在线服务 code2tutorial.com，用户只需粘贴 GitHub 链接即可生成教程，极大降低了代码库的学习门槛。
items.e: This project uses the Pocket Flow LLM framework to automatically crawl GitHub repositories and build knowledge bases. It analyzes entire codebases to identify core abstractions and interactions, transforming complex code into beginner-friendly tutorials with visualizations. The system has generated tutorials for popular frameworks like AutoGen, FastAPI, and LangGraph, reaching Hacker News front page with 900+ upvotes. An online service at code2tutorial.com is now available, allowing users to simply paste a GitHub link to generate tutorials without installation.

items.d: OCR model that handles complex tables, forms, handwriting with full layout.
items.z: Chandra OCR 2 是业界领先的文档智能模型，专精于复杂表格、手写体及数学公式的精准识别。支持90+语言，完美保留原始布局，输出HTML/Markdown/JSON结构化数据。提供本地(HuggingFace)与云端(vLLM)双模式，在手写表单、技术文档等场景表现卓越，是企业级文档自动化的核心引擎。
items.e: Chandra OCR 2 is a state-of-the-art document intelligence model excelling at complex tables, handwriting, and mathematical formulas. Supporting 90+ languages, it preserves full layout fidelity while outputting structured HTML/Markdown/JSON. With dual inference modes (local HuggingFace and remote vLLM), it delivers exceptional performance for forms, technical documents, and multilingual content, serving as a core engine for enterprise document automation.

items.d: An image-to-world skillset for Claude.
items.z: image-blaster 是一款基于 Claude AI 的图像转3D世界工具，5分钟内从单张图片生成可探索的3D环境、动态物体模型和音效。集成 World Labs Marble、Hunyuan 3D 和 FAL 等模型，支持 Unity/Unreal/Blender 等主流平台，为游戏开发、影视场景和建筑可视化提供自动化3D内容创作能力。
items.e: image-blaster is a revolutionary Claude AI-powered image-to-world skillset that transforms any single image into a fully realized 3D environment in under 5 minutes. The system intelligently orchestrates World Labs Marble for explorable Gaussian splat environments, Hunyuan 3D via FAL for textured mesh generation, and ElevenLabs for immersive sound effects. Designed for seamless integration with Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, and Three.js, it dramatically accelerates workflows in game development, film location scouting, architectural visualization, and robotics simulation.

items.d: 👩‍🚒 Good content deserves good paper. Layout rules and templates that let AI agents export PDF, PNG and editable PowerPoint.
items.z: Kami是AI文档生成的设计约束系统，解决AI输出布局混乱、设计平庸的核心痛点。内置10种专业模板（财报、简历、PPT、落地页等），通过统一约束语言确保视觉一致性。深度支持中英日CJK语言，专为Claude等AI Agent设计，开箱即用，轻量高效，让AI文档达到可交付品质。
items.e: Kami is a design constraint system for AI-generated documents, addressing inconsistent layouts and generic designs in AI outputs. It provides 10 professional templates (equity reports, resumes, slides, portfolios, landing pages) with unified constraints for visual consistency. Built for AI agents like Claude Code, it offers first-class English/Chinese support and best-effort Japanese/CJK. The lightweight system integrates seamlessly, enabling agents to produce production-ready, polished documents directly.

items.d: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
items.z: Chrome MCP Server是一款基于Chrome扩展的Model Context Protocol服务器，让AI助手直接控制用户现有浏览器。核心优势在于复用日常Chrome环境的登录状态与配置，实现隐私优先的本地自动化。提供20+工具支持截图、网络监控、书签管理等，内置SIMD加速的向量数据库实现智能语义搜索，跨标签页上下文感知，适用于复杂浏览器自动化与内容分析场景。
items.e: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol server that transforms your existing Chrome browser into an AI-controlled automation tool. Unlike Playwright-based solutions, it directly leverages your daily browser with preserved login states and configurations, ensuring privacy through local execution. It offers 20+ tools for screenshots, network monitoring, bookmark management, and more, plus SIMD-accelerated vector search for semantic content discovery. Cross-tab context awareness enables complex browser automation and intelligent content analysis for any LLM or chatbot client.

items.d: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
items.z: MemOS是面向LLM与AI Agent的自演化记忆操作系统，统一长期记忆的存/取/管，支持多模态、图结构API、MemCube知识库与混合检索。实现跨任务技能复用、异步调度与反馈校正，显著降低Token消耗，兼容DeepSeek Harness等生态，赋能持久上下文与个性化Agent。
items.e: MemOS is a self-evolving Memory Operating System for LLMs and AI Agents, unifying store/retrieve/manage of long-term memory with multi-modal support, graph-structured API, MemCube knowledge bases and hybrid retrieval. It enables cross-task skill reuse, async scheduling and feedback correction, delivering major token savings and DeepSeek Harness compatibility for persistent, personalized agents.

items.d: 📱 Display and control your Android device graphically with scrcpy.
items.z: Escrcpy 是基于 scrcpy 的跨平台 Android 设备图形化管控工具。通过 Electron 封装提供直观界面，支持多设备并行管理与可视化窗口编排。核心亮点包括集成 AutoGLM 实现自然语言智能控制、自动化工作流执行，以及 Gnirehtet 反向网络共享。适用于移动开发测试、批量设备操作等场景，提供低延迟、高性能的屏幕镜像体验。
items.e: Escrcpy is a cross-platform Android device management tool built on scrcpy. It provides an intuitive Electron-based GUI for mirroring and controlling Android devices with low latency. Key features include multi-device orchestration, natural language control via AutoGLM AI, automated workflow execution, and wireless connectivity with Gnirehtet reverse tethering. Ideal for mobile development, testing, and batch device operations.

items.d: Stealth headless browser for AI agents — bypass Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping. Drop-in Puppeteer/Playwright replacement.
items.z: camofox-browser 是基于 Camoufox（C++ 层修改的 Firefox 内核）构建的反检测浏览器服务，专为 AI 智能体设计。它通过底层指纹欺骗（WebGL、AudioContext、硬件并发数等）绕过 Cloudflare 和反爬机制，提供 REST API 接口。相比 Playwright，内存占用低至 40MB，支持可访问性快照（比 HTML 小 90%）、会话隔离和搜索宏，是 Puppeteer/Playwright 的直接替代方案。
items.e: camofox-browser is a stealth headless browser service for AI agents, built on Camoufox—a Firefox fork with C++-level fingerprint spoofing. It bypasses Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping by patching navigator.hardwareConcurrency, WebGL, AudioContext, screen geometry, and WebRTC before JavaScript execution. Offering a REST API with 90% smaller accessibility snapshots than HTML, stable element refs, session isolation, search macros, and ~40MB idle memory, it serves as a drop-in replacement for Playwright/Puppeteer in AI automation and web scraping workflows.

items.d: Beautiful map components. 100% Free, Zero config, one command setup.
items.z: mapcn 是一个免费开源的 React 地图组件库，提供零配置、一键集成的地图解决方案。基于 MapLibre GL 构建，深度集成 Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 样式体系，支持主题感知、可组合组件、标记弹窗、路线绘制等核心功能，适用于快速开发美观的地图可视化应用。
items.e: mapcn is a free, open-source React map component library that provides zero-config, one-command setup for beautiful map visualizations. Built on MapLibre GL and styled with Tailwind CSS, it seamlessly integrates with shadcn/ui design patterns. Key features include theme-aware light/dark mode adaptation, composable map components, rich markers with popups and tooltips, route/path drawing capabilities, and built-in controls—enabling rapid development of sophisticated map-based applications.

items.d: Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute.
items.z: improve 是一个 AI 代理技能，利用最强模型深度审计任意代码库，生成自包含的 Markdown 实施计划供廉价模型执行。核心价值在于智能分工：高智能模型负责 Recon 映射仓库栈与规范、多类别并行审计、Vet vetting 与优先级排序，执行交由低成本模型。计划含验证门、硬边界、停止条件与漂移检测，支持分支审计、execute 审查、GitHub issues 集成及 reconcile 闭环。适用于代码优化、安全审计、性能提升与功能规划场景，提升多模型代理工作流效率。
items.e: improve is an agent skill that uses the most capable models to audit any codebase and produce self-contained Markdown implementation plans for cheaper models to execute. Core value lies in intelligent division of labor: powerful models handle recon (mapping stack, conventions, verification commands), parallel multi-category audits (security, perf, tech debt, direction), vetting, and prioritization; execution is offloaded. Plans include verification gates, hard boundaries, STOP conditions, and drift checks. Supports focused/branch audits, isolated worktree execution with review, GitHub issue publishing, and reconciliation. Ideal for efficient codebase maintenance in multi-model AI agent ecosystems.

items.d: Turn your Notion workspace into a fast, customizable website. Built with Next.js + Notion API, with multi-platform deployment and no self-hosted server required.
items.z: NotionNext是基于Next.js与Notion API构建的高颜值静态博客系统，支持Vercel等多种部署方案，实现零服务器成本的网站搭建。专为创作者设计，可将Notion页面无缝转化为博客内容，提供主题定制、SEO优化及自动化部署能力，大幅降低技术门槛。
items.e: NotionNext is a visually appealing static blog system built with Next.js and Notion API, supporting multiple deployment options like Vercel for zero-server website setup. Designed for creators, it seamlessly transforms Notion pages into blog content with theme customization, SEO optimization, and automated deployment, significantly lowering technical barriers.

items.d: Git. Ship. Done - Core
items.z: GSD-Core是轻量级元提示与上下文工程系统，专为Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码工具设计。通过六命令循环（初始化、讨论、规划、并行执行、验证、交付）解决上下文腐烂，实现规范驱动开发。支持跨平台npm安装，生成原子提交与干净Git历史，适用于独立开发者和小团队。已获亚马逊、谷歌等工程师信赖，是AI辅助可靠交付的执行框架。
items.e: GSD-Core is a lightweight meta-prompting, context engineering, and spec-driven development system for AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more. It solves context rot with a six-command loop: initialize or map codebases, discuss phases, plan with verification, execute in parallel sub-agents using fresh contexts, verify, and ship with clean Git history. Ideal for solo builders and small teams. Cross-platform via npm, trusted by engineers at Amazon, Google, Shopify, and Webflow.

items.d: Open-source intelligence for the global theater. Track everything from the corporate/private jets of the wealthy, and spy satellites, to seismic events in one unified interface. Hook an AI agent up to have it parse through data and find previously unseen correlations. The knowledge is available to all but rarely aggregated in the open, until now.
items.z: ShadowBroker是实时多域开源情报平台，聚合60+公开数据源包括航班ADS-B、船舶AIS、卫星遥测及地震信息。基于Next.js与MapLibre GL构建交互式地图，支持35+数据层切换与右键地理情报查询。采用自托管架构确保隐私，面向分析师提供全球威胁监控与研究工作。
items.e: ShadowBroker is a real-time OSINT platform aggregating 60+ public data sources including aircraft ADS-B, maritime AIS, satellite telemetry and seismic events. Built with Next.js and MapLibre GL, it provides 35+ interactive data layers and geospatial analysis tools. Self-hosted deployment ensures privacy for analysts tracking global threats and conducting open-source intelligence research.

items.d: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative
items.z: Kiri 是一款用 Rust 编写的轻量级容器运行时，兼容 Docker CLI、Compose 与 buildx，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它通过单个小型 Linux 虚拟机运行容器，启动速度比 Docker Desktop 快约 80 倍，内存占用仅约 15 MB，并内置本地域名、HTTPS 证书、Kubernetes 集群及多语言界面，是 Docker Desktop 和 OrbStack 的高效替代方案。
items.e: Kiri is a lightweight container runtime written in Rust, compatible with Docker CLI, Compose, and buildx on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It runs containers in a single small Linux VM, starting about 80x faster than Docker Desktop with ~15 MB memory footprint. It offers local domains, HTTPS certificates, a one-command Kubernetes cluster, and a 38-language UI, serving as a fast alternative to Docker Desktop and OrbStack.

items.d: Automated penetration testing & attack surface management platform. Recon, scan, exploit, report - 600+ exploits, 90+ integrations, 10K+ detections.
items.z: Sn1per是一款自动化渗透测试与攻击面管理平台，整合侦察、漏洞扫描、漏洞利用与报告生成于统一工作区。内置600+漏洞利用、90+工具集成与上万检测规则，支持Community到Enterprise多版本，适用于个人红队与SOC团队的全流程攻防作业。
items.e: Sn1per is an automated penetration testing and attack surface management platform that unifies recon, scanning, exploitation and reporting. It orchestrates 90+ tools, ships 600+ exploits and 10K+ detections, with Community to Enterprise editions for solo pentesters and global SOC teams.

items.d: Give your agents the power of the Hugging Face ecosystem
items.z: Hugging Face Skills是面向AI/ML任务的标准化智能体技能定义，支持数据集创建、模型训练与评估。提供Codex、Claude、Gemini、Cursor等多平台兼容，以自包含文件夹形式打包指令与脚本，实现AI编码助手无缝集成。
items.e: Hugging Face Skills provides standardized agent skill definitions for AI/ML tasks including dataset creation, model training, and evaluation. It offers multi-platform compatibility with Codex, Claude, Gemini, and Cursor, packaging instructions and scripts in self-contained folders for seamless AI coding agent integration.

items.d: Skills for Design Engineers
items.z: UI Skills 是一个面向设计工程师和 AI 智能体的专业技能集合，收录 132 多个高质量技能，聚焦无障碍审计、动效性能优化、UI 基础清理及生产级前端设计等领域。核心价值在于 npx CLI 路由工具，能智能匹配任务至最合适技能，帮助人类与代理创建优质界面。应用场景覆盖 AI 生成代码优化、WCAG 合规检查、动画流畅性提升及组件开发。技术亮点是模块化专家技能、避免通用 AI 美学及多框架实践集成，实现专业、一致的高品质用户体验。
items.e: UI Skills is a curated collection of over 132 specialized skills for design engineers and AI agents to create superior interfaces. It covers accessibility audits, motion performance fixes, baseline UI polish, and production-grade frontend design. The core value is its CLI routing tool that intelligently matches tasks to the right skill set. Applications include refining AI-generated UIs, ensuring WCAG compliance, optimizing animations, and building polished components with frameworks like React and shadcn/ui. Key highlights are modular expert-contributed guidelines that avoid generic AI aesthetics and promote high craft quality and consistency.

items.d: Claude-first paid-media operations skill for Claude Code across 12 ad platforms (Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, X): source-grounded audits, deterministic findings and evidence coverage, versioned JSON reports, and capability-gated account changes.
items.z: 为Claude Code设计的付费广告审计AI技能，覆盖Google、Meta等8大平台，通过250+检查项在10-15分钟内完成原需4-6小时的人工审计。采用加权评分和并行代理技术，提供优先级行动方案与AI创意生成，支持跨平台部署，适用于PPC代理机构、企业内部营销团队及自由顾问。
items.e: An AI skill for Claude Code that automates paid advertising audits across 8 platforms including Google and Meta. It performs 250+ checks in 10-15 minutes, replacing 4-6 hours of manual work. Features weighted scoring, parallel agents, prioritized action plans, and AI creative generation. Cross-platform compatible for PPC agencies, in-house marketers, and freelance consultants.

items.d: A skill that turn any brand into a scrollable 3D world landing page
items.z: AI代理技能，能为任何品牌或行业生成滚动驱动的沉浸式3D世界落地页。滚动实现相机连续飞行穿越连贯场景，无剪辑。基于Higgsfield AI生成等距场景与视频，JS引擎驱动，支持移动端。框架无关，适用于品牌营销。
items.e: An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and similar tools that generates immersive scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing pages for any brand. Scrolling drives continuous camera flights through connected scenes without cuts. Uses Higgsfield AI for isometric scenes and frame-locked videos, with a vanilla JS scrub engine and mobile portrait support. Framework-agnostic for brand marketing.

items.d: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
items.z: 这是一个为AI编程代理设计的标准化技能库，通过MCP协议与Stitch设计工具深度集成。提供设计系统文档生成、提示词优化、设计稿转React组件等核心能力，兼容Claude Code、Cursor等主流AI编程工具。采用统一技能结构（SKILL.md + 脚本 + 资源 + 示例），实现从设计到代码的自动化工作流，显著提升AI编程效率与质量。
items.e: A standardized Agent Skills library for AI coding assistants, deeply integrated with Stitch design tool via MCP protocol. Provides core capabilities including design system documentation generation, prompt enhancement, and design-to-React conversion. Compatible with mainstream AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor. Features unified skill structure (SKILL.md + scripts + resources + examples) to automate design-to-code workflows and boost AI programming efficiency.

items.d: Agent skill that turns natural language, code, Terraform/K8s, SQL, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protobuf and GraphQL sources into editable, tested draw.io architecture diagrams: incremental sync, multi-view projection, drift diff, CI architecture tests, whiteboard derasterize, interactive HTML/PPTX/Mermaid exports.
items.z: drawio-skill 是一款 AI 驱动的技能，将自然语言描述转化为专业的 draw.io 图表。它支持 6 种预设类型（ERD、UML、序列、架构、ML/深度学习、流程图）、代码库（Python/JS/Go/Rust）结构可视化、10,000+ 官方形状搜索及 321 个 AI/LLM 品牌 logo。集成视觉自检与最多 5 轮迭代精炼，自动修复布局问题，支持 PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG 导出。与 Claude、Cursor 等多种 AI 代理兼容，适用于软件架构设计、代码可视化及系统文档生成场景。
items.e: drawio-skill is an AI agent skill that converts natural language into professional draw.io diagrams. It offers 6 presets (ERD, UML, Sequence, Architecture, ML/Deep Learning, Flowchart), codebase visualization for Python/JS/Go/Rust via Graphviz auto-layout, search across 10,000+ official shapes, and 321 AI/LLM logos. Features vision self-check with up to 5 rounds of refinement, auto-fixes layout issues, and exports to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor and other agents, ideal for architecture design, code analysis, and LLM app documentation.

items.d: Agent Reinforcement Trainer: train multi-step agents for real-world tasks using GRPO. Give your agents on-the-job training. Reinforcement learning for Qwen3.6, GPT-OSS, Llama, and more!
items.z: ART是基于GRPO算法的强化学习框架，用于训练多步智能体执行现实任务。它支持Qwen3.6、GPT-OSS、Llama等主流大模型，提供无服务器RL服务，可降低40%成本、加速训练并免去基础设施管理。开发者可轻松集成到Python应用，快速迭代智能体，提升可靠性。
items.e: ART is an open-source reinforcement learning framework that employs Generalized Policy Gradient Optimization (GRPO) to train multi-step agents for real-world tasks. It supports popular large language models including Qwen3.6, GPT-OSS, and Llama. The framework provides a serverless RL backend via W&B Training, which cuts costs by 40%, accelerates training by 28%, and eliminates infrastructure management. With an ergonomic Python API, ART allows developers to quickly iterate on agent development, enhancing reliability through experience-based learning.

items.d: Free Motion Capture for Everyone 💀✨
items.z: FreeMoCap是开源无标记动作捕捉系统，使用普通摄像头实现研究级3D人体运动重建。硬件无关、低成本，支持多机位同步标定、姿态估计与三角化，输出Blender/CSV等格式，面向科研、教育、生物力学与动画。
items.e: FreeMoCap is a free open-source markerless motion capture system delivering research-grade 3D human movement tracking from ordinary webcams. Hardware-agnostic and low-cost, it supports multi-camera sync, calibration, pose estimation and triangulation, with Blender/CSV exports for research, education, biomechanics and animation.

items.d: Agent harness for learning difficult things.
items.z: LearnHarness 是一款基于 AI 智能体的个性化学习工具，通过测量用户当前理解、规划依赖路径、逐步教学与练习，构建持久化知识图谱，实现自适应教学。支持多平台桌面应用、文件附件与语音输入，帮助用户深入掌握复杂知识。
items.e: LearnHarness is an AI-agent-powered learning tool that measures current understanding, plans dependency paths, teaches step-by-step, and builds a persistent knowledge graph for personalized adaptive learning. Available as a cross-platform desktop app with file attachment and dictation support, it helps users master difficult topics.

items.d: 类似按键精灵的鼠标键盘录制和自动化操作 模拟点击和键入 | automate mouse clicks and keyboard input
items.z: KeymouseGo 是一款轻量级跨平台自动化工具，通过录制鼠标键盘操作生成 JSON5 脚本并回放执行。支持 Windows/Linux/macOS，提供桌面 GUI 和命令行两种模式，可设定执行次数与热键控制。基于 Python 和 pynput 库开发，无需编程基础即可实现重复性办公、测试等任务的自动化，是精简绿色的按键精灵替代方案。
items.e: KeymouseGo is a lightweight cross-platform automation tool that records mouse and keyboard actions into JSON5 scripts for playback. Supporting Windows/Linux/macOS, it offers both GUI and CLI modes with configurable execution count and hotkeys. Built on Python and pynput, it enables automating repetitive tasks like office work and testing without programming knowledge, serving as a compact alternative to key wizard software.

items.d: High-performance browser automation bridge and multi-instance orchestrator with advanced stealth injection and real-time dashboard.
items.z: PinchTab 是专为 AI 智能体设计的高性能浏览器自动化桥接器。通过 12MB 的 Go 二进制文件提供 HTTP API，支持多实例 Chrome 进程 orchestration 与隐身注入。核心突破在于 token 效率——文本提取仅需 800 tokens/页，成本比截图方案低 5-13 倍。具备持久化配置文件、ARM64 优化和实时仪表板，是 AI 驱动 Web 自动化的轻量级基础设施。
items.e: PinchTab is a high-performance browser automation bridge designed for AI agents. This 12MB Go binary delivers HTTP API for multi-instance Chrome orchestration with advanced stealth injection. Its breakthrough is token efficiency—text extraction costs only 800 tokens/page, 5-13x cheaper than screenshots. Featuring persistent profiles, ARM64 optimization, and real-time dashboard, it's the lightweight infrastructure for AI-driven web automation.

items.d: Check if an email address exists without sending any email, written in Rust. Comes with a ⚙️ HTTP backend.
items.z: reacherhq/check-if-email-exists 是一个用 Rust 编写的开源工具，可在不发送邮件的情况下验证邮箱地址是否存在及可交付性。提供 Docker HTTP 后端（最受欢迎）、CLI 工具和 Rust 库三种方式。核心亮点包括 SMTP 连接探测、MX 记录验证、一次性邮箱与角色账号检测、catch-all 判断等，输出详细 JSON 结果。适用于邮件营销、用户注册验证、数据清洗及反欺诈场景，支持代理以实现大规模处理，采用双许可模式。
items.e: reacherhq/check-if-email-exists is a high-performance Rust open-source tool to verify email address existence and deliverability without sending any emails. It provides a popular Dockerized HTTP backend, CLI tool, and Rust library for integration. Key features include syntax validation, MX record checks, SMTP probing, detection of disposable emails, role accounts, catch-all addresses, and more, with detailed JSON output on reachability. Ideal for email marketing, user onboarding, data cleaning, and fraud prevention. Supports proxies for scale and uses dual licensing.

items.d: Technitium DNS Server
items.z: Technitium DNS Server 是开源跨平台权威/递归DNS服务器，支持自托管以提升隐私与安全。开箱即用，提供Web控制台，可网络级拦截广告与恶意软件，支持DoT/DoH/DoQ加密协议、集群管理、LDAP/OIDC认证及高性能异步IO。适用于家庭与企业网络，内置缓存、DNSSEC与应用扩展框架，显著提升解析速度与控制力。
items.e: Technitium DNS Server is an open-source cross-platform authoritative and recursive DNS server for self-hosting with strong privacy and security focus. It works out-of-the-box with a web console, enables network-wide ad/malware blocking, supports DoT/DoH/DoQ encrypted protocols, clustering, LDAP/OIDC auth, and high-performance async I/O. Ideal for home and enterprise networks, featuring advanced caching, DNSSEC, and an apps framework for enhanced control and speed.

items.d: Agent skills
items.z: Jane Street 开源了一套面向 AI 智能体的技能集合，每个技能以 SKILL.md 文件定义指令。首个技能 socratic-tutor 将大模型转化为严格的私人导师，通过诊断、0-5 级技能图谱、逐题提问、间隔复习和最终评估，采用苏格拉底方法系统化教授任意主题。适用于编码智能体或聊天机器人，只需复制技能目录或粘贴指令即可启用。
items.e: Jane Street open-sources a collection of skills for AI agents, each defined by a SKILL.md file. The first skill, socratic-tutor, turns an LLM into a strict personal tutor that teaches any topic via the Socratic method: diagnosis, a 0-5 level skill map, one question at a time, spaced review, and a final assessment. It works with coding agents or plain chatbots by copying the skill directory or pasting the instructions.

items.d: Supports running Armbian on Amlogic, Allwinner, and Rockchip devices. Support a311d, s922x, s905x3, s905x2, s912, s905d, s905x, s905w, s905, s905l, rk3588, rk3568, rk3399, rk3328, h6, etc.
items.z: 该项目将Armbian轻量级Linux系统移植到Amlogic、Rockchip和Allwinner等电视盒子及ARM开发板，支持s922x、s905x3、rk3588等多款芯片。用户可替换Android TV系统，将盒子转为基于Debian/Ubuntu的服务器，支持eMMC写入、内核更新与SSH远程管理。适用于家庭服务器、开发测试、NAS及媒体中心等场景，提供Docker镜像与详细文档，助力消费级设备变身高性能Linux机器。
items.e: This project ports the Armbian lightweight Linux distribution to TV boxes and ARM single-board computers based on Amlogic, Rockchip, and Allwinner SoCs such as s922x, s905x3, rk3588, and more. It enables users to replace Android TV with a full Debian/Ubuntu-based server operating system, featuring eMMC installation, kernel updates, and SSH remote management capabilities. Ideal for home servers, development platforms, NAS, and media centers, the project provides Docker images and comprehensive documentation to transform consumer devices into powerful, stable Linux machines for various server applications.

items.d: A modern platform for visual, flexible, and extensible graph-based investigations. For cybersecurity analysts and investigators.
items.z: Flowsint 是一款开源的 OSINT 图调查平台，专为网络安全分析师和调查人员设计。它通过可视化图谱探索实体间关联，集成域名、IP、社交媒体、加密货币等 20+ 自动化数据丰富器，支持本地部署保障隐私。采用模块化微服务架构，包含 FastAPI 后端、独立前端和 Celery 任务调度，提供灵活的威胁情报与数字取证解决方案。
items.e: Flowsint is an open-source OSINT graph investigation platform designed for cybersecurity analysts and investigators. It enables visual exploration of entity relationships through an interactive graph interface, powered by 20+ automated enrichers covering domains, IPs, social media, cryptocurrency, and breach data. Built with a modular microservices architecture featuring FastAPI backend, Celery task orchestration, and local deployment for privacy, it provides flexible threat intelligence and digital forensics capabilities while emphasizing ethical use and transparency.

items.d: the LLM vulnerability scanner
items.z: garak是NVIDIA开源的LLM漏洞扫描与红队评估工具，专注检测幻觉、数据泄露、提示注入、越狱、毒性生成等风险。支持Hugging Face、OpenAI、Bedrock等多种后端，结合静态、动态与自适应探针，类似nmap/Metasploit但专为生成式AI设计，助力模型安全加固。
items.e: garak is NVIDIA’s open-source LLM vulnerability scanner and red-teaming kit. It probes for hallucination, data leakage, prompt injection, jailbreaks, toxicity and more. Supporting Hugging Face, OpenAI, Bedrock and many backends, it combines static, dynamic and adaptive probes—like nmap/Metasploit for generative AI—to harden model safety.

items.d: Make bilingual epub books Using AI translate
items.z: bilingual_book_maker 是一款基于 AI 的电子书双语翻译工具，支持 epub/txt/pdf/srt 格式。核心亮点包括：集成 GPT-4、Claude、Gemini 等多款大模型，通过 litellm 统一管理非 OpenAI 模型；支持上下文感知翻译保持语义连贯；自动在多模型间负载均衡规避速率限制；提供 CLI 命令行工具，专为公版书设计，避免版权风险。
items.e: bilingual_book_maker is an AI-powered tool for creating bilingual e-books from epub/txt/pdf/srt files. Key features: integrates multiple LLMs including GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini via litellm for unified non-OpenAI model management; context-aware translation preserves semantic coherence across paragraphs; automatic load balancing across models prevents rate limiting and optimizes API costs; provides CLI for batch processing; specifically designed for public domain works to avoid copyright infringement risks while supporting parallel API keys.

items.d: Yet Another Document Translator
items.z: BabelDOC 是 PDF 科学论文翻译与双语对照库。它基于大语言模型实现高质量翻译，同时精准保留 PDF 布局、公式和表格。提供 CLI、Python API 和在线服务，支持嵌入其他程序或自部署。适用于学术研究者翻译外文论文，集成 Zotero 等工具。核心亮点包括布局分析、术语提取和复杂文档兼容处理。
items.e: BabelDOC is a specialized library for translating PDF scientific papers with bilingual comparison. It uses large language models for high-quality translations while precisely preserving original PDF layout, formulas, and tables. It provides CLI, Python API, and online services for embedding into applications or self-deployment. Ideal for academic researchers translating papers, with Zotero integrations. Key highlights include layout analysis, term extraction, and robust format handling.

items.d: auto sign cursor
items.z: 该仓库提供 Cursor Pro 账号自动化注册与续期解决方案，通过模拟用户行为实现免费获取 Pro 权限。主要服务于希望持续使用 AI 代码编辑器高级功能的开发者群体。技术实现涵盖自动化脚本、协议逆向及反风控策略。采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 非商业许可，使用者需自行承担合规风险。
items.e: This repository offers an automated solution for Cursor Pro account registration and renewal, enabling free access to premium features through simulated user interactions. It serves developers seeking continuous use of AI code editor advanced capabilities. Technical implementation includes automation scripting, protocol reverse engineering, and anti-detection mechanisms. Released under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 non-commercial license, users assume all compliance risks.

items.d: Google Cloud Knowledge Catalog Tools and Samples
items.z: 本仓库提供 Google Cloud Knowledge Catalog 的工具、代理与样本。该 AI 驱动数据目录平台通过动态知识图谱整合结构化与非结构化数据，为 AI 代理提供语义和业务上下文。核心包括开放知识格式（OKF）实现可移植 Markdown 知识表示、基于 BigQuery 与 LLM 的富集/发现代理、元数据即代码工具及交互式图谱可视化。适用于企业数据上下文管理、元数据自动化富集与检索解决方案构建。
items.e: The GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog repository delivers tools, agents, and samples for Google Cloud Knowledge Catalog, an AI-powered data catalog and metadata platform. It uses a dynamic knowledge graph to unify structured and unstructured data, providing semantics and business context for AI agents. Key elements include the Open Knowledge Format (OKF) for portable, vendor-neutral markdown-based knowledge; LLM-powered enrichment and discovery agents integrated with BigQuery; Metadata as Code tools; and interactive visualizations. It enables context management, enrichment, and retrieval solutions for enterprise AI applications.

items.d: A free, open-source Windows desktop organizer with native-feeling WinUI 3 widgets.
items.z: DeskBox是一款免费开源的Windows桌面整理工具，基于WinUI 3和.NET 10 Native AOT构建，提供原生质感的桌面小组件，支持文件整理、待办、搜索、天气和音乐控制等。它采用本地优先存储，不改变现有文件结构，支持Mica和Acrylic材质，兼容x64和ARM64，提供13种语言界面，是Stardock Fences的开源替代方案。
items.e: DeskBox is a free, open-source Windows desktop organizer built with WinUI 3 and .NET 10 Native AOT, offering native-feeling desktop widgets for file organization, todos, search, weather, and music controls. It is local-first, preserves existing file structures, supports Mica and Acrylic materials, works on x64 and ARM64, and provides 13 languages, serving as an open-source alternative to Stardock Fences.

items.d: KAG is a logical form-guided reasoning and retrieval framework based on OpenSPG engine and LLMs.  It is used to build logical reasoning and factual Q&A solutions for professional domain knowledge bases. It can effectively overcome the shortcomings of the traditional RAG vector similarity calculation model.
items.z: KAG是基于OpenSPG引擎与LLM的逻辑形式引导推理框架，专为专业领域知识库设计。它通过知识与块互索引结构、概念语义对齐及模式约束知识构建，有效解决传统RAG向量模糊性与GraphRAG噪声问题，支持多跳逻辑推理与精准事实问答，性能显著超越当前SOTA方法。
items.e: KAG is a logical form-guided reasoning and retrieval framework built on OpenSPG engine and LLMs for professional domain knowledge bases. It overcomes traditional RAG's vector ambiguity and GraphRAG's OpenIE noise via knowledge-chunk mutual indexing, semantic alignment, and schema-constrained knowledge construction. The framework enables multi-hop logical reasoning and precise factual question answering, delivering performance that significantly surpasses current state-of-the-art methods.

items.d: A free + OSS logo generator powered by Flux on Together AI
items.z: 开源免费的AI标志生成器，基于Together AI上的FLUX.2 pro与FLUX.1 Kontext，几秒内生成品牌级Logo并导出完整品牌套件。无需账号即可使用，支持参考图上传、多风格与SVG导出。采用Next.js + TypeScript构建，UI基于Radix与Tailwind，可选Clerk认证与Upstash限流，适合设计师与创业者快速创建专业视觉标识。
items.e: Free open-source AI logo generator powered by FLUX.2 pro and FLUX.1 Kontext on Together AI. Creates brand-ready logos in seconds and exports a full brand kit, fully account-less. Supports reference image upload, multiple styles and SVG export. Built with Next.js + TypeScript, Radix + Tailwind UI, optional Clerk auth and Upstash rate limiting. Ideal for designers and founders needing professional visual identity fast.

items.d: Generate audiobooks from e-books
items.z: audiblez 利用 Kokoro-82M 高质量语音合成模型，将 EPUB 电子书自动转换为 M4B 有声书。支持中英法等9种语言，提供命令行与图形界面，跨平台运行。GPU 加速下5分钟完成《动物农场》转换，是个人制作无障碍阅读内容的理想工具。
items.e: Audiblez converts EPUB e-books to M4B audiobooks using Kokoro-82M TTS model. Supporting 9 languages including Chinese and English, it offers CLI/GUI interfaces with cross-platform compatibility. With GPU acceleration, it processes 160K characters in 5 minutes, ideal for creating accessible content.

items.d: The system of action for AI-native cybersecurity—where intent becomes governed execution, evidence becomes operational memory, and every operation improves the next.
items.z: CyberStrikeAI是基于Go构建的AI原生网络安全平台，融合Eino多智能体编排（Deep/Plan-Execute/Supervisor）、MCP原生工具、RAG知识库与攻击链建模。它将自然语言意图转化为受治理的可审计安全行动，支持人机协同、资产/漏洞管理及授权渗透测试，适用于红队与安全运营场景。
items.e: CyberStrikeAI is a Go-based AI-native cybersecurity platform that turns natural-language intent into governed, auditable security actions. It combines Eino multi-agent orchestration (Deep, Plan-Execute, Supervisor), MCP-native tools, RAG knowledge, visual workflows and attack-chain analysis for authorized penetration testing and security operations.

items.d: 🏋 Modern open-source fitness coaching platform. Create workout plans, track progress, and access a comprehensive exercise database.
items.z: Workout.cool 是一个现代开源健身教练平台，支持创建个性化训练计划、追踪健身进度，并提供包含详细说明与视频演示的全面运动数据库。基于 Next.js 16、Prisma ORM 和 Feature-Sliced Design 架构构建，具备 Docker 自托管、多语言支持及 Stripe 集成，旨在为健身开源社区提供可靠、可维护的自托管解决方案。
items.e: Workout.cool is a modern open-source fitness coaching platform for creating personalized workout plans, tracking progress, and accessing a comprehensive exercise database with detailed instructions and video demos. Built on Next.js 16, Prisma ORM, and Feature-Sliced Design architecture, it supports Docker self-hosting, i18n, and Stripe integration, reviving reliable tools for the fitness open-source community.

items.d: The open source AI video agent: turns any coding agent into a video agent, with editors to change anything it makes.
items.z: OpenFilm是开源AI视频智能体，可将任意编码智能体转化为视频制作工具。它以单个HTML文件为核心，通过frame(t)函数驱动浏览器渲染每一帧，配合Studio编辑器支持手动或对话式修改视频元素，实现从生成到精剪的完整视频创作流程。
items.e: OpenFilm is an open-source AI video agent that turns any coding agent into a video maker. Using a single HTML file with a frame(t) function, it renders each frame in the browser via WebGL, canvas, SVG, or CSS. The Studio editor lets you manually or conversationally refine every element, trim clips on the timeline, and render MP4s—enabling end-to-end video creation without frameworks like Remotion. It works with Codex, Claude Code, and other agents.

items.d: 3FUI 是 ffmpeg 在 Windows 上的轻度专业交互外壳，收录大量参数，界面美观，交互友好。此项目面向国内使用环境，让普通人也能够轻松压制视频和转换格式。
items.z: 3FUI是Windows平台FFmpeg的专业交互外壳，基于.NET 10与WinForm框架开发。集成40+视频编码器（含硬件加速）、20+音频及10+图片编码器，支持深度自定义参数与无限制批量任务。面向追求参数透明与压制质量的专业用户，提供简洁高效的暗黑风格界面，无广告完全免费，需自备FFmpeg二进制以获得最新性能。
items.e: 3FUI is a professional interactive shell for FFmpeg on Windows, developed with .NET 10 and WinForm. It integrates 40+ video encoders (including hardware acceleration), 20+ audio and 10+ image encoders, supporting deep custom parameters and unlimited batch processing. Designed for professionals seeking transparent control and high-quality output, it features a clean dark-mode interface, is ad-free and completely free. Users must provide their own FFmpeg binary for optimal performance.

items.d: The open-source, privacy-friendly CAPTCHA you host yourself. Bots and AI agents out, people in.
items.z: Cap 是一款隐私优先的自托管验证码替代方案，采用 SHA-256 工作量证明机制，摒弃传统视觉 puzzles。仅 20KB 大小，零依赖，加载毫秒级，支持 Docker 独立部署。提供隐形验证与 M2M API 保护能力，通过 CSS 变量实现深度定制，为现代 Web 应用提供高效、私密的 bot 防护。
items.e: Cap is a privacy-first, self-hosted CAPTCHA alternative that replaces visual puzzles with SHA-256 proof-of-work challenges. At just 20KB with zero dependencies, it loads in milliseconds and supports standalone Docker deployment. Featuring invisible validation, M2M API protection, and CSS variable customization, it provides efficient, private bot mitigation for modern web applications.

items.d: nodejs-argo是一个强大的Argo隧道部署工具，专为PaaS平台和游戏玩具平台设计。它支持多种代理协议(VLESS、VMess、Trojan)等，有直连协议(Socks5、Hysteria2、Reality)可选开启，并集成了哪吒探针功能
items.z: nodejs-argo是一个专为PaaS平台和游戏玩具平台设计的Argo隧道代理部署工具，支持VLESS、VMess、Trojan等多种协议，并集成哪吒探针功能。基于Node.js实现，支持环境变量配置的固定/临时隧道、订阅生成及自动保活，适用于个人代理节点搭建。核心亮点包括多协议兼容、哪吒监控集成及npm模块化部署。
items.e: nodejs-argo is a powerful Argo tunnel deployment tool designed for PaaS and game toy platforms. It supports multiple proxy protocols including VLESS, VMess, and Trojan, with integrated Nezha probe functionality. Built on Node.js, it enables easy configuration via environment variables for fixed or temporary tunnels, subscription generation, and auto keep-alive, ideal for personal proxy node setup on cloud platforms. Key highlights include multi-protocol support, Nezha monitoring, and npm package deployment.

items.d: Ultra-high-performance, secure, all-in-one acceleration engine for developer resources
items.z: Xget 是面向开发者的超高性能、安全的一体化加速引擎，专为加速模型、数据集与软件包等资源获取而设计，支持多浏览器扩展与边缘平台部署，并可将资源直接转化为口播视频，无需时间线编辑，显著提升开发与内容创作效率。
items.e: Xget is an ultra-high-performance, secure, all-in-one acceleration engine for developer resources. It accelerates the retrieval of models, datasets, and packages, supports browser extensions and edge platform deployment, and can turn resources into talking-head videos without timeline editing, boosting development and content creation efficiency.

items.d: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
items.z: HA-MCP 是基于 Model Context Protocol 的智能家居 AI 网关，通过 FastMCP 提供 87 个工具，让 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 助手以自然语言配置和自动化控制 Home Assistant。支持 HACS 安装，兼容所有 Home Assistant 部署类型，实现全功能对等的进程内运行。
items.e: HA-MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that bridges AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT with Home Assistant. Built with FastMCP, it exposes 87 tools for natural language configuration and automation of smart home devices. Installs via HACS or the built-in Marketplace, runs in-process, and supports all Home Assistant deployment types.

items.d: Multi-account API gateway for Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console
items.z: 基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持流式对话、函数工具调用及文生图/视频功能。提供多账号池管理、额度同步和 Anthropic 协议兼容，内置 Admin 后台与 Web Chat 界面，支持 Docker/Vercel 部署，实现企业级 AI 能力统一管理。
items.e: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based gateway that converts Grok Web capabilities into OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling seamless integration with existing LLM applications. It supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, function tool calls, and text/image-to-video generation. Key features include multi-account pool management, quota synchronization, Anthropic protocol compatibility, and local media caching. The solution provides a comprehensive Admin backend and Web UI for management, supporting Docker, Vercel, and Render deployment for unified enterprise AI infrastructure.

items.d: AI 视频笔记生成工具 让 AI 为你的视频做笔记
items.z: BiliNote 是一款开源的 AI 视频笔记生成工具，支持 B 站、YouTube、抖音等多平台视频。通过 Fast-Whisper 实现本地音频转写，结合 GPT 大模型（OpenAI/DeepSeek/Qwen）自动生成结构化 Markdown 笔记。支持自动截图、视频跳转、多风格摘要，可本地部署保障隐私，适合学习、知识管理与内容创作场景。
items.e: BiliNote is an open-source AI-powered video note-taking tool supporting Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin and more. It leverages Fast-Whisper for local audio transcription and GPT models (OpenAI/DeepSeek/Qwen) to automatically generate structured Markdown notes. Features include auto-screenshots, video timestamp links, customizable summary styles, and local deployment for privacy protection. Ideal for learning, knowledge management, and content creation workflows with GPU acceleration support.

items.d: Become a cracked AI/ML researcher/engineer with this unconventional textbook covering maths, computing, and ML with intuition.
items.z: 这是一个面向AI/ML研究工程师的系统性学习资料库，涵盖数学基础、计算机科学和人工智能核心领域。内容强调直觉理解而非公式堆砌，从向量、矩阵、概率论等基础到Transformer、多模态学习、GPU编程等前沿技术。基于作者帮助多人成功入职DeepMind、OpenAI等顶级公司的实战经验，提供从理论到工程实践的一站式知识体系，适合面试准备和深度技术学习。
items.e: This is a systematic learning compendium for AI/ML Research Engineers, covering mathematics fundamentals, computer science, and core AI domains. Emphasizing intuitive understanding over dense notation, it spans from vectors, matrices, probability to cutting-edge topics like Transformers, multimodal learning, and GPU programming. Based on proven success in preparing candidates for top AI companies like DeepMind and OpenAI, it offers a comprehensive knowledge bridge from theory to engineering practice.

items.d: Open Source LLM Gateway 🦚
items.z: Manifest 是开源 LLM 网关，专为 AI Agent 与应用设计。通过统一 OpenAI 兼容端点，智能路由 API Key、订阅与本地模型请求至最优模型，支持 300+ 模型与 35+ 提供商。核心能力包括自动降级与故障自愈、全量请求日志、实时成本追踪与限额告警，消除单一供应商锁定，显著提升 Agent 可靠性并降低调用成本。
items.e: Manifest is an open-source LLM gateway for AI agents and apps. It unifies API keys, subscriptions, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, intelligently routing requests to the optimal model across 300+ models and 35+ providers. Key features include automatic fallbacks with self-healing, full request logging, real-time cost tracking, and usage limits—eliminating vendor lock-in while boosting agent reliability and cutting costs.

items.d: Generate beautiful dark-themed system architecture diagrams as standalone HTML/SVG files. Works as a Claude AI skill.
items.z: 通过Claude AI技能，将自然语言描述自动转换为专业深色主题架构图。输出独立HTML文件，无需设计工具，支持实时迭代修改。适用于系统设计评审、技术文档可视化，显著提升架构沟通效率与团队协作体验。
items.e: The Architecture Diagram Generator is a Claude AI skill that automatically converts natural language descriptions into professional, dark-themed system architecture diagrams. It outputs self-contained HTML files that can be opened in any browser without specialized software. Users can easily iterate on designs through conversational prompts, adding components or adjusting layouts instantly. This tool is ideal for system design reviews, technical documentation, and architecture presentations, dramatically improving communication efficiency and team collaboration while eliminating the need for manual diagramming tools and design expertise.

items.d: Animated components for design engineers. 150+ free shadcn/ui components, built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. MIT licensed.
items.z: 为设计工程师打造的UI组件库，提供92+可复制的AI智能体模式与4个全栈模板。基于Tailwind CSS开发，完全兼容Shadcn，支持一键复制、Next.js导出或v0导入，快速构建可访问的定制化界面。
items.e: UI component library for Design Engineers featuring 92+ copy-paste AI Agent patterns and 4 full-stack templates. Built with Tailwind CSS, fully Shadcn-compatible. Integrate via copy-paste, Next.js export, or v0 import for accessible, customizable interfaces.

items.d: One-stop Proxies Crawling and Aggregation Platform
items.z: wzdnzd/aggregator 是一个一站式免费代理池构建平台，支持从 Telegram、GitHub、Google 等多源爬取代理资源，自动验证活性与质量，聚合后转换为 Clash、V2Ray、SingBox 等客户端格式。提供 process.py 完整配置与 collect.py 简化两种模式，具备插件系统、多线程并发及 Gist 等灵活存储。适用于个人免费代理获取、机场订阅收集和自动化代理管理场景，核心价值在于高效多源爬取、智能验证与多协议兼容输出。
items.e: wzdnzd/aggregator is a one-stop platform for building free proxy pools. It crawls proxy resources from Telegram, GitHub, Google and other sources, automatically validates activity and quality, aggregates them, and converts to formats like Clash, V2Ray and SingBox. It offers full-featured process.py and simplified collect.py modes, with plugin system, multi-threading, and flexible storage backends like Gist. Ideal for personal proxy needs, subscription collection and automated management, highlighting efficient multi-source crawling, intelligent validation and broad protocol support.

items.d: Codex skill for generating quiet minimal zine-style editorial poster prompts and images.
items.z: Codex技能，将主题、句子、情绪或参考图转化为稀疏纸质纹理的极简zine风格编辑海报、生产级图像提示词或可复用视觉系统。默认3:5老化纸张画布，70%-90%负空间，单一高色度强调色，衬线/打字机字体与xerox/risograph印刷缺陷，营造安静日韩独立zine情绪，避免商业广告与华丽效果。
items.e: Codex skill that turns themes, sentences, moods or references into sparse paper-texture minimal zine-style editorial posters, production-ready image prompts or reusable visual systems. Features 3:5 aged-paper canvas, 70-90% negative space, one high-chroma accent, restrained serif/typewriter typography and xerox/risograph defects for quiet Japanese/Korean indie-zine mood, avoiding commercial layouts.

items.d: Windows版本微信客户端（非网页版）自动化，可实现简单的发送、接收微信消息，简单微信机器人
items.z: wxauto 提供 Windows 原生微信客户端的 Python 自动化接口，基于 UIAutomation 技术直接操控微信 3.9.X 版本，实现消息收发与简易机器人功能。无需 Web 版限制，支持 Windows 10/11 系统，适用于个人微信消息批量处理与自动化场景。项目已于 2025 年 10 月停止维护，仅限学习交流使用。
items.e: wxauto is a Python automation library for native Windows WeChat client (v3.9.X) that leverages UIAutomation technology to directly control the desktop application. It enables sending/receiving messages, building simple chatbots, and automating WeChat interactions without web versions. Compatible with Windows 10/11 and Python 3.9+, it serves personal automation needs. Important: Discontinued in October 2025, intended solely for educational and research purposes.

items.d: 🤖 A minimal and customizable Docker image running the Android emulator as a service.
items.z: 该仓库提供基于Alpine的最小化Docker镜像，用于将Android模拟器作为服务运行。支持KVM硬件加速和GPU加速（CUDA），可自定义Android版本与设备类型，内置ADB端口转发，兼容scrcpy远程控屏。专为CI/CD农场设计，提供无头运行模式，镜像体积可压缩至138MB（不含SDK），适用于自动化测试与远程Android开发场景。
items.e: Repository provides a minimal Alpine-based Docker image that runs Android emulator as a service. Features KVM hardware acceleration and GPU support (CUDA), customizable Android versions/device types, built-in ADB port forwarding, and scrcpy compatibility for remote screen control. Designed for headless CI/CD farms, the image can be compressed to 138MB (SDK-free variant). Ideal for automated testing and remote Android development with optimized performance and network accessibility.

items.d: ⚠️ Browser fingerprinting via favicon!
items.z: Supercookie 通过 favicon 缓存机制实现浏览器持久指纹追踪，为访客分配独特且难以清除的 ID。该 ID 在隐身模式、清除缓存、重启系统或使用 VPN/AdBlocker 后仍有效。项目仅用于教育演示，旨在揭示 favicon 跟踪的隐私风险。技术亮点包括跨会话持久性、实时 API 演示及 Node.js/Docker 部署，适用于隐私安全研究与开发者警示。
items.e: Supercookie demonstrates persistent browser fingerprinting via favicon caching, assigning unique, hard-to-clear IDs to visitors. The ID survives incognito mode, cache clears, browser restarts, VPNs, and ad blockers. Built for educational purposes only, it highlights privacy risks from favicon tracking. Key features include cross-session persistence, live demo APIs, and easy deployment with Node.js and Docker, ideal for security research and awareness.

items.d: Open-source ThreeUI Community catalog with live interactive components and complete Community source.
items.z: ThreeUI Community 是开源的 Three.js/WebGL 3D 组件与交互 Shader 目录，含 50 个父组件、164 个可浏览结果。提供实时预览、变体控制、源码查看与 React 封装包，支持 npm 安装。适用于落地页 Hero、3D 背景与视觉特效开发，MIT 许可，免登录获取完整社区实现。
items.e: ThreeUI Community is an open-source catalog of procedural Three.js/WebGL 3D components and interactive shaders, featuring 50 parent components and 164 browse results. It offers live previews, variant controls, source access, and a React package via npm. Ideal for hero sections, 3D backgrounds, and visual effects. MIT-licensed, no login required.

items.d: Email for professionals and teams
items.z: Mailflare 是基于 Cloudflare 的自托管专业邮件收件箱，支持自定义域名。通过 Cloudflare Email Routing 与 Workers 实现收发邮件、附件、共享邮箱、路由规则、实时通知等完整功能。数据存于用户自有 D1 与 R2，可一键部署或 Docker 自建，适合个人与团队低成本掌控企业邮箱。
items.e: Mailflare is a self-hosted professional email inbox for custom domains built on Cloudflare. It leverages Email Routing and Workers for full-featured send/receive with attachments, shared mailboxes, routing rules, real-time notifications and more. Data stays in your own D1 and R2. One-click deploy or Docker self-host, ideal for individuals and teams seeking low-cost control of business email.

items.d: DeepAudit：人人拥有的 AI 黑客战队，让漏洞挖掘触手可及。小白一键部署运行，自主协作审计 + 自动化沙箱 PoC 验证。支持 Ollama 私有部署 ，一键生成报告。支持中转站。​让安全不再昂贵，让审计不再复杂。
items.z: DeepAudit 是国内首个开源的 AI 多智能体代码审计系统，通过自主协作审计和自动化沙箱 PoC 验证，大幅降低漏洞挖掘门槛。支持 Ollama 私有部署，提供一键式操作和可视化报告，已实战发现 49 个 CVE 漏洞。适用于企业安全自检、开源项目审计和安全研究，让专业级代码审计触手可及。
items.e: DeepAudit is China's first open-source AI multi-agent code auditing system that democratizes vulnerability discovery through autonomous collaborative auditing and automated sandbox PoC validation. Supporting Ollama private deployment with one-click operation and visual reporting, it has discovered 49 CVEs in production. Ideal for enterprise security self-checks, open-source project auditing, and security research.

items.d: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs
items.z: 融合怪(VPS Fusion Monster)是功能全面的服务器测评脚本，提供自动化硬件与网络基准测试。Go重构版本彻底解耦环境依赖，支持非root用户运行，兼容多架构(amd64/arm64等)与主流Linux发行版。核心功能涵盖CPU/内存/磁盘性能测试、三网回程路由追踪、多节点网速测试及15数据库IP质量检测。支持交互菜单与参数化无值守模式，可自定义Geekbench版本、磁盘测试工具等，专为开发者与运维人员设计的极致轻量高效测评方案。
items.e: Fusion Monster (ECS) is a comprehensive server testing script for VPS benchmarking. The Go-based implementation eliminates environment dependencies, supports non-root execution, and maintains compatibility across multiple architectures (amd64/arm64/i386/arm) and Linux distributions. Core capabilities include CPU/memory/disk performance evaluation, triple-network routing analysis, multi-node speed tests, and IP quality validation via 15 databases. Features both interactive menu and headless parameter-driven modes, with customizable options for Geekbench versions, disk test utilities, and China-specific network endpoints, designed for developers and sysadmins.

items.d: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.
items.z: 全球首个开源AI原生矢量设计工具，首创并发Agent Teams协同架构，支持多模型智能调度与MCP服务。通过自然语言提示实时流式生成UI，提供Design-as-Code的JSON格式，实现跨平台AI驱动的设计到代码全流程。
items.e: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent Agent Teams for parallel UI generation. Transforms natural language prompts into live canvas designs with streaming animation, offering Design-as-Code JSON format and MCP server integration for cross-platform AI-driven design-to-code workflows.

items.d: The most full featured web-to-app toolkit on Android, a complete APK workshop that runs entirely on your phone
items.z: WebToApp 是一款运行在 Android 手机上的完整 APK 构建工具，可将 Web 项目直接打包为原生应用。无需 PC 或远程服务器，支持执行服务端运行时、签名 Google Play 包、运行 MV3 浏览器扩展，并内置抗审查网络栈，是移动端开发者的离线构建利器。
items.e: WebToApp is a full-featured on-device Android APK builder that converts web projects into native apps directly on your phone. It supports server runtime execution, Google Play signing, MV3 browser extensions, and an anti-censorship network stack — no PC or remote server required.

items.d: 🤖 Keep your forks up-to-date via automated PRs
items.z: Pull 是一款 GitHub App，通过自动化 PR 保持 fork 仓库与上游同步。基于 Deno 2.0 和 TypeScript 构建，支持 merge、squash、rebase 和硬重置等多种同步策略。可定时检测上游变更，自动创建 PR 并分配审查者，兼容分支保护规则。提供灵活的 YAML 配置，支持 GitHub Enterprise Server，解决了开发者维护 fork 时的手动同步痛点，提升开源协作效率。
items.e: Pull is a GitHub App that automates fork synchronization with upstream repositories via pull requests. Built on Deno 2.0 and TypeScript, it supports configurable merge strategies including merge, squash, rebase, and hard reset. The app periodically checks for upstream changes, automatically creates PRs with assignees and reviewers, and respects branch protection rules. With flexible YAML configuration and GitHub Enterprise Server support, it eliminates manual fork maintenance overhead and streamlines open-source collaboration workflows.

items.d: Simple Proxy Client to force proxy to any Windows/MacOS/Linux Application TCP and UDP traffic
items.z: ProxyBridge是轻量开源跨平台代理客户端（Proxifier替代品），支持Windows、macOS、Linux。它在系统层透明拦截指定进程的TCP/UDP流量，通过SOCKS5或HTTP代理路由、阻止或放行，无需修改应用配置，兼容无代理感知程序，适用于安全测试、流量分析及协议调试。
items.e: ProxyBridge is a lightweight open-source cross-platform proxy client (Proxifier alternative) for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It transparently redirects TCP/UDP traffic from specific processes through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies at the system level, supporting per-app routing, blocking, or allowing. Compatible with proxy-unaware apps without configuration changes, ideal for security testing and traffic analysis.

items.d: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
items.z: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型与 RAG 的智能问数系统，实现自然语言到 SQL 的精准转换。支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），提供开箱即用的部署体验，内置工作空间隔离与细粒度权限管控。通过术语库与示例校准持续优化，支持 Web 嵌入、MCP 调用等多种集成方式，快速赋能业务系统智能查询能力。
items.e: SQLBot is an LLM-powered intelligent data query system leveraging RAG for accurate Text-to-SQL conversion. It enables conversational data analysis (ChatBI) with out-of-the-box deployment, featuring workspace isolation and fine-grained access control. The system continuously improves through custom terminology and SQL examples, offering flexible integration via Web embedding and MCP calls to rapidly empower business applications with natural language query capabilities.

items.d: AI Agent Skill (Claude Code, Codex & more): Turn any script into animated stickman videos for faceless YouTube, Shorts & TikTok. 14+ styles with voiceover, captions & SFX. Free & open-source (MIT).
items.z: Stickman Video Director是一款Codex Skill工具，利用Gemini Omni Flash将任意文案或创意转化为一分钟火柴人视频完整提示包。包含英文配音脚本、六场景导演计划及6个独立生产提示，支持9:16/16:9/1:1格式与明暗主题。核心亮点为故事架构优化、密集视觉隐喻与镜头运动规划、生产一致性锁定及源素材忠实性。适用于YouTube Shorts、TikTok、Instagram Reels等平台的教育短片、励志故事和视觉解说，通过对话式迭代审批提升短视频创作效率与连贯性。
items.e: Stickman Video Director is a Codex Skill that transforms any copy or idea into a complete one-minute stickman video prompt package using Gemini Omni Flash. It produces a confirmed English voiceover, a detailed six-scene director's proposal, and six standalone production-ready prompts. Supports 9:16, 16:9, and 1:1 formats with light/dark themes. Key highlights include stronger story architecture, dense motion planning with metaphors and camera moves, production consistency locks across prompts, format-aware direction, and source fidelity. Ideal for educational shorts, motivational stories, and visual explainers on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube via conversational iterative approval.

items.d: MaiSaka, an LLM-based intelligent agent, is a digital lifeform devoted to understanding you and interacting in the style of a real human. She does not pursue perfection, nor does she seek efficiency; instead, she values warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection.
items.z: 麦麦MaiBot是基于大语言模型的交互式智能体，定位为数字生命，致力于以真实人类风格互动，追求温暖、真实与连接而非完美或效率。核心亮点包括自然闲聊风格、群聊氛围感知与风格模仿、基于人格理论的用户画像积累，以及强大插件扩展系统。适用于个性化陪伴、智能对话和群聊参与等场景，提供更人性化的AI体验。
items.e: MaiBot (MaiSaka) is an LLM-powered interactive agent designed as a digital lifeform that engages in authentic human-like interactions, prioritizing warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection over perfection or efficiency. Key highlights include natural conversational styles, reading the room in group chats while mimicking styles and learning slang, building user profiles via personality theory, and a robust plugin system for extensibility. Ideal for personal companionship, immersive group conversations, and customizable AI experiences.

items.d: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
items.z: 该仓库提供免费HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4及SOCKS5代理列表，每5分钟自动抓取验证更新，覆盖105国家约3900个有效代理，支持TXT/JSON/CSV多格式，按协议分类且无重复。核心价值是实时可靠的代理资源池，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集、隐私保护及绕过地理限制等场景。技术亮点包括自动化验证、多协议支持、便捷下载及NPM模块集成。
items.e: The proxifly/free-proxy-list repository provides a free, frequently updated list of HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies, fetched and validated every 5 minutes from 105 countries with around 3900 working entries. Available in TXT, JSON, and CSV formats, categorized by protocol and country with no duplicates. Core value lies in delivering real-time, reliable proxy resources ideal for web scraping, data collection, anonymity, and bypassing restrictions. Technical highlights include automated validation, multi-protocol support, easy downloads, and NPM module integration.

items.d: ChatGPT 官网接口纯协议逆向实现，Go 语言编写，高并发、低内存、高性能。指纹级请求还原，支持 GPT-Image-2.6 生图/改图、GIF 动图、文本模型与语音合成/转写，兼容 OpenAI 接口协议，在线批量生图，号池管理，支持导入 CPA、sub2api 号池，可接入 Cherry Studio、New API 等软件
items.z: 本项目逆向ChatGPT官网接口，实现OpenAI兼容的图片生成与编辑API，支持gpt-image-2等模型。提供账号池管理、Docker自托管及在线画图功能，兼容Cherry Studio，适用于个人图像服务。
items.e: ChatGPT2API is a reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interfaces, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for image generation and editing using models like gpt-image-2. It features account pool management with automatic quota refresh, multiple import methods including CPA and sub2api, proxy support, and Docker self-hosting. Includes an online drawing workbench and compatibility with tools like Cherry Studio and New API. Ideal for personal, non-commercial image generation and editing services with sustained account usage.

items.d: Find the local LLM that actually runs and performs best on your hardware. Ranked by real, recency-aware benchmarks, not parameter count. One command, run it instantly.
items.z: whichllm 是一款命令行工具，自动检测 GPU/CPU/RAM，从 Hugging Face 筛选适配模型，基于 LiveBench、Chatbot Arena 等真实多源基准进行 recency-aware 排名，而非参数量或 VRAM 简单匹配。支持 GPU 模拟、升级对比、模型规划、聊天启动及 JSON 输出，一条 uvx 命令即可运行。核心价值是证据驱动的本地 LLM 推荐，帮助用户在硬件限制下选出性能最优模型。
items.e: whichllm is a CLI tool that auto-detects hardware (GPU/CPU/RAM) and ranks the best-fitting local LLMs from Hugging Face using aggregated real-world benchmarks like LiveBench and Chatbot Arena, with recency awareness rather than size or VRAM heuristics. It supports GPU simulation, upgrade comparisons, model planning, chat launching, and JSON output. Run instantly via one uvx command. Delivers evidence-graded recommendations for optimal performance on specific hardware.

items.d: PDF craft can convert PDF files into various other formats. This project will focus on processing PDF files of scanned books.
items.z: PDF Craft 是基于 DeepSeek OCR 的本地 PDF 转换工具，专注于扫描书籍的数字化处理。支持 GPU 加速，可将 PDF 转换为 Markdown 或 EPUB 格式，自动识别文档结构、提取正文、过滤页眉页脚，并正确处理表格、公式和脚注。v1.0.0 后完全本地化，无需网络请求，性能显著提升。
items.e: PDF Craft is a high-performance local PDF conversion tool built on DeepSeek OCR technology, specifically designed for digitizing scanned books and documents. The tool leverages GPU acceleration to efficiently convert PDF files into structured Markdown or EPUB formats while preserving document integrity. Key features include automatic document structure recognition, intelligent extraction of main text content, removal of interfering elements like headers and footers, and proper handling of complex elements such as tables, mathematical formulas, and footnotes. Starting from version 1.0.0, PDF Craft operates entirely offline without network dependencies, eliminating previous limitations of LLM-based text correction while delivering substantially improved conversion speed and reliability for academic and technical documents.

items.d: 赫蹏（hètí）是专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强。它基于通行的中文排版规范而来，可以为网站的读者带来更好的文章阅读体验。
items.z: 赫蹏是专为中文网页内容设计的排版增强库，基于现代CSS与JavaScript实现。它提供网格对齐、中西文混排自动美化、标点挤压、竖排古文诗词版式等特性，支持简繁体与黑暗模式。通过简单的类名引入即可显著提升中文阅读体验，兼容主流样式重置方案，适配移动端。
items.e: Heti is a specialized typography enhancement library designed for Chinese web content presentation, implemented with modern CSS and JavaScript. It delivers grid-aligned layout, automatic Chinese-Western text spacing, punctuation compression, pre-configured layouts for classical texts and poetry, vertical writing support, and seamless dark mode adaptation. The library supports both simplified and traditional Chinese while being fully responsive for mobile devices. With simple class name integration, it dramatically elevates Chinese reading experience and is compatible with popular CSS reset solutions.

items.d: The control plane for 24/7 always-on agents. Turn long-horizon goals into verifiable results across Codex, Claude Code, and custom runtimes—from local SQLite to team scale.
items.z: LoopX是开源、提供商中立的本地优先控制平面，专为长周期AI智能体设计。它作为轻量状态内核运行于Codex、Claude Code等框架之上，持久保存目标、闸门、待办、证据与交接，提供治理、恢复与人机协作能力，使长时任务可审查、可重启并跨工具安全交接。
items.e: LoopX is an open, provider-neutral, local-first control plane for long-horizon AI agents. It layers a lightweight state kernel atop harnesses like Codex and Claude Code, preserving objectives, gates, todos, evidence and handoffs across turns while enabling governance, recovery and human-agent collaboration for durable, reviewable work.

items.d: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.
items.z: AutoHedge 是一个基于群体智能的多代理AI系统，可自动化构建对冲基金。系统采用Director、Quant、Risk Manager、Execution四层代理架构，实现从市场分析、策略生成到风险控制和交易执行的全流程自主化。目前支持Solana链上全自动交易，采用风险优先设计，提供结构化输出和企业级日志，适用于机构级量化交易场景。
items.e: AutoHedge is an enterprise-grade autonomous hedge fund platform powered by swarm intelligence and multi-agent AI systems. It orchestrates specialized agents for market analysis, strategy generation, risk management, and trade execution in a risk-first pipeline. Currently supporting full autonomous trading on Solana, it features structured JSON outputs, comprehensive logging, and modular architecture for institutional-grade quantitative trading with minimal human intervention.

items.d: A compact Agent Skill for highly simplified, rounded, subtly neo-skeuomorphic IP mascot logos.
items.z: 紧凑型Agent Skill，专为AI智能体生成极度简化、圆润可爱的公司级IP吉祥物。强调4-7个基本形状的粗壮剪影、三色语义配色、下角主导构图与微妙新拟物深度，兼容Codex、Coze、Doubao等主流Agent及顶级图像模型，输出可商用的可爱方图。
items.e: A compact Agent Skill that enables AI agents to generate extremely simple, cute, company-ready IP mascot logos. It enforces bold rounded silhouettes from 4–7 shapes, three semantic colors, lower-corner dominance and subtle neo-skeuomorphic depth. Compatible with Codex, Coze, Doubao and top image models; produces commercially usable square character assets.

items.d: pierre’s open source code
items.z: 这是一个来自PIERRE COMPUTER COMPANY的开源元仓库，作为公司开源项目的中央枢纽。该项目采用TypeScript技术栈，目前托管了两个核心开发者工具：Diffs（专业的代码差异分析平台）和Trees（先进的树形结构可视化软件）。作为官方开源门户，它提供统一的代码分发、技术文档和全球开发者支持服务，体现了现代软件企业对于开放协作、透明开发和社区驱动创新的核心理念。
items.e: This is an open-source meta-repository from PIERRE COMPUTER COMPANY, serving as a central hub for the organization's open-source initiatives and developer tools. Built with TypeScript, it currently hosts two core projects: Diffs (a sophisticated code diff analysis platform) and Trees (an advanced tree structure visualization software). As the company's official open-source portal, it provides unified code distribution, comprehensive documentation, and dedicated technical support channels for the global developer community, demonstrating modern software enterprises' commitment to open collaboration, transparent development practices, and community-driven innovation.

items.d: 一款专注于 AI 多模态翻译的工具，一键自动翻译 RPG/SLG 游戏、Epub/TXT 小说、PDF/Word/MD 文档、Srt/Ass/Vtt 字幕，以及漫画图片、音频与视频等内容。
items.z: AiNiee 是一款专注于复杂长文本 AI 翻译的工具，支持游戏、电子书、文档、字幕等全格式一键翻译。采用思维链翻译、上下文关联和 AI 术语表技术突破长文本翻译局限，深度适配 Mtool、Renpy 等游戏提取工具，提供术语提取、AI 润色等质量控制功能，实现高效高质量的多领域翻译。
items.e: AiNiee is an AI-powered translation tool specialized in complex long-text translation across games, ebooks, documents, and subtitles. It employs chain-of-thought translation, contextual association, and AI glossary to overcome long-text limitations. With deep integration of game extraction tools like Mtool and Renpy, it offers terminology extraction and AI polishing features for efficient, high-quality multilingual translation.

items.d: 使用ai生成多章节的长篇小说，自动衔接上下文、伏笔
items.z: AI小说生成器基于大语言模型实现多章长篇创作，核心解决长文本上下文连贯与伏笔管理难题。提供世界观构建、角色设计、智能分章生成功能，集成向量语义检索确保长期一致性，内置自动校对系统检测逻辑冲突。配备可视化工作台，支持本地知识库接入，适用于网文创作、剧本构思等场景。项目采用Python开发，兼容OpenAI/DeepSeek等API及Ollama本地部署方案。
items.e: AI Novel Generator leverages large language models for multi-chapter long-form fiction creation, addressing context coherence and foreshadowing management in lengthy narratives. It features worldbuilding tools, character design, intelligent chapter generation with multi-stage processing, and vector-based semantic search for long-term consistency. The built-in proofreading system detects plot contradictions and logical conflicts. A visual workbench provides full GUI control, supporting local knowledge base integration. Built with Python, compatible with OpenAI/DeepSeek APIs and Ollama local deployment, ideal for web novel writing and creative scripting.

items.d: A script allowing you to download images and videos from Telegram web even if the group restricts downloading.
items.z: 该脚本是一款Telegram网页端用户脚本，可突破群组下载限制，实现图片、视频、GIF及音频等媒体的无损下载。支持私聊、频道及故事内容，通过注入页面解锁下载按钮，兼容主流浏览器及脚本管理器。无需后端服务，适用于需备份Telegram受限媒体资源的用户。
items.e: This user script bypasses Telegram web's download restrictions to save images, videos, GIFs, and audios from chats, stories, and private channels. It injects into pages to unlock download buttons, compatible with major browsers via script managers like Tampermonkey. Lightweight and backend-free, it efficiently backs up restricted Telegram media content.

items.d: Remove visible and invisible AI watermarks from images and video, and AI provenance metadata from images, video, and audio. Python library, CLI, and agent skill for SynthID, C2PA, EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and common generative-AI marks. By Victor Kuznetsov.
items.z: 这个仓库提供CLI和库，用于移除AI生成图像的可见和不可见水印。支持Gemini、DALL-E、Stable Diffusion等主流模型，采用反向alpha混合算法快速移除Gemini的sparkle logo，通过扩散模型再生消除SynthID等不可见水印，并剥离C2PA、EXIF等元数据。具备智能人脸保护和批量处理能力，可绕过社交媒体AI检测。
items.e: This repository offers a comprehensive CLI and library solution for removing both visible and invisible AI watermarks from images generated by major models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, and Midjourney. It employs a novel reverse alpha blending algorithm to deterministically remove the Gemini/Nano Banana sparkle logo in under 0.05 seconds without GPU requirements, using a three-stage NCC detector for dynamic positioning. For invisible watermarks including SynthID, StableSignature, and TreeRing, it utilizes diffusion-based regeneration at native SDXL resolution (~1024px) with controlled noise addition and denoising. The tool comprehensively strips AI metadata (C2PA manifests, EXIF, XMP, PNG text chunks), removes "Made with AI" labels that trigger social media flags, and features Smart Face Protection to prevent AI distortion. Additional capabilities include Analog Humanizer adding film grain to bypass AI classifiers and efficient batch processing for directories.

items.d: Easy and blazing-fast book searcher, create and search your private library.
items.z: 极速图书搜索引擎，支持创建私有书库。一分钟索引超1000万图书元数据，检索响应仅30微秒。提供跨平台桌面应用、命令行工具及Web API，支持Docker、Vercel/Netlify部署，可按字段精准搜索。
items.e: Ultra-fast book search engine for private libraries. Indexes 10M+ books/min, searches in 30µs. Cross-platform desktop, CLI, Web API. Docker/Vercel support.

items.d: Open-source auth gateway connecting 1700+ SaaS providers to AI agents through SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP, and OpenAPI.
items.z: OpenConnector 是开源 AI 智能体连接网关，替代 Pipedream/Composio。一次授权连接 1500+ SaaS（GitHub、Gmail、Notion 等），通过 SDK、CLI、MCP、HTTP/OpenAPI 暴露 10000+ 预置 Actions。支持凭证管理、可检查 Action 契约、策略控制与运行日志，可自托管（Docker/Node/K8s）或使用 OOMOL 托管运行时。
items.e: OpenConnector is an open-source auth gateway for AI agents, an alternative to Pipedream/Composio. Connect 1500+ SaaS providers once and expose 10,000+ prebuilt Actions via SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP and OpenAPI. It handles credentials, inspectable contracts, policies and logs, supporting self-hosting (Docker/Node/K8s) or OOMOL-hosted runtime.

items.d: A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.
items.z: UI SDK 是一个为 AI 智能体设计的用户界面行为库，提供键盘导航、焦点管理、选择、弹出、拖放等交互行为，并内置 ARIA 无障碍支持。通过 @ui-sdk/core 定义原始组件，可无缝适配 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components，助力智能体快速生成下一代 UI。
items.e: UI SDK is a library of behaviors for AI agents to build next-generation user interfaces. It provides keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag-and-drop, and ARIA accessibility. Built on @ui-sdk/core, it offers adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components, enabling agents to generate UIs seamlessly.

items.d: Collection great groups, channels, bots and libraries for Telegram
items.z: 这是一个精选的Telegram资源聚合仓库，系统整理了官方与社区开发的优质机器人、群组、频道及开发库。涵盖新闻资讯、群组管理、财务记账、语音转译、PDF处理等多元化场景，提供从功能工具到社区运营的完整生态索引，是Telegram用户发现服务和开发者寻找灵感的核心枢纽。
items.e: A curated repository aggregating premium Telegram resources including bots, groups, channels, and development libraries. Features diverse applications spanning news delivery, community moderation, financial tracking, speech translation, and PDF processing. Provides a comprehensive ecosystem index for both end-users seeking utility services and developers exploring bot development opportunities on the Telegram platform, serving as a central discovery hub.

items.d: Open-source, desktop-grade AI agent that gets real work done — data analysis, slides, docs, video & web research. Built on OpenClaw; runs tools on your real desktop and takes commands from your phone via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk & Telegram.
items.z: 网易有道推出的LobsterAI是一款24/7全场景AI个人助理，基于Electron+React构建跨平台桌面应用。核心采用Cowork模式，支持本地或Alpine沙盒环境执行任务，内置Office文档生成、Playwright自动化、Remotion视频生成等技能。通过Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu实现移动端远程控制，具备持久化记忆与权限审批机制，覆盖数据分析、PPT制作、邮件处理等办公场景。
items.e: LobsterAI by NetEase Youdao is a 24/7 all-scenario AI personal assistant built on Electron+React. Its core Cowork mode executes tasks in local or Alpine sandbox environments, featuring built-in skills like Office document generation, Playwright automation, and Remotion video creation. It enables remote control via IM platforms (Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu), persistent memory, permission gating, and covers productivity scenarios including data analysis, presentation creation, and email management.

items.d: Beancount: Double-Entry Accounting from Text Files.
items.z: Beancount 是一种基于文本的复式记账领域特定语言，将会计逻辑代码化。通过纯文本文件定义交易记录，支持自动化报告生成和 Web 界面展示，适用于个人理财与中小企业记账。v3 版本保持极简主义设计，强调持久性与可编程性，为开发者提供灵活的财务管理工具。
items.e: Beancount is a text-based domain-specific language for double-entry bookkeeping that codifies accounting logic into plain text files. It enables automated report generation and provides a web interface for visualization. Designed for personal finance and small business accounting, Beancount emphasizes minimalism, durability, and programmability. The current stable v3 version offers developers a flexible, scriptable financial management tool that treats accounting as code, ensuring long-term data portability and extensibility.

items.d: Matt Pocock skills 的简体中文本地化：人工审核每一次更新，定期同步上游，支持 Claude、Codex 和 DSH 插件。

items.e: This repository is the Simplified Chinese localization of mattpocock/skills, optimized for Chinese large language models and native developers. It applies a skill-guided content localization strategy, translating only natural language while preserving skill names, commands, code blocks, paths, and identifiers to ensure full installation and runtime compatibility. It delivers AI skills across engineering and productivity domains, enabling Chinese prompt engineering with reduced cognitive load and seamless integration into Chinese development workflows. Updates are synced from upstream with rigorous validation.

items.d: Turn your Telegram account into an unlimited, secure cloud storage drive. an Open-source desktop app built with Tauri, Rust, and React.
items.z: Telegram Drive是一款开源跨平台桌面应用，利用Telegram API将账号转化为无限安全的云存储驱动。基于Tauri、Rust和React构建，提供熟悉的文件资源管理器界面，支持Saved Messages和Channels作为文件夹。核心亮点包括高性能虚拟滚动、媒体流式播放、内置PDF查看器、拖放上传、密码保护分享链接、本地REST API支持AI集成、代理及VPN优化。隐私优先，数据与密钥本地存储，无第三方服务器。兼容Windows、macOS、Linux及Android平台。
items.e: Telegram Drive is an open-source cross-platform desktop app that turns your Telegram account into unlimited, secure cloud storage. Built with Tauri, Rust, and React, it provides a familiar file explorer using Saved Messages and Channels as folders. Highlights include high-performance virtual scrolling, media streaming, built-in PDF viewer, drag-and-drop, password-protected shareable links, local REST API for AI integration, proxy/VPN optimization, and privacy focus with all data local and no third-party servers. Supports Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

items.d: An Xposed module to intercept applist detections
items.z: 基于Xposed框架的Android隐私保护模块，通过拦截应用列表请求隐藏已安装应用，防止其他应用检测Root工具来识别设备Root状态，同时抵御基于应用列表的指纹追踪，并提供隐藏效果验证功能。
items.e: An Xposed module for Android that intercepts app list requests to hide installed applications from other apps. It prevents apps from detecting root-related tools (such as Fake Location or Storage Isolation) that would reveal a device is rooted. Additionally, it blocks apps from using app list enumeration as fingerprinting data or for other nefarious purposes. The module also provides built-in verification methods to test whether app list hiding is working properly, ensuring comprehensive privacy protection on rooted Android devices.

items.d: 最好用的 sing-box 一键安装脚本 & 管理脚本，自动创建 Hysteria2 协议；支持 TUIC，Trojan，REALITY 等所有常见的协议
items.z: 233boy/sing-box 是 sing-box 的最佳一键安装与管理脚本，支持 VLESS-REALITY 默认及 TUIC、Trojan、Hysteria2、Shadowsocks 等所有常见协议。核心价值在于高效自动化部署与管理：一键添加/更改配置、自动 TLS、多配置并行运行、零学习成本。适用于 Linux 服务器快速搭建安全代理服务，实现网络隐私保护与访问优化。技术亮点包括 BBR 启用、Caddy 伪装集成、兼容 sing-box 命令，设计强调高效率与极易用。
items.e: The 233boy/sing-box repo offers the ultimate one-click installation and management script for sing-box. It supports VLESS-REALITY by default and all common protocols including TUIC, Trojan, Hysteria2, Shadowsocks 2022, and various WS/H2/QUIC variants with TLS. Core value is high-efficiency automation for multi-config operation, one-click protocol addition and config changes, auto TLS, and BBR activation. Ideal for quickly deploying secure proxy servers on Linux for privacy protection and network optimization. Highlights include zero learning curve, Caddy fake site integration, full sing-box command compatibility, and powerful shortcuts.

items.d: An open-source vibe coding platform that helps you build your own vibe-coding platform, built entirely on Cloudflare stack
items.z: Cloudflare VibeSDK 是基于 Cloudflare 全栈生态的开源 AI 应用生成平台。它允许企业通过自然语言描述自动生成 React+TS+Tailwind 应用，并一键部署至 Workers。核心亮点包括 AI 智能纠错、沙箱实时预览、多 LLM 网关集成，以及可定制的组件库支持，适用于构建内部工具、SaaS 扩展和客户赋能平台。
items.e: Cloudflare VibeSDK is an open-source AI-powered full-stack app generator built entirely on Cloudflare's developer platform. It enables natural language-driven React+TypeScript+Tailwind application creation with one-click deployment to Workers. Key features include AI error correction, sandboxed live previews, multi-LLM gateway integration, and customizable component libraries—ideal for internal tools, SaaS extensions, and customer-facing AI platforms.

items.d: 📃 A better UX for chat, writing content, and coding with LLMs.
items.z: Open Canvas 是 LangChain 开源的 AI 文档协作平台，基于 LangGraph 构建多智能体系统。核心亮点包括：内置反思智能体实现跨会话记忆，支持从现有文档开始而非强制聊天，提供可定制快捷操作和版本回溯，同时支持代码与 Markdown 实时渲染编辑。作为 OpenAI Canvas 的开源替代方案，它通过持久化用户风格规则实现个性化体验，适用于写作、编程等场景。
items.e: Open Canvas is LangChain's open-source AI document collaboration platform built on LangGraph multi-agent architecture. Key innovations include: built-in reflection agents with cross-session memory, starting from existing documents instead of chat-only, customizable quick actions, artifact versioning, and live code/Markdown editing. As an open alternative to OpenAI Canvas, it personalizes experiences by persisting user style rules and insights, ideal for writing, coding, and collaborative content creation.

items.d: Persistent memory for Claude Code, Codex and 6 other AI agents, stored as plain markdown in your Obsidian vault. New: Crew, one shared logbook so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok Bot know what each other did. 48 commands: semantic search, self-rewriting notes, key-less research, scheduled agents.
