items.z: obsidian-second-brain 将 Obsidian vault 转变为跨 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 和 OpenCode 四 CLI 的活 AI 第二大脑。43 命令实现笔记自重写、自动知识合成、实时网络/X/YouTube 研究、/obsidian-architect 代码文档化、Google Calendar 集成及反幻觉机制。基于 Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式，vault 自我更新并调和矛盾，助力构建不断进化的个人知识系统。
items.e: obsidian-second-brain transforms your Obsidian vault into a living AI-first second brain across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. With 43 commands, it delivers self-rewriting notes that update existing pages and auto-reconcile contradictions, following Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Features include live research from web/X/YouTube, /obsidian-architect for codebase docs, keyless research, Google Calendar integration, scheduled agents, role presets, and anti-hallucination tools, enabling autonomous knowledge compounding.

items.d: Open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS / 安卓 / 鸿蒙兼容层
items.z: 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》iOS/macOS 兼容层，将 Switch 版游戏原生移植至 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。基于 aarch64 原生执行与 Metal 图形重实现，支持术士君临扩展、完整触控操作、60fps 流畅运行，用户自备游戏文件即可离线畅玩。
items.e: Open-source iOS/macOS compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with Reign of the Warlock. Runs the Switch build natively on Apple devices via aarch64 execution and Metal graphics reimplementation, with full touch controls and 60 fps.

items.d: The Librum client application
items.z: Librum 是一款基于 Qt 框架构建的开源跨平台电子书阅读与管理应用，核心价值在于融合个人数字图书馆与云同步能力。支持 EPUB 等格式，提供笔记、高亮、AI 辅助工具及深度界面定制，可自托管实现多设备无缝访问。集成 70,000+ 免费书籍资源，以现代化交互设计和隐私优先架构，为追求个性化与可控性的数字阅读者提供一体化解决方案。
items.e: Librum is an open-source, cross-platform e-book reader built on Qt framework that merges personal digital library management with cloud synchronization. It offers note-taking, highlighting, AI-powered tools, and deep UI customization, supporting self-hosting for multi-device access. Featuring 70,000+ free books and a modern interface, it delivers a privacy-focused, all-in-one reading solution for users seeking personalized digital literacy experiences.

items.d: 既然来了，就留下你的Star吧！Serv00 | CT8 | Hostuno | VPS | 游戏机 | sing-box(reality + hy2 + vmess-argo +tuic5)四合一无交互一键安装脚本(已适配Alpine)，支持纯V6 vps，丰富的分流服务, 可添加anytls,socks5,ss-2022等协议
items.z: sing-box多协议代理一键安装脚本，支持VLESS-reality、VMess-ws-tls(Argo)、Hysteria2、Tuic5等协议，适配VPS、Serv00、CT8、Alpine等环境。集成哪吒探针、Argo隧道与订阅管理，提供无交互部署、端口自定义与分流服务，适合快速搭建代理节点与网络加速场景。
items.e: One-click installation script for sing-box multi-protocol proxy, supporting VLESS-reality, VMess-ws-tls (Argo), Hysteria2, Tuic5. Compatible with VPS, Serv00, CT8, Alpine and more. Integrates Nezha monitoring, Argo tunnels and subscription features for automated deployment, custom ports and traffic routing in proxy and acceleration use cases.

items.z: Bypass Paywalls Clean for Chrome 是一款浏览器扩展，旨在帮助用户绕过新闻网站和在线出版物的付费墙限制。该扩展通过内容脚本和网络请求拦截技术，自动检测并规避付费订阅提示，使用户能够免费访问原本需要付费的内容。本仓库为扩展的专属支持与问题追踪平台，主代码已迁移至 gitflic.ru。
items.e: Bypass Paywalls Clean for Chrome is a browser extension designed to help users bypass paywalls on news sites and online publications. It employs content scripts and network request interception to automatically detect and circumvent paywall restrictions, allowing free access to premium content. This repository serves as the dedicated support and issue tracking platform, with the main codebase having been migrated to gitflic.ru.

items.d: Exa MCP for web search and web crawling!
items.z: Exa MCP Server 是 Exa Labs 推出的 Model Context Protocol 服务，为 AI 助手提供强大的网页搜索、代码检索和企业研究能力。该服务通过标准化接口将 Exa 的智能搜索技术无缝集成到 Cursor、VS Code、Claude 等主流开发环境，支持多种部署方式。开发者只需获取 API 密钥即可让 AI 具备实时网络信息获取和深度内容抓取能力，显著增强智能编程助手的上下文理解和数据检索功能。
items.e: The Exa MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol service by Exa Labs that equips AI assistants with advanced web search, code retrieval, and company research capabilities. It seamlessly integrates Exa's intelligent search technology into popular development environments like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude through standardized interfaces. Developers can easily connect via API key to enable AI assistants with real-time web information access and deep content crawling, dramatically enhancing context awareness and data retrieval for intelligent coding assistants.

items.d: Undetected version of the Playwright testing and automation library.
items.z: Patchright 是 Playwright 的补丁增强版，专为 Chromium 浏览器打造，作为可直接替换的 undetected 自动化框架。通过修复 Runtime.enable、命令行参数等常见泄漏，有效绕过 Cloudflare、Akamai、Kasada 等反爬系统，支持 Python、NodeJS 与 .NET，适用于高隐蔽性网页爬虫与自动化场景。
items.e: Patchright is a patched, undetected drop-in replacement for Playwright, focused on Chromium browsers. It fixes major detection leaks (Runtime.enable, automation flags, etc.) to bypass Cloudflare, Akamai, Kasada and similar anti-bot systems. Available for Python, NodeJS and .NET, ideal for stealth web scraping and browser automation.

items.d: OpenClaw: Use All Major AI Models NO API Token! Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao/Grok/Qwen/Manus/Kimi
items.z: OpenClaw Zero Token 是 OpenClaw 的零 Token 分支，通过浏览器驱动官方网页 UI（Playwright CDP 自动化）实现无需 API Token 免费调用 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao、Kimi 等十余款主流大模型。提供统一 HTTP 网关、Web UI、CLI/TUI 接口，支持提示注入工具调用（web_search 等）和 AskOnce 多模型对比。本地存储凭证，无配额限制。适用于 AI 开发者构建智能体、模型测试及成本敏感场景。
items.e: OpenClaw Zero Token is a fork of OpenClaw focused on zero-token LLM access. It automates official web UIs via browser login (Playwright CDP) to freely call Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Kimi and more through a unified gateway. Features include prompt-injected tool calling, AskOnce multi-model comparison, Web UI, CLI, and local credential storage. No API keys or quotas required. Ideal for developers building AI agents, model benchmarking, and cost-free LLM workflows on Node.js with Chrome.

items.d: Recursive-Open-Meta-Agent v0.1 (Beta). A meta-agent framework to build high-performance multi-agent systems.
items.z: ROMA是一个递归开放元代理框架，专注于构建高性能分层多智能体系统。该框架通过元代理架构实现智能体的递归组合与层次化管理，支持复杂任务的自动分解与协同执行。核心价值在于简化多智能体系统的构建流程，提供可扩展的递归设计模式，适用于需要动态编排和高效协作的AI应用场景。技术亮点包括分层代理治理、递归任务分解和开放扩展机制，为构建下一代智能系统提供基础设施。
items.e: ROMA is a Recursive Open Meta-Agent framework designed for building high-performance hierarchical multi-agent systems. It enables recursive composition and hierarchical management of agents through meta-agent architecture, supporting automatic decomposition and collaborative execution of complex tasks. The framework simplifies multi-agent system development with extensible recursive design patterns, ideal for AI applications requiring dynamic orchestration and efficient coordination. Key technical features include hierarchical agent governance, recursive task decomposition, and open extensibility mechanisms, providing robust infrastructure for building next-generation intelligent agent ecosystems with high scalability.

items.d: Chrome扩展：支持GPT（Codex） / kiro / Grok自动注册、上传
items.z: FlowPilot是专注于ChatGPT账号全生命周期管理的Chrome自动化插件。它实现从注册、验证码处理、Plus支付到平台接入的完整自动化链路，支持多邮箱方案和支付渠道，具备智能重试与批量执行能力。适用于AI账号规模化运营场景，可高效处理数百账号的自动化流程。
items.e: FlowPilot is a specialized Chrome extension for automated lifecycle management of ChatGPT accounts. It orchestrates complete workflows from registration, CAPTCHA handling, Plus payment processing to platform integration. The tool supports multiple email providers, payment gateways, and verification services, featuring intelligent retry mechanisms and batch execution capabilities. Designed for large-scale AI account operations, it enables efficient management of hundreds of accounts with high success rates and comprehensive record tracking.

items.d: 🚀 Transparent proxy injector for Antigravity. Force SOCKS5/HTTP proxy without TUN mode on Windows. | 专为 Antigravity 打造的免 TUN 强制代理工具，支持 DLL 注入与进程流量劫持。
items.z: Antigravity-Proxy 是专为 Google Antigravity AI 编辑器设计的 Windows 透明代理注入工具。通过 DLL 注入（version.dll 等）和 MinHook 钩子，精准劫持 language_server、node.exe 等进程的网络流量，强制走 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，无需 Clash TUN 模式。核心价值在于进程级流量控制，避免全局代理影响本地开发，解决中国用户系统代理不生效痛点。支持详细日志诊断与 IP 出口检测，C++17 实现，部署简单。
items.e: Antigravity-Proxy is a Windows-specific transparent proxy injector tailored for Google's Antigravity AI-powered agentic IDE. It uses DLL injection (e.g., version.dll) and MinHook to hijack network traffic from Antigravity processes like language_server_windows_x64.exe and node.exe, forcing SOCKS5/HTTP proxy routing without TUN mode. This enables selective proxying for Chinese users facing system proxy bypass issues, avoiding global traffic impact. Features C++17 implementation, detailed logging, IP diagnostics for location restrictions, and easy deployment to the app directory.

items.d: 🏞️ PicX，免费、安全的一站式在线图片处理平台。
items.z: PicX 是一款基于 GitHub API 的在线图床管理工具，无需下载安装即可使用。它支持拖拽上传、批量操作、图片压缩和水印处理，提供 Markdown/HTML 等多种链接格式。通过 GitHub OAuth 或 Token 认证，用户可将 GitHub 仓库作为免费图床，配合 jsDelivr 等 CDN 实现高速访问，是开发者和技术写作者的理想图片托管解决方案。
items.e: PicX is a GitHub API-based online image hosting management tool that requires no download or installation. It supports drag-and-drop upload, batch operations, image compression, and watermarking, providing multiple link formats like Markdown/HTML. Through GitHub OAuth or Token authentication, users can leverage GitHub repositories as free image hosts, combined with CDNs like jsDelivr for high-speed access, making it an ideal image hosting solution for developers and technical writers.

items.d: Curated list of the best truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure. Daily updated.
items.z: 这是一个全面收录高质量开源AI项目的精选列表，涵盖核心框架、基础模型、推理引擎、AI代理、RAG、MLOps等14大类别。为开发者提供从研究到生产落地的完整技术栈导航，助力快速发现与集成前沿开源AI工具，推动AI技术民主化。
items.e: A comprehensive curated list of high-quality truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure spanning 14 categories from core frameworks to production deployment. Covers the entire AI technology stack including foundation models, inference engines, agentic AI systems, RAG, MLOps, and AI safety tools. Serves as an essential developer resource for discovering, evaluating, and integrating cutting-edge open-source AI solutions, significantly lowering barriers to AI adoption and fostering innovation through open collaboration.

items.d: OpenKB: Open LLM Knowledge Base
items.z: OpenKB是开源CLI的LLM知识库系统，通过编译文档构建结构化wiki，支持PageIndex无向量长文档检索与推理。知识一次性持久化积累，自动生成摘要、概念页与交叉引用，优于传统RAG每次重算。兼容多LLM、多模态输入及Skill Factory蒸馏专家技能。适用于知识管理、学术研究与智能体构建场景。
items.e: OpenKB is an open-source CLI system that uses LLMs to compile raw documents into a structured, interlinked wiki-style knowledge base. Powered by PageIndex for vectorless long-document retrieval and reasoning, it compiles knowledge once into a persistent wiki with automatic summaries, concepts, and cross-references—unlike traditional RAG. Supports multi-LLM via LiteLLM, multi-modality, query/chat, and Skill Factory for portable expert skills. Ideal for knowledge management, research, and AI agent development.

items.d: 高颜值第三方 B 站 React Native 客户端
items.z: JKVideo 是一款基于 React Native 和 Expo 构建的高颜值第三方 B 站客户端，支持 Android、iOS 和 Web 三端。核心亮点包括完整的 DASH 视频播放系统（4K HDR）、实时弹幕同步、纯 TypeScript 实现的 WBI 签名算法，以及 Zustand 状态管理。提供扫码登录、下载管理和局域网分享功能，是跨平台视频应用开发的优秀实践。
items.e: JKVideo is a high-quality third-party Bilibili client built with React Native and Expo, supporting Android, iOS, and Web platforms. Key features include complete DASH video playback (4K HDR), real-time danmaku synchronization, pure TypeScript WBI signing algorithm, and Zustand state management. It offers QR code login, download management, and LAN sharing capabilities, serving as an excellent example of cross-platform video application development.

items.d: 🤹 Access thousands of icons as components on-demand universally.
items.z: unplugin-icons 是基于 Iconify 的通用图标组件库，提供超20万图标并支持150+图标集。通过按需加载机制仅打包实际使用的图标，显著减小构建体积。支持 Vite、Webpack 等主流构建工具及 React、Vue 3 等框架，具备自动导入、SSR/SSG 友好、自定义图标等特性，适用于现代前端项目。
items.e: unplugin-icons is a universal icon library leveraging Iconify, providing 200,000+ icons across 150+ sets. It enables on-demand loading to bundle only used icons, reducing bundle size. Compatible with major build tools (Vite, Webpack, Rollup) and frameworks (React, Vue 3, Svelte), it features auto-importing, custom icons, and SSR/SSG support without FOUC for modern web development.

items.d: Lossless Claw — LCM (Lossless Context Management) plugin for OpenClaw
items.z: Lossless Claw 是 OpenClaw 的无损上下文管理插件，基于 LCM 论文实现。它通过 DAG 结构摘要系统解决 AI 代理长对话的 token 限制问题，将所有消息持久化到 SQLite 数据库，并使用 LLM 动态生成多层次摘要，确保对话历史完整可查。提供搜索工具让代理随时召回细节，实现永不遗忘的智能体体验。
items.e: Lossless Claw is a Lossless Context Management (LCM) plugin for OpenClaw that solves AI agents' context window limitations through innovative DAG-based summarization. Instead of truncating old messages, it persists every message in SQLite and creates hierarchical LLM-generated summaries, forming a directed acyclic graph that preserves all original details. The system dynamically assembles context by combining recent messages with relevant summaries, ensuring no information is ever lost. With built-in tools like lcm_grep and lcm_expand, agents can instantly search and retrieve any historical detail, delivering a seamless never-forget conversational experience while staying within model token constraints.

items.d: AI You Control: Choose your models. Own your data. Eliminate vendor lock-in.
items.z: Thunderbolt 是 Mozilla 开源的跨平台 AI 客户端，主打'AI You Control'理念。支持本地部署，兼容 Ollama、llama.cpp 等本地推理引擎及 OpenAI 兼容 API，彻底摆脱供应商锁定。提供桌面、移动端全覆盖，面向企业客户，支持私有化部署，强调数据主权与安全可控，目前处于安全审计阶段，即将企业就绪。
items.e: Thunderbolt is Mozilla's open-source, cross-platform AI client championing 'AI You Control' with full vendor lock-in elimination. It supports local deployment, integrates with Ollama, llama.cpp and OpenAI-compatible APIs, ensuring data ownership. Available across desktop and mobile platforms, it targets enterprise on-premise deployment with enhanced security and privacy, currently undergoing security audit for production readiness.

items.d: Image Hosting solution, Flickr/imgur alternative, make it easy for users to share their images. Using Cloudflare Pages and Telegraph.
items.z: Telegraph-Image 是基于 Cloudflare Pages 和 Telegram Channel 的免费图床方案，替代 Flickr/imgur。核心价值：无限存储（单图5MB限制）、零服务器成本、自动绑定 pages.dev 域名或自定义域名。技术亮点包括可选 AI 图片审查、后台管理（网格/瀑布流视图）、批量删除与分页功能，完全依赖 Cloudflare 免费额度运营。
items.e: Telegraph-Image is a free image hosting solution using Cloudflare Pages and Telegram Channel as a Flickr/imgur alternative. Key value: unlimited storage (5MB/image cap), zero server cost, automatic *.pages.dev domain or custom domain binding. Technical highlights include optional AI image moderation, backend management (grid/waterfall views), batch operations, and full operation within Cloudflare's free tier limits.

items.d: OpenRAG is a comprehensive, single package Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform built on Langflow, Docling, and Opensearch.
items.z: OpenRAG是基于Langflow、Docling和OpenSearch的开箱即用RAG平台，提供智能文档搜索与AI对话能力。支持可视化工作流构建、多Agent协调与企业级语义检索，可快速部署处理真实数据，实现生产级企业知识管理。
items.e: OpenRAG is a production-ready RAG platform integrating Langflow, Docling, and OpenSearch for intelligent document search and AI conversations. It features visual workflow orchestration, multi-agent coordination, and enterprise-grade semantic retrieval, enabling rapid deployment on messy real-world data.

items.d: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
items.z: Deep Research是一个隐私优先的深度研究工具，支持Gemini、OpenAI、Deepseek等主流大模型，可在2分钟内生成综合性研究报告。核心亮点包括：浏览器端本地数据处理确保隐私安全；支持Searxng、Tavily等搜索引擎；提供知识图谱构建和本地知识库管理；支持MCP服务器和SSE API。基于Next.js构建，可一键部署至Vercel或Cloudflare，适用于快速调研和知识整理场景。
items.e: Deep Research is a privacy-first deep research tool that leverages multiple LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Deepseek, etc.) to generate comprehensive reports in approximately 2 minutes. Key features include local browser-side data processing for privacy, integration with search engines like Searxng and Tavily, knowledge graph generation, and local knowledge base management. Built with Next.js, it supports MCP server and SSE API, offering one-click deployment to Vercel or Cloudflare. Ideal for rapid research and knowledge organization with full data control.

items.d: 《大语言模型》作者：赵鑫，李军毅，周昆，唐天一，文继荣
items.z: 本书系统阐述大语言模型技术体系，涵盖预训练、微调、对齐及提示工程等核心内容。基于作者团队前沿研究与工业实践，提供完整技术框架与路线图，配套教学课件。适合具深度学习基础的读者入门大模型技术，可作为高校课程与行业研发权威参考。
items.e: This book systematically presents the comprehensive technical framework of Large Language Models, covering fundamental aspects including pre-training, fine-tuning, alignment, and prompt engineering. Based on the authors' pioneering research and practical industrial experience in developing models like Wenlan and Yulan, it offers a structured learning roadmap with supplementary lecture slides. Aimed at readers with foundational deep learning knowledge, this authoritative volume serves as an essential reference for both academic courses and industrial R&D in LLM technology, bridging theoretical concepts with real-world implementation.

items.d: An AI-Powered Speech Processing Toolkit and Open Source SOTA Pretrained Models, Supporting Speech Enhancement, Separation, and Target Speaker Extraction, etc.
items.z: ClearerVoice-Studio是阿里巴巴开源的AI语音处理工具包，集成语音增强、分离、超分辨率及目标说话人提取等SOTA预训练模型。支持10+音频格式与立体声处理，提供灵活的NumPy接口和完整训练/推理脚本。其FRCRN降噪模型已在ModelScope被调用超300万次，为研究、开发和生产提供一站式解决方案。
items.e: ClearerVoice-Studio is an open-source AI-powered speech processing toolkit by Alibaba, featuring SOTA pretrained models for speech enhancement, separation, super-resolution, and target speaker extraction. Supporting 10+ audio formats with stereo processing, it offers flexible NumPy interfaces and comprehensive training/inference scripts. Its FRCRN denoiser has surpassed 3 million uses on ModelScope, delivering a production-ready solution for researchers and developers.

items.d: Standalone iOS app to spoof GPS location without jailbreak. Includes Shadowrocket/Surge/Loon/QX/Stash module.
items.z: 无需越狱的iOS GPS位置伪造工具。利用代理软件HTTPS解密与MITM功能，拦截Apple定位响应，修改WiFi及蜂窝基站坐标，实现任意地点定位。基于原Go项目移植为JavaScript模块，适配Shadowrocket、Surge、Loon等五大平台。新增多格式兼容、运动状态伪造等功能。适用于隐私保护、应用测试与地图验证，配置参数简单，即导即用。
items.e: A jailbreak-free iOS GPS location spoofer that intercepts Apple's location responses via proxy apps' HTTPS decryption and MITM. It modifies WiFi and cell tower coordinates to fake any location. Ported from an original Go app to JavaScript modules for Shadowrocket, Surge, Loon, Quantumult X, and Stash. Adds cell tower spoofing, multi-format support, and motion state faking. Ideal for privacy protection, app testing, and map verification with simple config parameters.

items.d: A contact solver for physics-based simulations involving 👚 shells, 🪵 solids, 🪢 rods, 🧱 rigid bodies and ⏳ sand.
items.z: ZOZO开源的高性能GPU接触求解器，专为布料、固体和绳索的物理仿真设计。采用FEM有限元方法与符号力雅可比，支持超1.8亿接触点的大规模并行计算，实现无穿透的精确模拟。提供Blender插件、Docker部署和Python API，适用于时尚电商、游戏特效等场景，单精度GPU加速确保高效稳定。
items.e: ZOZO's high-performance GPU contact solver for physics simulation of shells, solids and rods. Leveraging FEM with symbolic force jacobians, it handles over 180M contacts in parallel with penetration-free accuracy. Features Blender integration, Docker deployment and Python APIs, ideal for fashion e-commerce and visual effects. Single-precision GPU acceleration ensures efficiency.

items.d: On-device subtitle generation that connects directly to DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, and After Effects.
items.z: AutoSubs 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的跨平台 AI 字幕生成工具，本地运行 Whisper 等模型实现高精度语音转录。支持说话人分离、多语言翻译，可导出 SRT 或直接导入 DaVinci Resolve 进行高级样式定制。无需云端订阅，保障数据隐私，为视频创作者提供高效、可定制的自动化字幕解决方案。
items.e: AutoSubs is a cross-platform desktop application that generates AI-powered subtitles locally on user devices without cloud dependencies. Built on Tauri framework with React frontend and Rust backend, it leverages state-of-the-art models including Whisper, Parakeet and Pyannote for accurate transcription, speaker diarization and translation. The tool offers one-click export to SRT or direct integration with DaVinci Resolve, featuring per-speaker styling and real-time editing capabilities. Designed for video creators and post-production professionals, it delivers privacy-preserving, efficient subtitle workflows with full customization options.

items.d: skill to create best prompts for generating videos with seedance2.0
items.z: 该GitHub仓库提供针对字节跳动Seedance 2.0多模态AI视频生成模型的提示词撰写技能，专为Claude等AI智能体设计。核心包括输入约束、@引用语法、镜头语言、提示结构模式及多场景模板，覆盖广告、戏剧、MV和教育内容。基于官方文档，助力用户通过结构化提示工程高效生成高质量视频提示，提升AI视频创作的专业水平与效率。
items.e: This repository provides specialized skills for AI agents to craft optimal prompts for ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 multimodal video generation model. It covers input constraints, @ reference syntax, camera language, prompt structures, and ready-to-use templates for ads, dramas, MVs, and educational content. Based on official docs, it enables efficient high-quality prompt engineering in tools like Claude Code and Cursor, boosting video output across creative and commercial scenarios.

items.d: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
items.z: Codeg 是多智能体 AI 编程协作工作区，统一聚合 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 等十余种 AI 编码代理，支持跨代理会话迁移与 @ 委派协作，提供桌面端、自托管服务器、Docker 及移动端全平台部署，让多个 AI 代理在同一结构化界面中协同完成开发任务。
items.e: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace that unifies 15+ AI coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and more—into a single structured conversation interface with live diffs and project file browsing. It supports cross-agent session import, search, and transfer, plus @-delegation for inter-agent task collaboration in isolated worktrees. Deployable as a desktop app, self-hosted server, Docker container, or mobile apps for iOS and Android, with integrations for Telegram, Lark, and WeChat for remote access.

items.d: 自建 Docker 镜像加速与管理服务。零磁盘缓存、可视化面板、支持上游账号认证，支持一键部署Docker、K8s、Quay、Ghcr、Mcr、elastic、nvcr等镜像加速
items.z: 该项目提供一键部署的Docker镜像加速服务，基于官方Registry支持Docker Hub、K8s、Quay等主流仓库代理。支持自动配置反向代理（Nginx/Caddy）、缓存控制、IP黑白名单及私有镜像拉取，解决国内镜像下载慢和频率限制问题。可部署在自有服务器或ClawCloud/Render等免费平台，附带Web管理面板实现镜像搜索与容器监控。
items.e: This project provides a one-click deployable Docker image acceleration service based on the official Registry, supporting proxies for Docker Hub, K8s, Quay, and other major registries. It features automatic reverse proxy (Nginx/Caddy) setup, cache control, IP whitelisting/blacklisting, and private image pulling to address slow downloads and rate limits in China. It can be deployed on private servers or free platforms like ClawCloud/Render, with a web management panel for image search and container monitoring.

items.d: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.
items.z: gzh-design-skill 是一个专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版技能，将 Markdown 一键转为微信编辑器兼容的内联 HTML。内置 6 套精选主题及主题生成器，支持自动章节编号、关键词下划线、代码块图片 GIF 处理，并通过 Python 双重校验脚本确保质量。适用于教程测评、深度分析、数据报告等场景，规避平台格式限制，实现确定性高质量输出，提升内容创作效率。
items.e: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready, inline-styled HTML optimized for the WeChat public account editor. It features 6 curated themes, a theme generator, automatic chapter numbering, keyword highlighting, code block/image/GIF support, and dual Python validation scripts. Ideal for tutorials, reviews, analyses, and reports, it ensures WeChat compatibility and deterministic quality for agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

items.d: AI-powered penetration testing assistant using local LLM on linux (Parrot OS)
items.z: METATRON是一款完全本地运行的CLI渗透测试AI助手，基于Ollama部署的定制Qwen模型（metatron-qwen），自动调用nmap、whois、nikto等真实侦察工具，结合DuckDuckGo与CVE查询，进行漏洞分析、利用建议与修复推荐。支持Agentic循环、MariaDB全量历史存储及PDF/HTML报告导出，无需云端或API密钥，专为Parrot OS等Linux环境打造。
items.e: METATRON is a fully local CLI AI penetration testing assistant powered by a custom Qwen model (metatron-qwen) via Ollama. It automates real recon tools (nmap, whois, nikto, etc.), integrates DuckDuckGo and CVE lookups, and performs vulnerability analysis, exploit suggestions, and fix recommendations. Features an agentic loop, MariaDB history storage, and PDF/HTML report export. Runs entirely offline with no API keys, designed for Parrot OS and Linux.

items.d: Terraink: The Cartographic Poster Engine that creates unique and customizable map posters
items.z: TerraInk 是一款基于 OpenStreetMap 数据的地图海报生成引擎。用户可通过地理编码搜索全球任意地点，自定义配色主题、地图图层和字体样式，并导出高分辨率 PNG 打印文件。采用 Bun+React+TypeScript 全栈技术，集成 MapLibre 实现矢量地图渲染，为设计师和地理爱好者提供便捷的创意地图制作工具。
items.e: TerraInk is a cartographic poster engine that generates unique, customizable map posters using real OpenStreetMap data. The platform offers smart geocoding for global locations, a rich theme system with dozens of curated color palettes, detailed map layer controls for roads, water, parks and buildings, and flexible typography options with Google Fonts integration. Built on a modern Bun+React+TypeScript stack with MapLibre for vector tile rendering, it enables users to export print-ready high-resolution PNG posters at any dimension, serving as an accessible creative tool for designers, geography enthusiasts, and anyone seeking personalized map art.

items.d: 📜 A minimalist personal website embodying the purity of paper and freshness of snow.
items.z: Shiro 是为 Mix Space 生态系统打造的极简主义个人网站主题，融合纸的纯净与雪的清新。基于 Next.js 16 App Router 构建，集成 Jotai 状态管理、Socket.IO 实时推送和 Motion 物理动画，Lighthouse 性能评分超 90。支持 Markdown 扩展、多语言、实时活动状态展示，提供优雅的写作与阅读体验。
items.e: Shiro is a minimalist personal website theme designed for the Mix Space ecosystem, embodying the purity of paper and freshness of snow. Built on Next.js 16 App Router with Jotai state management, Socket.IO real-time communication, and Motion physics-based animations, it achieves Lighthouse scores above 90. The theme features Markdown extensions, multilingual support via next-intl, real-time activity status, and a dedicated 'Recently' thoughts system, delivering an elegant writing and reading experience.

items.d: 京东抢购自动下单助手，GUI 支持 Windows 和 macOS
items.z: 京东小猪手是Python开发的跨平台自动抢购助手，核心功能包括7x24小时库存监听、自动下单及微信通知。支持扫码登录与预售定金模式，提供Windows/macOS图形界面，简化配置流程。采用SKU/AreaID精准定位商品与配送区域，适用于秒杀、缺货商品监控等场景，提升抢购成功率。
items.e: JdBuyer is a Python-based cross-platform automation assistant for JD.com flash sales. It provides 24/7 stock monitoring, automatic order placement, and WeChat notifications. The tool features QR code login, GUI support for Windows/macOS, and handles pre-sale deposits. Users configure SKU/AreaID for precise targeting, making it effective for seckill events and out-of-stock tracking, giving regular buyers equal opportunity against automated scalpers.

items.d: 四柱八字命理分析
items.z: 基于Claude Code的赛博算命Skill，通过交互对话收集出生信息，自动排出四柱八字、大运与流年，并参照《穷通宝典》《滴天髓》等九本经典典籍，进行日主强弱、十神关系、五行平衡、格局判定及事业感情健康综合分析。纯标准库Python实现，零依赖，专为传统文化学习与娱乐参考设计。
items.e: A Claude Code Skill for BaZi (Four Pillars) destiny analysis. It interactively collects birth details, computes year/month/day/hour pillars plus luck cycles, and delivers professional readings on day-master strength, ten gods, five elements, patterns, and life advice, grounded in nine classical Chinese metaphysics texts. Pure standard-library Python, zero dependencies.

items.d: List of Science courses with video lectures
items.z: 该仓库聚合了MIT、斯坦福、耶鲁等顶尖学府的数学与科学视频课程资源，涵盖物理、量子力学、弦理论等前沿领域。核心价值在于提供免费、高质量的系统化学习材料，适合自学深造和教学参考。技术亮点是资源整合与分类，便于用户快速定位所需课程。
items.e: This repository curates a comprehensive collection of free video lectures from prestigious institutions including MIT, Stanford, and Yale, spanning mathematics, physics, quantum mechanics, string theory, and cosmology. It offers systematically organized, high-quality educational resources for self-paced learning and academic reference. The key technical value lies in its meticulous categorization and direct access to otherwise hard-to-find advanced course materials from world-renowned professors.

items.d: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers
items.z: NodeWarden 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的第三方 Bitwarden 兼容服务端，实现零成本自托管密码管理。支持多用户、附件存储、TOTP 及 Passkey 等核心功能，兼容全平台官方客户端。利用 R2/KV 存储保障数据安全，适合个人及小团队私有化部署，规避企业版订阅费用。
items.e: NodeWarden is a third-party Bitwarden-compatible server deployed on Cloudflare Workers, enabling zero-cost self-hosted password management. It supports multi-user access, attachments, TOTP, and Passkey features while maintaining full compatibility with official clients across platforms. Leveraging R2/KV storage for data security, it's ideal for individuals and small teams seeking private deployment without enterprise subscription fees.

items.d: Build a modern LLM from scratch. Every line commented. Explained like we are five.
items.z: 这是一个从零构建现代大语言模型的教学项目，采用LLaMA 3架构风格，包含12章7500+行完全注释的代码。核心亮点是"像教五岁小孩一样解释复杂概念"，通过儿童级类比和逐行注释深入讲解RoPE位置编码、注意力机制、RMSNorm、SwiGLU等核心技术。提供18个独立主题解释器和完整句子前向传播演练，仅需Python基础即可理解LLM底层原理，适合想真正掌握Transformer架构的开发者。
items.e: An interactive textbook for building a modern LLM from scratch using LLaMA 3-style architecture. Features 12 chapters with 7,500+ fully commented lines, 18 standalone topic explainers, and child-friendly analogies for complex concepts like RoPE, attention, and SwiGLU. Requires only basic Python knowledge, no ML prerequisites. Includes narrative walkthroughs tracing sentences through the entire model, making it ideal for engineers who want deep understanding of Transformer internals rather than just API usage.

items.d: Open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution platform with AI quality inspection, illustrated admin help, hosted sites, browser-assisted publishing, and signed updates.
items.z: GEOFlow 是开源的 GEO 内容工程与多站点分发系统，通过 AI 生成、RAG 知识库、素材管理和任务自动化，实现可信内容资产的全链路管理。支持多模型调用、智能审核、SEO 优化和静态页面分发，适用于大规模内容生产与多渠道发布场景。基于 Laravel 和 pgvector，提供 Docker 一键部署方案。
items.e: GEOFlow is an open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution system that orchestrates AI generation, RAG knowledge bases, material management, and task automation into a sustainable workflow. It enables teams to transform trusted resources into manageable, publishable, and trackable content assets across multiple channels. Key features include multi-model AI integration, intelligent review, SEO optimization, static page generation, and analytics. Built on Laravel with PostgreSQL and pgvector, it offers Docker Compose deployment for scalable content operations.

items.d: Extract any website’s design system into tokens in seconds: logo, colors, typography, borders & more. One command.
items.z: Dembrandt 是一款一键提取任意网站设计系统的 CLI 工具。基于 Playwright 渲染页面并分析 DOM 计算样式，自动输出 Logo、颜色、字体、间距、边框、阴影、动效与组件等完整设计令牌，支持 W3C DTCG、shadcn/ui、Tailwind 等多格式导出，并可在 CI 中检测设计漂移，生成品牌指南或供 AI 代理使用。
items.e: Dembrandt is a CLI tool that extracts any website’s design system into standardized tokens in one command. Powered by Playwright, it analyzes computed DOM styles to capture logo, colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion and components. Outputs W3C DTCG, shadcn/ui, Tailwind themes and more; supports CI drift detection, brand guides and AI-agent ready DESIGN.md.

items.d: Virtual DSM in a Docker container.
items.z: vdsm/virtual-dsm 是一个创新的轻量级 NAS 解决方案，通过在 Docker 容器中虚拟化运行 Synology DSM 系统，结合 KVM 硬件加速技术实现接近原生的性能表现。项目支持多磁盘管理、物理设备直通、CPU 与内存灵活配置，可快速部署于 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 平台，适用于个人私有云存储、开发测试环境及轻量级生产场景。
items.e: vdsm/virtual-dsm is an innovative lightweight NAS solution that virtualizes Synology DSM within Docker containers, leveraging KVM hardware acceleration to deliver near-native performance. This project provides comprehensive storage virtualization capabilities including multi-disk management, raw device passthrough, and dynamic resource allocation for CPU and memory. With support for Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and GitHub Codespaces, it enables rapid deployment across Linux, Windows, and macOS platforms. The solution is particularly suited for personal cloud storage, development testing environments, and scenarios requiring flexible, containerized NAS infrastructure with enterprise-grade features.

items.d: AI-Powered Python & Python-Powered AI (Python-Use)
items.z: Python-Use 提出了一种名为 'AI Think Do' 的 AI Agent 2.0 新范式，旨在取代依赖外部插件和复杂工作流的传统 Agent 1.0 架构。其核心思想是将完整的 Python 解释器环境直接交给 LLM，让模型通过自主编写、调试和执行 Python 代码来直接操作真实环境（如数据、浏览器、文件系统），从而实现任务驱动的端到端自动化。该方案摒弃了 MCP、Function Calling 和插件注册等中间层，强调 'Code is Agent'，以极简架构释放 AI 的原生执行能力。
items.e: Python-Use introduces a novel AI Agent 2.0 paradigm called 'AI Think Do', designed to replace traditional Agent 1.0 architectures reliant on external plugins and complex workflows. Its core principle is providing LLMs direct access to a full Python interpreter, enabling them to autonomously write, debug, and execute code to interact with real environments (data, browsers, file systems) for task-driven end-to-end automation. It eliminates intermediate layers like MCP, Function Calling, and plugin registration, advocating 'Code is Agent' to unleash native AI execution capabilities with a minimalist architecture.

items.d: Help AI coding agents write modern Go
items.z: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines 为 AI 编码代理提供 Go 现代编程指南。从 go.mod 自动检测项目 Go 版本，使用 1.0-1.27 最新特性（slices.Contains、cmp.Or、errors.AsType[T] 等）。规避训练数据滞后和频率偏见，生成简洁高效代码，减少后续维护。涵盖 modernize 分析器全部目标功能，适用于 Junie、Claude Code、Cursor 等代理。
items.e: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines provides Go modern coding guidelines for AI coding agents. Automatically detects project Go version from go.mod and uses latest features from 1.0 to 1.27 (e.g., slices.Contains, cmp.Or, errors.AsType[T]). Avoids training data lag and frequency bias, generating clean and efficient code with minimal maintenance. Covers all targets of the modernize analyzer; integrates with Junie, Claude Code, Cursor and others.

items.d: Curated list of AI-powered developer tools.
items.z: 该仓库系统性地整理了AI驱动的开发者工具生态，覆盖智能IDE、终端代理到自动化CI/CD的全链路场景。核心价值在于通过LLM增强代码生成、重构与调试效率，并引入多智能体编排和沙箱隔离技术实现安全自治。典型应用包括Cursor/Windsurf等AI-Native编辑器、PR审查机器人及数据库智能助手，是开发者迈向AI编程时代的导航地图。
items.e: This repository curates an ecosystem of AI-powered developer tools spanning intelligent IDEs, terminal agents, and automated CI/CD pipelines. It enhances coding efficiency through LLM-driven generation, refactoring, and debugging, while introducing multi-agent orchestration and sandboxing for secure autonomy. Key applications include AI-native editors like Cursor/Windsurf, PR review bots, and database assistants, serving as a roadmap for developers transitioning to AI-augmented programming.

items.d: A browser extension that helps users publish content to multiple social media platforms with one click.
items.z: 这款浏览器扩展MultiPost支持一键将内容同步发布到知乎、微博、小红书、抖音等10多个平台。无需任何登录或API Key，完全免费。提供扩展API和RESTful API便于开发者集成。解决了内容创作者跨平台发布的难题，提升效率。适用于社交媒体营销和内容自动化分发场景。
items.e: MultiPost is a browser extension that allows users to publish content such as text, images, and videos to over 10 social media platforms including Zhihu, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin with just one click. No login, registration, or API key is needed, and the service is completely free. It provides an Extension API and a RESTful API for easy integration into web applications or scripts. This tool solves the challenges content creators face when posting across multiple platforms, greatly improving efficiency. It is ideal for social media marketing and automated content distribution scenarios, with a companion Markdown editor available.

items.d: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
items.z: sepia 是可移植的 Agent Skill，基于 StoryScope 研究，从叙事架构层消除 AI 写作痕迹。小说先修复因果与主题结构，再处理篇章与字句；专业文按场景（发版说明、PR、事故复盘等）匹配规则。支持 77+ 代理及 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 等原生插件，提供写、审、改、重写四种操作。
items.e: sepia is a portable Agent Skill that de-AIs writing at the architectural layer, based on StoryScope research. Fiction repairs narrative structure before style; professional prose applies venue-matched rules for release notes, PRs, postmortems and more. Works with 77+ agents via Skills CLI, plus native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build and others, offering write, review, refactor and recreate operations.

items.d: Something about tools
items.z: 这是一个自动化系统重装工具集，核心为InstallNET.sh脚本，支持命令行一键网络重装Debian、Ubuntu、CentOS、AlmaLinux、RockyLinux、Kali、Alpine及Windows 11系统。适用于VPS和物理服务器快速部署，仅需wget即可运行，自动处理各发行版依赖差异。提供默认SSH/RDP配置，特别适合资源受限环境（Alpine仅需256MB内存），是运维人员批量管理和恢复系统的利器。
items.e: This is an automated system reinstallation toolkit centered around the InstallNET.sh script. It enables one-command network-based reinstallation of Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS, AlmaLinux, RockyLinux, Kali, Alpine Linux, and Windows 11 via command line. Designed for rapid VPS and bare-metal server deployment, it runs with minimal dependencies (wget only) and automatically handles distribution-specific package management differences. Provides default SSH/RDP configurations and is optimized for resource-constrained environments (Alpine requires just 256MB RAM), making it ideal for sysadmins managing batch operations and system recovery.

items.d: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration
items.z: Anything Analyzer是一款全能协议分析工具，集成内嵌浏览器抓包、MITM代理、JS Hook与AI大模型，支持网页、桌面应用、终端脚本及手机App的全场景流量捕获，所有请求统一汇入Session。AI实现两阶段智能分析、API逆向、安全审计、加密代码提取与流式报告，内置MCP Server/Client无缝对接AI Agent和IDE。基于Electron+React+TypeScript的跨平台桌面应用，显著提升协议逆向与调试效率。
items.e: Anything Analyzer is an all-in-one protocol analysis toolkit combining embedded browser capture (CDP), MITM proxy, JS hooks for fingerprint spoofing and encryption interception, and AI-powered analysis. It unifies traffic from websites, desktop apps, terminals, scripts, and mobile apps into sessions for automated API reverse engineering, security audits, JS encryption reversal, and more. Built-in MCP server/client enables seamless integration with AI agents and IDEs like Claude and Cursor. Developed with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it provides a cross-platform desktop solution to streamline protocol analysis and debugging.

items.d: The RethinkDNS resolver that deploys to Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io
items.z: Serverless-dns 是一个自托管的无服务器 DNS 解析器，提供类似 Pi-Hole 的内容过滤功能，支持 DNS-over-HTTPS 和 DNS-over-TLS。它可一键部署到 Cloudflare Workers、Deno Deploy、Fastly 和 Fly.io 等边缘平台，利用其免费层即可满足10-20台设备的日常需求。服务器处理延迟仅0-2毫秒，端到端延迟中位数为10-30毫秒，具备全球覆盖能力。
items.e: Serverless-dns is a self-hosted, serverless DNS resolver with Pi-Hole-like content blocking, supporting DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) and DNS-over-TLS (DoT). It deploys effortlessly to edge platforms including Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io. The free tiers suffice for 10-20 devices monthly. Server processing takes 0-2ms, with end-to-end latency of 10-30ms (median), enabling global low-latency DNS resolution.

items.d: Deep dive into Claude Code internals — architecture, agent loop, context engineering, and more. / 深入解析 Claude Code 源码：架构、Agent 循环、上下文工程、工具系统等
items.z: 这个项目深入解析Claude Code的50万行TypeScript源码，揭示其百万级DAU生产系统的架构设计。核心亮点包括：4级渐进式上下文压缩解决token限制，5层纵深防御保障安全执行，工具预执行与全链路流式输出实现极致性能，以及静默恢复机制提升用户体验。适合AI Agent开发者和架构师学习。
items.e: This project provides a comprehensive analysis of Claude Code's 500,000-line TypeScript source codebase, revealing the engineering architecture powering this leading AI programming agent. It dissects critical production-grade designs: 4-level progressive context compression managing token constraints, 5-layer security system preventing dangerous operations, tool pre-execution with full streaming pipeline for perceived performance, and silent recovery mechanisms with 7 retry strategies. The 12-chapter documentation covers agent loops, context engineering, and tool orchestration, serving as a valuable resource for developers building production AI agents.

items.d: 😎 🔗 Awesome list about all kinds of resources for learning Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing.
items.z: 这是一份精心整理的网络安全学习资源大全，专为渗透测试和道德黑客入门者设计。收录从基础书籍到实战平台的完整体系，涵盖CTF挑战、漏洞实验室、恶意软件分析等核心领域。通过Hack The Box、TryHackMe等在线靶场，学习者可获真实渗透测试经验。项目强调实践导向，包含OSCP风格实验和权限提升专项训练，是构建网络安全知识体系的权威参考资料。
items.e: A curated collection of comprehensive resources for learning ethical hacking and penetration testing. It covers foundational books, hands-on CTF platforms like Hack The Box and TryHackMe, vulnerable web applications, malware analysis tools, and Linux pentesting distributions. The repository features OSCP-style labs, privilege escalation workshops, and extensive vulnerability databases. Designed for structured skill development from beginner to advanced levels, it serves as an authoritative guide for building practical cybersecurity expertise through real-world scenarios and community-driven contributions.

items.d: An index & manager of Onedrive based on serverless. Can be deployed to Vercel/Heroku/SCF/FG/FC/CFC/PHP web hosting/VPS.
items.z: 一个基于Serverless架构的Onedrive文件管理器，支持Vercel、Heroku及国内云函数平台部署。通过生成直链实现用户直传直下载，大幅节省服务器带宽成本。提供可视化文件管理界面，支持多用户、多目录，适用于个人云盘分享、团队文档协作及静态资源托管场景。
items.e: A serverless-based OneDrive index and manager that enables seamless deployment across Vercel, Heroku, and major Chinese cloud function platforms including Tencent SCF, Huawei FG, Alibaba FC, and Baidu CFC. The system generates direct URLs allowing end-users to upload and download files directly through Microsoft's infrastructure, minimizing server bandwidth consumption to near zero. With an intuitive web interface supporting multi-user access and directory management, it transforms OneDrive into a fully functional cloud storage portal suitable for personal file sharing, team collaboration, and static website hosting. Its PHP implementation ensures broad compatibility with various hosting environments while maintaining low operational costs.

items.d: Deploy Your Frontend in a Single Command. Claude Code Skills supported.
items.z: PinMe 是一款零配置的前端静态部署工具，通过单命令将构建产物上传至去中心化网络。无需服务器管理，自动处理可用性与持久性，提供可验证内容防止篡改。深度集成 AI 工作流，支持 Claude Code 等直接部署，兼容 React/Vue/Next.js 等主流框架，为开发者与 AI 代理提供极简发布体验。
items.e: PinMe is a zero-config static frontend deployment tool that publishes sites to decentralized networks with a single command. It eliminates server management, automatically handling availability and persistence while providing verifiable content to prevent tampering. With deep AI workflow integration supporting Claude Code, it offers a frictionless publishing experience for developers and AI agents, compatible with React/Vue/Next.js frameworks.

items.d: Public collection of high-quality templates created by General Legal attorneys with CC0 license
items.z: General Legal 律师团队打造的开源法律模板库，涵盖 NDA、MSA、隐私政策、数据处理协议等 12 类科技初创企业常用合同。采用 LLM 优化 Markdown 与 .docx 双格式，CC0 协议完全免费，可直接用于 AI 法律文档生成场景。
items.e: A CC0-licensed collection of 12 attorney-drafted legal templates for startups and tech companies, covering NDAs, MSAs, privacy policies, and DPAs. Available in LLM-optimized Markdown and .docx formats, ideal for AI-powered legal document generation.

items.d: List of 67 awesome DESIGN.md and SKILL.md design skill files for agentic tools like Claude Design, Google Stitch, Codex, Cursor, and other AI tools
items.z: 该仓库为Claude Code、Cursor等AI编程助手提供67个结构化设计系统技能文件。每个技能包含SKILL.md（AI可读的组件规范、可访问性约束、质量标准）和DESIGN.md（人类可读的设计意图）。通过TypeUI CLI一键集成，确保AI生成UI符合品牌规范、设计一致性与WCAG 2.2 AA标准，实现AI辅助开发中设计质量与效率的质的飞跃。
items.e: A curated registry of 67 design system skill files specifically engineered for AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Each skill delivers structured instructions via SKILL.md (machine-readable component rules, accessibility constraints, quality gates) and DESIGN.md (human-readable rationale and maintenance notes). The TypeUI CLI enables one-command integration directly into projects, ensuring AI-generated UIs automatically adhere to brand guidelines, design consistency, and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance. This fundamentally transforms AI-assisted development by embedding design system intelligence into agent workflows, enabling rapid prototyping at scale while maintaining human oversight and quality control.

items.z: dg-ai-notes 是冬瓜的 AI 学习笔记仓库，专注 Pi-Agent SDK 深度教程。Pi-Agent 作为生产级 AI Agent 运行时底座，提供 Agent Loop、工具系统、消息系统、事件驱动及会话管理等核心能力。教程分 10 章系统拆解源码设计，每章涵盖概念、实现与设计取舍，提供 TypeScript 和 Python 双版本对照，支持在线 Web 阅读、Markdown 下载、PDF 及 Notebook 实验。帮助开发者理解生产级 Agent 架构，搭建可靠 AI 应用。
items.e: dg-ai-notes is Winter Melon's AI learning notes repo focused on an in-depth tutorial for the Pi-Agent SDK. Pi-Agent is a production-grade runtime base for AI Agents, featuring Agent Loop, tool system, messaging, event-driven architecture, and session management. The 10-chapter tutorial dissects source code design with both TypeScript and Python versions, offering web reading, Markdown/PDF downloads, and an interactive notebook. It helps developers understand and build reliable AI Agent systems.

items.d: In-place tweak injection with insert_dylib and ChOma.
items.z: TrollFools 是一款专为 TrollStore 设计的轻量级 tweak 注入工具，利用 insert_dylib 和 ChOma 实现 Mach-O 二进制文件的原地动态库注入。支持 iOS 14-17 系统应用及 App Store 应用的修改，无论是解密还是加密状态。采用 SwiftUI 开发，界面现代且体积小巧，旨在替代有缺陷的 optool，为越狱社区提供高效稳定的 tweak 部署方案。
items.e: TrollFools is a lightweight tweak injection tool specifically designed for TrollStore ecosystem, leveraging insert_dylib and ChOma to perform in-place dynamic library injection directly into Mach-O binaries. It supports iOS 14-17, capable of modifying removable system applications, decrypted App Store apps, and even encrypted App Store apps with bare dynamic libraries. Written entirely in SwiftUI, it delivers a modern user interface while maintaining a small package size. The project aims to replace the problematic optool by compiling a statically linked install_name_tool, providing the jailbreak community with a more reliable and efficient solution for tweak deployment.

items.d: ✦ Gemini ➜ OpenAI API proxy. Serverless!
items.z: 该项目是一个OpenAI API格式的代理，将请求转发至Google Gemini API。利用Gemini免费层的慷慨额度，让仅支持OpenAI接口的开发者工具无缝切换至Gemini模型。支持Vercel、Netlify、Cloudflare Workers等Serverless平台一键部署，无需服务器维护，同时提供Node、Deno、Bun本地运行方案，突破地域限制。
items.e: This project provides a serverless proxy that translates OpenAI API requests to Google Gemini API format. By leveraging Gemini's generous free tier, it enables developers to use OpenAI-exclusive tools with Gemini models at zero cost. Supports one-click deployment to Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, and Deno Deploy without server maintenance. Offers local development via Node, Deno, or Bun, allowing users outside supported regions to obtain API keys via VPN and access Gemini's powerful models seamlessly.

items.d: A calm, open system for organizing life and work. Tasks, projects, notes, areas, and smart workflows - self-hosted or hosted.
items.z: tududi是一款自托管任务管理工具，融合个人简洁性与专业项目组织能力。核心亮点包括智能递归任务系统（支持多种模式、完成触发机制）、Telegram集成、多层级结构（领域-项目-任务-子任务），以及24种语言支持。面向注重隐私与效率的个人及团队，提供开放API与响应式设计，实现数据自主可控的生产力提升。
items.e: tududi is a self-hosted task management tool that merges personal simplicity with professional project organization. Its core features include an intelligent recurring task system with multiple patterns and completion-based triggers, seamless Telegram integration, and a hierarchical structure (Areas > Projects > Tasks > Subtasks). Designed for privacy-conscious individuals and teams, it offers 24-language support, OpenAPI documentation, and responsive design for full data control and productivity across devices.

items.z: RKNN-Toolkit2是Rockchip NPU的完整AI部署工具链，支持模型转换、推理与性能评估。提供C/Python API，覆盖RK3588/RV1106等多款芯片，具备自动混合精度与图优化能力，助力边缘AI应用快速落地。包含Toolkit、Runtime及Lite版本，支持Python 3.6-3.12，是嵌入式AI开发的核心基础设施，不兼容旧版RKNN-Toolkit。
items.e: RKNN-Toolkit2 is a complete AI deployment toolchain for Rockchip NPU platforms, enabling model conversion, inference and performance evaluation. It provides both C and Python APIs, supporting multiple chips including RK3588 and RV1106 series. Key features include automatic mixed precision, enhanced graph optimization, and compatibility with Python 3.6-3.12. The toolkit accelerates edge AI application development on embedded devices and is not compatible with the legacy RKNN-Toolkit, requiring migration for new projects.

items.d: Introduction to Autonomous Robots
items.z: 本仓库提供MIT出版社《自主机器人导论：机制、传感器、执行器与算法》教材的LaTeX源代码。该书聚焦自主机器人计算原理，涵盖机制、传感器、执行器和算法。采用CC-BY-NC-ND许可，允许非商业教学用途并需署名。可通过LaTeX或Overleaf编译PDF，印刷版见亚马逊。是机器人教育与研究的重要资源。
items.e: The repository provides the LaTeX source for the MIT Press textbook 'Introduction to Autonomous Robots: Mechanisms, Sensors, Actuators, and Algorithms'. It focuses on the computational principles of autonomous robots, covering mechanisms, sensors, actuators, and algorithms. Licensed under CC-BY-NC-ND for non-commercial use like teaching with attribution. Users can compile the PDF via LaTeX or Overleaf; print edition available on Amazon. An essential resource for robotics education and research.

items.d: Open-source AI humanizer: rewrite AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding prose. LLM rewriting + multi-engine translation, with step-by-step traces. Python CLI, n8n & Docker.
items.z: 开源AI文本人性化工具，采用DeepSeek大模型两次创造性重写结合Google与Niutrans多引擎翻译链，通过中文→日语→芬兰语→英语的远距离语言跳转，有效绕过Turnitin、GPTZero等主流AI检测器。5步标准管道保留原始写作风格，实现100%关键信息留存，专为学术写作与内容创作场景设计。
items.e: Open-source AI text humanization toolkit that defeats Turnitin, GPTZero and all major AI detectors via a production-grade 5-step Standard Pipeline. Leverages DeepSeek LLM's creative rewriting at temperature 1.3 combined with multi-engine translation hops (Google Translate + Niutrans) across linguistically distant languages (Chinese→Japanese→Finnish→English). Preserves original writing style while achieving 100% key information retention, optimized for academic and content creation workflows.

items.d: GDM Science Skills to speed up agentic scientific workflows with better grounding and higher token efficiency. Integrate insights from AlphaGenome, AFDB, UniProt and 30+ other databases and tools.
items.z: google-deepmind/science-skills 是 Google DeepMind 推出的科学技能集合，旨在加速 AI 智能体的科学工作流。它集成 AlphaGenome、AFDB、UniProt 等 30+ 数据库和工具，提供结构化指令、脚本资源，提升事实 grounding 和 token 效率。技能 spanning 基因组学、结构生物学、化学信息学及文献检索等领域，与 Google Antigravity 深度集成，助力高效科研任务。
items.e: The google-deepmind/science-skills repo delivers a bundle of agent skills from Google DeepMind to enhance scientific workflows for AI agents. It integrates over 30 databases and tools like AlphaGenome, AFDB, and UniProt, offering structured instructions and scripts for better grounding and token efficiency. Covering genomics, structural biology, cheminformatics, and literature search, these skills are optimized for the Google Antigravity platform, improving reliability and enabling efficient scientific automation.

items.d: :earth_americas: machine learning tutorials (mainly in Python3)
items.z: 这个仓库是系统性的机器学习教程集合，以Jupyter Notebook形式提供。内容涵盖深度学习、强化学习、时间序列等多个领域，核心特色在于平衡数学原理与工程实践：既包含NumPy/SciPy等科学计算栈的从零实现，也演示TensorFlow、PyTorch、scikit-learn等主流框架的工业级应用。适合希望深入理解算法底层并掌握实际部署技能的学习者。
items.e: This repository is a comprehensive collection of machine learning tutorials in Jupyter Notebook format. It covers diverse topics including deep learning, reinforcement learning, time series analysis, and recommendation systems. The key feature is balancing mathematical theory with hands-on implementation—both from scratch using Python's scientific stack (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, PySpark) and with popular frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and Hugging Face. It serves as an educational resource for learners seeking deep algorithmic understanding alongside practical engineering skills in model deployment and A/B testing.

items.d: AI reads books: Page-by-Page PDF Knowledge Extractor & Summarizer. script performs an intelligent page-by-page analysis of PDF books, methodically extracting knowledge points and generating progressive summaries at specified intervals
items.z: 该工具通过AI逐页解析PDF书籍，自动提取核心知识点并生成渐进式摘要。支持智能过滤目录/索引页，具备断点续处理与Markdown结构化输出能力。适用于个人深度学习、研究资料整理与知识库构建，实现从海量书籍中高效提炼结构化知识，提升阅读效率与知识内化效果。
items.e: This tool performs AI-powered page-by-page analysis of PDF books, automatically extracting key knowledge points and generating progressive summaries at configurable intervals. Featuring intelligent filtering of TOC/index pages, resume capability, and structured Markdown output, it maintains contextual flow while processing. Ideal for deep learning, research material processing, and knowledge base construction, it efficiently transforms massive books into structured knowledge, significantly improving reading efficiency and knowledge internalization through systematic analysis.

items.d: Transcribe and summarize videos and podcasts using AI. Open-source, multi-platform, and supports multiple languages.
items.z: 开源AI视频转写工具，支持YouTube、TikTok、Bilibili等30+平台及本地音视频文件。采用字幕优先架构，无字幕时调用Faster-Whisper实现高精度语音识别，经AI优化后生成多语言摘要。支持任意OpenAI兼容API，Docker部署，适合内容创作者与研究者快速提取视频核心内容。
items.e: An open-source AI-powered video and podcast transcription tool supporting 30+ platforms including YouTube, TikTok, and Bilibili, plus local audio/video file uploads. Its subtitle-first architecture extracts native subtitles instantly when available, using Faster-Whisper as fallback for high-accuracy speech recognition. The tool leverages any OpenAI-compatible API for intelligent text optimization, typo correction, and multi-language summarization. Built with FFmpeg for media processing and Docker support, it's ideal for content creators, researchers, and educators to efficiently convert multimedia content into structured, searchable text with AI-enhanced summaries.

items.d: A translation-based Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs
items.z: Stela 是面向 x86-64 PC 的通用 Apple Silicon 层，通过 UEFI 启动，集成 arm64-to-x86-64 翻译器（覆盖 3000+ 指令）、NVIDIA Metal 驱动（AIR 转 NIR）和 Apple silicon 硬件模型，使 macOS 27 能在 Intel/AMD 机器上运行。目前开发中，速度较慢。
items.e: Stela is a general-purpose Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs. It boots via UEFI, integrating an arm64-to-x86-64 translator (covering 3000+ instructions), a Metal driver for NVIDIA GPUs (AIR to NIR), and an Apple silicon hardware model, enabling macOS 27 to run on Intel/AMD machines. Currently in development, it is slow.

items.d: Stealth browser automation for AI agents over MCP and the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigation, network hooks, DOM extraction, and pixel-accurate UI cloning.
items.z: Stealth Browser MCP 是专为 MCP 兼容 AI 智能体打造的不可检测浏览器自动化框架。基于 nodriver 与 Chrome DevTools Protocol，能有效绕过 Cloudflare、Queue-It 等反爬系统。核心亮点包括像素完美 UI 元素克隆（提取完整 CSS/DOM/事件）、网络流量拦截与 AI 动态生成 Python 钩子实现实时修改。提供 97 个模块化工具，支持最小化部署与跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker）。无缝集成 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端，通过自然语言聊天执行高级浏览器任务，适用于受保护网站的网页抓取、自动化测试与数据提取。
items.e: Stealth Browser MCP delivers undetectable browser automation for MCP-compatible AI agents. Powered by nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol, it bypasses Cloudflare, Queue-It, and other anti-bot systems. Highlights include pixel-accurate UI cloning with full CSS/DOM extraction, comprehensive network interception, and an AI-driven dynamic hook system for real-time traffic modification via generated Python functions. It features 97 modular tools with minimal/core modes, cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker), and seamless integration with Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients. Enables natural language control for stealth web scraping, automated testing, and interactions on protected sites.

items.d: Handwriting animation for the web. Supports any font or text.
items.z: Tegaki 是一个网页手写动画库，能将任意字体转化为自然的手写动画效果。无需手动路径绘制或原生依赖，支持 React、Vue、Svelte 等框架及多语言内置字体。适用于演示、教学、创意设计和视频制作场景，提供自定义字体生成和跨平台集成，技术实现纯 Web 且易于使用。
items.e: Tegaki is a powerful web library designed to transform any font into realistic animated handwriting effects. Without the need for manual path creation or native dependencies, it animates text stroke by stroke with natural timing. It provides seamless support for popular frameworks including React, Svelte, Vue, and SolidJS, along with built-in fonts covering multiple languages such as Latin, Arabic, Japanese, and Korean. This makes it perfect for use in presentations, educational materials, creative web designs, and programmatic video creation. Additionally, it includes tools for generating custom font bundles and easy cross-platform integrations.

items.d: AGENTS.md rules / skills for AI coding agents: Codex, Cursor & Claude Code. Inspired by Clean Code, Refactoring, DDD, Clean Architecture and DDIA programming books.
items.z: 本仓库将经典软件工程著作（如Clean Code、DDD、DDIA）提炼为AI编程智能体（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex）可执行的规则集。提供full/mini/nano三版本适配不同上下文窗口，注入工程化思维与架构治理，提升AI生成代码的质量与可维护性。
items.e: This repository distills classic software engineering books (Clean Code, DDD, DDIA) into executable rule sets for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). It provides three versions (full/mini/nano) to fit different context windows, injecting engineering mindset and architecture governance into AI-generated code. The tool-agnostic Markdown format enhances code quality and maintainability while supporting editor-specific configurations for optimal AI-assisted development.

items.d: Modern Admin Dashboard Template built with Shadcn UI and Next.js 16
items.z: 基于Next.js 16、TypeScript与Shadcn UI的现代化管理后台模板，提供CRM、财务等多场景仪表板。支持亮暗主题切换、响应式布局与同构文件系统架构，内置Tailwind CSS v4、Zustand状态管理和TanStack Table数据处理，助力快速构建可扩展的企业级应用。
items.e: Modern admin dashboard template built with Next.js 16, TypeScript and Shadcn UI, featuring multiple pre-built dashboards for CRM, finance and other business scenarios. Supports light/dark theme switching with multiple color presets, responsive layouts, and colocation-based file system architecture for better code organization. Integrated with Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand for lightweight state management, and TanStack Table for advanced data handling. Includes authentication flows and role-based access control (planned). Enables rapid development of scalable enterprise applications with customizable themes and flexible layouts.

items.d: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
items.z: RAG Web UI是基于RAG技术的智能对话系统，用于构建私有化知识库问答服务。支持PDF、DOCX、Markdown等文档的自动分块与向量化，兼容OpenAI、DeepSeek及Ollama本地模型，可切换ChromaDB/Qdrant向量数据库。具备多轮对话、引用溯源、异步处理及OpenAPI接口，适用于企业知识库与智能客服场景。
items.e: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology for building private knowledge base Q&A services. It offers comprehensive document management supporting PDF, DOCX, Markdown formats with automatic chunking and vectorization. The system features a frontend-backend separated architecture, flexible LLM support (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), and interchangeable vector databases (ChromaDB, Qdrant) via Factory pattern. Production-ready capabilities include multi-turn dialogue, citation tracking, async processing, and OpenAPI interfaces, suitable for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent customer service applications.

items.d: An open source fingerprint browser based on Ungoogled Chromium. 指纹浏览器 隐私浏览器
items.z: 这是一个基于Ungoogled Chromium开源项目的隐私浏览器，专门设计用于对抗浏览器指纹追踪。项目提供Chromium 138至144多个版本的预编译二进制文件，全面支持Windows、Linux和macOS平台。通过深度移除Google服务组件并强化反指纹采集机制，有效保护用户隐私，适用于需要高匿名性的网络访问和多账号管理场景。
items.e: This is an open-source privacy browser based on Ungoogled Chromium, specifically engineered to resist browser fingerprinting. The project offers pre-compiled binaries for Chromium versions 138 through 144, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. By deeply removing Google services and enhancing anti-fingerprinting protections, it effectively prevents fingerprint collection while maintaining Chromium's core functionality. Perfect for anonymous browsing and multi-account management requiring strong privacy controls.

items.d: Give your AI agent access to your live Chrome session — works out of the box, connects to tabs you already have open
items.z: 让AI智能体直接操控正在使用的Chrome浏览器，无需重新登录或启动新实例。通过Chrome原生调试协议建立持久连接，支持截图、DOM操作、网络监控等能力。相比Puppeteer方案，可访问已登录状态，稳定处理百个标签页，适合需要与真实浏览器环境交互的智能体场景。
items.e: Enables AI agents to directly control your live Chrome session without relogin or new instances. Establishes persistent connections via Chrome's native debugging protocol, supporting screenshots, DOM manipulation, and network monitoring. Unlike Puppeteer-based solutions, it accesses authenticated states and reliably handles 100+ tabs, ideal for agents interacting with real browser environments.

items.z: Google Gemini电脑使用预览版是基于Gemini 2.5模型的浏览器自动化代理工具。它通过自然语言指令直接控制浏览器执行搜索、填表等网页操作，集成Playwright实现本地浏览器控制，同时支持Vertex AI和Browserbase云端部署。开发者可通过Python CLI快速调用，体验Gemini模型的"计算机使用"能力，适用于网页自动化、测试和智能交互场景。
items.e: The Google Gemini Computer Use Preview is a browser automation agent powered by the Gemini 2.5 model. It translates natural language instructions into executable browser actions like searching and form filling. The tool leverages Playwright for local browser control and supports cloud deployment via Vertex AI and Browserbase. Accessed through a Python CLI, it demonstrates Gemini's 'computer use' capability, enabling developers to automate web interactions, testing, and intelligent browsing tasks through simple text commands.

items.d: Agent skills and an AI-native SwiftUI component library for iOS apps: animations, Metal shaders, charts, components and full-stack modules your coding agent can build from.
items.z: ShipSwift 是一个 AI 原生的 SwiftUI 组件库，提供生产就绪的动画、图表、UI 组件和全栈模块配方。通过 MCP 服务器或本地技能安装，AI 工具如 Claude、Cursor 可即时获取代码与上下文，快速构建真实 iOS 应用。兼容 30+ AI 编码助手，含可搜索目录和 App Store 展示 App，还提供自定义开发服务。适用于加速原生 iOS 开发与 AI 辅助编程。
items.e: ShipSwift is an AI-native SwiftUI component library providing production-ready components and full-stack recipes for animations, charts, UI elements, and modules. Via MCP server or local skills, AI tools like Claude and Cursor instantly access code and context to build real iOS apps. Compatible with 30+ AI coding assistants, it includes a searchable catalog, App Store showcase app, and custom development services. Accelerates native iOS development with AI assistance for Swift 5.0+ and iOS 18+.

items.d: Components from design to production
items.z: LiftKit是一个面向设计师的UI框架，通过数学公式自动实现设计最佳实践。核心提供缩放、间距和色彩的系统化解决方案，确保视觉对称、比例平衡和色彩平滑过渡。目前仅支持Next.js，正处于重写阶段以符合现代开发标准。项目由兼职维护者开发，暂不建议生产环境使用。其平台无关的设计系统可无缝集成到现代前端工作流中。
items.e: LiftKit is a UI framework for perfectionists that automatically enforces design best practices through mathematical formulas for scaling, spacing, and color. It ensures optical symmetry, balanced proportions, and smooth color ramps without manual effort. Currently Next.js-only, it's being rewritten with Base UI primitives to meet modern standards. The designer-built system is platform-agnostic and aims to make developers better designers. Maintained by part-time contributors, it's not production-ready yet but offers a robust foundation for design-system-driven development with community-driven expansion and Tailwind integration efforts.

items.d: Autonomous penetration testing using a swarm of AI agents. Orchestrates recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting specialists with ReAct reasoning — supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes. Built with Go and 7+ native security tools.
items.z: Pentest Swarm AI是首个基于真实群体架构的开源渗透测试工具，通过AI代理群协同完成侦察、分类、利用和报告全流程。支持漏洞赏金、持续监控和CTF模式，集成nmap、sqlmap、Burp等7+原生安全工具，兼容Claude、Ollama等多种大模型，采用ReAct推理实现真正自主化的安全测试。
items.e: Pentest Swarm AI is the first open-source penetration testing tool built on a real swarm architecture, orchestrating specialized AI agents for reconnaissance, classification, exploitation, and reporting. Supporting bug bounty programs, continuous monitoring, and CTF competitions, it integrates 7+ native security tools including nmap, sqlmap, Burp, and Metasploit. Built with Go and ReAct reasoning, it's compatible with Claude, Ollama, and other LLMs, enabling truly autonomous security testing through stigmergic multi-agent coordination.

items.d: Curated tools, case studies and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware and protocols. Source-reviewed, English and Chinese.
items.z: 该仓库汇集了网站、游戏、应用、二进制、固件和协议等六大领域的逆向工程工具、案例与论文，共5000余项资源，均经来源审查，支持中英双语，为安全研究、漏洞挖掘和软件分析提供一站式导航。
items.e: This repository curates tools, case studies, and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware, and protocols. With over 5,000 resources, all source-reviewed and bilingual, it serves as a comprehensive hub for security research, vulnerability discovery, and software analysis.

items.d: PDF scientific paper translation with preserved formats - 基于 AI 完整保留排版的 PDF 文档全文双语翻译，支持 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等服务，提供 CLI/GUI/Docker
items.z: PDFMathTranslate-next是一款基于AI的PDF科学论文翻译工具，能完整保留原文排版、公式、图表及注释，支持Google、DeepL、Ollama、OpenAI等多种翻译服务。提供CLI、GUI和Docker三种部署方式，适用于学术研究者进行双语对照阅读与分析。依托BabelDOC框架实现高保真格式翻译，显著提升科研效率。
items.e: PDFMathTranslate-next is an AI-powered tool for translating scientific PDF papers while fully preserving layout, formulas, charts, and annotations. It supports multiple services including Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI, offering CLI, GUI, and Docker interfaces. Ideal for researchers to read and analyze academic documents bilingually. Built on BabelDOC for high-fidelity format retention, boosting research efficiency.

items.d: Open Source Clones of Popular Games
items.z: 这是一个开源游戏克隆数据库网站，聚合各类经典游戏的开源复刻版本信息。采用YAML管理游戏数据，Python构建静态站点，支持Docker一键部署。开发者可通过PR或Issue提交游戏条目，GitHub Actions实现自动化构建部署。为游戏开发者提供学习参考和项目发现平台。
items.e: This is an open-source game clones database website that aggregates information about open-source reimplementations of popular classic games. It uses YAML files for structured game data management, Python for static site generation, and supports Docker deployment. Developers can contribute new game entries via pull requests or GitHub issues, with GitHub Actions automating the build and deployment workflow. The platform serves as a valuable resource for game developers to discover open-source projects, reference implementations, and learn from existing game clones.

items.d: 提升部署在cloudflare、vercel或netlify的网页在中国的访问速度和稳定性   cf优选域名 | cf优选ip | cloudflare | vercel | netlify | 加速 | 国内 | 中国 | 境内 | 大陆
items.z: 该项目通过自定义CNAME解析，优化Cloudflare、Vercel和Netlify服务在中国大陆的访问体验。核心机制是定时测试各平台IP的速度与稳定性，优选出最佳节点并配置三网解析，将国内流量引导至最优线路，海外使用官方IP。相比官方Anycast常将流量路由至东南亚导致拥堵，此方案能有效改善晚高峰时段的访问速度和连通性稳定性，仅需修改DNS记录即可实现，特别适合部署在海外FaaS平台的中文网站加速。
items.e: This project enhances access speed and stability for websites hosted on Cloudflare, Vercel, or Netlify in mainland China through custom CNAME redirection. It automatically tests IPs from these platforms every 40 minutes, selecting optimal nodes for China's three major ISPs while using official IPs overseas. By bypassing problematic anycast routing that often directs Chinese traffic to Southeast Asia, it significantly improves connectivity during peak hours and prevents single-point failures. The solution requires only DNS configuration changes, making it ideal for accelerating Chinese access to overseas serverless deployments.

items.d: 🏆 Top-1 on 5+ benchmarks | Web UI | Supports MiroThinker, Claude, Kimi, OpenAI
items.z: MiroFlow 是一款性能优先的开源 AI 智能体框架，在 9+ 基准测试中提升任意大模型性能。支持 GPT-5、Claude、Kimi 等模型一键切换，通过智能回滚、迭代推理和工具编排优化表现。提供 FastAPI+React Web 界面、无代码技能系统和多智能体图工作流，适用于模型评估、智能体研发与生产部署，结果完全可复现。
items.e: MiroFlow is a performance-first open-source AI agent framework that enhances any LLM's capabilities across 9+ benchmarks. It enables one-line model switching between GPT-5, Claude, Kimi, and others via YAML config, optimizing performance through smart rollback, iterative reasoning, and tool orchestration. Features include a FastAPI+React Web UI, code-free skill system, and multi-agent graph workflows, ideal for model evaluation, agent development, and production deployment with fully reproducible results.

items.d: AI Powered Knowledge Graph Generator
items.z: 这是一个基于大语言模型的知识图谱自动生成系统。它将非结构化文本解析为'主-谓-宾'三元组，通过实体标准化和关系推理构建结构化知识网络，并生成交互式可视化。系统支持任何OpenAI兼容的LLM API（如Ollama、vLLM），提供文本分块、实体消歧、关系推断等完整流水线，适用于文档知识挖掘、研究资料整理等场景。核心价值在于将海量文本转化为可探索的语义网络，实现知识的直观呈现与深度关联分析。
items.e: This is an automated knowledge graph generation system powered by Large Language Models. It processes unstructured text by extracting Subject-Predicate-Object triplets via LLMs, then constructs structured knowledge networks through entity standardization and relationship inference. The system produces interactive visualizations and supports any OpenAI-compatible API endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, cloud services). Key features include text chunking, entity resolution, transitive inference, and configurable pipelines. It transforms textual information into explorable semantic networks, enabling deep knowledge discovery and visual analytics for research and document analysis.

items.d: QuantMind is an open source agent-native knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance.
items.z: QuantMind是面向量化金融的智能知识提取与检索框架，将论文、新闻、报告等非结构化内容转化为语义知识图谱。采用两阶段架构：提取阶段通过多模态解析、领域特定LLM和智能代理实现结构化、标签化与去重；检索阶段支持嵌入向量、RAG、多跳推理等场景。适用于对冲基金、机构投资者快速探索因子策略与市场洞见，提升研究效率并挖掘Alpha。获NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop接受。
items.e: QuantMind is an intelligent knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance. It transforms unstructured content such as papers, news, reports, and SEC filings into a semantic knowledge graph. Built on a decoupled two-stage architecture, the extraction stage uses multi-modal parsing, domain-specific LLMs, tagging, and agentic workflows for structuring and deduplication; the retrieval stage enables embeddings, RAG, DeepResearch multi-hop reasoning, and knowledge-aware generation. Ideal for hedge funds and research teams to accelerate factor and risk model discovery. Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop.

items.d: DeepTeam is a framework to red team LLMs and AI agents.
items.z: DeepTeam是开源的LLM红队测试框架，专为AI系统提供安全渗透测试。它通过模拟越狱、提示注入等50+攻击方式，检测AI代理、RAG和聊天机器人中的隐私泄露、偏见等漏洞。基于DeepEval构建，支持本地运行LLM-as-a-Judge评估，并提供生产环境防护护栏，助力AI系统安全加固。
items.e: DeepTeam is an open-source red teaming framework designed for LLM systems, functioning as penetration testing for AI. It simulates over 50 attacks like jailbreaking and prompt injection to uncover vulnerabilities such as data leakage and bias in AI agents, RAG pipelines, and chatbots. Built on DeepEval, it runs locally with LLM-as-a-Judge metrics and offers guardrails for production security, strengthening AI system resilience.

items.d: Open source AI terminal for cloud and infrastructure management, enabling you to deploy, troubleshoot, and automate services using natural language and intelligent agents.
items.z: Chaterm是一款AI原生的智能终端代理，旨在成为DevOps副驾驶。它通过自然语言交互重塑传统命令行体验，内置专家知识库和自主Agent引擎，可自动分解复杂任务并执行从日志分析到服务回滚的全链路操作。支持EC2、数据库和Kubernetes管理，提供智能上下文补全和移动端语音交互能力，消除技术栈认知壁垒，让开发者具备资深SRE的运维能力。
items.e: Chaterm is an AI-native intelligent terminal agent designed as a DevOps co-pilot. It revolutionizes the command-line experience through natural language interaction, featuring a built-in expert knowledge base and autonomous agent engine capable of planning and executing complex workflows from log analysis to service rollback. It manages EC2 instances, databases, and Kubernetes clusters while offering intelligent contextual completion and real-time voice interaction on mobile devices, empowering developers with SRE-level operational capabilities.

items.d: Free, open-source web app for learning about ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies, design your own visually, export as RDF/XML, and share interactive diagrams. Zero backend, fully static.
items.z: Ontology Playground是一款免费开源的纯静态网页应用，专为学习本体论及Microsoft Fabric IQ语义建模设计。用户可浏览零售、医疗等六大领域预构建本体目录，使用可视化编辑器设计本体并实时预览Cytoscape.js交互图表，支持RDF/XML导入导出与GitHub一键PR提交。内置结构化学习课程、实验室、任务系统及嵌入式组件，采用React 19和TypeScript构建，无后端依赖。适用于数据工程师与AI开发者快速掌握企业知识图谱构建技能。
items.e: Ontology Playground is a free, open-source, fully static web app for learning ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ semantic modeling. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies across six domains like Retail and Healthcare, visually design with live Cytoscape.js graph previews, import/export RDF/XML, and submit PRs via GitHub. Features a learning hub with courses, labs, quests, and embeddable widgets. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, zero backend. Ideal for data professionals and AI developers mastering enterprise knowledge graphs.

items.d: Automatically crawl arXiv papers daily and summarize them using AI. Illustrating them using GitHub Pages.
items.z: 该工具通过 GitHub Actions 每日自动爬取 arXiv 论文，并利用 DeepSeek AI 生成中文总结，完全无需服务器。提供个性化高亮、跨设备访问及 SKILL 可插拔过滤系统，帮助研究者零成本追踪 cs.CV、cs.AI 等领域最新进展，日均成本仅 0.2 元，支持偏好导出与一键部署。
items.e: This tool automatically crawls arXiv papers daily via GitHub Actions and generates Chinese summaries using DeepSeek AI, requiring zero server infrastructure. It offers personalized highlighting, cross-device compatibility, and a plug-and-play SKILL system for custom filtering, enabling researchers to track the latest advancements in cs.CV, cs.AI and other fields at near-zero cost (~0.2 CNY/day). Features include local preference storage, flexible date filtering, and seamless preference export for reproducible setups.

items.d: The Public Suffix List
items.z: 公共后缀列表（PSL）是互联网基础设施的关键组件，定义了用户可直接注册域名的公共后缀（如.com、.co.uk）。它支撑浏览器Cookie安全策略，防止恶意跨站访问，被所有主流浏览器和网络库广泛采用。项目由志愿者维护，遵循严格审核流程，确保域名系统与开发者生态的精准衔接。
items.e: The Public Suffix List (PSL) is a critical internet infrastructure component that defines all publicly registrable domain suffixes, such as .com, .co.uk, and .pvt.k12.ma.us. It enables browsers and network libraries to implement secure cookie scoping, preventing cross-site request forgery and other security vulnerabilities. This volunteer-maintained project provides the definitive bridge between ICANN's domain name system and real-world developer needs through strict validation guidelines and community-driven updates, ensuring universal acceptance across the web ecosystem while maintaining meticulous accuracy through a rigorous PR review process.

items.d: A CLI for Twitter/X — feed, bookmarks, and user timeline in terminal
items.z: 无需API密钥的Twitter/X终端客户端，支持浏览时间线、书签、搜索及发帖等完整功能。采用浏览器Cookie认证与TLS指纹模拟技术绕过检测，提供结构化JSON/YAML输出，专为AI智能体与自动化脚本设计，支持代理与速率限制规避。
items.e: Twitter/X CLI bypassing API keys via browser cookies and TLS spoofing. Full read/write operations with structured JSON/YAML output optimized for AI agents and automation scripts.

items.d: Seedance 2.0 prompt skill，使用该Skill生成Seedance 2.0 视频提示词
items.z: 这是一个为Claude Code定制的提示词技能，专为字节跳动Seedance 2.0视频生成平台设计。它能将自然语言创意转化为结构化生产级提示词，支持十大核心能力包括一致性控制、镜头动作复制、声音设计和音乐卡点。内置多模态参考系统、时间轴分镜技术和场景化策略，涵盖电商广告、短剧、仙侠动画等垂直领域，显著提升AI视频创作效率。
items.e: A custom Claude Code skill designed for ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 video generation platform. It transforms natural language ideas into structured, production-ready prompts with ten core capabilities including consistency control, camera motion replication, sound design, and beat sync. Features multi-modal reference system, timestamp storyboarding, and scenario-specific strategies for e-commerce, short dramas, xianxia animation, and more, dramatically improving AI video creation efficiency.

items.d: Enhances Tesseract OCR output using LLMs (local or API) for error correction, smart chunking, and markdown formatting of scanned PDFs
items.z: 该项目通过LLM增强传统OCR流程，显著提升扫描PDF的识别准确率与可读性。核心采用Tesseract进行基础OCR识别，再利用本地或API大模型进行智能纠错、分块与Markdown格式化。支持异步处理与GPU加速，适用于文档数字化、档案管理等场景，有效解决OCR常见错误与格式混乱问题。
items.e: This project enhances traditional OCR pipelines using LLMs to significantly improve accuracy and readability of scanned PDFs. It employs Tesseract for base OCR, then leverages local or API-based LLMs for intelligent error correction, smart chunking, and Markdown formatting. Key features include asynchronous processing, GPU acceleration for local inference, and flexible hybrid deployment. Designed for document digitization, archival management, and office automation, it effectively resolves common OCR errors, duplicate content, and formatting inconsistencies while preserving document structure.

items.d: 将被语言阻隔的作品，带到读者的语言中。Bringing literature into your language.
items.z: 文译（wenyi）是专注于多语言小说翻译成中文的AI工具，支持EPUB/FB2/TXT输入并保留原排版、图片、目录和链接。采用多档LLM（strong/cheap/fast）驱动的流水线，包括全书预扫、术语库管理、滚动上下文、润色、章末审校和一致性QA，确保长文本翻译准确连贯。提供CLI断点续传功能，适合个人或小团队实现外国文学的自动化本地化。
items.e: Wenyi is an AI-powered tool for translating multilingual novels from EPUB, FB2 or TXT into Chinese while preserving original formatting, images, TOC and links. It uses a multi-tier LLM pipeline (strong/cheap/fast) with book pre-scan, glossary management, rolling context, polishing, chapter review and consistency QA for accurate long-form translations. Features CLI with resumable processing, ideal for efficient localization of foreign literature.

items.d: Find, benchmark and install in CLI 170+ FREE coding LLM models across 15+ providers in real time
items.z: 该工具解决了开发者在170+免费AI编程模型中选择的难题。它能实时并行测试15+提供商的模型，通过智能算法计算稳定性分数（综合p95延迟、抖动、峰值率和正常运行时间），并将最优模型一键集成到各种AI编程工具中，让开发者从选择到编码只需不到10秒。
items.e: This powerful CLI tool solves developers' biggest pain point when using free AI coding models: uncertainty about which model is fastest and most stable at any given moment. It continuously benchmarks approximately 170 free or free-limited coding LLMs across 15 trusted providers in real-time, calculating a comprehensive Stability Score that evaluates p95 latency (30%), jitter/variance (30%), spike rate (20%), and uptime (20%). Once you select a model, it instantly configures your preferred AI coding environment—whether it's Continue, Cline, OpenHands, Aider, or dozens of others—getting you from question to coding in under 10 seconds.

items.d: A curated list of medical LLMs, multimodal systems, datasets, benchmarks, and more. 🏥
items.z: 本仓库是医疗人工智能领域的系统化资源大全，全面涵盖医学大语言模型、多模态医疗系统、专业数据集与权威评测基准。通过自动化提取海量论文与开源项目中的前沿模型和数据集，提供清晰、结构化且易于导航的集合，帮助研究人员和开发者快速追踪领域进展、精准定位所需资源，显著加速医学AI领域的创新与应用落地。
items.e: A curated repository systematically organizing medical AI research resources, including medical large language models, multimodal systems, specialized datasets, and evaluation benchmarks. Through automated extraction of trending models and datasets from extensive research papers and open-source projects, it provides a clean, structured, and easily navigable collection. This comprehensive resource helps researchers and developers quickly track field advancements, precisely locate relevant resources, and accelerate innovation in medical artificial intelligence applications, significantly reducing the time needed to discover and utilize state-of-the-art medical AI technologies.

items.d: Your Self-Hosted Knowledge Base
items.z: NoteDiscovery 是一款轻量级自托管笔记与知识库应用，强调数据隐私与所有权。采用纯 Markdown 文件存储，支持知识图谱可视化、LaTeX 数学、Mermaid 图表、内置绘图编辑器及插件扩展。通过 MCP 协议实现与 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 助手的深度集成，支持笔记搜索、创建与组织。提供美观响应式界面、可选认证和多语言支持，是 Notion、Obsidian 的免费开源替代方案，适合开发者、知识工作者及隐私敏感用户，Docker 一键部署，无订阅费用与厂商锁定。
items.e: NoteDiscovery is a lightweight self-hosted note-taking and knowledge base application that empowers users with full control over their data. Notes are stored as plain Markdown files, featuring an elegant web UI with graph visualization, LaTeX/MathJax support, Mermaid diagrams, a drawing editor, and extensive customization via themes and plugins. It stands out with MCP integration for AI tools like Claude and Cursor, enabling direct note search, creation, and organization. Responsive across devices with optional auth and multi-language support, it serves as a free, open-source alternative to Notion or Obsidian for privacy-focused developers and knowledge workers, with effortless Docker deployment and zero subscriptions or lock-in.

items.d: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's full functionality over HTTP.
