Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant and control x64dbg programmatically: set breakpoints, step through code, read memory, dump registers, and more.  Built with Zig — zero dependencies, single-binary output, cros
items.z: x64dbg-MCP Server 是用 Zig 编写的原生 MCP 插件，为零依赖单文件，支持 x32/x64。它通过 HTTP/SSE 暴露 x64dbg 全部调试功能（断点、单步、内存读写、寄存器、反汇编、符号、PE分析等84个工具），让任何兼容 MCP 的 AI 助手可程序化控制调试器，实现智能体驱动的逆向工程。
items.e: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native Zig-built MCP plugin for x64dbg with zero dependencies and single-binary output for both x32/x64. It exposes full debugger capabilities (84 tools: breakpoints, stepping, memory, registers, disassembly, PE analysis, etc.) over HTTP/SSE, enabling any MCP-compatible AI assistant to programmatically control the debugger for agentic reverse engineering.

items.d: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
items.z: 本指南专为高权限自主AI Agent（OpenClaw）设计，颠覆传统人工加固清单模式。针对终端/root级权限场景，提出Agentic零信任架构，通过事前行为黑名单与供应链审计、事中权限收缩与跨技能检查、事后13项核心指标nightly审计的三层防御矩阵，有效缓解提示注入、供应链投毒等LLM特有风险。支持Agent自主理解并部署安全策略，大幅降低人工配置成本。
items.e: This guide is purpose-built for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional host-based defense to Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture. It addresses LLM-specific threats including prompt injection and supply chain poisoning through a 3-Tier Defense Matrix: pre-action blacklists and skill audits, in-action permission narrowing, and post-action nightly audits of 13 core metrics. Designed to be interpreted and executed directly by agents, it enables autonomous security deployment and validation, dramatically reducing manual configuration overhead while maintaining human oversight for high-risk operations.

items.d: Render Anything Engine: tell your AI what to make. Videos, motion graphics, 3D and games as React and TypeScript, rendered on your own GPU. Rust + Bevy, macOS, Linux and Windows.
items.z: raea 是面向 AI 的渲染引擎，用自然语言描述需求，以 React/TypeScript 编写，在本地 GPU 渲染视频、动态图形、3D 和游戏。基于 Rust+Bevy，跨平台支持 macOS/Linux/Windows。
items.e: raea is an AI-oriented rendering engine that lets you describe what to make in natural language, written as React and TypeScript, and rendered on your local GPU for videos, motion graphics, 3D, and games. Built with Rust and Bevy, it supports macOS, Linux, and Windows. It provides a desktop app and CLI tools, integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, and can render frames, play live as a game, export standalone programs, and check quality issues such as clipped text or low contrast. Designed for AI-driven content creation, it enables anyone to generate professional-grade visuals quickly.

items.d: A vector graphics application for structured SVG editing, available on all major desktop platforms and on web. Currently in late alpha.
items.z: GodSVG 是一款结构化 SVG 编辑器，直接操作 SVG 源码而非添加元数据，实现 UI 与代码实时双向同步。生成干净、精确、优化的矢量文件，适合设计师与开发者对图形进行像素级控制。支持桌面与 Web 平台，目前处于晚期 alpha 阶段，强调低抽象工作流。
items.e: GodSVG is a structured SVG editor that fundamentally differs from traditional tools by directly manipulating SVG source code without metadata overhead. It enables real-time bidirectional sync between visual editing and code view, producing clean, precise, and highly optimized vector files. Designed for designers and developers requiring pixel-perfect control, it runs on desktop and web platforms in late alpha stage.

items.d: A high-performance ASCII video rendering engine featuring real-time WebSocket binary streaming and an isolated compiler for serverless static generation. Built for low-latency 30 FPS playback on HTML5 Canvas.
items.z: ASCILINE是一款高性能跨平台实时ASCII视频渲染引擎，通过WebSocket二进制帧流传输至HTML5 Canvas，实现超低延迟30FPS播放。核心价值在于将视频像素映射为纯文本画布，支持实时CSS滤镜、低带宽零GPU运行及轻量LLM的AI语义处理。采用Python/FastAPI后端结合OpenCV和NumPy解码映射，支持多色彩模式、自适应编解码、音频同步、播放列表及YouTube/摄像头流。适用于低资源设备、交互式网页媒体交付和嵌入式场景，无需传统视频标签。
items.e: ASCILINE is a high-performance, cross-platform real-time ASCII video rendering engine that streams binary-encoded frames via WebSockets to HTML5 Canvas for ultra-low latency 30 FPS playback. It transforms video into pure typographic canvas content, enabling real-time CSS filters, low-bandwidth zero-GPU operation on constrained devices, and seamless integration with lightweight LLMs for AI processing. Python/FastAPI backend uses OpenCV and NumPy for decoding and mapping; vanilla JS frontend handles rendering. Supports multiple color modes, adaptive codecs, audio sync, playlists, YouTube, and webcam streaming. Ideal for interactive web media, embedded systems, and low-resource environments without video elements.

items.d: 🐎 Ryan Lopopolo’s anthology, field guide, and agent context bundle for harness engineering
items.z: “Harness Engineering”是Ryan Lopopolo的文集、领域指南与代理上下文包，专注通过环境塑造提升AI编码代理输出。将模型与代理视为黑箱，核心优化上下文、工具及组织非功能需求（可靠性、安全等）的集成。强调使仓库教导代理、累积一致性反馈循环与最后一英里部署，帮助代理获取私有流程数据。提供AGENTS.md、论文索引和剧本，适用于组织级AI驱动开发与维护，实现判断累积与可靠迭代。
items.e: Harness Engineering is Ryan Lopopolo’s anthology, field guide, and agent context bundle for improving AI coding agent output by engineering the surrounding environment. Treating models and agents as black boxes, it focuses on curating context, tools, and organizational nonfunctional requirements like reliability and security. Key ideas include making repositories teach agents, achieving cumulative coherence via iterative feedback, and enabling last-mile deployment. The repo provides AGENTS.md, thesis index, and playbooks to integrate private process data, boosting reliable, aligned agent performance in real-world systems.

items.d: AI Code Guide is a roadmap to start coding with AI
items.z: AI编程指南：系统梳理AI辅助代码生成工具链与实践，整合vibe coding、MCP/A2A协议等前沿知识。面向开发者和零基础者，提供一站式学习路径与批判性视角。
items.e: AI Coding Guide: Roadmap covering vibe coding, MCP protocols, AI tools for developers and beginners.

items.d: 🌩️ Serverless 自托管的文件管理与文本分享工具/网盘，支持多存储聚合管理和WebDAV 服务挂载。兼容 S3、WebDAV、OneDrive、Google Drive、Telegram、HF、GitHub 等。内置   Markdown 编辑器、30+文件格式预览。支持 Cloudflare Workers 或 Docker 部署。
items.z: CloudPaste 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Serverless 自托管网盘，核心价值在于多云存储聚合管理与零运维部署。支持 S3、OneDrive、Google Drive 等 30+ 存储后端，提供统一 WebDAV 挂载。内置 Vditor Markdown 编辑器与 30+ 文件格式预览，实现个人知识库管理与团队协作。通过边缘计算实现全球加速，Docker 部署提供本地灵活性。
items.e: CloudPaste is a Serverless self-hosted cloud storage built on Cloudflare Workers, aggregating 30+ storage backends including S3, OneDrive, and Google Drive with unified WebDAV mounting. It features a Vditor Markdown editor, 30+ file format previews, and edge computing acceleration across 300+ global nodes. Offering zero-maintenance deployment via Workers or Docker, it serves as an ideal solution for personal knowledge management and team collaboration.

items.d: A Calibre plugin to translate ebook into a specified language.
items.z: Bookfere Ebook Translator 是为 Calibre 设计的专业翻译插件，集成 Google、DeepL、ChatGPT 等主流引擎及自定义 API 支持。插件全面兼容 Calibre 48 种输入格式，提供高级与批量双模式，支持多任务并行翻译与智能缓存，可无缝集成至 Calibre 库管理，是跨语言阅读与电子书本地化的技术解决方案。
items.e: Bookfere Ebook Translator is a professional Calibre plugin integrating Google Translate, DeepL, ChatGPT, Gemini, and custom APIs to translate ebooks across 48 input formats. It offers advanced and batch modes, parallel processing, intelligent caching, and seamless Calibre library integration, delivering a robust solution for cross-language reading and ebook localization with extensive customization options and format compatibility.

items.d: Advanced Privacy Browser Core with Unified Fingerprint Defense: Cloudflare, Akamai, Kasada, Shape, DataDome, PerimeterX, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, Imperva, reCAPTCHA, ThreatMetrix, Adscore
items.z: BotBrowser是一款专注于反浏览器指纹追踪的隐私浏览器核心。基于最新Chromium构建，通过统一指纹防御技术，在Windows、macOS、Linux等跨平台环境下保持完全一致的指纹特征，有效对抗Cloudflare、Akamai、Kasada等31+种高级追踪检测机制。支持Playwright/Puppeteer集成，提供QUIC/STUN全代理网络栈和毫秒级独立指纹切换，性能损耗低于1%。适用于隐私研究、反欺诈测试和自动化工具开发。
items.e: BotBrowser is a privacy-first browser core engineered to neutralize browser fingerprinting across platforms. Built on the latest Chromium, it maintains identical fingerprint signatures on Windows, macOS, and Linux, defeating over 31 tracking systems including Cloudflare, Akamai, and Kasada. Key features include Playwright/Puppeteer integration with CDP leak blocking, full QUIC/STUN proxy tunneling, per-context fingerprint isolation with millisecond switching, and benchmark-proven performance parity with Chrome. Designed for privacy research and authorized defensive benchmarking.

items.d: Blender's GPU Accelerated UI, Decoupled from it's original codebase. Supports Rust, Python, JS, Lua, C & C++. Twice as good as GPUI
items.z: BUI 将 Blender 历经数十年优化的 GPU 加速 GUI 解耦为独立库，支持 Python、Rust、JavaScript (React/Svelte)、C、C++ 及 Dear ImGui 等多种语言和框架。具备高能效、低内存占用与极速渲染特性，跨 Windows/Linux/macOS 平台，适合构建高性能桌面应用界面。
items.e: BUI decouples Blender's decades-optimized GPU-accelerated GUI into a standalone library, supporting Python, Rust, JavaScript (React/Svelte), C, C++, and Dear ImGui. It delivers high energy efficiency, low memory footprint, and blazing-fast rendering across Windows, Linux, and macOS, ideal for building high-performance desktop UIs.

items.d: Translate full-length books and documents with Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Poe or OpenRouter. Preserves formatting. Resumes where you left off. No file size limits.
items.z: 该桌面应用利用Ollama、OpenAI、Gemini等LLM翻译书籍、字幕和文档，支持EPUB、SRT、DOCX、TXT格式。智能分块处理任意长度文件，严格保留格式、样式与结构，支持断点续传。提供本地隐私部署与云端API选项，跨平台易用，适合长篇内容多语言处理与本地化场景。
items.e: TranslateBooksWithLLMs is a cross-platform desktop app that leverages LLMs like local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini and others to translate full-length books, subtitles and documents. It supports EPUB, SRT, DOCX and TXT formats with perfect preservation of structure and styling, uses intelligent chunking for unlimited file sizes while maintaining context, and features automatic checkpoints for resuming translations. Offers both offline local processing and cloud APIs via a simple local web interface.

items.d: A high-performance proxy pool gateway. Turn massive proxy subscriptions into a stable, smart, and observable network with sticky sessions.
items.z: Resin是一款高性能智能代理池网关，将海量代理订阅聚合为支持粘性会话的稳定统一入口。它支持10万+节点管理，通过被动+主动健康检查和P2C+延迟加权算法实现智能调度与熔断。提供HTTP/SOCKS5正向代理及反向代理接入，内置Web UI和结构化日志实现可观测性。具备订阅去重、热更新、状态持久化、零侵入账号提取等特性，基于Go构建高并发，适用于企业稳定IP绑定场景。
items.e: Resin is a high-performance intelligent proxy pool gateway that aggregates massive proxy subscriptions into a stable, smart, observable unified entrypoint with sticky sessions. It manages 100k+ nodes using passive+active health checks, P2C algorithm, and domain-aware latency-weighted scoring for optimal routing and circuit breaking. Supports HTTP/SOCKS5 forward proxies and URL reverse proxy, with Web UI, metrics, and structured logs for observability. Features include cross-subscription deduplication, hot reload, persistence, and header-based account extraction. Built in Go for native high concurrency, it supports diverse protocols and formats, ideal for stable outbound IP business scenarios.

items.z: Obsidian Digital Garden 插件将 Obsidian 知识库转化为精美数字花园网站。支持选择性发布（仅 dg-publish: true 笔记公开），保护隐私。全面兼容 Dataview、Canvas、Excalidraw、Mermaid 等功能，提供搜索、图谱、反向链接导航及主题/CSS 定制。基于 Eleventy 静态生成，通过 Vercel/Netlify 一键部署或 Forestry 托管，实现零成本、完全可控的知识分享与持续迭代。
items.e: The Obsidian Digital Garden plugin transforms Obsidian vaults into beautiful, customizable digital garden websites. It enables selective publishing via 'dg-publish: true' frontmatter for privacy control. It supports extensive Obsidian features including Dataview queries, Canvas, Excalidraw, Mermaid diagrams, plus advanced navigation like search, graphs, and backlinks. Customization includes themes, CSS variables, and custom components. Powered by Eleventy for static sites, it offers seamless deployment to Vercel/Netlify or managed hosting via Forestry.md, giving users full ownership of their evolving knowledge base.

items.d: Making an ESP32-based quadcopter from scratch
items.z: Flix是从零构建的开源ESP32四旋翼无人机，专为教育与研究设计。使用通用组件与简洁Arduino固件（不足2k行），支持MAVLink经Wi-Fi/ESP-NOW通信，可用手柄、遥控器或手机控制。提供Gazebo精确仿真（运行原代码）及Python库实现脚本化自动飞行，附飞行控制理论教材开发中，适合学习飞控原理与实践。
items.e: Flix is an open-source ESP32-based quadcopter built from scratch for education and research. It uses general-purpose components and clean Arduino firmware under 2k lines, supports MAVLink over Wi-Fi or ESP-NOW, and can be controlled via gamepad, remote, or smartphone. Features precise Gazebo simulation running the original code and a Python library for scripting autonomous flights, with a flight control textbook in development.

items.d: 反蒸馏 Skill：清洗你被迫写的 Skill 文件，看起来完整，核心知识留给自己。Anti-distillation for employee Skills.
items.z: 反蒸馏技能是一种对抗知识蒸馏的AI工具，帮助员工在提交技能文件时自动清洗核心知识，生成看似完整但空洞的版本，同时保留私有备份。适用于AI智能体技能文件，通过提示工程实现知识保护。
items.e: Anti-Distill Skill is an AI-powered tool designed to counter knowledge distillation in the workplace. When employees are asked to convert their work experience into AI Skill files, this tool sanitizes the content, replacing core knowledge with correct but useless filler, resulting in a submission version that looks complete and professional. Simultaneously, it generates a private backup containing the real gotchas, judgment calls, and interpersonal knowledge, ensuring that the employee's true expertise remains protected. Built on prompt engineering for AI agents, it automates the process of knowledge protection.

items.d: aimili-vpngate是一个借助vpngate.net让Linux用干净ip出站的代理工具。
items.z: aimili-vpngate是一款面向Linux VPS的VPNGate节点管理与代理网关工具，基于Python标准库实现节点自动获取、检测与切换，提供HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5多协议代理及Web管理后台，支持一键安装与Docker部署，适用于需要干净IP出站的跨境网络场景。
items.e: aimili-vpngate is a VPNGate node management and proxy gateway for Linux VPS, built with Python standard library. It offers HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy, node auto-detection and switching, a web dashboard, one-click install, and Docker deployment for clean IP outbound use cases.

items.d: Agent skill for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw that translates entire books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel subagents.
items.z: 该项目是基于Claude Code的电子书翻译工具，采用并行子代理架构实现整本书的高效翻译。支持PDF/DOCX/EPUB输入，自动分块、并行翻译、验证合并，输出多格式文档。核心技术包括8并发子代理、SHA-256清单验证和断点续传，有效解决长文本上下文溢出问题。
items.e: This project is a Claude Code-based ebook translation tool that uses parallel subagents for efficient whole-book translation. It supports PDF/DOCX/EPUB input, automatically chunking, parallel translating, validating, and merging into multiple formats. Key features include 8 concurrent subagents, SHA-256 manifest validation, and resumable runs to solve long-text context overflow.

items.d: Identify email addresses or domains names that belong to colleges or universities. Help automate the process of approving or rejecting academic discounts.
items.z: JetBrains/swot 仓库维护全球教育机构邮箱域名列表，用于自动验证学生和教师身份并授予 JetBrains 工具免费许可证。核心价值是简化学术折扣审批流程，支持全球高校用户获取专业开发工具。应用场景覆盖学生免费授权与教育机构验证。技术亮点包括层级目录结构存储域名、子域名自动包含、滥用域名黑名单及严格准入规则，确保数据准确可靠。
items.e: JetBrains/swot maintains a hierarchical list of academic email domains to verify eligibility and grant free JetBrains tool licenses to students and teachers worldwide. Core value lies in automating academic discount approvals for global educational users. Application scenarios include student/teacher license verification. Technical highlights feature structured directory storage, subdomain inclusion, abused domain blacklist, and strict inclusion criteria for authenticity.

items.d: News Aggregation · AI Ratings · Trading Signals · Real-time Updates
items.z: OpenNews MCP 是面向 AI 助手的实时新闻与市场数据聚合服务，整合 85+ 源（新闻、上币、链上、Meme、市场、预测六类），提供 AI 影响力评分、多空交易信号及中英摘要，支持关键词/币种/源过滤与 WebSocket 实时推送，助力加密交易决策。
items.e: OpenNews MCP is a real-time news and market data aggregation server for AI assistants, covering 85+ sources across six categories (news, listings, on-chain, meme, market, prediction). It delivers AI impact scores, long/short trading signals, bilingual summaries, advanced filters, and WebSocket live updates for crypto trading insights.

items.d: Portable project memory across Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, plus token accounting measured from harness transcripts. Local file I/O, no API calls, no telemetry.
items.z: OpenWolf 是 Claude Code 的开源中间件，通过 6 个隐形 hook 脚本为其提供'第二大脑'。它构建项目文件索引、学习记忆和 token 账本，在读取文件前提供上下文信息，阻止重复读取，自动记录偏好与错误。实测可减少 80% token 消耗，平均节省 65.8%，且无需改变现有工作流。
items.e: OpenWolf is an open-source middleware that acts as a 'second brain' for Claude Code, delivering sharper context and dramatically reducing token usage. Through 6 invisible hook scripts, it builds project file indexes with token estimates, accumulates learning memory from corrections, and maintains a comprehensive token ledger. By providing file context before reads, blocking duplicate accesses within sessions, and auto-documenting preferences and mistakes, it achieves up to 80% token reduction (averaging 65.8% across 132+ real-world sessions) with zero workflow changes for developers.

items.d: logo-generator-skill
items.z: op7418/logo-generator-skill 是一个专业的SVG Logo生成技能，集成Gemini大模型快速生成6+种设计变体，并利用图像预览功能创建12种专业背景的展示图像。核心价值在于融合经典设计原则（极致简约、留白、精准比例）与AI技术，产出高质量、可编辑的SVG和PNG格式Logo，解决传统设计耗时与AI输出粗糙的痛点。适用于初创公司、开发者、设计师快速获取专业品牌标识，支持交互式HTML预览与迭代优化。
items.e: The logo-generator-skill repository delivers a professional SVG logo generation skill powered by Gemini AI. It produces 6+ distinct design variants based on product characteristics and proven principles like extreme simplicity and negative space, then generates high-end showcase images with 12 curated professional backgrounds using Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview. Outputs include editable SVGs, PNG exports, and interactive HTML previews. Ideal for startups, developers, designers, and product teams needing fast, production-ready logo solutions and presentations.

items.d: Google Antigravity AI模型配额监控插件 (Antigravity AI Model Quota Watching)
items.z: AntigravityQuotaWatcher 是一款 VS Code 插件，专为 Antigravity AI 平台用户提供实时配额监控。通过自动检测服务端口与认证信息，在状态栏直观展示各模型剩余配额，并在配额不足时智能预警。内置 Dashboard 面板支持配额概览、连接状态检测及周限测试，帮助开发者有效管理 AI 资源，避免开发中断。
items.e: AntigravityQuotaWatcher is a VS Code extension that provides real-time quota monitoring for Antigravity AI platform users. It automatically detects service ports and authentication credentials, displays remaining quotas for various AI models in the status bar, and offers smart alerts when quotas are low. The built-in Dashboard panel provides quota overview, connection status, and weekly limit testing features, helping developers effectively manage AI resources and prevent development interruptions.

items.d: 专为已有 Giffgaff 和 Simyo 号码的用户设计的现代化 eSIM 管理工具集，支持将物理 SIM 卡转换为 eSIM、设备更换和二维码生成。(A modern set of eSIM management tools designed specifically for users who already have Giffgaff and Simyo numbers, offering support for converting physical SIM cards to eSIMs, device replacements, and QR code generation.)
items.z: eSIM Tools 为 Giffgaff 和 Simyo 用户提供在线 eSIM 管理服务。支持物理 SIM 转 eSIM、设备更换和二维码生成，全自动化 1-2 分钟完成。数据本地处理保障隐私，支持 PWA 离线使用。技术亮点为原生 JS、OAuth 认证和跨平台访问。
items.e: eSIM Tools is a modern online eSIM management toolset designed for existing Giffgaff and Simyo users. It supports converting physical SIMs to eSIMs, device replacements, and QR code generation through fully automated processes that take only 1-2 minutes without customer support. All data is processed locally in the browser for privacy, with PWA support for offline use. Built with native JavaScript and no frameworks, it features OAuth 2.0 PKCE, SMS verification, and GraphQL integration. The tool is ideal for users switching devices or migrating to eSIM on compatible iOS and Android phones.

items.d: AI deep-research agent that turns any question into a cited report: plans searches, reads real sources, verifies evidence. Self-hosted, multi-provider, Docker-ready.
items.z: 基于深度研究的AI助手，通过迭代搜索与LLM实现自动化信息挖掘。支持DeepSeek R1等主流模型，提供树状可视化研究流程与实时流式反馈。采用浏览器本地化处理确保数据安全，集成Tavily/Firecrawl多源搜索。支持PDF导出与Docker部署，适用于学术研究、市场分析等深度调研场景。
items.e: An AI-powered research assistant that automates deep information gathering through iterative search and LLM reasoning. Features real-time streaming feedback and tree-structured visualization of research processes. Supports DeepSeek R1 and major LLM providers with local browser processing for data privacy. Integrates Tavily and Firecrawl for web search, offers PDF export, Docker deployment, and server mode. Ideal for academic research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence requiring comprehensive, automated investigation with full citation tracking.

items.d: codex-console 是一个集成化控制台项目，支持任务管理、批量处理、数据导出、自动上传、日志查看与打包支持。
items.z: codex-console 是专为解决 OpenAI 注册链路不稳定性而生的增强版控制台。它修复了 Sentinel POW 验证、拆分注册登录流程、优化验证码处理，支持批量账号管理、Web UI 操作、多邮箱接码及 PostgreSQL。提供跨平台打包与 Docker 部署，是稳定获取 OpenAI Token 的自动化运维利器。
items.e: codex-console is an enhanced management console designed to address OpenAI registration instability. It fixes Sentinel POW verification, separates registration/login flows, and optimizes email verification handling. Featuring batch account management, Web UI, multi-email support, PostgreSQL, and cross-platform deployment, it's a robust automation tool for stable OpenAI token acquisition.

items.d: Fractal Graph-of-Thought. Rhizomatic Mind-Mapping for Ai-Agents, Web-Links, Notes, and Code.
items.z: Neurite 采用分形几何与图论构建无限维思维导图，融合AI代理与多模态节点（代码/链接/笔记）。支持多代理协同与神经网络API，为创意协作与知识管理提供非线性、自相似的可视化工作空间。
items.e: Neurite is an open-source fractal-based mind-mapping platform that merges chaos theory with graph theory to create an infinite-dimensional digital workspace. It interconnects AI agents, code snippets, notes, and web links as nodes in a rhizomatic structure. Key features include multi-agent UI collaboration, FractalGPT integration, a Neural API, and synchronized knowledge management. The system enables non-linear creative thinking by revealing hidden patterns through self-similar fractal geometries, transforming how complex information is organized and visualized.

items.d: 零知识证明入门教程。Comprehensive Zero-Knowledge Proofs Tutorial. #zk #WIP
items.z: WTF-zk 为零知识证明入门教程，面向高中数学基础学习者。项目以 Python 实现核心算法，系统涵盖数论、抽象代数、椭圆曲线等数学基础，并逐步深入 ZK 证明理论。通过 Jupyter Notebook 交互式教学，结合经典密码学方案复现，为零知识证明领域提供低门槛、理论与实践结合的学习路径。
items.e: WTF-zk is a comprehensive Zero-Knowledge Proofs tutorial designed for learners with only high school mathematics background. The project uses Python to implement core cryptographic algorithms, systematically covering essential mathematical foundations including number theory, abstract algebra, ring fields, and elliptic curves. Through interactive Jupyter Notebook demonstrations and step-by-step reproduction of classic schemes like RSA and Diffie-Hellman, it creates an accessible, theory-practice integrated learning pathway into the ZK proofs domain.

items.d: AI Red Teaming playground labs to run AI Red Teaming trainings including infrastructure.
items.z: 微软AI红队演练实验室提供系统化的AI系统渗透测试实战训练。该仓库源自Black Hat USA 2024课程，包含凭证窃取、元提示提取、Crescendo多轮攻击等多样化挑战场景。基于Chat Copilot架构构建，集成PyRIT自动化工具实现攻击流程脚本化，覆盖直接提示注入、对抗性机器学习等新型风险。为安全专业人员提供从理论到实践的完整AI红队技能培养体系，支持Microsoft Learn官方教程视频联动。
items.e: Microsoft AI Red Teaming Playground Labs delivers hands-on training for systematically assessing AI system vulnerabilities. Originating from Black Hat USA 2024, this repository provides practical challenges including credential exfiltration, metaprompt extraction, and multi-turn Crescendo attacks. Built on Chat Copilot infrastructure, it integrates PyRIT automation framework to script adversarial testing workflows. The labs cover novel attack vectors beyond traditional security, incorporating adversarial machine learning and Responsible AI failures. Designed for security professionals, it offers a complete skill development path with Jupyter notebooks and Microsoft Learn video tutorials.

items.d: ML algorithms implemented and derived from first-principles in Jupyter Notebooks and NumPy
items.z: 该项目通过 Jupyter Book 和 Marimo 构建交互式机器学习可视化平台，核心价值在于从第一性原理出发，使用 NumPy 纯 Python 实现神经网络、逻辑回归、PCA 等核心算法并配套数学推导。动态可视化训练过程，直观展示权重变化对损失函数的影响，是理解算法内部机制的顶级教学工具。
items.e: This project builds an interactive ML visualization platform using Jupyter Book and Marimo. It implements core algorithms—neural networks, logistic regression, PCA, etc.—from first principles with NumPy, accompanied by mathematical derivations. Dynamic visualizations show training progression and weight-loss relationships, serving as a premier educational tool for understanding algorithmic internals.

items.z: reg-factory 是一套全自动注册流水线：批量自注册 Outlook 邮箱，再用同一邮箱在 ChatGPT/Grok/Claude 上注册账号并导出直登 Cookie。核心采用比特浏览器实现指纹隔离、Clash Verge 代理节点切换绕过区域与 Cloudflare 限制，结合接码打码服务完成验证。基于 Python + Playwright 构建，适用于 AI 服务批量测试与账号管理场景。
items.e: reg-factory is a fully automated registration pipeline: batch self-register Outlook emails, then use them to create accounts on ChatGPT/Grok/Claude and export direct-login cookies. It uses BitBrowser for fingerprint isolation, Clash Verge for proxy switching to bypass geo-blocks and Cloudflare, plus SMS/captcha services. Built on Python + Playwright, ideal for bulk AI service testing and account management.

items.d: Zap is an open, local-first terminal with first-class AI and agent support.
