items.d: Turn your Telegram Channel into a MicroBlog.
items.z: BroadcastChannel 是一个基于 Astro 的工具，可将 Telegram 频道转化为轻量级微型博客。它无需浏览器端 JavaScript，提供 SEO 友好的站点地图和 RSS 订阅，支持 Cloudflare、Vercel 等无服务器部署。用户只需配置频道用户名，即可快速搭建独立博客，实现内容同步与自定义域名绑定。
items.e: BroadcastChannel transforms your Telegram channel into a lightweight microblog using Astro. It requires zero client-side JavaScript, delivers SEO-friendly sitemaps and RSS feeds, and supports deployment on serverless platforms like Cloudflare and Vercel. Simply configure your channel username to launch a standalone blog with custom domain support.

items.d: Perplexity style AI Search engine clone built with Gemini 2.0 Flash and Grounding
items.z: 基于 Gemini 2.0 Flash 的 AI 搜索引擎，提供 Perplexity 式实时问答体验。核心亮点在于 Google Search Grounding 技术，确保答案附带可溯源的引用来源。全栈 TypeScript 架构（React + Express）实现高效开发，支持会话内追问，适用于研究、学习与精准信息检索场景。
items.e: Gemini-Search is a production-ready AI search engine clone that replicates Perplexity's core functionality using Google's cutting-edge Gemini 2.0 Flash model. Its key technical innovation lies in the Search Grounding integration, which fetches real-time web results and automatically generates citations for every answer. The full-stack TypeScript implementation combines React with Vite on the frontend and Express.js on the backend, delivering a responsive, modern interface with conversational memory. Designed for researchers, students, and professionals seeking accurate, traceable information with minimal latency.

items.d: CORTEX RAG is an enterprise retrieval and knowledge assistant that helps teams find accurate answers from company data with citations, permission-aware retrieval, and fast deployment
items.z: Cortex RAG是一款完全本地的超级RAG系统。支持上传PDF/DOCX/TXT等文档，通过Streamlit界面提问，集成上下文检索、RAG-Fusion、GraphRAG、CRAG、神经重排序、HyDE等九大技术，结合BM25+FAISS+NetworkX知识图谱，实现精准检索、相关性验证、实时推理与来源引用。基于Ollama本地大模型，无需API密钥或云服务，配备语义缓存和多轮对话记忆，保障隐私。适用于敏感文档智能分析、离线知识库构建及个人问答场景。
items.e: Cortex RAG is a fully local, privacy-first super RAG engine. Upload PDFs, DOCX or TXT files via Streamlit and ask questions. It integrates nine advanced techniques—Contextual Retrieval, RAG-Fusion with RRF, GraphRAG on NetworkX, Corrective RAG, Neural Reranking, HyDE, live reasoning streaming, semantic caching, and chat memory—plus hybrid search (BM25 + FAISS). Powered by Ollama local LLMs, it retrieves, cross-checks, reasons, and cites sources entirely on-device. No API keys, cloud uploads, or subscriptions. Ideal for secure document Q&A, offline knowledge bases, and sensitive data analysis.

items.d: Warp+Psiphon, an anti censorship utility for iran
items.z: Warp-Plus是基于Cloudflare Warp的开源实现，深度集成Psiphon链式代理，专为伊朗等高审查环境打造的抗审查工具。支持Warp-in-Warp双层隧道改变虚拟NAT位置、SOCKS5代理、端点扫描与跨平台部署（含Termux），提供快速、安全且灵活的翻墙VPN解决方案。
items.e: Warp-Plus is an open-source Cloudflare Warp implementation enhanced with Psiphon chaining for robust censorship circumvention in restrictive regions like Iran. It features Warp-in-Warp dual tunneling to shift virtual NAT locations, SOCKS5 proxy support, endpoint scanning, and cross-platform compatibility including Termux, delivering a fast, secure VPN solution for unrestricted internet access.

items.d: A taxonomy for open source cryptocurrency, blockchain, and decentralized ecosystems
items.z: Electric Capital 推出的 Open Dev Data 是一个结构化的区块链与 Web3 开源生态分类法。它提供 CLI 工具链，支持按时间快照导出 JSONL 格式的仓库数据，并集成 DuckDB 实现本地高性能分析。通过交互式 SQL 界面，开发者可快速洞察比特币、以太坊等生态的子系统分布与项目演进，为生态研究提供精准数据基础。
items.e: Open Dev Data by Electric Capital is a structured taxonomy for blockchain and Web3 open-source ecosystems. It offers a CLI toolkit to export repository data in JSONL format with historical snapshots, integrates DuckDB for local high-performance analytics, and provides an interactive SQL interface. Developers can quickly analyze subsystem distributions and project evolution across ecosystems like Bitcoin and Ethereum, enabling precise ecosystem research.

items.d: Fast, native Rust + GPUI workspace for local and SSH with MCP tools—no WebView, no telemetry, open source.
items.z: OxideTerm 是一款基于 Tauri 2 和纯 Rust SSH 实现的一体化终端工作台，将本地 Shell、SSH、SFTP、远程 IDE 和 AI 代理集成于单一原生二进制文件中。其核心技术亮点包括智能重连、连接复用、MCP 协议与 RAG 知识库的 AI 集成，以及无 Electron、无 OpenSSL 的轻量化架构，为开发者和运维人员提供高效、稳定的跨平台远程开发体验。
items.e: OxideTerm is an all-in-one terminal workspace built with Tauri 2 and pure Rust SSH, integrating local shells, SSH, SFTP, remote IDE, and AI agent into a single native binary. Key technical highlights include smart reconnection, connection multiplexing, MCP protocol with RAG-based AI integration, and a lightweight architecture without Electron or OpenSSL, delivering efficient and stable cross-platform remote development experience for developers and operations teams.

items.d: Medium Unlocker (now Freedium App) is an android app designed to access Medium, NYT, Bloomberg, Washington Post, Financial Times, Reuters, The Economist articles without any paywalls.
items.z: Freedium（原Medium Unlocker）是一款Android原生应用，基于Java+WebView实现，支持通过Freedium与Archive.is镜像无障碍阅读Medium、纽约时报、华盛顿邮报、彭博、路透社、经济学人及金融时报文章。提供分享接收、深度链接、镜像自动切换、历史书签、阅读位置记忆、Markdown复制及离线友好功能，解决多订阅墙痛点。
items.e: Freedium (formerly Medium Unlocker) is a native Android app built with Java and WebView that unlocks paywalled articles from Medium, NYT, Washington Post, Bloomberg, Reuters, The Economist and Financial Times via Freedium and Archive.is mirrors. It offers share-sheet integration, deep links, auto-fallback mirrors, history, bookmarks, scroll memory, Markdown export and offline-friendly reading for casual multi-publisher access.

items.d: A step-by-step guide to build your own AI agent.
items.z: 这是一个18步渐进式教程，从零构建生产级AI智能体。涵盖单智能体能力（工具、记忆、网络访问）、事件驱动架构、多智能体协作及生产化特性。每个步骤提供可运行代码与详细设计决策，使用LiteLLM支持多模型提供商，适合学习与实践。
items.e: An 18-step progressive tutorial for building production-ready AI agents from scratch. Covers single-agent capabilities (tools, memory, web access), event-driven architecture, multi-agent collaboration, and production features. Each step includes runnable code and design decisions, using LiteLLM for multi-provider support, ideal for learning and practice.

items.d: ChirmyRam OneDrive Repository
items.z: 这是一个基于国际版OneDrive构建的超大规模媒体资源仓库，总存储量达150TB，涵盖动画、影视、剧集、电子书等分类。项目采用多账号负载均衡架构，通过alist目录程序提供WebDAV和Rclone访问支持，解决了API调用限制问题。内容按中文拼音和英文首字母双重索引组织，主要提供MKV格式内封字幕视频。技术亮点包括Golang单文件部署、多盘符抽象管理、以及完整的播放器推荐方案。
items.e: A massive OneDrive-based media repository totaling 150TB+ across nine dedicated drives for animations, movies, TV series, 4K ISOs, and e-books. The project implements multi-account load balancing via alist (Golang) to overcome API throttling, offering WebDAV and Rclone access protocols. Content is dual-indexed by Chinese pinyin and English names, primarily in MKV format with embedded subtitles. Key technical features include single-binary deployment, abstracted multi-drive management, and comprehensive media player recommendations for optimal playback experience.

items.d: a multi node frp webui and for https://github.com/fatedier/frp server and client management, which makes this project a Cloudflare Tunnel/Tailscale Funnel/Ngork platform and agent open source alternative
items.z: FRP-Panel 是 frp 的开源可视化管理平台，提供集中式配置、多节点编排与边缘 Worker 部署能力。项目采用 Master-Server-Client 架构，支持 WireGuard 智能组网与动态调度，可替代 Cloudflare Tunnel 等商业服务，大幅简化 NAT 穿透与内网服务暴露的运维复杂度，实现统一认证与实时监控。
items.e: FRP-Panel is an open-source visual management platform for frp that provides centralized configuration, multi-node orchestration, and edge Worker deployment capabilities. Adopting a Master-Server-Client architecture, it supports WireGuard smart networking and dynamic scheduling, serving as a self-hosted alternative to commercial services like Cloudflare Tunnel. The platform significantly simplifies NAT traversal and internal service exposure operations while enabling unified authentication, real-time monitoring, and zero-configuration credential distribution across distributed environments.

items.d: A wrapper that exposes Google AI Studio Build as OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic compatible APIs.（一个将 Google AI Studio Build 封装为兼容 OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic 风格 API 的工具）
items.z: AIStudioToAPI 是一个将 Google AI Studio 网页端封装为兼容 OpenAI、Gemini 和 Anthropic API 格式的代理工具。它利用浏览器自动化技术实现多账号管理、工具调用及生图/TTS 模型访问，提供可视化 Web 控制台和 VNC 登录功能，便于开发者将 AI Studio 能力无缝集成到现有应用。
items.e: AIStudioToAPI is a wrapper that converts Google AI Studio's web interface into OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic-compatible API formats. Leveraging browser automation, it supports multi-account management, function calling, and access to Gemini models for image generation and text-to-speech. The tool provides a web console with VNC login capabilities, enabling seamless integration of AI Studio features into existing applications.

items.z: Grok2API 基于 FastAPI 构建 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持聊天补全、图像编辑、视频生成及 Anthropic 接口。核心亮点包括多账号池管理、流式输出、工具调用、本地缓存与自动维护。提供 Docker 一键部署（含防 Cloudflare 方案）、内置 Admin 后台与 WebUI，适用于 AI 应用集成与多模态内容生成。
items.e: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based Grok gateway exposing web capabilities via OpenAI-compatible APIs for chat, image editing, video generation, and Anthropic endpoints. Key highlights: multi-account pooling, streaming, tool calling, local caching, auto-maintenance. Offers Docker deployment with anti-CF options, admin panel, and WebUIs. Ideal for AI app integration and multimodal tasks.

items.d: Integrate Grok's powerful real-time search capabilities into Claude via the MCP protocol!
items.z: 通过 MCP 协议将 Grok 实时搜索能力集成至 Claude，突破模型知识截止限制。基于 FastMCP 构建，提供 AI 优化的结构化搜索结果，支持多平台过滤与网页抓取。可一键禁用官方工具并强制路由，实现无缝即插即用。适用于事实核查、实时信息检索与研究分析场景，显著增强 AI 的时效性信息获取能力。
items.e: Integrates Grok's real-time search capabilities into Claude via MCP protocol, effectively breaking through the model's knowledge cutoff limitation. Built on FastMCP framework, it delivers AI-optimized structured search results with multi-platform filtering and web scraping support. Features one-click disabling of native tools with forced routing for seamless plug-and-play experience. Includes automatic time injection and dynamic model switching capabilities. Ideal for fact-checking, real-time information retrieval, and research analysis scenarios, significantly enhancing AI's ability to access up-to-date information and verify facts with current data.

items.d: Run OpenClaw on Android with a single command — no proot, no Linux
items.z: 该项目通过仅安装glibc动态链接器（ld.so）替代传统proot-distro方案，实现OpenClaw在Android/Termux上的一键部署，存储开销从1-2GB降至约200MB，并提供独立APK应用，无需完整Linux发行版即可运行Node.js应用。
items.e: Runs OpenClaw on Android/Termux using only glibc ld.so, eliminating proot-distro. Cuts storage from 1-2GB to ~200MB with one-command setup and a standalone APK app.

items.d: Github Starred Repositories Manager
items.z: Gitstars 是专为开发者设计的 GitHub 星标仓库管理工具。它解决了星标过多导致的查找难题，提供按主题/语言分类、README 预览和快速直达功能。内置的 Gitstars Ranking 每日更新 GitHub 星标 Top100 项目，支持按编程语言筛选，帮助开发者高效发现优质开源项目。支持 Vercel 一键部署，实现个人星标仓库的私有化智能管理。
items.e: Gitstars is a specialized GitHub starred repositories manager for developers. It addresses the challenge of finding repositories among numerous stars by offering categorization by topics/languages, README preview, and quick access. The built-in Gitstars Ranking updates daily with GitHub's top 100 starred projects across programming languages, enabling efficient discovery of quality open-source projects. One-click Vercel deployment enables private intelligent management of personal starred repositories.

items.d: A multi-agent system that keeps running for ~100 hours and solve a very complicated coding or math problem that can be verified
items.z: Goal-Driven是一个多智能体协作框架，通过主从智能体架构实现复杂问题的持续求解。系统以明确目标和严格标准驱动子智能体长时间工作（30-300小时），自动评估进度直至达标。已成功应用于编译器、数据库等系统级项目开发，如C++实现TypeScript编译器（100小时）和Rust实现SQLite（30小时），显著扩展了AI解决复杂工程问题的能力边界。
items.e: Goal-Driven is a multi-agent collaboration framework designed for solving highly complex, verifiable problems through sustained continuous effort. It employs a master-slave architecture where the master agent monitors sub-agent progress against predefined goals and criteria, maintaining persistent work cycles for 30-300 hours until success conditions are satisfied. The system has demonstrated remarkable capabilities in system-level development, including building a C++ TypeScript compiler from scratch in 100 hours and a Rust-based SQLite implementation in 30 hours. By automating long-horizon software engineering tasks, it pushes the boundaries of AI-driven complex problem solving.

items.d: Javascript library for generating identicons. Running in the browser and on Node.js.
items.z: Jdenticon 是一个轻量级 JavaScript 库，用于生成高识别度的 identicon 头像。它支持 SVG 和 Canvas 渲染，可在浏览器和 Node.js 环境中运行。通过确定性哈希算法，相同输入始终生成一致的视觉图标，完美适合作为用户头像占位符。库体积小巧，零依赖，并提供 React、Angular 等主流框架的集成方案，是构建用户标识系统的理想选择。
items.e: Jdenticon is a lightweight JavaScript library for generating highly recognizable identicon avatars. Supporting both SVG and Canvas rendering, it runs in browsers and Node.js. Using deterministic hash algorithms, identical inputs always produce consistent visual icons, making it perfect for user avatar placeholders. With minimal bundle size, zero dependencies, and official integrations for React, Angular, and other frameworks, it's an ideal solution for user identification systems.

items.d: Run OpenClaw AI Gateway on Android — standalone Flutter app with built-in terminal, web dashboard, and one-tap setup. Also available as a Termux CLI package.
items.z: OpenClaw 将 OpenClaw AI 网关移植到 Android 平台，提供免 root 的 Flutter 独立应用和 Termux CLI 两种模式。通过 proot 技术自动构建 Ubuntu 环境并安装 Node.js 22 和 OpenClaw，实现一键部署。应用内置终端模拟器、Web 管理面板、实时日志查看和网关启停控制，支持 API 密钥配置和后台常驻服务。可选安装 Go 和 Homebrew 开发工具，让 Android 设备成为便携的 AI 网关节点。
items.e: OpenClaw brings the OpenClaw AI Gateway to Android via a standalone Flutter app and Termux CLI package. It uses proot to automatically set up an Ubuntu environment with Node.js 22 and OpenClaw, requiring no root access. The app features a built-in terminal emulator, embedded web dashboard, real-time log viewer, and gateway controls. It supports one-tap deployment, API key configuration, background foreground service, and optional installation of Go and Homebrew tools, turning Android devices into portable AI gateway nodes.

items.z: Isoflow 是基于 React 的开源网络图绘制组件，提供拖放编辑器、可扩展图标系统（支持 AWS/Azure 等云插件）和代码/图片导出功能。作为 MIT 许可的开源核心项目，社区版适用于 IT 基础设施可视化、云架构设计与网络拓扑规划场景。技术亮点在于灵活的插件机制与 React 组件的易集成性，助力快速构建专业网络文档。
items.e: Isoflow is an open-source React component for drawing network diagrams. It features a drag-and-drop editor, extensible icon system with plugins for AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and export options to code or images. As an MIT-licensed open-core project, the Community Edition is ideal for architecture visualization, infrastructure planning, and network topology scenarios. Highlights include plugin extensibility and seamless React integration.

items.d: Jailed in-app purchase cracker (iOS 12-16)
items.z: SatellaJailed 是一款专为 iOS 12-16 设计的应用内购买破解工具，支持非越狱（jailed）和部分越狱设备。通过动态库注入技术，它能在应用购买流程中拦截并绕过苹果的支付验证机制。工具提供三种安装方式：电脑脚本自动打补丁、Azula 应用补丁和 Esign 签名集成，支持 TrollStore 和 Dopamine 环境。使用时发起购买后取消确认弹窗即可。核心功能默认启用，iOS 15+ 用户可开启高级选项。注意并非所有应用都兼容。
items.e: SatellaJailed is an iOS 12-16 in-app purchase cracker designed for jailed and partially jailbroken devices. It employs dynamic library injection to intercept and bypass Apple's payment verification during purchase flows. The tool offers three installation methods: computer-based script patching, Azula app patching, and Esign signature integration, compatible with TrollStore and Dopamine environments. Users initiate a purchase and cancel the Apple ID confirmation popup to activate. Core functionality is enabled by default, with advanced features available for iOS 15+. Note that not all applications are supported, and success rates may vary depending on the target app.

items.d: AetherViz Master - 互动教育可视化建筑师，将任意教学主题转化为沉浸式3D交互网页
items.z: AetherViz Master 是一款 AI 驱动的互动教育可视化工具，能将任意教学主题一键转化为沉浸式 3D 交互网页。支持物理、化学、生物、数学等多学科，自动识别领域并匹配最佳渲染方案。核心价值在于零代码生成专业教学页面，集成 Three.js 3D 引擎、SVG 混合渲染、KaTeX 公式及 OrbitControls 交互。适用于教师、学生和内容创作者，通过 Claude 等 AI 助手实现快速沉浸式学习内容创作，提供粒子系统、测验面板和响应式玻璃拟态 UI。
items.e: AetherViz Master is an AI-powered interactive educational visualization tool that instantly converts any teaching topic into immersive 3D interactive web pages. It supports subjects like physics, chemistry, biology, and math with automatic domain recognition and optimal rendering selection. Core value lies in zero-code generation of professional teaching pages using Three.js 3D engine, hybrid SVG rendering, KaTeX formulas, and OrbitControls. Ideal for teachers, students, and creators, it integrates with AI assistants like Claude for rapid immersive content creation, featuring particle systems, quizzes, and responsive glassmorphism UI.

items.d: Free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher for web scraping and multi-accounting. By the ShardX team (formerly ProxyShard). Engine-level fingerprint spoofing in Chromium 158 (WebGL / WebGPU / Client Hints / fonts / TLS), 220+ device profiles bundled, stable QUIC + WebRTC over SOCKS5.
items.z: ShardX 是开源反检测浏览器启动器，基于修改版 Chromium 152 引擎实现多层指纹伪装，内置 220+ 设备配置，支持 SOCKS5 代理下 QUIC/WebRTC，提供多语言 SDK 与 MCP 服务，适用于网页爬虫与多账号管理。
items.e: ShardX is a free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher built on a patched Chromium 152 engine with deep fingerprint spoofing across WebGL, WebGPU, Client Hints, fonts, and TLS layers. It bundles 220+ device profiles, supports stable QUIC and WebRTC over SOCKS5 proxies, and provides multi-language SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Rust along with a local API and MCP server. Designed by the ProxyShard team, it is ideal for web scraping and multi-account management workflows at scale.

items.d: 专业的短剧剧本创作skill,从选题立项到分集撰写、质量自检、合规审核、海外出海，覆盖短剧剧本生产全流程。
items.z: 这是一个面向AI编程助手的短剧剧本创作技能包，覆盖选题立项到出海全流程。提供13种题材模板、四层反派体系、五种钩子类型和节奏曲线系统，支持双语格式与合规审查。通过结构化提示工程实现自动化剧本生产，大幅提升创作效率与质量。
items.e: This is a professional short drama screenplay creation skill package for AI programming assistants. It covers the complete workflow from topic selection to episode writing, quality review, compliance check, and overseas expansion. The tool provides 13 genre templates, a four-tier villain system, five hook types, and a rhythm curve system with paid content optimization. It supports both domestic and international formats with bilingual capabilities, featuring automated quality scoring and compliance review. Built on structured prompt engineering, it streamlines script creation, dramatically enhancing production efficiency while ensuring professional quality.

items.d: AI Agent Skill to generate and render beautiful Mermaid diagrams as SVG or terminal ASCII — 15 themes, 6 diagram types, batch CLI, no browser.
items.z: 专为AI Agent设计的Mermaid图表渲染技能，本地无浏览器生成精美SVG/PNG/终端ASCII，支持15主题、6种图类型（流程图/时序/状态/类/ER/XY）与批量CLI，无缝集成Claude Code、Cursor等环境。
items.e: AI Agent skill for rendering beautiful Mermaid diagrams locally without a browser. Outputs themed SVG, PNG, or terminal ASCII/Unicode. Supports 15 themes, 6 diagram types, batch CLI, and seamless integration with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.

items.z: 基于 Cloudflare Pages 和 Next.js 的 Serverless 图床服务。利用 Cloudflare 免费额度实现无限存储且零成本运营，无需自备服务器和域名。集成内容审核 API 自动屏蔽不良图片，提供完整的后台管理系统，支持访问统计、黑白名单管控，并可配置 Telegram 机器人实时通知。
items.e: A Serverless image hosting service built on Cloudflare Pages and Next.js. Offers unlimited storage at zero cost within Cloudflare's free tier, eliminating the need for self-hosted servers and domains. Features automated content moderation API for inappropriate images, a full-featured admin panel with access analytics, IP/referer whitelisting/blacklisting, and configurable Telegram bot notifications.

items.d: Portable AI code quality reviews for Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents: six Agent Skills for architecture, technical debt, tests and remediation.
items.z: brooks-lint是一款基于《人月神话》等12本经典工程书籍的AI代码审查工具。它诊断代码中的6种衰退风险，输出带书籍引用、严重性标签和修复建议的结构化发现。支持PR审查、架构审计、技术债务评估、测试套件审查及全扫自动修复等6种模式。作为Claude Code插件和Codex CLI技能集成，提供一致、可追溯的代码质量评估。适用于软件开发团队提升可维护性、降低技术债务，超越传统linter和纯AI审查。
items.e: brooks-lint is an AI-powered code review tool grounded in twelve classic engineering books including The Mythical Man-Month and Refactoring. It diagnoses code across six decay risks such as Cognitive Overload and Change Propagation, producing structured findings with book citations, severity labels, and actionable remedies. Featuring six analysis modes including PR reviews, architecture audits, tech debt assessments, test suite reviews, and full-sweep auto-fix, it integrates as a Claude Code plugin and Codex CLI skill. This delivers consistent, traceable code quality insights superior to plain LLMs or traditional linters, ideal for software teams improving maintainability and reducing technical debt.

items.d: Launch JIT enabled iOS app with a second iOS device
items.z: Jitterbug 是一款创新工具，通过两台 iOS 设备间 WiFi 配对，利用 libimobiledevice 实现跨设备调试，从而在非越狱设备上启用 JIT 编译。它支持创建 VPN 隧道实现设备自调试，需配合开发者镜像使用。主要应用于 iOS 性能优化、模拟器开发及逆向工程，为开发者提供绕过系统限制的灵活调试方案。
items.e: Jitterbug is an innovative debugging tool that enables JIT compilation on non-jailbroken iOS devices by leveraging WiFi pairing between two iOS devices through libimobiledevice. It facilitates tethered app launches with debugger attachment and creates VPN tunnels for self-debugging scenarios. The solution requires Developer Disk Images and supports installation via AltStore or sideloading. Primary use cases include iOS performance optimization, simulator development, and security research, offering developers a flexible approach to bypass Apple's JIT restrictions while maintaining device security integrity.

items.d: A lightweight knowledge base for people and agents, with ultra fast indexing and most precise retrieval.
items.z: SAG-Wiki 是一款轻量级本地知识库，为个人与 AI 智能体提供超快索引和精确检索。基于 Rust/Tauri 构建，无需 LLM 调用即可索引百万字符约 200ms，采用自研 SAG2 证据检索技术，支持跨语言问答、全局快捷键快速搜索及多种文档格式，答案可溯源至原文。
items.e: SAG-Wiki is a lightweight local knowledge base for humans and AI agents, offering ultra-fast indexing and precise retrieval. Built with Rust/Tauri, it indexes a million characters in ~200ms without LLM calls. Its original SAG2 evidence retrieval outperforms RAG/GraphRAG, supports cross-language Q&A, global quick search, and multiple document formats with traceable answers.

items.d: LuaN1aoAgent is a fully autonomous AI-driven penetration testing agent powered by graph-based cognitive reasoning.
items.z: LuaN1aoAgent是基于DeepSeek V3.2的AI渗透测试智能体，采用P-E-R（规划-执行-反思）协作框架与因果图推理技术，模拟人类专家思维实现全自动漏洞挖掘。在XBOW基准测试中达到90.4%成功率，单次漏洞利用成本仅0.09美元，支持动态路径规划与持续学习进化，重塑自动化安全测试范式。
items.e: LuaN1aoAgent is an AI penetration testing agent powered by DeepSeek V3.2, featuring the P-E-R (Planner-Executor-Reflector) framework and causal graph reasoning. It simulates human expert cognition for fully autonomous vulnerability discovery, achieving 90.4% success rate on XBOW benchmark at a median cost of $0.09 per exploit. Its dynamic planning and continuous learning capabilities redefine automated security testing.

items.d: Skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving icons
items.z: Better Icons 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的 MCP 服务器和 CLI 工具，支持从 150 多个图标集合中搜索检索 20 万以上图标。它帮助 Cursor、Claude 等 AI 编码代理准确获取图标 SVG，避免 token 浪费和样式不一致，支持多框架导出、项目文件同步、自动学习用户偏好及批量/相似图标检索，有效提升 AI 辅助开发效率。
items.e: Better Icons is a specialized MCP server and CLI tool for AI agents, enabling search and retrieval of over 200,000 icons from 150+ collections. It assists coding assistants like Cursor and Claude in accurately fetching icons and SVGs, avoiding token waste on inline code. Key capabilities include auto-learning preferences, direct project file syncing, batch retrieval, cross-collection similar icons, and exports for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid plus raw SVG.

items.d: A golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized by a Grafana dashboard.
items.z: 基于Go实现的SSH tarpit（endlessh），通过故意延迟响应浪费暴力破解攻击者时间，并导出Prometheus指标，配合Grafana仪表板可视化攻击源地理位置与统计数据。适用于SSH安全防护与威胁情报场景，支持Docker部署、GeoIP查询、健康检查，轻量高效且可观测性强。
items.e: A Golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) that delays responses to waste brute-force attackers' time while exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized via a Grafana dashboard showing geolocations and attack statistics. Ideal for SSH defense and threat intelligence, with Docker support, GeoIP lookup, and health checks.

items.d: 👏极客时间 pdf & markdown 文档
items.z: 该项目聚合极客时间优质课程文档，提供 Markdown 与 PDF 双格式离线资源。核心价值在于构建可全文检索的技术知识库，支持 Docker 一键部署解决图片加载问题，并适配 PC 与移动端浏览器。基于 MkDocs-Material 主题实现优雅阅读体验，是技术人离线学习与知识管理的实用方案。
items.e: This project aggregates GeekTime's premium course documentation, offering offline Markdown and PDF resources. Its core value lies in building a full-text searchable technical knowledge base, featuring Docker deployment for image loading fixes, and responsive design for PC/mobile browsers. Powered by MkDocs-Material, it provides an elegant reading experience for developers' offline learning and knowledge management.

items.d: WebAI2API: 基于 Camoufox 的网页 AI 转 API 工具，支持 LMArena/Gemini等，多窗口并发与账号隔离。 | Web AI to OpenAI API via Camoufox. Supports LMArena/Gemini and more, multi-window concurrency & account isolation.
items.z: WebAI2API是基于Camoufox的网页AI服务转API工具，支持LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT等20+平台。通过拟人化操作模拟规避检测，提供OpenAI格式接口，支持多窗口并发与账号级浏览器隔离，内置任务队列和故障转移机制，配备可视化管理界面，实现高效稳定的AI服务调用。
items.e: WebAI2API converts web-based AI services (LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT etc.) into OpenAI-compatible APIs using Camoufox. It simulates human-like interactions to bypass detection, supports multi-window concurrency with account isolation, and includes task queuing, failover mechanisms, plus a web management interface for stable AI service integration.

items.d: 🚀 Full-stack Next.js 15 + Cloudflare Workers template with D1 database, R2 storage, Better Auth, and Server Actions. Production-ready with automated CI/CD and generous free tiers.
items.z: 该模板深度融合 Next.js 15 与 Cloudflare Workers 边缘计算平台，提供生产级全栈解决方案。核心亮点包括 D1 分布式 SQLite 数据库、R2 对象存储、Better Auth 认证体系及 Server Actions 数据交互，通过 Drizzle ORM 实现端到端类型安全。内置 GitHub Actions 自动化流水线与预览部署，充分利用 Cloudflare 免费层实现低成本启动，支持从 MVP 到企业级应用的无缝扩展。
items.e: This production-ready template integrates Next.js 15 with Cloudflare Workers edge computing, delivering a full-stack solution featuring D1 distributed SQLite database, R2 object storage, Better Auth authentication, and Server Actions. With end-to-end TypeScript via Drizzle ORM, automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions, and preview deployments, it leverages Cloudflare's generous free tier for cost-effective MVP development while scaling seamlessly to enterprise applications.

items.d: A new open-source format for interactive video on the web, with a built-in state machine, frame-accurate transitions, and packed-alpha transparency.
items.z: AVAL 是一种开源网页交互式动画格式与运行时，支持内置确定性状态机、帧精确过渡、打包 alpha 透明度及连续部分循环。它将独立解码的运动单元和小型状态图编码在单个 .avl 资产中，浏览器维持解码时间线连续推进，无需视频 seek，实现 hover、focus 等状态驱动交互。提供编译器（FFmpeg）、Web 播放器元素及 graph/format/player 等包，支持 fallback 标记和 SSR。当前为技术预览，适用于短时预渲染动画的复杂状态管理与高效渲染。
items.e: AVAL is an open-source web format and runtime for short prerendered interactive animations. It features a built-in deterministic state machine, frame-accurate transitions, packed-alpha transparency, and continuous partial loops. The .avl asset encodes independently decodable motion units and a state graph, enabling the browser to maintain a continuous decoder timeline without seeking. Includes compiler using FFmpeg, web player element with fallback support, and packages for graph, format, and rendering. Ideal for state-driven web UIs with hover/focus interactions. Currently a technical preview leveraging WebCodecs.

items.d: Outlook 注册机
items.z: OutlookRegister 是一款自动化 Outlook/Hotmail 账号注册工具，基于 Patchright/Playwright 模拟人类填表行为，支持自动过验证码、代理池与并发，集成 moemail 临时邮箱或 Outlook Graph API 辅助验证，可将成功账号存储至 Results 目录，适用于批量账号获取场景。
items.e: OutlookRegister is an automated Outlook/Hotmail account registration tool using Patchright/Playwright to simulate human form-filling, with auto captcha solving, proxy pools, concurrency, and support for moemail temp emails or Outlook Graph API verification. Successful accounts are saved to Results, ideal for bulk account generation.

items.d: 把英文论文读成舒服的中文：本地 PDF 论文翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI、文献管理。Read English papers in comfortable Chinese.
items.z: EasyRead 是一款本地论文阅读工具，支持 PDF 翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI 和文献管理。通过多模型 API 实现舒适的中文阅读，帮助科研人员高效理解英文论文。
items.e: EasyRead is a local paper reading tool that supports PDF translation, side-by-side comparison, AI Q&A, and reference management. It leverages multiple model APIs to provide comfortable Chinese reading, helping researchers efficiently understand English papers.

items.d: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
items.z: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 与 Cloudflare 全栈构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等十余种渠道。项目采用边缘计算架构，通过 Cloudflare Pages 与 D1 数据库实现零成本部署，提供接口组批量推送能力。UI 基于 shadcn/ui 打造，兼具美观与易用性，适用于监控告警、自动化通知等场景。
items.e: MoePush is an open-source, adorable message push service built on Next.js and Cloudflare stack, supporting over 10 channels including DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, and more. Leveraging edge computing architecture with Cloudflare Pages and D1 database, it enables zero-cost deployment and batch push via group interfaces. The UI, crafted with shadcn/ui, combines aesthetics with usability. Ideal for monitoring alerts and automated notifications, it offers a developer-friendly solution with GitHub OAuth integration and seamless deployment.

items.d: Vocat is an open-source web control panel and engineering toolkit for Quectel EC20/EC25-class cellular modems. It combines modem discovery, live radio status, AT and USSD terminals, SMS, WiFi Calling, eSIM management, network selection, proxy routing, notifications, audit logs, and release automation in one self-contained service.
items.z: Vocat 是开源的移远 EC20/EC25 蜂窝模组 Web 管理面板，集成模组发现、射频监控、AT/USSD 终端、短信、WiFi Calling、eSIM 管理、网络选择与代理路由，Go+React 单二进制部署，支持多架构 Docker。
items.e: Vocat is an open-source web control panel for Quectel EC20/EC25 cellular modems, integrating modem discovery, radio monitoring, AT/USSD terminals, SMS, WiFi Calling, eSIM management, network selection, and proxy routing. Built with Go and React, it deploys as a single binary with multi-arch Docker support.

items.d: Realm 全功能一键中转脚本，终端可视化界面构建网络转发服务.Realm: Full-featured one-click network relay — configure and manage forwarding rules from an interactive TUI.
items.z: 纯Shell脚本实现的Realm全功能网络中转管理工具，提供交互式TUI界面一键配置转发规则。同步官方最新特性（TCP/UDP、WS/WSS/TLS隧道、MPTCP、多入口多出口、Proxy Protocol），并扩展负载均衡、故障转移、端口流量监控限速与网络链路测试，支持多发行版与离线安装，极简高效搭建中转服务器。
items.e: A pure Shell-script tool for full-featured Realm network relay management with an interactive TUI. Syncs all official Realm capabilities (TCP/UDP, WS/WSS/TLS tunnels, MPTCP, multi-entry/exit, Proxy Protocol) and adds load balancing, failover, port traffic monitoring/limiting, and link testing. Supports multiple distros and offline install for lightweight relay server setup.

items.d: 600 行 TypeScript 写成的超级迷你版 pi，让你轻松从 0 写出属于你的 pi-agent
items.z: 本项目用约600行TypeScript从零实现迷你版pi编码Agent（nano-pi），支持读文件、改代码、执行命令。配套交互网站，阅读时右侧同步补全源码，并提供Trace断点调试，直观展示Agent数据流与核心循环。剥离工程细节，聚焦直觉化组件设计，适合快速掌握AI智能体原理与实现。
items.e: A 600-line TypeScript mini coding agent (nano-pi) built from scratch, inspired by pi. Supports file reading, code editing and command execution via OpenAI-compatible APIs. Interactive site progressively reveals source code while reading, with Trace debugging for execution flow. Strips engineering complexity to focus on core agent ideas, ideal for learning AI agent architecture.

items.d: Secure MCP runtime for AI agents to operate local machines, servers, and containers with multi-device orchestration.
items.z: AgentDock 为 AI 智能体提供安全 MCP 运行时，支持多设备编排与跨平台控制。通过统一 MCP 接口实现文件、命令、Git、浏览器自动化等操作，兼容 ChatGPT、Claude 等客户端。支持多实例连接同一对话协调跨设备工作，具备明确权限边界、任务可恢复性和技能扩展能力，适用于开发部署、运维管理和真实环境自动化场景。
items.e: AgentDock is a secure MCP runtime empowering AI agents with controlled access to local machines, servers, and containers via multi-device orchestration. It unifies file operations, command execution, Git, browser automation, and extensible Skills into an MCP interface compatible with clients like ChatGPT and Claude. Multiple instances connect to one conversation for cross-device coordination, featuring explicit permissions, recoverable tasks, and structured results. Ideal for development, deployment, and operations beyond coding quotas across platforms.

items.d: This is a project that unifies the management of LLM APIs. It can call multiple backend services through a unified API interface, convert them to the OpenAI format uniformly, and support load balancing. Currently supported backend services include: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepBricks, OpenRouter, Gemini, Vertex, etc.
items.z: uni-api 统一管理 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等主流 LLM API，转换为标准 OpenAI 格式。支持权重/地域/轮询四种负载均衡、自动重试与渠道冷却机制，纯配置文件管理，无前端依赖，适合个人部署。
items.e: uni-api unifies LLM APIs into OpenAI format. Supports 4 load balancing types, auto-retry, channel cooling, pure config management, no frontend, ideal for personal deployment.

items.d: 划时代的字体切割工具，CJK与任何字符！支持 otf、ttf、woff2 字体多线程切割，完美地细颗粒度地进行包大小控制。A revolutionary font subetter that supports CJK and any characters! It enables multi-threaded subset of otf, ttf, and woff2 fonts, allowing for precise control over package size.
items.z: cn-font-split 是专为Web场景打造的字体子集化工具，通过Rust核心与WebAssembly技术实现秒级切割。针对中文等CJK字符集大包体积痛点，提供细粒度字符拆分与多线程处理，支持OTF/TTF/WOFF2格式及可变字体。跨平台一致性输出，集成Vite等前端工具链，显著优化网页字体加载性能。
items.e: cn-font-split is a revolutionary font subsetting engine designed for web font optimization, particularly for massive CJK character sets. Built with Rust and WebAssembly, it enables fine-grained character-level splitting with multi-threaded processing, achieving 50ms latency for 2MB fonts. Supporting OTF/TTF/WOFF2 formats, variable fonts, and complex glyph rendering via Harfbuzz integration, it delivers consistent outputs across browsers, Node.js, Deno, Bun, and native platforms. The tool integrates seamlessly with Vite, Webpack, and other frontend toolchains, eliminating render-blocking font loading while reducing bundle sizes by up to 90% and supporting 95+ OpenType features.

items.d: Open-source AI companions, desktop pets, long-term memory & proactive chat. 人机恋开源项目大全。让你的家机能够脱离官端自主存在，拥有记忆和主动性。
items.z: 精选面向长期AI伴侣关系的开源软件、基础设施与社区，覆盖客户端、桌宠、主动心跳、长期记忆、情感状态、语音视觉具身与数据主权等模块，强调脱离官端自主运行，助力构建有记忆、主动性与持续性的人机恋体验。
items.e: Curated open-source list of software, infrastructure and communities for long-term AI companion relationships. Covers clients, desktop pets, proactive messaging, memory systems, emotion state, voice/visual embodiment and data ownership, enabling independent, memory-rich and proactive companions beyond official platforms.

items.d: PwnPad is an affordable, hands-on hardware hacking platform built for practical learning. It features a range of challenges that walk users through key hardware security concepts, from PCB design to side-channel attacks.
items.z: PwnPad是一个低成本硬件黑客学习平台，专为实践教学设计。用户可搭建不到20美元的设备，通过12个挑战掌握PCB设计、焊接、UART/SPI/I2C通信、ISP固件提取、电压故障注入和时序侧信道攻击等核心技能。平台采用跳线引脚切换挑战，无需重刷固件，所有flag通过串口获取。项目提供固件、硬件原理图、挑战文档和工具脚本，适合初学者从理论到实战入门嵌入式系统安全。
items.e: PwnPad is an affordable hardware hacking learning platform for hands-on education. Users build the setup for under $20 and tackle 12 challenges covering PCB design, soldering, UART/SPI/I2C protocols, ISP/EEPROM firmware extraction, voltage fault injection, and timing side-channel attacks using basic $50 tools. A jumper pin selector switches challenges without reflashing, with flags retrieved via serial interfaces. The project includes firmware, schematics, challenge guides, and tools to bridge theory and practice in embedded systems security.

items.d: CSAPP 中文文档与学习资料：《深入理解计算机系统》第三版全章节 Markdown，含练习题答案、八大实验中文翻译及官方自学实验包，方便在线阅读与离线学习。
items.z: 本仓库提供《深入理解计算机系统》（CSAPP第三版）完整中文Markdown资料，涵盖全部12章正文、练习题与原书答案、附录及八大实验的中文说明与官方自学包。支持在线阅读网站（章节导航、全文搜索、深色模式）与本地离线使用，方便系统学习计算机底层原理、做题与实验实践。
items.e: Complete Chinese Markdown resources for CSAPP 3rd Edition, including all 12 chapters, practice problem answers, appendices, and Chinese translations of the eight official labs with self-study packages. Features an online reading site with navigation, full-text search and dark mode, plus offline Markdown for systematic study of computer systems, problem-solving and hands-on labs.

items.d: Visibility into AI agent activity on endpoints, with on-device detection, optional pre-action blocking, and forensic reconstruction.
items.z: numbat 是 PerplexityAI 开发的端点可见性工具，专注于 AI 智能体在桌面、CLI、IDE 和网关上的活动监控。通过本地钩子、插件、OTLP/HTTP 日志和磁盘会话 artifact 观察，将数据归一化为统一事件模型，由本地 CEL 规则引擎进行检测。支持实时监控、多步序列规则、可选预行动阻断、取证重建、机密红化 NDJSON 记录，以及库存、时间线和案例打包工具。以单静态二进制分发至 macOS、Linux、Windows，强调本地处理与隐私保护，适用于 AI 智能体部署的安全监控、合规与取证场景。
items.e: Numbat is a PerplexityAI endpoint visibility tool focused on monitoring AI agent activity across desktop, CLI, IDE, and gateway platforms. It observes agents via local hooks, plugins, OTLP/HTTP logs, and on-disk session artifacts, normalizing events into a unified model evaluated by a local CEL rule engine. Features include live monitoring, multi-step sequence rules, opt-in pre-action blocking, forensic reconstruction from artifacts, secret-redacted NDJSON records, and tools for inventory, timelines, and portable case bundles. Distributed as a single static binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows, it emphasizes local processing and privacy for security monitoring, compliance, and forensics in AI agent deployments.

items.d: AppStore++ tweak for TrollStore
items.z: AppStore++ 是一款基于 TrollStore 的 iOS 越狱插件，允许用户直接降级已安装的 App 至任意历史版本。它集成 AppStore 搜索、版本兼容性检测、IPA 库管理及应用数据备份，支持 iPad 分屏界面，为越狱用户提供便捷的应用版本管理方案。
items.e: AppStore++ is a TrollStore-based iOS jailbreak tweak that lets users downgrade installed apps to any historical version. It integrates App Store search, version compatibility detection, IPA library management, and app-data backups, with iPad split-view support, offering a convenient app version management solution for jailbroken devices.

items.d: Free skills from the Hyperagent team
items.z: Hyperagent团队开源的免费AI智能体技能库，以独立JSON文件封装可复用工作流与方法论。覆盖品牌书生成、黏土动画视频、设计系统、业务模拟运营、数据可视化等专业场景，让Agent一次加载即可执行复杂端到端任务，无需重复提示。
items.e: Open-source free skills library from the Hyperagent team: reusable JSON workflows for AI agents. Covers brand book generation, claymation video production, design systems, business simulation operations, data visualization and more, enabling agents to execute complex end-to-end tasks without repeated prompting.

items.d: CodeStable 是一套面向严肃软件工程、坚持人在环的 AI 编码工作流。它不以编排 Agent 为中心，而是组织需求、架构、特性、问题与历史决策，让 Codex 和 Claude 驱动的开发过程可控、可追溯、可持续演进。
items.z: CodeStable 是一套坚持人在环的 AI 编码工作流，专为严肃软件工程设计。它不以 Agent 编排为中心，而是通过 .codestable/ 文件树组织需求、架构、特性、问题与历史决策，使 Codex 和 Claude 驱动的开发过程可控、可追溯、可持续。集成 cs-onboard、cs-feat 等 skills，支持风险分级流程、显式审查门禁及工程化 build-evaluate 闭环迭代 skills。适用于长期迭代的复杂项目，解决上下文溢出与知识丢失。
items.e: CodeStable is a human-in-the-loop AI coding workflow tailored for serious software engineering. Instead of orchestrating agents, it structures software elements—requirements, architecture, features, issues, and decisions—into a human- and AI-readable .codestable/ file tree for controllable, traceable, and sustainable development with Codex and Claude. It provides skills like cs-onboard and cs-feat with risk-based flows, explicit review gates, and an engineering build-evaluate loop for skill iteration. Ideal for long-term, complex projects to prevent context overflow and knowledge loss.

items.d: 微信读书 koreader 插件，在 koreader 里阅读微信读书里的书籍、公众号文章，支持阅读进度同步，阅读时长上报和统计，本地书籍支持获取微信读书划线和想法内容，支持Kindle、Kobo等所有能安装 koreader 的设备。
items.z: 微信读书 KOReader 插件，可在 Kindle、Kobo 等设备上阅读微信读书书籍与公众号文章，支持进度同步、时长统计、划线想法获取及章节预下载，打通封闭系统与微信读书生态。
items.e: KOReader plugin for WeRead on Kindle/Kobo: progress sync, reading stats, highlights, pre-download.

items.d: Premium hand-drawn animated architecture diagram Codex skill
items.z: 该Codex技能通过JSON规范生成高端手绘动态架构图，支持输出可编辑Excalidraw文件、PNG静态预览及真实动画GIF，包含流动高光、模块脉冲等效果。采用Python Pillow本地渲染，无需浏览器或外部API，专为技术文章、系统架构和流程图设计，提供专业黑背景可视化方案，内置帧差验证确保动画质量。
items.e: This Codex skill generates premium hand-drawn animated architecture diagrams from JSON specs, producing editable Excalidraw files, PNG previews, and genuinely animated GIFs with moving glow points and pulsing modules on a dark canvas. It uses local Python Pillow rendering with no external dependencies, ideal for technical articles, system architectures, and workflows, including built-in frame-diff verification for motion.

items.d: 使用Telegram作为存储的文件外链系统，不限制文件大小和格式。
items.z: tgState 是一款创新的文件外链系统，深度利用 Telegram 的 Bot API 和 FileID 机制，将 Telegram 频道/群组作为无限容量存储后端。系统支持任意大小格式的文件存储分发，提供 Web 界面和 API 上传接口，可作为图床或私有网盘使用。支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，配合 CloudFlare 可实现高效 CDN 加速。
items.e: tgState is an innovative file hosting system that leverages Telegram's Bot API and FileID mechanism to utilize Telegram channels/groups as unlimited-capacity storage backend. Supporting files of any size and format, it provides both web interface and API for uploads, functioning as image hosting or private cloud storage. Features flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or binary, with CloudFlare CDN integration for optimized content delivery.

items.d: Python library for Agentic Document Extraction (ADE).
items.z: LandingAI ADE Python库提供智能文档提取能力，支持同步/异步调用与大规模文档处理。基于Pydantic构建全类型SDK，内置指数退避重试机制，可插拔HTTP后端。通过MCP服务器无缝集成AI助手，实现文档结构化数据提取自动化。适用于金融、法律、医疗等领域的非结构化文档转结构化数据场景，提升数据处理效率。
items.e: LandingAI ADE Python library enables intelligent document extraction via agentic AI. Features fully-typed SDK with Pydantic models, sync/async clients, and built-in exponential backoff retries. Supports large document processing through async jobs and pluggable HTTP backends (httpx/aiohttp). MCP server integration allows AI assistants to interact with the API seamlessly. Ideal for automating structured data extraction from unstructured documents in finance, legal, healthcare and other domains, transforming PDFs and images into machine-readable JSON with schema-based precision, high reliability and production-ready performance.

items.d: 【零费用】一个让人呼吸顺畅的 Telegram 双向私聊机器人 🤖 / [Zero Cost] A Smooth-Operating Two-Way Private Messaging Telegram Bot 🤖
items.z: Open Wegram Bot 是基于 Cloudflare Worker/Vercel 的 Telegram 双向私聊机器人，实现零成本、无服务器、无数据库的消息中转。采用无状态架构，支持 GitHub/Vercel 等多平台一键部署，无需绑定域名即可运行。适用于个人消息代理、轻量级客服等场景，提供稳定可靠的双向通信能力，是 LivegramBot 的免费替代方案。
items.e: Open Wegram Bot is a Telegram two-way private messaging bot built on Cloudflare Worker/Vercel, enabling zero-cost, serverless, database-free message forwarding. Featuring stateless architecture, it supports one-click deployment via GitHub/Vercel/Deno/Netlify without custom domain binding. Designed for personal message proxy and lightweight customer service, it provides stable bidirectional communication as a free alternative to LivegramBot with multi-bot support and encrypted security tokens for reliable operation.

items.d: 🦊 内置 AI 逆向 Agent 的 Firefox — 通用 JS/JSVMP/WASM/签名逆向工作站，SpiderMonkey 引擎层非侵入 trace，把加密参数从黑盒还原成不依赖浏览器的纯算法
items.z: Firefox-Reverse是一款内置AI逆向Agent的定制Firefox浏览器。通过SpiderMonkey引擎层非侵入trace，将网页JS/JSVMP/WASM/签名等加密参数从黑盒还原为独立Node.js/Python算法。同时支持独立profile和进程的指纹环境隔离管理。兼容DeepSeek等多家大模型，内置64个工具，实现自动化抓包、trace与验证。适用于API逆向、网页爬虫开发及安全研究场景。
items.e: Firefox-Reverse is a customized Firefox browser with a built-in AI reverse engineering Agent. It employs non-intrusive tracing at the SpiderMonkey engine layer to convert black-box JS, JSVMP, WASM, and signature parameters from web pages into standalone Node.js or Python algorithms. It also provides fingerprint environment management via isolated profiles and processes. Compatible with multiple LLMs and featuring 64 tools, it enables automated tracing, verification, and environment handling for API reverse engineering, web scraping, and security research.

items.d: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs
items.z: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图艺术生成工具，无需安装即可将全球城市地图转化为精美海报。采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端界面，Rust WASM 处理地图渲染，Bun 作为高性能运行时。支持亚洲、欧洲、美洲等数十个热门城市，提供即时预览与高清导出，是旅行纪念与城市美学创作的理想选择。
items.e: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map art generator that transforms city maps into stunning posters without installation. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust WASM for map rendering and Bun as the high-performance runtime. Supporting dozens of cities across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, it offers instant preview and HD export, ideal for travel memorabilia and urban aesthetic creation.

items.d: Selfhost web archiving and sharing service.
items.z: 基于 Cloudflare 的免费网页归档服务，通过浏览器插件将页面保存为单文件 HTML，利用 Worker+D1+R2 全栈方案实现低成本存储与检索。集成 AI 自动标签分类、文件夹管理与阅读模式，支持移动端适配，提供完整的归档、搜索与分享功能，适合个人知识沉淀。
items.e: Web Archive is a free, serverless web archiving and sharing service built entirely on Cloudflare's platform. It captures webpages as single-file HTML through a browser extension and stores them using Cloudflare D1 database and R2 storage via Workers. The platform features AI-powered automatic tag classification, folder organization, reading mode, mobile responsiveness, and searchable archives. Leveraging Cloudflare's generous free tier, it provides a cost-effective, scalable solution for personal knowledge management and digital content preservation.

items.d: 🤖 The largest directory for AI-ready documentation and tools implementing the proposed llms.txt standard
items.z: 这是一个 llms.txt 标准的中央资源库，聚合了多种开发者工具与实现方案。通过标准化文档访问协议，指导 AI 模型精准理解项目文档，提升 AI 编程助手准确性与开发者体验。提供 Chrome 插件、VS Code 扩展、MCP 协议支持及 CLI 工具，覆盖主流开发环境，推动 LLM 与文档生态的互操作性。
items.e: The largest directory for the emerging llms.txt standard, curating production-ready implementations and developer tools across the ecosystem. It establishes a standardized protocol for how LLMs should access and interpret project documentation, significantly improving AI coding assistant accuracy and developer productivity. The hub provides Chrome extensions, VS Code plugins, Model Context Protocol integration, Raycast extensions, and CLI tools covering major development environments, fostering seamless interoperability between AI models and documentation ecosystems while setting clear boundaries for AI-content interaction.

items.d: A comprehensive book on neural networks and large language models in NLP
items.z: NiuTrans/NLPBook仓库发布《Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models》一书，由童晓、朱靖波撰写。系统覆盖机器学习与神经网络基础、词向量、RNN/CNN、Seq2Seq、Transformer，以及大模型的预训练、生成、提示工程、对齐与推理等前沿内容。提供各章节及完整免费PDF下载，基于arXiv论文扩展，适合NLP研究者、学生和开发者学习使用，并有中、日、法等多语言翻译版本。
items.e: The NiuTrans/NLPBook repository presents the book 'Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models' by Tong Xiao and Jingbo Zhu. It comprehensively covers ML and neural network foundations, word vectors, RNN/CNN, Seq2Seq, Transformers, plus LLM topics including pre-training, generative models, prompting, alignment, and inference. Free PDF chapters and full book are available, expanded from arXiv papers. Ideal educational resource for NLP researchers, students, and practitioners, with translations into multiple languages.

items.d: Open-source High-Level System Design, DSA, and AI Engineering handbooks. CC BY-SA 4.0, Free Forever.
items.z: handbook-academy/engineering-handbook 是开源工程手册仓库，包含两本CC BY-SA 4.0免费手册。HLD手册159章、719 Mermaid图、3100+引用，系统覆盖高阶系统设计、分布式系统与基础设施（从TCP/IP到LLM服务）；DSA手册120章、226图、多语言LeetCode解法，专注数据结构算法与面试实践。内容规模相当于数千页教科书，提供系统化深度学习与职业准备资源。
items.e: The handbook-academy/engineering-handbook repository hosts two sibling open-source engineering handbooks under CC BY-SA 4.0. The HLD Handbook delivers 159 chapters on high-level system design, distributed systems, and modern infrastructure with 719 Mermaid diagrams and 3,100+ citations. The DSA Handbook covers 120 chapters of data structures and algorithms, including multi-language LeetCode solutions and interactive widgets. Together they provide massive, free curricula equivalent to thousands of pages for deep engineering learning and interview preparation.

items.d: A Cursor skill that gives AI agents real UI component knowledge — best practices, layout patterns, and design-system conventions for 60+ interface components — so it generates production-grade UI instead of generic output.
items.z: 这是一个 Cursor AI 技能，为 AI 编程注入 60+ UI 组件的专业设计知识，包括最佳实践、布局模式和设计系统规范。通过消除 AI 的随意猜测，它能自动生成符合现代 SaaS、企业级或创意风格的生产级前端代码，显著提升 UI 开发质量与效率。
items.e: This Cursor AI skill provides AI agents with deep expertise on 60+ UI components, covering accessibility standards, responsive layout patterns, and design system conventions meticulously curated from component.gallery. It eliminates generic output by delivering specific best practices, common layouts, and anti-patterns for each component, automatically generating production-grade interfaces in five style presets: Modern SaaS, Apple-level Minimal, Enterprise/Corporate, Creative/Portfolio, and Data Dashboard. The result is senior-designer-quality UI code that follows proven patterns without manual template assembly, significantly accelerating frontend development workflows.

items.d: 🔒True end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) chat system in web. 🔒真正的网页端到端加密聊天系统
items.z: NodeCrypt 是一个基于 Web 的真正端到端加密聊天系统，采用零知识架构确保服务器无法获取明文消息。系统使用三层安全体系：RSA-2048 身份验证、ECDH-P384 密钥协商和混合对称加密（AES-256 + ChaCha20）。基于 Cloudflare Workers 部署，无需数据库，支持匿名聊天和前向安全性，所有加密在客户端完成。
items.e: NodeCrypt is a true end-to-end encrypted web chat system implementing zero-knowledge architecture where servers cannot access plaintext messages. It employs a three-layer security model: RSA-2048 for server authentication, ECDH-P384 for key negotiation, and hybrid symmetric encryption (AES-256-CBC for control messages, ChaCha20 for chat content). Built on Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects and WebSocket, the system requires no database storage, supports anonymous communication, and provides forward secrecy. All encryption occurs client-side using Web Cryptography API, with room passwords as key derivation factors. The open-source implementation is verifiable through browser developer tools and network traffic analysis.

items.d: Official repository of my book "A Hands-On Guide to Fine-Tuning LLMs with PyTorch and Hugging Face"
items.z: 这是一本使用PyTorch和Hugging Face微调大语言模型的实战指南。系统讲解量化、LoRA低秩适配、数据集格式化等稳定核心技术，涵盖模型加载、SFTTrainer微调到本地部署全流程。提供可直接运行的Google Colab notebooks，适合具备Transformer基础的中级开发者深入理解配置原理与底层实现。
items.e: A hands-on guide repository for fine-tuning Large Language Models with PyTorch and Hugging Face. Covers quantization, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and dataset formatting templates through practical Colab notebooks. Includes complete workflow from loading quantized models to supervised fine-tuning with SFTTrainer and local deployment. Targets intermediate practitioners, explaining configuration principles and stable concepts essential for adapting to evolving LLM technologies.

items.d: Free open-source Multilogin/Incogniton/Kameleo alternative for fingerprint spoofing (Canvas/WebGL/User-Agent). Perfect for Selenium/Playwright/Puppeteer automation, web scraping, social media bots, ads verification, and multi-accounting based on chromium. Avoid bans, bypass anti-bot systems, and prevent tracking with customizable stealth browsing
items.z: Undetectable Fingerprint Browser 是一款基于 Chromium 的开源反检测浏览器，提供全面的指纹欺骗能力，覆盖 Canvas、WebGL、字体等关键维度。其独家一致性分析引擎确保所有欺骗字段逻辑自洽，有效绕过反机器人系统。内置自动化模块完美兼容 Playwright/Puppeteer，适用于网络爬虫、社交媒体多账号运营及广告验证等场景，是 Multilogin 等商业方案的开源替代。
items.e: Undetectable Fingerprint Browser is an open-source anti-detection browser built on Chromium that delivers comprehensive fingerprint spoofing for Canvas, WebGL, fonts, and more. Its exclusive consistency analysis engine ensures logical alignment across all spoofed fields to effectively bypass anti-bot systems. With built-in automation modules fully compatible with Playwright/Puppeteer, it's ideal for web scraping, social media multi-account management, and ad verification, offering a powerful free alternative to commercial solutions like Multilogin.

items.d: Plug-and-play JSON style prompts for Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image & Midjourney. Copy one style.json, get a consistent look. New styles every week.
items.z: 该仓库精选68个可复用的JSON提示模板库，专为AI图像生成提供结构化视觉风格参考。每个style.json封装提示模板、变量、风格锚点与示例，支持ChatGPT、Claude等LLM即插即用，实现一致、可迭代的图像输出。涵盖涂鸦、海报、拼贴、编辑等类别，解决一次性文本提示难以复用的问题。每日更新，附预览与目录，适合设计师与内容创作者构建专业视觉工作流。
items.e: This repo curates 68 reusable JSON prompt templates for consistent AI image generation. Each style.json packages visual design references into structured prompts with variables, fidelity anchors, and examples for plug-and-play use in LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude. It solves inconsistent one-off prompts by enabling repeatable styles across doodle, poster, collage, editorial, and travel themes. Updated daily with previews and catalog; ideal for designers seeking reliable, high-quality visual outputs in multimodal workflows.

items.d: High-performance native SSH client in Rust, GPU-rendered with GPUI: host manager, terminal, WinSCP-style SFTP and port forwarding. Rust 编写、GPU 渲染的原生 SSH 客户端。
items.z: ShellRS 是一款 Rust 编写的高性能跨平台原生 SSH 客户端，基于 GPUI 实现 GPU 渲染界面。集成 Xshell 风格主机管理、WinSCP 风格 SFTP 文件传输及端口转发，支持多级跳板与代理连接，无 Electron 依赖，并提供 CLI 供 AI 智能体调用。
items.e: ShellRS is a high-performance, cross-platform native SSH client written in Rust, featuring GPU-accelerated rendering powered by the GPUI framework from the Zed editor. It unifies Xshell-style host management, tabbed terminals, WinSCP-style dual-pane SFTP file transfer, and SSH port forwarding into a single integrated window. The client supports multi-level jump hosts, HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy connections, and stores credentials securely in the system keychain. With no Electron or JVM dependencies, it delivers native performance. A built-in CLI tool also enables AI agents like Claude Code to execute commands and transfer files on saved hosts.

items.d: 基于 11 个内容洞见维度的自媒体创作 Skill，适用于各种智能体  给它一个主题，它给你一篇完整的文章、5 个备选标题、以及每张配图的生成 prompt。
items.z: 这个仓库提供了一个基于11个内容洞见维度的AI智能体写作技能，能够根据主题自动生成可直接发布的完整文章、5个备选标题及配图prompt。支持微信公众号、小红书、抖音多平台适配，通过系统性思考框架提升内容深度与传播力，输出结构化Markdown，显著提高创作效率与质量。
items.e: This repository offers a viral writing skill for AI agents based on 11 content insight dimensions. Given a topic, it generates complete articles, 5 alternative titles with strategies, and AI image prompts. It adapts to WeChat, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin platforms with distinct styles, outputs structured Markdown, and enhances content depth and engagement through systematic thinking frameworks.

items.d: 👏 Make learning a lifelong habit. 学无止境
items.z: my-geektime 是极客时间VIP课程的音视频私有化部署系统。支持一次缓存永久观看，一键发布课程为在线文档，以及本地音视频下载。基于Docker容器化技术，提供跨平台部署能力，实现学习资源的离线管理与在线访问，适合构建个人终身学习知识库。
items.e: my-geektime is a self-hosted GeekTime VIP course platform specializing in audio/video resource management. It enables permanent offline viewing through one-time caching, one-click online documentation publishing, and local media downloads. Built with Docker containerization for cross-platform deployment (amd64/arm64), it transforms streaming content into private learning assets. This tool eliminates dependency on official servers, providing lifelong access to purchased courses while maintaining content organization, search capabilities, and seamless playback functionality for individual learners.

items.d: An isometric world‑builder set in Tolkien’s Middle‑earth, where you create and shape your own landscapes inspired by its iconic lands and lore.
items.z: 这是一个基于托尔金中土世界的等距地图构建工具，支持7大种族领地和混合模式。采用Next.js 16、React 19和TypeScript 5技术栈，提供3x3至20x20的网格编辑、6类地形瓦片、角色叠加和拖拽绘制功能。支持PNG/JSON导入导出、撤销操作、本地存储和社区地图共享。适用于游戏原型设计、粉丝创作和地理可视化场景，具备深度链接加载和瓦片回退机制。
items.e: An isometric map builder set in Tolkien's Middle-earth featuring 7 distinct realms and mixed-mode support. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript 5, it offers grid-based editing (3x3 to 20x20), 6 tile categories, character overlays, and click/drag painting. Key features include PNG/JSON import/export, undo support, Zustand-powered localStorage persistence, and community collections. Ideal for game prototyping, fan creations, and geographic visualization, with deep-link loading and automatic tile fallback mechanisms.

items.z: Oz Skills 是为 Warp AI 代理和 Oz 系统设计的可复用技能库，通过 Markdown 文件定义开发规范与工作流程。技能以 YAML 前置元数据 + 内容的形式存储于 `.agents/skills/` 目录，支持项目级和全局级自动发现加载。该仓库提供预制技能模板，实现 AI 代理的上下文感知能力，显著提升开发协作效率，支持社区贡献扩展。
items.e: Oz Skills is a curated collection of reusable Agent Skills for Warp AI agents and Oz systems, defining development conventions and workflows through Markdown files. Skills are stored in `.agents/skills/` directories with YAML frontmatter and markdown content, supporting automatic discovery at both project and global levels. This repository provides pre-built skill templates that enable context-aware AI assistance, significantly improving development collaboration efficiency while allowing community contributions.

items.z: VoHive是面向EC20 4G模组的代理管理平台，支持短信收发、多卡eSIM管理、网卡绑定代理、多Bot控制及VoWiFi功能。支持一键安装与Docker部署，兼容ModemManager。适用于多模组代理与短信服务场景，亮点是设备绑定代理与运维自动化。
items.e: VoHive is an integrated management and proxy platform for Quectel EC20 4G modules. It enables SMS sending and receiving via web or bots, multi-SIM card management, eSIM profile add/switch/delete, SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies strongly bound to device network cards, remote control using Telegram, Feishu or QQ bots, and VoWiFi activation with simulated outgoing calls. The platform supports easy one-click installation on Linux or Docker deployment and is compatible with ModemManager. It is suitable for scenarios involving multiple modems for SMS services and proxy pools. Its technical highlight lies in hardware-level device binding for proxies and automation in operations.

items.d: Reality协议目标网站检测工具 - 一键检测网站是否适合作为Reality协议目标，支持TLS检测、地理位置分析、CDN识别等功能
items.z: RealityChecker是专为V2Ray Reality协议设计的目标域名检测工具。通过多维度扫描（TLS 1.3/X25519支持、证书有效性、SNI匹配、CDN识别、地理位置及被墙检测），快速筛选出适合作为Reality目标的优质域名。支持批量检测与智能报告，有效规避热门网站和CDN风险，是搭建稳定代理服务的必备工具。
items.e: RealityChecker is a specialized domain validation tool designed exclusively for V2Ray Reality protocol. It performs comprehensive multi-dimensional scans including TLS 1.3/X25519 support verification, certificate validity and SNI matching checks, CDN detection, geolocation analysis, and GFW blocking status assessment. The tool enables batch processing of domains and generates intelligent reports to identify optimal Reality targets while filtering out high-risk candidates such as popular websites and CDN-hosted domains. With its ability to detect subtle technical characteristics, it serves as an essential utility for building stable, secure, and high-performance proxy configurations.

items.d: A tiny hand on a stick that points at things on your Mac screen.
items.z: TinyHand 是一款 macOS 屏幕指针工具，在屏幕上显示一只小手或激光点，用于演示、录屏或远程指导时精准指向内容。支持点击、拖动画线、添加箭头、36种手势及声音反馈，可通过菜单栏快捷键或 tinyhand:// URL 自动化控制，轻量且开源。
items.e: TinyHand is a macOS on-screen pointer tool that displays a tiny hand or laser dot to precisely point at content during demos, recordings, or remote guidance. It supports clicking, drag-drawing, arrowheads, 36 hand styles, and tap sounds, controllable via menu bar shortcuts or tinyhand:// URLs. Lightweight and open-source.

items.d: Code for the Molmo2 Vision-Language Model
items.z: Molmo2 是艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）开源的视觉-语言模型，在视频理解、点驱动定位与跟踪任务上达到开源 SOTA 水平。支持单图、多图和视频推理，具备长上下文处理能力，提供 Transformers 和 vLLM 高效部署方案，适用于智能分析、视觉交互和自动化决策等场景。
items.e: Molmo2 is an open vision-language model from the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) that achieves state-of-the-art performance in video understanding, point-driven grounding, and tracking among open-source models. It supports single-image, multi-image, and video inference with long-context capabilities. The repository provides comprehensive training/evaluation code, pre-trained checkpoints, and efficient deployment via Transformers and vLLM. Ideal for intelligent visual analysis, interactive grounding, and automated decision-making applications.

items.d: 🚀 OpenAI-compatible Freebuff proxy with dynamic free-agent tracking, token rotation, and ready-to-use Docker deployment.
items.z: Freebuff2API 是一个 OpenAI 兼容代理服务器，将 Freebuff 免费 AI 模型转换为标准 OpenAI API 格式。支持多账号 token 自动轮换提升调用额度，动态模拟官方 SDK 指纹规避检测，并提供 Docker 快速部署。适用于开发者在不更换现有 OpenAI SDK 代码的前提下，零成本调用 Freebuff 的 AI 模型服务。
items.e: Freebuff2API is an OpenAI-compatible proxy server that transforms Freebuff's free AI models into standard OpenAI API endpoints. It features automatic multi-token rotation for higher throughput, dynamic client fingerprinting to mimic official SDK behavior, and Docker deployment. Enables developers to use Freebuff's AI services with any OpenAI-compatible client without code changes.

items.d: Reusable AI video production skills library for creation, recreation, motion design, openers, and QA.
items.z: 这是一个长期维护的AI视频制作技能库，沉淀视频创作、复刻、动效设计、片头包装与质检等可复用方法。核心收录证据驱动的参考视频复刻质检（PSNR/SSIM验证）、暗色SaaS魔术短片生成及黑底白字打字开场技能，适用于Codex、Claude Code等AI代理。通过npx skills模块化安装与扩展，按视频类型和环节组织，显著提升专业视频生产效率与像素级质量控制。
items.e: This is a long-term maintained library of reusable AI video production skills, curating methods for video creation, recreation, motion design, opener packaging, and QA. It includes evidence-driven reference video replica QC with PSNR/SSIM verification, dark SaaS magic UI shorts, and black-white text typing openers. Designed for AI agents like Codex and Claude Code, it supports modular npx skills installation and structured extension by video type and workflow, boosting efficiency and precision in AI-assisted video production.

items.d: Grok2API (Cloudflare Workers) one-click deploy with auto D1+KV provisioning
items.z: 基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok AI 代理 API，全面适配最新 Web 调用格式。支持流式/非流式对话、图像生成与深度思考，内置号池并发与自动负载均衡机制。提供 Cloudflare Workers 无服务器部署方案，集成 D1 数据库与 KV 存储。具备可视化后台管理、自动注册、Token 状态智能判定等企业级功能，实现多端部署一致性。
items.e: FastAPI-based proxy API for Grok AI, fully adapted to the latest web calling format. Supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, image generation/editing, and deep thinking with built-in account pool concurrency and auto load balancing. Offers Cloudflare Workers serverless deployment with D1 database and KV storage integration. Features visual admin panel, auto-registration with Turnstile solver, intelligent token status detection, and consistent behavior across local, Docker, and serverless deployments.

items.d: Self-hosted SIM/eSIM gateway for VoWiFi calling, SMS, cellular data and isolated regional egress
items.z: MDD Sim Gateway 是面向 Debian/Ubuntu/Armbian ARM64 的自托管多 SIM/eSIM 通信网关。它整合蜂窝模块、USB 读卡器、IMS、EAP-AKA、ModemManager 与 sing-box，通过中英文 Web 控制台实现真实 SIM 鉴权（不读取 Ki/OP）、浏览器软电话通话与短信、多模块统一管理及独立国家出口 TUN，UDP 失败时不泄漏。适用于自建 VoWiFi、隔离区域网络出口与运营商线路保号场景。
items.e: MDD Sim Gateway is a self-hosted multi-SIM/eSIM communication gateway for Debian/Ubuntu/Armbian ARM64. It integrates cellular modules, USB readers, IMS, EAP-AKA, ModemManager and sing-box into a bilingual web console, enabling real SIM authentication (no Ki/OP exposure), browser softphone calls/SMS, multi-module management and isolated country egress TUNs that never leak on UDP failure. Ideal for self-hosted VoWiFi, regional network isolation and carrier line keepalive.

items.d: Terminal UI to get stuff done in the browser
items.z: Browser Use Terminal 是一个基于 Rust 的终端 UI 工具，用于让 LLM 代理自动化控制浏览器完成真实任务。它通过直接 CDP 连接操作真实 Chrome 会话，支持无头模式和云端执行，提供可交互的终端界面来观察、控制和恢复任务。核心优势在于 2倍成本效益和速度提升，适用于需要认证状态的企业 Web 应用自动化。
items.e: Browser Use Terminal is a Rust-based TUI that enables LLM agents to automate browser tasks via direct CDP control. It leverages real Chrome sessions with existing login states, supports headless and cloud execution, and offers an interactive interface for task monitoring and intervention. The custom LLM harness achieves 2x cost reduction and performance gains, perfect for complex authenticated web workflows.
