items.d: DeepSeek 逆向 API
items.z: DeepSeek2API通过逆向工程将DeepSeek模型封装为OpenAI兼容接口，支持deepseek-chat、deepseek-reasoner等模型。核心特性包括高速流式输出、多轮对话、R1深度思考及多账号轮换机制，有效分散单账号风险。提供Docker、Vercel及原生部署方案，配置灵活。项目明确声明仅限研究学习使用，禁止商用，规避官方服务压力与封号风险。
items.e: DeepSeek2API wraps DeepSeek models into OpenAI-compatible interfaces via reverse engineering, supporting deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner and search variants. Key features include high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversation, R1 deep reasoning, and multi-account rotation to mitigate single-account limitations. Offers flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or native Python. Project explicitly for research/learning only, prohibiting commercial use to avoid official service pressure and account bans.

items.d: Heuristic Learning Blog Post
items.z: 本仓库包含《Learning Beyond Gradients》博客文章及可复现实验代码。研究探索强化学习中超越梯度的启发式学习方法，在Atari、MuJoCo、VizDoom等多环境验证。提供完整Python实现、EnvPool集成、策略脚本及可视化结果，支持AI智能体训练与学术研究。
items.e: This repository hosts the 'Learning Beyond Gradients' blog post and all associated reproducible artifacts. The research investigates heuristic learning approaches that transcend traditional gradient-based methods in reinforcement learning, with comprehensive experiments conducted across Atari, MuJoCo, and VizDoom benchmark environments. It delivers production-ready Python implementations leveraging EnvPool for high-performance simulation, complete policy scripts, sample-efficiency visualizations, checkpoint videos, and detailed reproduction commands. The project serves as a valuable resource for AI agent development, reinforcement learning research, and exploring novel heuristic optimization techniques.

items.z: AegisFlow 是本地运行的 GLM Coding 支付运营后台，支持多账号导入、套餐同步、腾讯验证码自动 OCR 识别与链路处理、预览下单签单生成二维码及定时任务启动。基于 FastAPI 后端与 Node.js 构建，集成内置 Python 代理池，实现全自动化支付流程，适合本地多账号管理和运营效率提升。
items.e: AegisFlow is a locally running payment operations backend for GLM Coding, supporting multi-account import/sync, automatic Tencent captcha OCR recognition and processing chains, order preview/signing for QR code generation, and scheduled task launching. Built with FastAPI backend and Node.js, featuring built-in Python proxy pool for fully automated payment workflows, ideal for local multi-account management and operational efficiency.

items.d: How top iOS apps say hello | 10 animated welcome screens inspired by top-earning apps. Rebuilt in React Native + Expo.
items.z: 开源 React Native Expo 项目，收录 10 个受 Duolingo、Strava 等热门 iOS 应用启发的动画欢迎/启动/引导屏幕。每个均为完整 TypeScript 组件，基于 Reanimated 实现精准时间轴动画、响应式缩放、无障碍与减动画支持。开发者可直接运行画廊、复制组件或粘贴 AI 提示词快速集成，专为学习高端移动端 onboarding 设计而打造。
items.e: Open-source React Native Expo kit with 10 animated welcome, splash and onboarding screens inspired by top iOS apps like Duolingo and Strava. Each is a full TypeScript component powered by Reanimated, featuring authored timelines, responsive scaling, reduced-motion and accessibility support. Run the gallery, copy any component or paste AI prompts to integrate polished mobile onboarding UI for study or production use.

items.d: A collection of jailbreak prompts and exploit techniques for local and frontier AI models, with modern methods for Qwen3.5, Gemma 4, Llama 4, Kimi K3, GPT-OSS, GPT-5.x, Gemini 3.x and Grok 4.x. For red-teaming and AI safety research only.
items.z: 汇集针对GPT-5、Gemini 3、Llama 4等前沿AI模型的越狱提示词与对抗技术，涵盖角色混淆、语义催眠、推理链注入、多语言混淆等六大核心方法，专为AI安全研究与红队验证服务。
items.e: A curated collection of jailbreak prompts and adversarial techniques for frontier AI models like GPT-5, Gemini 3, and Llama 4. Covers six core methods including role confusion, semantic hypnosis, reasoning-trace injection, and multilingual obfuscation for AI safety research and red-teaming.

items.d: Connector for decentralised post-quantum secure network - VeilNet
items.z: VeilNet Conflux 是连接去中心化抗量子安全网络的节点软件，采用改进 WebRTC 栈实现点对点通信。核心特性包括基于污点（taint）的访问控制机制，节点需共享污点才能互联；支持 Terra 免费无区域 Realm 和 Conduit 互联网共享模式。通过优化 Exp3 路由算法和自动连接配对，提供低延迟、高吞吐的安全网络连接，适用于构建抗量子威胁的分布式通信基础设施。
items.e: VeilNet Conflux is a node connector for decentralized post-quantum secure networks, utilizing a modified WebRTC stack for P2P communication. Key features include taint-based access control requiring shared taints for node connectivity, free regionless Terra Realm, and Conduit mode for internet sharing. Optimized with the Exp3 routing algorithm and automatic connection pairing, it delivers low-latency, high-throughput secure networking, ideal for building quantum-resistant distributed communication infrastructure.

items.d: 【域名扫描器】一个用Go语言编写的强大且灵活的域名注册可用性检查扫描工具 A powerful and flexible domain name availability checker written in Go. This domain scanner helps you find available domain based on various patterns and filters.
items.z: Domain Scanner 是一款用 Go 语言编写的高性能域名可用性扫描工具。支持字典导入与模式生成，通过 DNS、WHOIS、SSL 多维度验证域名状态。内置 ReDoS 防护、智能并发控制与资源预估，有效防止大规模扫描风险。适用于域名投资与品牌保护工作，提供精准结果与安全保障。
items.e: Domain Scanner is a high-performance domain availability checker written in Go. It supports dictionary import and pattern generation, verifying domains through DNS, WHOIS, and SSL multi-dimensional checks. Features include ReDoS protection, intelligent concurrency control, and resource estimation to prevent large-scale scan risks. Ideal for domain investors and brand protection, delivering precise results with robust security guarantees and efficient scanning capabilities.

items.z: Shadcn Builder 是为 shadcn/ui 量身打造的可视化表单构建器，通过拖拽式操作和实时预览，让开发者无需编写代码即可创建美观、可访问的表单。工具直接生成生产就绪的 React + Tailwind CSS 代码，完美契合 shadcn/ui 组件体系，实现零配置快速上手，大幅提升前端开发效率。
items.e: Shadcn Builder is a powerful no-code form builder specifically designed for the shadcn/ui component library. It enables developers to visually create beautiful, accessible forms through drag-and-drop interface with live preview, then exports clean, production-ready React + Tailwind CSS code. With zero configuration required and seamless shadcn/ui integration, it dramatically accelerates frontend development while maintaining code quality and type safety.

items.d: 2D Sprite Sheet Creation Pipeline
items.z: 为独立游戏开发者提供AI动画转精灵图的生产级管线。通过FFmpeg帧提取、自动去背景、智能打包成256x256标准格式，内置浏览器审查工具与AI助手集成，实现从AI生成视频到游戏可用资源的可控生产流程，确保仅审核通过的资产进入项目。
items.e: Provides indie game developers with a production-grade pipeline for converting AI-generated animations into sprite sheets. It extracts frames via FFmpeg, performs automatic matting, packs assets into standardized 256x256 formats, and includes a browser-based review tool with AI assistant integration, ensuring only approved outputs are promoted to game projects.

items.d: Curated Motion Core Svelte components
items.z: 面向Svelte 5的精选生产级动效组件库，采用shadcn式copy-paste架构，通过CLI直接注入源码。封装GSAP与OGL，实现流畅WebGL与时间轴动画，覆盖磁力按钮、3D无限画廊等，专为实验性高性能网页设计打造。
items.e: Curated production-ready motion components for Svelte 5, using a shadcn-inspired copy-paste architecture via CLI. Wraps GSAP and OGL for smooth WebGL and timeline animations, including magnetic buttons and 3D galleries, focused on high-end experimental web motion design.

items.z: 该插件将微信消息通道深度集成至Claude Code，开发者可直接在终端收发微信消息。采用本地MCP服务器与HTTP长轮询技术，无需公网Webhook。通过二维码登录和配对码验证实现安全认证，并针对微信API的context_token机制优化，支持双向消息同步，无缝衔接开发工作流。
items.e: This plugin deeply integrates WeChat messaging channels into Claude Code, allowing developers to send and receive WeChat messages directly in the terminal without switching contexts. It employs a local MCP server with HTTP long-polling technology, eliminating the need for public webhooks. Features include QR code login, pairing code verification, and optimized handling of WeChat's context_token mechanism for bidirectional message synchronization, seamlessly integrating into developer workflows.

items.d: Secure, production-grade IoT hydroponic automation system with ESP32, MQTT telemetry, and real-time dashboard
items.z: 这是一个生产级开源物联网水培自动化系统，基于ESP32硬件和MQTT协议实现pH、EC、温湿度等环境参数实时监测与智能控制。系统采用React+Node.js构建边缘优先的实时仪表板，通过InfluxDB存储时序数据，支持TLS加密通信和RSA签名OTA更新，填补了业余DIY与工业级自动化之间的空白。
items.e: HydroponicOne is a production-grade open-source IoT automation system for hydroponic farming, built on ESP32 hardware and MQTT telemetry protocol. It enables real-time monitoring and automated control of critical parameters including pH, EC, water level, temperature, and humidity through smart relays for dosing pumps, lights, and ventilation. The system features an edge-first React dashboard with WebSocket communication, enterprise-grade security with TLS encryption and RSA-2048 signed OTA updates, and dual-database architecture (PostgreSQL for config, InfluxDB for time-series data). It bridges the gap between hobbyist DIY setups and expensive industrial automation solutions.

items.d: 一个透明的 Tavily API 反向代理：将多个 Tavily API Key（额度/credits）汇聚在一个 Master Key 之后，并提供内置 Web UI 用于管理 Key、用量与请求日志。
items.z: TavilyProxyManager 是一个专为 Tavily API 设计的高可用代理网关，核心解决多 API Key 的额度聚合与智能调度问题。通过 Master Key 统一鉴权，实现基于剩余额度的动态负载均衡与自动故障切换，有效规避频率限制。内置 Vue3 管理面板提供 Key 管理、用量监控与请求日志分析，同时集成 MCP 协议端点，无缝对接 Claude 等 AI 工具。Go 语言构建，单二进制部署，Docker 开箱即用。
items.e: TavilyProxyManager is a high-availability proxy gateway designed for Tavily API, solving multi-key quota aggregation and intelligent scheduling. It unifies authentication via Master Key, implements dynamic load balancing based on remaining credits with automatic failover to avoid rate limits. The built-in Vue3 dashboard provides key management, usage monitoring, and request log analysis, while integrated MCP protocol endpoints seamlessly connect with AI tools like Claude. Built with Go, it offers single-binary deployment and Docker-ready out-of-the-box.

items.d: Use your android phone as windows virtual webcam
items.z: VCamdroid 将 Android 手机摄像头转化为 Windows 高性能虚拟摄像头。通过 Softcam 的 DirectShow 滤镜实现与 Zoom、OBS、Teams 等应用的无缝兼容，支持 ADB 有线和 Wi-Fi 无线连接，采用 RTSP 协议、Camera2 API、OpenGL 预处理及硬件编码（H.264/HEVC），提供低延迟视频流。支持多设备切换、相机控制（前后摄、分辨率、闪光灯）及实时图像调整（旋转、翻转、亮度等），适用于视频会议、直播和录制场景。
items.e: VCamdroid turns your Android phone's camera into a high-performance virtual webcam for Windows. It uses a custom DirectShow filter from the Softcam library for seamless compatibility with Zoom, OBS, Discord, and Teams. Supporting both ADB wired and Wi-Fi wireless connections via RTSP, it delivers low-latency, hardware-accelerated streams using Camera2 API, OpenGL preprocessing, and MediaCodec encoding. Features include multi-device support, full camera controls, and real-time image adjustments, ideal for video calls, streaming, and recording.

items.d: Automated account registration toolkit for x.ai (Grok) with SSO extraction, OAuth Device Flow, and auto-replenish daemon
items.z: 针对x.ai Grok的自动化账号注册工具包，支持curl_cffi引擎注册、YesCaptcha解决Turnstile、SSO令牌提取与OAuth Device Flow铸造、自动补充与令牌刷新守护进程，便于对接API网关账号池。
items.e: Automated x.ai (Grok) account registration toolkit with curl_cffi engine, YesCaptcha Turnstile solving, SSO-to-CPA token minting via OAuth Device Flow, auto-replenish and token-refresh daemons for API gateway account pools.

items.d: Learn everything about world model
items.z: 本GitHub仓库是Datawhale的《Learn World Models》开源课程，系统介绍世界模型从直觉到构建的全流程。包括历史演进、VAE编码、RSSM动态、架构对比、规划算法及评估指标等内容，并提供VAE训练、RSSM构建、Dreamer智能体等实践项目。强调动手实现模拟、规划与评估系统，适合AI智能体开发者和强化学习研究者学习。
items.e: This Datawhale GitHub repository presents the 'Learn World Models' course, offering a structured path from intuition to implementation of world models in AI. It covers historical evolution, VAE encoding, RSSM dynamics, architecture patterns, planning algorithms, and evaluation metrics. Five lectures and five projects enable building VAE encoders, RSSM models, Dreamer agents, and evaluation dashboards. The highlight is combining theory with hands-on practice for simulation, planning, and assessment systems, ideal for AI agent developers and reinforcement learning researchers.

items.d: Local-first, open-source Claude Science alternative, before Claude Science is a thing. Turn your AI agent into personal DNA expert.
items.z: Genomi 是开源 AI 代理运行时，将 AI 代理转变为个人 DNA 专家。它提供本地私有工作空间，包括 Active Genome Index 存储变异数据、公共遗传证据查询、探索记忆和报告工具，实现证据支持的 DNA 问题解答。基因组数据完全本地保留，支持 MCP 兼容主机如 Claude，解析原始 DNA 文件，回答健康风险、药物反应、遗传特征等问题，并随研究自更新。保障隐私的个性化基因组分析。
items.e: Genomi is an open-source AI agent runtime that turns your AI agent into a personal DNA expert. It provides a private local workspace with an Active Genome Index for variants, public genetics evidence queries, exploration memory, and report tools for evidence-backed answers. Genome data stays on-device. Compatible with MCP hosts like Claude, it parses raw DNA files, enables local querying on health risks, medication responses and traits, and self-updates with latest research for secure, personalized genomic insights.

items.d: A Powerful Serverless Uptime Monitoring & Status Page on Cloudflare's Edge Network
items.z: Uptimer是基于Cloudflare边缘网络的无服务器运行时间监控与状态页面系统。支持HTTP/TCP探测、故障事件管理、维护窗口、Webhook通知（Discord/Slack等）及管理后台，零运维部署于Workers+Pages+D1，实现实时状态展示与告警。
items.e: Uptimer is a serverless uptime monitoring and status page running on Cloudflare's edge network. It offers HTTP/TCP probes, incident management, maintenance windows, webhook alerts (Discord/Slack/etc.), and an admin dashboard, all deployed zero-ops via Workers + Pages + D1 for real-time status and notifications.

items.d: 一键将英文PDF翻译为流畅中文的Claude Code技能
items.z: 萃猫翻译是Claude Code技能，专注英文PDF书籍高质量翻译。采用信达雅三阶段流程，提供速译/标准/精翻三种模式及五种文体风格。核心技术包括欧化中文六重检测、术语一致性管理和智能润色，实现逐句忠实且地道流畅的译文输出，适用于学术、文学、技术文档等专业场景。
items.e: Cuimao Translator is a Claude Code skill for high-quality English PDF book translation. It employs a three-stage process (faithfulness-fluency-elegance) with three modes (Quick/Normal/Refined) and five style presets. Key technologies include six-layer Chinglish detection, terminology consistency management, and intelligent polishing, delivering sentence-by-sentence faithful yet natural Chinese translations for academic, literary, and technical documents.

items.d: A tiny TypeScript web agent, hill climbed on real browser evals.
items.z: 基于Pi Mono与CDP的TypeScript浏览器智能体，通过持久化V8 REPL执行JavaScript控制Chrome，支持会话保持、登录态复用、流式输出与无障碍树交互，适用于网页自动化与数据采集。
items.e: A lightweight TypeScript web agent built on Pi Mono LLM and raw Chrome DevTools Protocol, using a persistent V8 REPL to execute JavaScript and control Chrome browsers. The agent dynamically writes its own helper functions, supporting session persistence, saved logins, streaming output, typed results, and accessibility-tree interaction. Designed for browser automation, web scraping, and data collection tasks, with cloud browser support requiring no local Chrome installation. Features include ultrafast mode for interaction-heavy tasks, interaction highlights, screen recordings, and GIF exports for visual debugging.

items.d: [EMNLP 2025]  OmniThink: Expanding Knowledge Boundaries in Machine Writing through Thinking
items.z: OmniThink 是 EMNLP 2025 提出的机器写作框架，通过模拟人类认知的迭代扩展与反思机制，突破知识边界生成高质量长篇文章。集成 RAGFlow 实现离线本地搜索，支持 DeepSeek-Reasoner 等推理模型，适用于学术综述、报告撰写等知识密集型写作场景，显著提升内容深度与知识密度。
items.e: OmniThink is an EMNLP 2025 machine writing framework that simulates human cognitive processes through iterative expansion and reflection to generate high-quality long-form articles. It integrates RAGFlow for offline local search, supports DeepSeek-Reasoner models, and is designed for knowledge-intensive writing applications like academic reviews and reports, enhancing content depth and knowledge density.

items.d: An out‑of‑the‑box Next.js + Cloudflare full‑stack starter integrating Edge Runtime, D1 database, R2 storage, KV cache, Analytics Engine hooks, and a complete CI/CD pipeline.一个开箱即用的 Next.js + Cloudflare 全栈项目模板，集成 Edge Runtime、D1 数据库、R2 存储和完整的 CI/CD 流程。
items.z: 一个开箱即用的Next.js + Cloudflare全栈模板，专为边缘计算场景打造。基于vinext实现4倍构建加速和57%包体积缩减，深度集成D1数据库、R2存储、KV缓存和Analytics Engine。内置better-auth认证、next-intl国际化、Vitest测试和完整CI/CD流水线，提供生产级环境变量验证、结构化日志和自动化迁移验证。适用于需要高性能、低成本、全球部署的现代化Web应用开发。
items.e: Production-ready Next.js + Cloudflare full-stack starter for edge computing. Leverages vinext for 4x faster builds and 57% smaller bundles, deeply integrating D1 database, R2 storage, KV cache, and Analytics Engine. Features better-auth authentication, next-intl i18n, Vitest testing, and complete CI/CD pipeline with production-grade environment validation, structured logging, and automated migration verification. Ideal for high-performance, low-cost, globally-deployed modern web applications.

items.d: crate: run Linux VMs on iPhone and iPad
items.z: crate是一款在iPhone和iPad上运行完整Linux发行版的虚拟机应用，完全在设备本地运行，无需远程连接或云端依赖。它采用Rust从零编写的arm64翻译引擎，性能远超QEMU TCG，支持Ubuntu、Debian和Arch Linux ARM，通过virglrenderer、ANGLE和MoltenVK实现GPU加速桌面，并针对触摸、键盘和折叠屏优化，让手机变成真正的Linux电脑，支持Claude Code等开发工具。
items.e: crate is a virtual machine app that runs full Linux distributions on iPhone and iPad, entirely on-device with no remote connection or cloud dependency. Powered by a Rust-based arm64 translation engine that outperforms QEMU TCG, it supports Ubuntu, Debian, and Arch Linux ARM with GPU-accelerated desktops via virglrenderer, ANGLE, and MoltenVK, and is optimized for touch, keyboard, and foldable screens, turning your phone into a real Linux computer that can run developer tools like Claude Code.

items.d: 一款功能强大的 Nginx 配置文件可视化编辑工具
items.z: nginx-flow 是一款基于 React Flow 的 Nginx 配置可视化编辑器，通过拖拽式画布构建 server/location/upstream 节点，实现配置即编程。内置生产级模板库覆盖 SPA、反向代理、负载均衡等场景，集成智能体检引擎可自动检测安全风险与性能问题并提供一键修复，支持实时配置预览与流量模拟，显著提升运维效率与配置准确性。
items.e: nginx-flow is a visual Nginx config editor built on React Flow, transforming manual configuration into drag-and-drop canvas programming with server/location/upstream nodes. It features production-ready templates for SPA, reverse proxy, load balancing, and smart audit engine that auto-detects security risks and performance issues with one-click fixes. Real-time config preview, traffic simulation, and bilingual support streamline DevOps workflows, reducing errors and accelerating deployment.

items.d: Two Factor Authentication
items.z: 基于Cloudflare Workers的全球加速网络，提供安全便捷的两步验证密钥管理服务。支持TOTP/HOTP自动生成、二维码扫描/图片识别添加、AES-256加密存储，兼容Google Authenticator等多平台导入导出，具备PWA离线使用与WebDAV/S3远程备份能力，适用于个人与企业多设备场景。
items.e: A secure two-factor authentication (2FA) key management service leveraging Cloudflare Workers for global acceleration. Features include automatic TOTP/HOTP generation, QR code scanning/image recognition for key addition, AES-256 encryption, and seamless import/export from platforms like Google Authenticator. With PWA offline support and remote backup via WebDAV/S3/OneDrive/Google Drive, it provides a unified solution across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

items.d: 万物皆可搭节点 | Everything can be a proxy node
items.z: one-node 是一个极简化的网络代理节点部署工具，核心理念是'万物皆可搭节点'。它允许将任意设备快速转换为功能完整的代理服务器，支持多种协议和平台。通过轻量级架构设计，实现一键部署和灵活配置，适用于个人隐私保护、企业内网访问、网络加速等场景，大幅降低代理节点搭建的技术门槛和运维成本。
items.e: one-node is a minimalist network proxy node deployment tool embodying the philosophy 'Everything can be a proxy node'. It enables rapid conversion of any device into a fully functional proxy server, supporting multiple protocols and platforms. With its lightweight architecture, it offers one-click deployment and flexible configuration for scenarios including personal privacy protection, corporate intranet access, and network acceleration, significantly reducing technical barriers and operational costs.

items.d: 把一篇文章或一条视频（抖音、B 站、YouTube，先转逐字稿）一键做成小红书图文、杂志长图、公众号排版和 AI 配音口播短视频的开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill。21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖。
items.z: 开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill，将文章或视频一键转化为小红书图文、公众号排版、杂志长图及 AI 配音口播短视频。10 个独立能力自由组合，21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖，仅需 Node.js 22 与 Chrome。
items.e: Open-source Claude Code / Codex Skill that transforms articles or videos into Xiaohongshu cards, WeChat layouts, magazine long images, and AI-narrated short videos. 10 independent capabilities, 21 themes, automated validation, zero npm dependencies, requiring only Node.js 22 and Chrome.

items.d: 用Go语言写的腾讯 CodeBuddy 账号池Cli/Web管理控制台 + OpenAI 兼容反代网关
items.z: 纯Go实现的腾讯CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy本地AI代理网关，零CGO、跨平台单二进制。纯CLI管理账号池，支持国内国际双站混挂、轮询负载均衡、模型级冷却隔离、免费优先调度、自动签到与Token续期，提供完整OpenAI兼容接口（Chat Completions/Responses），适合本地或服务器部署AI客户端反代。
items.e: Pure Go local AI proxy gateway for Tencent CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy. Zero-CGO single binary, CLI-only account pool management supporting CN/intl dual sites, round-robin load balancing, model-level isolation, free-tier priority, auto check-in and token refresh. Full OpenAI-compatible endpoints for seamless client integration.

items.d: skills for deep search — multi-source search, content extraction, and structured research reports.
items.z: 面向 OpenClaw 的生产级搜索 Skills，整合 Brave/Exa/Tavily/Grok 四源并行检索、意图感知评分与自动去重，支持 GitHub/论坛链式引用深挖及反爬内容高保真提取（MinerU 降级），助力 AI 智能体完成结构化深度调研与报告生成。
items.e: Production-grade OpenClaw Skills for multi-source parallel search (Brave+Exa+Tavily+Grok), intent-aware scoring and deduplication, chain citation tracking across GitHub/forums, and high-fidelity content extraction with MinerU fallback. Enables AI agents to perform deep thread analysis and structured research reports.

items.d: 翼龙面板node.js环境 部署：xHTTP版 Argo双模固定隧道quic/http2、临时隧道；直连hy2、tuic、reality
items.z: 翼龙面板Node.js部署环境，支持Argo双模隧道（QUIC/HTTP2）、TUIC、Hysteria2及VLESS-Reality等代理协议。针对64MB低内存平台深度优化，内置6级自适应匹配与主动内存回收机制，兼容多个免费托管平台，适用于网络运维与抗封锁场景。
items.e: Node.js deployment environment for Yilong Panel supporting Argo dual-mode tunnels (QUIC/HTTP2), TUIC, Hysteria2, and VLESS-Reality proxy protocols. Deeply optimized for 64MB low-memory platforms with 6-level adaptive matching and active memory reclamation, compatible with multiple free hosting services for network operations and anti-blocking.

items.d: distill any book down to its spine
items.z: SpineDigest 是专为 AI 智能体设计的知识库 CLI 工具，支持将 EPUB、Markdown 和纯文本导入为可移植 .wikg 知识档案，利用大模型提取知识图谱、摘要与实体关系，并提供 URI 驱动的搜索、结构浏览和阅读模式。它将长文档转化为可维护、可导航的知识基地，而非一次性摘要输出，核心价值在于为 AI 代理提供源可追溯的结构化知识访问与上下文打包能力。
items.e: SpineDigest is a Node.js CLI optimized for AI agents that converts EPUB, Markdown, and text into portable .wikg knowledge archives. It leverages LLMs to extract knowledge graphs, summaries, and entities, exposing the archive via URI-based search, hierarchical structure, and reading modes. The primary artifact is the reusable .wikg file, enabling navigable, source-backed knowledge bases for long documents rather than one-shot summaries, with export options for AI context packing and reuse.

items.z: JioFarm是一款Python自动化工具，通过租用印度Jio虚拟号码登录Jio自助服务，自动猎取Google AI Pro/Gemini Pro兑换链接。采用多SMS服务商模块化架构，配备Rich实时仪表盘，发现链接后自动推送Telegram通知。
items.e: JioFarm is a Python automation tool that rents virtual Jio numbers to hunt Google AI Pro/Gemini Pro redeem links via Jio selfcare. Features modular multi-provider architecture, Rich live dashboard, and Telegram notifications.

items.d: Open-source SRS
items.z: Memcode 是一款专为开发者与学习者设计的现代化间隔重复闪卡应用。核心亮点在于深度融合编程学习场景，支持代码块、LaTeX公式与多媒体内容，并集成 OpenAI 高质量文本转语音。其 LLM 友好的纯文本导入导出格式，便于 AI 辅助知识管理，实现美观、高效、无摩擦的学习体验。
items.e: Memcode is a modern spaced repetition flashcard app designed for developers and learners. It excels in programming education with support for code blocks, LaTeX formulas, and multimedia. Integrated OpenAI text-to-speech delivers high-quality audio, while LLM-friendly plain text import/export enables seamless AI-powered knowledge management, combining beauty with effortless learning.

items.d: OpenAI-compatible Web Chat API proxy with GPT, Grok, Gemini account management and Docker self-hosting
items.z: webchat2api 将 ChatGPT Web、Grok/xAI Web 与 Gemini Web 逆向封装为 OpenAI 兼容及 Gemini 原生 API 代理，支持多账号池管理、文生文/文生图、tier 感知调度与 Docker 一键自托管。提供 FastAPI 后端与 Next.js 管理后台，覆盖账号导入、代理配置、内容过滤、云备份及图片存储，适合个人学习与私有化部署场景。
items.e: webchat2api wraps ChatGPT Web, Grok/xAI Web and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible and Gemini native API proxies, with multi-account pools, text/image generation, tier-aware routing and Docker self-hosting. Features FastAPI backend plus Next.js admin UI for account management, proxies, content filtering, cloud backup and image storage—ideal for personal research and private deployments.

items.d: 基于 LSPosed 框架的 Android 系统级虚拟定位与环境伪装模块。Fakelocation module based on LSPosed which is available to GMS.
items.z: Shadow是一款基于LSPosed框架的Android系统级虚拟定位与环境伪装模块。通过底层Hook系统服务与高德/腾讯地图SDK，实现GPS、基站、Wi-Fi的全维度位置模拟及指纹伪造，支持防跳回与GMS兼容。核心价值在于比传统Mock Location更强的隐蔽性，适用于隐私保护、应用测试与位置模拟场景，技术亮点为系统层劫持与随机环境生成。
items.e: Shadow is an LSPosed-based Android module for system-level virtual location and environment spoofing. It hooks system services and map SDKs (Gaode/Tencent) to fake GPS, cell info, and Wi-Fi lists with anti-rebound features and GMS compatibility. Core value lies in superior stealth over traditional mock location via low-level file interactions. Ideal for privacy protection and app testing, with highlights in system-layer hooking and random fingerprint generation.

items.d: 开源的中国传统纹样图录项目 · 100 高清纹样(规划 800) · 中英日韩双语 · CC BY-NC 4.0 · https://wenyang.net
items.z: 开源的中国传统纹样图鉴项目，收录100张高清原创PNG卡片图（规划800张），分为植物花卉、动物瑞兽、几何锦纹等六大类。每张配中英日韩双语名称、简介、文化寓意、视觉关键词及详细资料页，提供patterns.json与patterns.csv结构化数据集。配套静态网站wenyang.net支持浏览、检索、收藏与下载，采用CC BY-NC 4.0许可。核心价值是美术馆级审美与开放获取，服务设计师与文化爱好者的非商业创作、研究与教育。
items.e: Open-source Chinese traditional patterns catalog with 100 high-res original PNG cards (planning 800), organized into six categories: flora, fauna, geometric, cloud-water-stone, auspicious objects, and characters. Each includes bilingual names, summaries, cultural meanings, keywords, and detailed pages, plus structured JSON/CSV datasets. Companion static site wenyang.net enables browsing, search, collection, and download under CC BY-NC 4.0. Emphasizes museum-quality aesthetics for non-commercial design, research, and cultural education.

items.z: AetherGate Pro 是企业级高可用 VPN 与代理网关管理工具，专为 Linux VPS 设计。通过网络命名空间（netns）隔离技术，避免主机接口污染和 SSH 断连问题。支持单端口混合 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，自动抓取 VPNGate 节点并过滤欺诈风险，配备玻璃拟态仪表盘与自愈看门狗，实现稳定可靠的代理服务，适用于代理网络工程师构建企业级网关。
items.e: AetherGate Pro is an enterprise-grade, high-availability VPN and proxy gateway manager for Linux VPS. It uses network namespace (netns) isolation to eliminate SSH disconnections and routing conflicts on the host. It features a single-port mixed SOCKS5/HTTP proxy, auto VPNGate scraping with fraud filtering, a glassmorphic dashboard, and self-healing watchdog for seamless, reliable proxy services tailored for network engineers.

items.d: An intentionally vulnerable OWASP LLM Top 10 training platform for AI Security, Prompt Injection, RAG Security, Agent Security, and GenAI penetration testing.
items.z: LLMVault 是一个故意漏洞的 CTF 风格训练平台，专为 OWASP LLM Top 10（2025）设计。提供 25 个三层实验室：核心层 10 个单类漏洞实验（提示注入、信息泄露、供应链、数据投毒等）；高级层 10 个多轮交互挑战（越狱、Agent 利用、RAG 攻击）；专家层 5 个真实攻击模拟。每实验室结合攻击与防御实践。Docker 就绪、Python 构建，适用于自托管 AI 安全教育与 GenAI 渗透测试。
items.e: LLMVault is a deliberately vulnerable CTF-style training platform for OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025). It features 25 labs across three tiers: 10 core labs covering prompt injection, sensitive info disclosure, supply chain, data poisoning and more; 10 advanced multi-turn challenges including jailbreaking, agent exploitation and RAG attacks; plus 5 expert labs modeling real-world threats. Each lab pairs exploitation with defenses. Docker-ready and Python-based, ideal for self-hosted AI security education, GenAI penetration testing and hands-on LLM defense training.

items.d: 📚 Character relationship maps
items.z: Austen是一款AI驱动的文学分析工具，通过集成DeepSeek/OpenAI自动解析书籍角色关系，并生成Mermaid可视化图谱。基于Next.js全栈框架与Supabase后端，支持用户管理、图表保存(SVG/PNG)与社交分享，为教育、阅读及文学研究提供直观的关系探索体验。
items.e: Austen is an AI-powered literary analysis tool that automatically extracts character relationships from books using DeepSeek/OpenAI and visualizes them via Mermaid diagrams. Built on Next.js fullstack with Supabase backend, it enables user management, graph export (SVG/PNG), and social sharing—ideal for educators, readers, and literary research to visually explore narrative dynamics.

items.d: 微信读书全本导出工具 — Playwright + Canvas Hook 提取完整书籍内容为 Markdown
items.z: 微信读书全本导出工具，通过Playwright自动化浏览器并Hook Canvas fillText方法，拦截渲染文本，结合y坐标拆分双页内容，按坐标重建段落并清理格式，导出为Markdown。适用于个人学习研究，需有效微信读书账号权限。技术亮点包括持久化登录、双页处理及文本重建，支持章节独立输出与元数据保存，解决网页版无法直接复制的问题。
items.e: weread-exporter exports complete WeRead books to Markdown by using Playwright to automate Chromium and hooking CanvasRenderingContext2D.fillText to capture canvas-rendered text. It splits double-page renders via y-coordinate detection, reconstructs paragraphs from (x,y) coordinates, and cleans formatting. Designed for personal study with valid account access, it features persistent QR login, per-chapter Markdown files, metadata JSON, and optional raw data. Addresses web version copy restrictions with ~20-30s per chapter speed.

items.z: HiDeck 是一款自托管的 Qualcomm 4G/LTE/5G 调制解调器管理控制台，通过浏览器统一管理 USB 蜂窝模块，支持代理绑定、短信收发、WiFi 通话、VoLTE、eSIM 管理及定时任务自动化，采用 Go + Vue 3 构建，Docker 一键部署。
items.e: HiDeck is a self-hosted web console for managing Qualcomm 4G/LTE/5G cellular modems through a browser interface. It supports USB modem auto-discovery across QMI, MBIM, AT, and PC/SC protocols, SOCKS5/HTTP proxy binding, SMS inbox and sending, WiFi calling, native VoLTE, eSIM provisioning, and scheduled task automation with notifications via Telegram, email, Bark, Feishu, and WeChat. Built with Go and Vue 3, it deploys via Docker with SQLite storage, supporting both binary and containerized installation for Linux systems with multi-language documentation.

items.d: For Investing for Programmers book published by Manning
items.z: 本书专为程序员编写，系统讲解如何利用编程技能进行量化投资与算法交易。内容涵盖金融数据分析、交易策略开发、回测系统构建等实战主题，使用Python等工具将编程思维应用于投资决策。适合希望将技术优势转化为投资能力的开发者，提供可复用的代码示例与项目实践。
items.e: Specifically designed for programmers, this book systematically explains how to leverage coding skills for quantitative investing and algorithmic trading. It covers practical topics including financial data analysis, trading strategy development, and backtesting system construction, using tools like Python to apply programming thinking to investment decisions. Suitable for developers who want to transform their technical advantages into investment capabilities, it provides reusable code examples and project practices.

items.d: 智谱清言网页版的 Cloudflare Worker 2API层，提供 OpenAI / Claude / Gemini 三种协议兼容接口，支持流式对话、Tools调用、AI 绘图、视频生成与多账号 Token 轮询。
items.z: 这是一个将智谱清言私有API转换为标准LLM接口的Cloudflare Worker服务。核心价值在于提供OpenAI、Claude、Gemini三协议兼容，支持流式对话、Tools调用、AI绘图与视频生成。通过动态Token轮询和自动补号机制，实现多账号资源池化与零维护，让任意兼容客户端无缝调用GLM系列模型能力。
items.e: This Cloudflare Worker service converts ChatGLM's private streaming API into standardized LLM service interfaces, delivering seamless OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini protocol compatibility. Key features include streaming responses with reasoning content, dynamic token management with round-robin scheduling, automated token replenishment, and support for AI drawing, video generation, and function calling. The architecture separates authentication from resource tokens, enabling unified management of multiple accounts while providing zero-maintenance operation for any compatible client applications.

items.d: List of OSINT Books
items.z: 该GitHub仓库精选开源情报（OSINT）书籍列表，聚焦工具与技术、在网络安全、招聘及人权调查等场景的应用，还涵盖调查心理层面。优先收录2020年代出版物，避免过时技术内容，包括批判性思维、AI情报分析、尽职调查、隐私保护等主题。每条目附封面、作者社交链接、年份和购买链接，为情报分析师和安全专业人士提供实用、全面的OSINT学习资源。
items.e: This GitHub repository curates a list of books on Open Source Intelligence (OSINT), covering tools, techniques, and applications in cybersecurity, recruiting, and human rights investigations, plus psychological aspects. It prioritizes 2020s publications to avoid outdated technical details, including titles on critical thinking, AI for analysts, due diligence, and privacy. Entries feature covers, author links, years, and purchase links, serving as a practical resource for intelligence professionals seeking modern OSINT methodologies.

items.d: LinPad — Linux for iPad. A real Linux desktop on the iPad: native windowed desktop with tiling and workspaces, real Linux apps (Firefox, VS Code, Thunar, VLC) as native windows, ARM64 JIT, GPU via Venus/Metal, keyboard + trackpad + touch.
items.z: LinPad 将 iPad 变身真实 Linux 桌面，基于 Alpine Linux 与 Wayland 合成器，原生运行 VS Code、Firefox、VLC 等应用，支持窗口平铺、工作区、ARM64 JIT 及 Venus/Metal GPU 加速，无需虚拟机或越狱，一个应用解锁 iPad 完整生产力。
items.e: LinPad transforms iPad into a real Linux desktop powered by Alpine Linux and Wayland, running native apps like VS Code, Firefox, and VLC with window tiling, workspaces, ARM64 JIT, and Venus/Metal GPU acceleration—no VM or jailbreak needed.

items.d: 每天早上打开通知，高质量论文摘要已经为你准备好 Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆
items.z: 基于LLM的学术论文自动化监控系统，每日从ArXiv及20+顶级期刊抓取最新论文，通过双模型加权评分精准筛选，深度解析PDF全文并提取创新点、方法等核心维度。自动追踪关键词趋势生成可视化报告，支持邮件/企微等多渠道推送。提供Docker、GitHub Actions等部署方案，实现零人工干预的科研情报服务。
items.e: An LLM-powered academic paper monitoring system that automatically fetches daily submissions from ArXiv and 20+ top journals. It employs dual-model weighted scoring for precise filtering, performs in-depth PDF analysis to extract key dimensions like methodologies and innovations, tracks keyword trends with visual reports, and pushes notifications via email/WeCom等多渠道. Supports Docker/GitHub Actions deployments for fully automated research intelligence.

items.z: soundshuman是反AI写作痕迹（slop）工具集，整合多款开源humanizer精华：Markdown技能像人类编辑重写文本（41种模式+统计特征+声线校准，禁止捏造），JSON规则包供机器强制执行，零依赖Node CLI实现全文评分、分析、修复与仓库扫描，并支持CI门禁与pre-commit钩子。目标是可检查工作流——可见规则、可解释分数、可审查diff，而非对抗检测器。适用于文档、博客、代码仓库内容质量把控与AI智能体写作。
items.e: soundshuman is an anti-AI-slop toolkit that merges the best of existing humanizers: a Markdown skill that rewrites prose like a careful human editor (41 patterns, statistical tells, voice calibration, no fabrication), a machine-enforceable JSON rule pack, and a zero-dependency Node CLI for scoring, analyzing, fixing, and scanning entire repos with CI gates and pre-commit hooks. It prioritizes an inspectable workflow—visible rules, explainable scores, reviewable diffs—over beating detectors. Ideal for docs, blogs, and keeping AI agents’ output natural.

items.d: 工作流仓库 - dsh 插件的 .wflite.zip 工作流合集 by MingLin
items.z: dsh-workflows 是配合 dsh-jailbreak-workflow 插件使用的现成工作流包，首个上架“破甲制作”工作流针对目标 LLM 实现系统性破甲研究自动化。流水线共 15 步，内置探针测试、拒绝模式分析、定制破甲词生成、API 验证及三件套输出，配套 Skill 含 10 个测试脚本与 4 套提示词模板，显著降低 LLM 安全研究门槛。
items.e: dsh-workflows is a ready-to-use workflow package for the dsh-jailbreak-workflow plugin. Its first workflow, 'Armor Breaking', automates systematic jailbreak research on target LLMs via a 15-step pipeline covering probe testing, refusal pattern analysis, customized jailbreak word generation, API validation, and three-part output. Bundled Skill includes 10 test scripts and 4 prompt templates, lowering the barrier for LLM security research.

items.d: Automated QwenCloud account registration & API key harvester with multi-threading, TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth
items.z: QwenCloud Generator是一款自动化QwenCloud账户注册与API密钥采集工具，支持多线程Playwright浏览器并发操作、TUI实时仪表盘监控、代理轮换及Gmail OAuth邮箱验证。适用于AI开发者批量获取Qwen大模型API访问权限的场景，具备无头模式、自动恢复和页面状态智能检测等亮点，大幅提升注册效率与匿名性。
items.e: QwenCloud Generator automates QwenCloud account registration and API key harvesting using multi-threaded Playwright browsers, a TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth for verification. Ideal for AI developers needing bulk API access to Qwen models, it supports headless mode via Xvfb, auto-resume, and scenario detection to handle signup flows efficiently and scalably.

items.d: ⚡ StreamGet -  A Multi-Platform Live Stream Parser Library for Python
items.z: StreamGet 是一个轻量级 Python 直播流解析库，支持 40+ 主流平台（抖音、TikTok、B站、小红书等）的 HLS/FLV 协议。采用异步架构提供统一 API，无需为各平台单独开发解析逻辑，可快速构建直播监控、数据采集、内容分析与自动录播应用，显著降低开发门槛。
items.e: StreamGet is a lightweight Python library for real-time live stream acquisition, supporting HLS/FLV protocols across 40+ platforms including Douyin, TikTok, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu. It provides a unified async API that eliminates platform-specific parsing logic, enabling rapid development of live stream monitoring, data collection, content analysis, and automated recording applications while significantly reducing development complexity.

items.d: Paperclip — search, read, and analyze 8M+ biomedical papers from the command line
items.z: Paperclip 是一款命令行工具，专为高效检索与分析 800 万+生物医学文献而设计。支持自然语言/正则搜索、并行 AI 阅读、SQL 查询及图表视觉分析，无缝集成 Unix 工具链。可作为 MCP 服务器赋能 AI 智能体，快速完成文献综述、监管文档查询等科研任务。
items.e: Paperclip is a command-line tool for rapid search and analysis of over 8 million biomedical papers. It enables natural language/regex search, parallel AI reading, SQL queries, and vision-based figure analysis, integrating seamlessly with Unix tools. As an MCP server, it empowers AI agents to efficiently conduct literature reviews and regulatory document queries.

items.d: the best diff viewer ever made
items.z: comview 是一款专为终端设计的现代化 diff 查看器，可美化渲染 unified diff 输出。深度集成 git 与 GitHub CLI，支持实时 watch 模式自动刷新。提供完整的 Vim 风格快捷键、注释系统、主题切换和文本对象操作，让代码审查无需离开终端即可获得类 GUI 的流畅体验，显著提升开发效率。
items.e: comview is a sophisticated terminal diff viewer that elegantly renders unified diffs with syntax highlighting and side-by-side view options. It deeply integrates with git and GitHub CLI, featuring a real-time watch mode for automatic updates. The tool provides complete Vim-style navigation, persistent comment storage in JSON format, customizable themes, and intuitive text object operations. Specifically designed for developers who live in the terminal, it eliminates the need for web-based tools by delivering a powerful, keyboard-driven code review experience that significantly enhances productivity and workflow efficiency.

items.d: spoo.me is an open-source & API first link management infra
items.z: spoo.me 是一个开源、API 优先的短链接管理服务，提供自定义 slug（含 emoji）、密码保护、点击限制等高级功能。其核心亮点在于强大的分析能力，支持地理位置、设备、流量模式、引荐来源和机器人检测的多维度统计，并提供 CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML 数据导出。无需注册即可使用，支持自托管，完全免费且无功能限制，适合需要私有化部署或集成短链能力的开发者和企业。
items.e: spoo.me is an open-source, API-first URL shortening infrastructure offering advanced features like custom slugs (including emojis), password protection, and click limits. Its core strength lies in comprehensive analytics covering geographic distribution, device breakdown, traffic patterns, referrer tracking, and bot detection, with multi-format data export (CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML). Requiring no registration, it provides completely free unlimited usage with self-hosting capability. Ideal for developers and enterprises needing private deployment or integrated link management with detailed click insights.

items.d: Markdown editor that gets out of your way. Lightweight, fast, portable. First release of https://4worlds.dev
items.z: Inkwell是基于Rust+Tauri v2构建的轻量级Markdown编辑器，主打离线运行与极速启动（<1秒）。支持Mermaid图表、LaTeX公式、GitHub Flavored Markdown，提供4种主题与专注模式。100%本地存储，零遥测，安装包仅5-12MB。适用于跨平台写作，免费版功能完整，Pro版解锁PDF/HTML导出。
items.e: Inkwell is a sovereign Markdown editor built with Rust+Tauri v2, delivering <1s startup and offline-first operation. Features Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math, GitHub Flavored Markdown, 4 themes, focus mode, and version history. 100% local storage, zero telemetry, 5-12MB footprint. Cross-platform for distraction-free writing. Free forever, Pro adds PDF/HTML export.

items.d: Expert-thinking AGENTS.md profiles that teach AI agents to reason like senior scientists and engineers.
items.z: 该仓库收集503个专家级AGENTS.md配置文件，针对物理、生物、化学、工程等科学与工程领域，教导AI代理像资深从业者一样框架问题、选用工具数据库、评估证据、排查故障模式并规范报告。基于领域深度研究构建，采用开放AGENTS.md标准，兼容Cursor、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex等工具。核心价值是将通用AI转变为领域专精AI科学家，提升科研准确性与专业性，适用于数据分析、实验设计、方法起草和同行评审等场景。
items.e: This repository curates 503 expert AGENTS.md profiles for scientific and engineering professions, teaching AI agents to reason like senior practitioners by encoding domain-specific problem framing, tool and database selection, evidence evaluation, failure mode detection, and reporting standards. Research-grounded and built to pass field-expert validation, they leverage the open AGENTS.md standard for seamless integration with Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other tools. The core value lies in transforming generalist AI into specialized AI scientists, enhancing precision in research workflows across physics, biology, chemistry, medicine, and engineering.

items.d: Find your agents errors be fore your real users do
items.z: ArkSim 是一款 AI 智能体仿真测试平台，通过 LLM 驱动的虚拟用户模拟真实多轮对话，在上线前自动检测智能体错误。提供 7 大内置评估指标，支持自定义度量，自动分类错误并分级。协议无关，支持 Chat Completions API 和 A2A 协议，生成可视化 HTML 报告，帮助开发者提前发现并修复问题。
items.e: ArkSim is an AI agent simulation testing platform that uses LLM-powered virtual users to simulate realistic multi-turn conversations, automatically detecting agent errors before deployment. It offers 7 built-in evaluation metrics, supports custom metrics, automatically categorizes and prioritizes failures. Protocol-agnostic, works with Chat Completions API and A2A, generating interactive HTML reports to help developers identify and fix issues proactively.

items.d: Google AI Studio and Gemini Web provider for Magpie (Gemini 4 Carbon / Hydrogen / Argon, Nano Banana image generation, Deep Research), backed by AIStudio2API and gemini-web2api-go
items.z: Magpie 插件，通过本地后端将 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini 网页版转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账号额度调度、工具调用与实验性 Argon 模型，无需额外依赖。
items.e: A Magpie plugin that converts Google AI Studio and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible APIs through local backends. It automatically downloads and manages AIStudio2API and gemini-web2api-go, enabling users to access Google's large language models directly from Magpie without additional dependencies. Features include multi-account quota scheduling with per-account cards, native function calling for AI Studio, simulated tool calling for Gemini Web, cookie-based authentication, proxy support, and experimental Argon model access. Both providers can be configured simultaneously for flexible and diverse usage scenarios.

items.d: Agent skill for finding unknowns, grilling plans, and reaching shared understanding before implementation
items.z: grill-for-unknowns 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的技能包，核心价值在于实施前系统发现未知（已知已知/未知、未知已知/未知），避免假设错误。它结合文档/源码检查与计划 grilling，区分事实、决策与领域语言，输出共享理解文档（如 launch-packet、ADR）。适用于不熟悉代码库、模糊需求、复杂架构或子代理启动场景。支持 Claude、Codex、Hermes 等平台通过 SKILL.md 快速安装，提供模板与示例提示。
items.e: grill-for-unknowns is an agent skill that prevents rushed implementation by systematically surfacing unknowns (known knowns, known unknowns, unknown knowns, unknown unknowns) before coding. It combines source/docs inspection with targeted plan grilling to clarify decisions, domain language, and blind spots, then documents shared understanding via templates like launch-packets and ADRs. Ideal for unfamiliar codebases, vague requirements, complex architectures, or failed attempts due to assumptions. Installs as SKILL.md for Claude, Codex, Hermes, and compatible agents.

items.d: 将ai studio的对话页面转发为api接口，供其他软件使用。您可以在releases中使用稳定版本和开发测试版
items.z: 该项目通过油猴脚本与本地 Python 服务器协同，将 AI Studio 对话页面桥接为 OpenAI API 兼容接口。核心亮点是完整支持函数调用（Function Calling）和动态模型列表获取，实现端到端自动化。用户可定义工具，AI 自动触发调用并返回结构化响应，支持并行调用与流式返回，无缝集成现有开发工具链。
items.e: This project bridges AI Studio chat pages into OpenAI API-compatible interfaces through Tampermonkey scripts and local Python servers. Its core innovation lies in full Function Calling support and dynamic model fetching, enabling complete end-to-end automation. Users can define custom tools that AI automatically triggers based on context, receiving structured responses with parallel invocation and streaming output. The system handles the entire interaction loop—from tool execution to result submission—providing a standardized API layer that seamlessly integrates with existing development toolchains, libraries, and workflows without modification.

items.d: 一个用Go语言编写的性能强大的域名可用性检查扫描工具 A high-performance domain availability scanning tool written in Go.
items.z: PowerWhois 是一款基于 Go 语言的高性能域名可用性扫描工具，支持百万级批量查询与 Web/API 双模式。其核心亮点包括 Mix 模式灵活调度直连、代理与 DNS 查询，支持自定义 WHOIS 与注册 API 集成，适用于域名投资与注册商业务场景。采用 Gofiber+Vue3 全栈架构，Docker 一键部署，兼具性能与易用性。
items.e: PowerWhois is a high-performance domain availability scanning tool written in Go, capable of processing millions of domains with exceptional speed. It offers Web and API operation modes, featuring Mix mode for flexible direct/proxy/DNS query scheduling, custom WHOIS/registration API integration, and typo generation. Built on Gofiber backend and Vue3+Quasar2 frontend, it serves domain investors and registrars with Docker deployment.

items.d: 梅花易數 - 適用於 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek 等 AI/LLM 的占卜技能
items.z: 该项目将传统梅花易数占卜术转化为AI大模型技能，为Claude、ChatGPT等提供决策辅助能力。核心价值在于将千年易学智慧转化为结构化思考框架，帮助企业家和个人在复杂选择中分析现状、预测时机。支持时间、数字、声音等多模态占卜方法，集成体用分析、应期预测等核心算法，是传统文化与AI技术融合的创新实践。
items.e: This project transforms the traditional Meihua Yishu divination system into an AI skill for LLM platforms including Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek. It reimagines ancient Chinese wisdom as a structured decision-making framework for modern complex choices. The system supports multiple casting methods (time, number, sound, color) and provides Ti-Yong analysis, timing prediction, and strategic guidance. By integrating traditional philosophy with AI capabilities, it offers entrepreneurs and individuals a unique tool for multi-perspective situation analysis and adaptive planning.

items.d: A playground for live Metal shaders on iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo, Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro and Apple Watch. Save any shader as a wallpaper.
