items.d: 基于 Cookie/Token 认证、自动绕过 Cloudflare (CF) 人机验证、高级反检测伪装、高速流式 API 转换、Docker 一键部署
items.z: notion-2api 是一个将 Notion AI 非官方接口转换为 OpenAI 兼容格式的高性能代理层。基于 FastAPI 和 cloudscraper 实现 Cloudflare 绕过与反检测，支持流式响应和多模型调用。Docker 一键部署让任意 OpenAI API 客户端无缝接入 Notion AI 能力，适用于自动化脚本、AI 应用集成等场景。
items.e: notion-2api is a high-performance proxy service that transforms Notion AI's unofficial backend into a fully compatible OpenAI API interface. Leveraging FastAPI and cloudscraper, it automatically bypasses Cloudflare protection while implementing advanced anti-detection mechanisms. The solution supports real-time streaming responses (stream=true) and maintains session state across multiple models. With Docker-based deployment, developers can instantly provision a private API endpoint, enabling any OpenAI-compatible application or script to harness Notion AI's capabilities without official API access.

items.d: Read premium articles for free with this Bookmarklet
items.z: Readium 是一个轻量级书签工具，通过 JavaScript 技术绕过付费墙限制，让用户免费访问 Medium、Substack 等平台的优质内容。项目采用 Vue.js 构建官方网站，部署于 GitHub Pages，提供一键式便捷操作。相比浏览器扩展，书签形式无需安装，更加便携高效，是数字内容自由访问的实用解决方案。
items.e: Readium is a lightweight bookmarklet that bypasses paywalls to provide free access to premium content on platforms like Medium and Substack. Built with Vue.js and deployed on GitHub Pages, it offers a one-click solution without requiring browser extension installation. This portable tool leverages JavaScript to remove content restrictions, delivering a streamlined alternative to traditional ad-blockers or subscription management tools for effortless reading of gated articles. Its open-source nature ensures transparency and community-driven improvements.

items.d: Find and track available single-word domains from your terminal.
items.z: 终端CLI工具，用于快速查找可用单词域名。直接通过RDAP与WHOIS查询注册表，支持单词多TLD检查或扫描内置11822个品牌词列表，结果本地SQLite持久化并支持断点续扫。提供过滤排序、价格查询与交互式界面，严格区分available/registered/unknown状态，适合域名猎人与开发者高效发现优质域名。
items.e: Terminal CLI tool to find available single-word domains. Queries registries directly via RDAP and WHOIS, supports single-word multi-TLD checks or scanning 11,822 bundled brandable words. Results stored in local SQLite with resumable scans, filters, pricing and interactive TUI. Strictly separates available/registered/unknown states for reliable discovery by domain hunters and developers.

items.z: ChatGPT订阅支付链路自动化研究项目，聚焦支付流程（直卡/PayPal BA/hCaptcha）的工程实现与代理对齐。基于FastAPI后端核心引擎与React前端面板，支持多代理池与接码对接，仅供学习研究使用。
items.e: Research project on automating ChatGPT subscription payment chains, covering card binding, PayPal BA flows and hCaptcha handling. Built with FastAPI backend engines and React frontend panel, integrating multi-proxy pools and SMS services for study purposes only.

items.d: 一个用于AI驱动开发的通用任务管理系统，使用Google Gemini模型，专为与Cursor AI无缝协作而设计。
items.z: 这是一个专为AI驱动开发设计的智能任务管理系统，深度适配Cursor等AI编程工具。系统采用免费的Gemini 2.5 Pro模型替代Claude，显著降低成本并提升稳定性。核心亮点包括：融合业务知识库实现精准任务拆解、智能自动确定任务粒度、提供可视化Web界面管理、支持中英双语输出，有效解决中文开发者在AI编程中的任务管理痛点。
items.e: An intelligent task management system designed for AI-driven development, deeply integrated with AI coding tools like Cursor. It replaces costly Claude with free Gemini 2.5 Pro for stability and cost-efficiency. Key features include: business knowledge base integration for precise task decomposition, automatic granularity determination, visual web UI management, and bilingual (EN/ZH) support, streamlining AI development workflows for Chinese developers.

items.d: Phantom-Motion is an incredibly powerful, epic interactive dynamic visual storytelling generator. Its capabilities are limited only by the bounds of your imagination! 它是一个极其硬核的史诗级交互式动态视觉叙事生成器。它的实力只取决于你的想象力高低！
items.z: Phantom Motion 是一款基于 AI 的智能动态视觉叙事引擎，通过融合 GSAP 电影级运镜、Three.js GPGPU 粒子系统与 KaTeX 数学渲染，实现文本剧本到 60FPS 4K 商业视频的无缝转换。其 Audio-First 架构确保微秒级音画同步，Monocle 版式引擎与 WYSIWYG 交互套件支持所见即所得编辑，彻底革新传统影视制作流程。
items.e: Phantom Motion is an AI-powered dynamic visual storytelling engine that transforms text scripts into 60FPS 4K commercial videos. It integrates Hollywood-grade GSAP camera work, Three.js GPGPU particle systems, and KaTeX math rendering with Audio-First architecture for microsecond audio-visual sync. The Monocle layout engine and WYSIWYG editing suite revolutionize traditional video production workflows.

items.d: 地址生成器:Random US tax-free state address generator with real OSM/USPS data — map-verified on Google Maps, supports global countries (HK, India, RU, etc.), multi-language (ZH/EN/RU/ES/PT), pure frontend, no server storage.
items.z: 这是一个纯前端的地址生成器，基于真实OSM/USPS数据生成美国免税州及多国地址，支持多语言且无需后端存储。核心亮点在于生成的地址可通过Google Maps验证，提供灵活的配置接口与模块化设计，适用于测试数据生成和隐私敏感场景。
items.e: A pure frontend address generator using real OSM/USPS data to create US tax-free state and global addresses. Features Google Maps-verifiable outputs, multilingual support, and zero server storage. Designed for test data generation with configurable data paths and modular architecture.

items.d: A automatic pipeline that processing obsidian vault by llm from pinbord, obsidian Clipper etc.
items.z: Obsidian Vault Pipeline 是一个基于 Obsidian 的可审计知识状态运行时系统，利用 LLM 实现从 Pinboard、Obsidian Clipper 等来源的自动捕获、编译与复用。核心流程 Capture → Compile → Reuse，内置 Ingest 至 Derive 六阶段流水线，将原始材料转化为证据链、关系、图谱等结构化知识。提供 ovp CLI、autopilot 模式及本地 UI，支持 research-tech 等领域包扩展。亮点在于状态模型分离（Source/Candidate/Canonical/Projection/Governance）、证据可追溯与 Pack API 可扩展性，适用于个人知识管理与研究自动化。
items.e: Obsidian Vault Pipeline is an auditable knowledge state runtime for Obsidian vaults that uses LLMs to automatically capture, compile, and reuse knowledge from sources like Pinboard and Obsidian Clipper. It follows the Capture → Compile → Reuse narrative with a six-stage pipeline (Ingest to Derive), transforming raw inputs into evidence chains, relations, contradictions, and graphs. Features CLI tools (ovp --full, autopilot), local UI, domain packs like research-tech, and a strict state model (Sources, Candidates, Canonical State, Projections, Governance). Highlights include traceable evidence, rebuildable projections, and extensible Pack API for scalable PKM and research workflows.

items.d: 🤖 An AI-powered desktop automation agent built with Electron &   Next.js - Control your computer like manus, but as a native   desktop app, an ai browser!
items.z: 基于Electron与Next.js的AI桌面自动化浏览器，实现类Manus的计算机控制。核心特性：双模式交互（ChatAgent轻量对话/Deep Explore多智能体工作流）、多模态任务执行、可视化定时调度。支持DeepSeek/Qwen/Gemini等AI提供商，集成Tavily/Serper搜索与MCP服务。采用React 19+Zustand架构，提供原生桌面体验，适用于智能办公、研究分析与自动化场景。
items.e: An AI-powered desktop automation browser built with Electron and Next.js that enables Manus-like computer control through a native application. Key features include dual-mode interaction (ChatAgent for lightweight conversations vs. Deep Explore for multi-agent workflows), multi-modal task execution, and visual scheduling. Supports major AI providers (DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemini, Claude) with integrated search engines (Tavily/Serper) and MCP services. Built on React 19+Zustand architecture, it delivers native desktop experience for intelligent office work, research analysis, and automation scenarios.

items.z: EdgeTunnel (Refactored) 是 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级隧道代理工具，支持 VLESS 和 Trojan 协议。模块化 ESM 架构支持 Wrangler 部署、KV 配置与订阅生成。核心价值为工程化 Serverless 代理方案，易扩展二次开发。适用于网络代理与边缘计算场景，性能依托全球边缘网络。
items.e: EdgeTunnel (Refactored) is a lightweight tunnel proxy tool on Cloudflare Workers supporting VLESS and Trojan protocols. It uses a modular ESM architecture for easy Wrangler CLI deployment, local debugging, and Git version control. Configuration is managed via Cloudflare KV, with automatic subscription link generation for clients like Clash and Sing-box. The core value is an engineering-friendly, extensible Serverless proxy solution ideal for developers to learn Worker development and WebSocket communication. It leverages global edge network for performance in secure tunneling and proxy scenarios.

items.d: Open-source network quality monitoring platform with multi-node Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, IPv6 and Traceroute testing.
items.z: 开源多节点网络质量监控平台，支持Ping/TCPing/HTTP/DNS/Traceroute/IPv6探测。采用Master+Agent+RabbitMQ架构，基于RuoYi-Vue-Plus、Next.js与Prometheus Blackbox，提供Agent自动上下线、一键部署、IP地理解析及广告系统，助力企业低成本搭建网络运维与测速平台。
items.e: Open-source multi-node network quality monitoring platform supporting Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, Traceroute and IPv6. Built with Master+Agent+RabbitMQ architecture using RuoYi-Vue-Plus, Next.js and Prometheus Blackbox. Features auto Agent management, one-click deployment, IP geolocation and ad system for low-cost enterprise network ops.

items.d: The genuine open dictionary, grounded by Wikitionary and explained more with LLMs
items.z: 基于 Wiktionary 构建的开源多语言词典，通过 LLM 增强解释质量。核心亮点是处理 10M+ 词条的流式流水线架构，支持自动分区、数据清洗及 50 并发 LLM 调用生成结构化学习内容，TOON 格式优化 token 使用达 30-60%。适用于语言学习应用、词典服务和 NLP 数据增强。
items.e: An open multilingual dictionary rebuilding from Wiktionary with LLM-enhanced definitions. Its architecture processes 10M+ entries via streaming pipeline, featuring automated partitioning, data cleaning, and 50-concurrent LLM calls for generating learner-friendly structured content. Optimized with TOON format reducing token usage by 30-60%. Ideal for language learning apps and NLP data augmentation.

items.d: Shadowfetch is a lightweight fetcher built with native TCP Sockets, for Cloudflare Workers.
items.z: Shadowfetch 是 Cloudflare Workers 的隐私优先网络请求库，通过原生 TCP 套接字绕过内置 fetch 的元数据泄露问题。核心功能包括自动剥离 cf-ipcountry、cf-connecting-ip 等敏感头信息，确保用户 IP 与地理位置不被意外暴露。适用于需严格隐私保护的代理、镜像或数据转发场景，提供轻量级、可控的请求控制能力。
items.e: Shadowfetch is a privacy-focused fetcher for Cloudflare Workers that leverages native TCP sockets to prevent metadata leakage from built-in fetch. It sanitizes sensitive headers like cf-ipcountry and cf-connecting-ip, ensuring user IP and geolocation remain hidden. Ideal for privacy-sensitive proxying, mirroring, and data forwarding with minimal overhead and maximum control.

items.d: Video to ASCII React component.
items.z: react-video-ascii 是一个基于 WebGL2 的高性能 React 组件，可将视频实时转换为 ASCII 艺术。支持自定义字符集、亮度/饱和度调节及字形/亮度双渲染模式。内置鼠标悬停高亮/散射、点击波纹/扩散动画及加载揭示效果。适用于创意编码、艺术展示和网页特效场景，通过 GPU 加速确保流畅体验。
items.e: react-video-ascii is a high-performance React component that converts videos to ASCII art in real-time using WebGL2 acceleration. It offers extensive customization including character sets, brightness/saturation controls, and dual rendering modes (shape/luminance). Features interactive mouse hover effects (brighten/scatter), click animations (ripple/spread), and reveal transitions. Ideal for creative coding, artistic displays, and web experiments with smooth GPU-accelerated rendering.

items.d: VerbaAurea： 一个文档预处理工具，专注于为知识库构建提供高质量的文本数据。
items.z: VerbaAurea 是专注于知识库构建的智能文档预处理工具，通过多维度评分系统实现语义完整的文档分割。支持DOCX/PDF批量处理，保留原始格式，提供Web界面与命令行两种模式。核心亮点包括句子边界检测、自适应长度控制与中英文差异化处理策略，为RAG和LLM微调提供高质量训练数据。
items.e: VerbaAurea is an intelligent document preprocessing tool specialized for knowledge base construction, achieving semantic-preserving segmentation through a multi-dimensional scoring system. It supports batch processing of DOCX/PDF formats with original formatting retention, offering both Web UI and CLI modes. Key features include sentence boundary detection, adaptive length control, and differentiated processing strategies for Chinese/English texts, delivering high-quality training data for RAG and LLM fine-tuning.

items.d: 基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok2API，适配最新的Web调用格式，支持流式对话、图像生成、图像编辑、联网搜索、视频生成、深度思考，支持号池并发调用和自动负载均衡。
items.z: Tomiya233/grok2api 将 xAI 的 Grok 大模型封装为 OpenAI API 兼容接口，基于 FastAPI 构建。核心亮点包括：异步流式处理架构确保高并发性能，智能号池管理与负载均衡机制最大化调用稳定性，自动缓存解决资源链接 403 限制，提供完整的管理界面与统计监控。适用于需要将 Grok 集成至现有 AI 应用或构建高可用 Grok 服务的开发者。
items.e: Tomiya233/grok2api wraps xAI's Grok model into OpenAI API-compatible interfaces using FastAPI. Key features include: asynchronous streaming architecture for high concurrency, intelligent token pool management with auto load balancing, automatic caching to bypass 403 restrictions, and comprehensive admin dashboard with statistics. Enables developers to integrate Grok into existing AI applications or build highly available Grok services with enterprise-grade reliability.

items.d: Disposable, ephemeral network infrastructure powered by GitHub Codespaces.
items.z: Fluffy-Barnacle利用GitHub Codespaces快速部署一次性网络基础设施，提供SOCKS5代理、HTTPS文件托管和WireGuard隧道。专为渗透测试设计，支持多区域部署、自动重连及Burp Suite集成，实现免费临时的出口IP轮换，显著提升安全研究效率。
items.e: Fluffy-Barnacle transforms GitHub Codespaces into ephemeral network infrastructure, deploying SOCKS5 proxies, HTTPS file hosting, and WireGuard tunnels in seconds. Designed for penetration testing, it features multi-region deployment, auto-reconnection, and Burp Suite integration. Each Codespace rotation provides fresh egress IPs, enabling efficient, policy-compliant security research and network operations.

items.d: Graph database native to the cloud. Embedded, multi-tenant, built on object storage.
items.z: NamiDB是一款基于对象存储的云原生图数据库引擎。它将节点和边以列式文件形式存于S3等桶中，桶为唯一真相源，支持Cypher查询。引擎支持嵌入式（如DuckDB）、HTTP服务器或云托管三种模式，利用S3条件写入实现多租户零协调架构。专为AI智能体构建知识图谱设计，成本可归零、备份简单，填补Kùzu归档后的空白。
items.e: NamiDB is a cloud-native graph database built on object storage. It persists nodes and edges as columnar files in S3 buckets, with the bucket as the single source of truth. It supports Cypher queries and runs embedded like DuckDB, as an HTTP server, or in hosted cloud using the same engine. S3 conditional writes enable multi-tenancy without consensus layers. Ideal for AI agents needing knowledge graphs, it offers zero-cost scaling and simple S3 backups. It fills the gap after Kùzu's archiving.

items.d: 英译汉翻译润色 · English→Chinese translate & polish skill (英中对照)
items.z: 基于叶子南《高级英汉翻译理论与实践》构建的英译汉润色技能，通过七阶段工作流消除翻译腔，支持中英对照输出，可集成于Claude Code等AI智能体，适用于翻译、润色与校对场景。
items.e: A translation polishing skill for English-to-Chinese, based on Ye Zinan's advanced translation theory. It uses a seven-stage workflow to eliminate translationese, supports bilingual output, and integrates with AI agents like Claude Code for translation, polishing, and proofreading.

items.d: OneDrive public directory listing, and One-Click Deploy to Vercel. Powered by Vercel and Next.js.
items.z: 基于 Next.js 和 Vercel 的 OneDrive 目录列表程序，支持一键部署。通过将配置迁移至 Vercel 环境变量，省去手动修改配置文件的繁琐步骤，实现快速上线。提供文件预览、下载功能，支持文件夹密码保护，并优化 OAuth 认证流程以增强安全性，适合免费搭建私有文件分享站点。
items.e: A OneDrive directory listing solution built with Next.js and Vercel, featuring one-click deployment. By migrating configurations to Vercel environment variables, it eliminates manual config file editing, enabling rapid setup. Offers file preview and download capabilities, supports password-protected folders, and enhances OAuth security by auto-closing authentication channels.

items.d: An AI-assisted newsroom workflow system for event tracking, evidence organization, approval chains, correction handling, and post-publication monitoring.
items.z: NewsFlow 是一款 AI 辅助的新闻编辑室工作流系统，专注于新闻生产中高成本、高责任的中间流程。系统通过 AI 智能体实现线索归并、证据结构化、风险审查、签发审批和发布后监测，建立完整的人机协同审核机制。采用 FastAPI+React 技术栈，支持自托管和二次开发，为新闻机构提供可审计、可追溯的数字化协作平台。
items.e: NewsFlow is an AI-assisted newsroom workflow system focusing on the high-cost, high-responsibility intermediate processes of news production. It employs AI agents to handle lead clustering, evidence structuring, risk assessment, approval chains, and post-publication monitoring, establishing a comprehensive human-in-the-loop review mechanism. Built with FastAPI+React stack, it supports self-hosting and secondary development, providing news organizations with an auditable, traceable digital collaboration platform for editorial governance and fact-checking workflows.

items.d: 收集免费机场转成Socks5代理池
items.z: airProxyPool是一个自动化代理池项目，通过收集免费机场的SS/VMess代理，使用aggregator验证并由glider提供SOCKS5统一接口。支持自动更新、检测和故障转移，实现高可用代理服务。适用于爬虫和隐私保护场景，简化代理管理流程。
items.e: airProxyPool is an automated proxy pool that collects free airport SS/VMess proxies, validates them with aggregator, and exposes a unified SOCKS5 interface via glider. It supports auto-updates, checks and failover for high availability, ideal for scraping and privacy scenarios.

items.d: 华为云 CodeArts Agent OpenAI 兼容代理 · 多账号轮转 + token 自动续期保活 + 并发控制 + WebUI
items.z: 华为云 CodeArts Agent（盘古助手）的 OpenAI 兼容代理，纯 Go 实现无需客户端。支持多账号轮转、Token 自动续期保活、并发控制与 WebUI 管理，内置模型可用性探测、每日签到积分自动领取及工具调用支持，可将华为云盘古大模型无缝接入 OpenAI 生态。
items.e: OpenAI-compatible proxy for Huawei Cloud CodeArts Agent (Pangu). Pure Go, no client required. Features multi-account rotation, auto token refresh, concurrency control, WebUI, model probing, daily credit auto-claim, and tool calling support for seamless integration with the OpenAI ecosystem.

items.z: Sprite Lab是一款纯浏览器端工具，专为图像背景去除与精灵图自动切割设计。无需上传或AI模型，利用Canvas API实现多通道alpha抠图消除边缘光晕，并通过连通像素扫描智能检测帧。支持动画预览、帧排除及ZIP导出（含manifest），全部本地处理，保障隐私与离线可用。适用于2D游戏开发和动画资产准备。
items.e: Sprite Lab is a fully client-side web tool for automatic background removal and spritesheet slicing. Using only the HTML Canvas API, it detects backdrops like green screens or checkerboards and applies multi-pass alpha matting to eliminate edge halos. Connected pixel analysis enables intelligent frame detection without grids. Features include animation previews, frame exclusion, and ZIP exports with manifests. Everything runs locally with no uploads, AI, or servers—ideal for 2D game asset preparation.

items.d: minimalism, blog theme for Astro
items.z: Astro Air 是一款基于 Astro 框架的极简多语言博客主题，支持中、英、日、韩等五种语言，内置置顶文章、阅读时长、目录导航、暗色主题及 RSS 订阅等丰富功能。采用 Bun 作为包管理器和运行时，提供流畅的动画交互与响应式布局，适合追求简洁与性能的个人博客站点。
items.e: Astro Air is a minimal multilingual blog theme built on Astro, supporting five languages including English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. It features pinned posts, reading time, table of contents, dark mode, and RSS feeds. Powered by Bun for fast tooling, it delivers smooth animations and responsive layouts, ideal for personal blogs prioritizing simplicity and performance.

items.d: hotmail register
items.z: 这是一个基于Python的Outlook/Hotmail自动化注册工具，采用ruyiPage库驱动Firefox浏览器实现全流程自动化。支持批量注册、代理IP、验证码服务集成及无头模式，可生成虚假注册信息并保存账号凭证。适用于测试研究等非商业场景，采用PolyForm非商用许可证。
items.e: This Python automation tool leverages ruyiPage library to control Firefox browser for fully automated Outlook/Hotmail account registration. Key features include bulk account creation with configurable delays, proxy server support for IP rotation, integration with 2captcha for automated captcha solving, headless mode operation, and fake identity generation using Faker library. Designed specifically for testing and research purposes under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license, it automatically saves credentials to text files with comprehensive logging and screenshot capture capabilities.

items.d: 极简 Cloudflare Worker，接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取
items.z: ni-mail 是一个极简 Cloudflare Worker，通过 Email Routing 接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取。使用 KV 存储最多 50 封邮件，postal-mime 解析为结构化 JSON，支持 API Key 鉴权和多自定义域名，附件仅存 metadata。无需数据库、前端或 JWT，部署简单，适合自动化脚本获取邮件内容，实现轻量级邮件集成。
items.e: ni-mail is a minimalist Cloudflare Worker that receives private domain emails via Cloudflare Email Routing and exposes them through a simple HTTP API. It stores up to 50 emails in KV, parses them with postal-mime into structured JSON, supports API key auth and multiple custom domains, and keeps only attachment metadata. No database, frontend or JWT needed; ideal for automation scripts fetching emails in a lightweight, serverless setup.

items.d: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。
items.z: GitHubStarsIndex 自动化抓取 GitHub Star 仓库，调用 AI 生成智能摘要与技术标签。支持增量更新、高并发处理，输出 Markdown 和交互式 HTML 页面，可无缝同步至 Obsidian 知识库或 GitHub Pages，实现个人技术资产的智能化管理与高效检索。
items.e: GitHubStarsIndex automates fetching GitHub starred repositories and generates AI-powered summaries with technical tags. Supporting incremental updates, concurrent processing, and Jinja2 templating, it outputs structured Markdown and interactive HTML pages with search functionality. The tool seamlessly syncs to Obsidian vaults or deploys to GitHub Pages with multilingual support, transforming scattered stars into a searchable, organized technical knowledge base for efficient asset management.

items.z: Openmind是一个自托管数字commonplace book。保存链接、引用、图片和想法，通过颜色、词语或语义找回。Postgres+Go部署，pgvector语义搜索，颜色提取。功能有阅读器、Drift、Desk、Lenses、RSS。AI可选，JSON导出。
items.e: Openmind is a self-hosted digital commonplace book for saving links, quotes, images, and thoughts, rediscovering them via colors, words, or semantic vibes. It offers instant capture, Postgres with pgvector for full-text and semantic search, color palette extraction, distraction-free reader, Drift for resurfacing forgotten items, Desk for pinning, Lenses for saved queries, and RSS feed integration. Deployed as a single Go binary with Docker, AI is optional through adapters. Emphasizes user data control with JSON exports. Perfect for personal knowledge management without backlogs.

items.d: onekey script to install xray on alpine system
items.z: 专为Alpine Linux设计的Xray-core一键安装脚本，自动从官方GitHub下载最新版本，安装至系统路径，配置基础SOCKS代理，并注册为OpenRC服务实现开机自启。适用于轻量级服务器快速部署代理节点，简化Alpine环境下的Xray运维。
items.e: One-click shell script to install and configure Xray-core on Alpine Linux. Automatically downloads the latest official release, installs the binary, sets up a basic SOCKS proxy, and registers it as an OpenRC service with auto-start. Ideal for lightweight servers needing quick proxy deployment.

items.d: Script to submit both IPv6 and IPv4 addresses to DuckDNS
items.z: 该脚本解决DuckDNS不支持IPv6自动更新的问题，通过Shell实现IPv4/IPv6双栈地址自动提交。自动检测NAT环境，一键配置并创建cron定时任务，适用于家庭服务器和物联网设备。轻量级设计，依赖curl等基础工具，确保在提供服务的设备上直接运行。
items.e: This script resolves DuckDNS's lack of IPv6 auto-update support by automatically submitting both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses via Shell. It detects NAT environments, provides one-click configuration with automated cron job setup, and is ideal for home servers and IoT devices. Lightweight design relies on curl and standard tools, ensuring direct execution on service-providing devices.

items.z: Eubiota是一个专注于人类微生物组自主发现的模块化智能体平台。它通过协调专业智能体，结合领域工具，执行规划、执行与验证的迭代循环，确保证据严谨性。该平台利用结果驱动优化，加速微生物组领域的机制推理与实验设计，旨在提升科研探索的效率与深度。
items.e: Eubiota is a modular agentic AI platform designed for autonomous microbiome discovery. It orchestrates specialized agents to execute an iterative cycle of planning, execution, and verification via shared memory, ensuring rigorous evidence grounding. The framework integrates domain-specific tools and employs outcome-driven refinement to accelerate mechanistic reasoning and experimental design in human microbiome research.

items.d: 利用Deno提供的服务进行代理中转
items.z: DenoProxy是基于Deno运行时构建的轻量级动态代理服务，核心能力在于通过URL参数实时配置代理目标，并将/proxy路径请求无缝转发至指定后端。项目采用Deno原生HTTP服务器与KV存储，支持本地运行与Deno Deploy云部署双模式，适用于API调试、跨域请求代理及开发环境网络中转等场景，具备配置灵活、部署极简的技术特征。
items.e: DenoProxy is a lightweight dynamic proxy service built on Deno runtime, featuring real-time target configuration via URL parameters and seamless request forwarding for /proxy paths. Leveraging Deno's native HTTP server and KV storage, it supports both local execution and Deno Deploy cloud deployment. Ideal for API debugging, cross-origin request proxying, and development environment network tunneling, it delivers flexible configuration and minimal deployment overhead.

items.d: Multi-Agent Autonomous Medical Collaboration System
items.z: MediCareAI-Agent 是一个多Agent自主医疗协作系统，采用患者驱动+AI辅助+医生验证模式。系统通过多路径RAG和外部知识分析实现智能诊断与个性化治疗规划，支持主动康复监测和异常告警。技术栈基于Python 3.12+FastAPI异步后端与React 19前端，兼容多LLM提供商，集成pgvector向量数据库，提供完整的医疗级生产部署方案。
items.e: MediCareAI-Agent is a multi-agent autonomous medical collaboration system that reimagines healthcare through patient-driven, AI-assisted, and doctor-validated workflows. It enables intelligent diagnosis via multi-path RAG, personalized treatment planning, proactive rehabilitation monitoring, and seamless doctor collaboration. Built on Python 3.12+FastAPI async backend and React 19 frontend, it supports multiple LLM providers, integrates pgvector for medical knowledge retrieval, and delivers production-ready deployment with Docker.

items.d: 一个基于 Next.js 开发的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理私服，支持一键部署到Vercel。解决国内 Pull 镜像困难问题。
items.z: Pocker 是基于 Next.js 的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理系统，专为解决国内 Docker Hub 拉取缓慢而设计。系统通过 GitHub Actions 自动化将镜像转存至华为云 SWR，支持一键 Vercel 部署、多区域节点切换、镜像/标签/命名空间全生命周期管理，并提供用量统计与暗黑模式。让每个人都能拥有自主可控的 Docker 私服。
items.e: Pocker is a full-stack Docker registry management system built with Next.js, designed to solve slow Docker Hub pulls in China. It automatically transfers images to Huawei Cloud SWR via GitHub Actions, enabling one-click Vercel deployment. Key features include multi-region node switching (23 global nodes), complete lifecycle management of images/tags/namespaces, usage statistics, dark mode, and automated workflows. It empowers individuals and teams to own private Docker registries with full data control and security.

items.d: Generated files for SuttaCentral editions
items.z: SuttaCentral 发布系统生成的佛教经典数字版本文件库。存储多语言、多格式的巴利语三藏及注释文献，为网站和移动应用提供结构化内容支持。核心价值在于实现佛学文献的自动化发布、跨格式转换与国际化分发。
items.e: Repository containing generated digital edition files for SuttaCentral. Stores multilingual, multi-format Pali Canon and commentarial texts, providing structured content for web and mobile applications. Core value lies in automated publishing, cross-format conversion, and international distribution of Buddhist scriptures.

items.d: Ubuntu 26.04 + Phosh for the Xiaomi 12T Pro / Redmi K50 Ultra (diting, SM8475) on mainline Linux: build system, packages, kernel patches
items.z: 该仓库将 Ubuntu 26.04 LTS 与 Phosh 移动桌面环境移植至小米 12T Pro/Redmi K50 Ultra（骁龙8+ Gen 1），包含主线 Linux 内核补丁、完整构建系统、Debian 打包及音频/相机/视频解码等硬件适配，实现手机运行完整 Linux 桌面系统。
items.e: This repository ports Ubuntu 26.04 LTS with the Phosh mobile desktop environment to the Xiaomi 12T Pro / Redmi K50 Ultra (Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1, SM8475). It provides mainline Linux kernel patches, a complete build system, Debian packaging, and hardware enablement for audio, camera, and video decoding (VA-API), enabling a full Linux desktop on a smartphone using upstream stable kernel with device-specific patches.

items.d: A modern personal time management and task tracking application
items.z: Fates 是一款基于 Tauri 和 Svelte 构建的开源时间管理与任务追踪应用。它通过可视化时间轴、热力图和数据分析帮助用户识别时间黑洞，内置 AI 助手可优化任务描述并自动生成周报。采用本地优先存储策略保障隐私，支持多端同步，旨在解决职场人士时间管理混乱、工作效率低下及周报总结困难等痛点。
items.e: Fates is a modern open-source time management and task tracking application built with Tauri and Svelte, designed to help professionals combat productivity challenges. It features visual timeline views, GitHub-style calendar heatmaps, and comprehensive data analytics to reveal time consumption patterns. The integrated AI assistant optimizes task descriptions, auto-generates weekly reports, and provides intelligent scheduling suggestions. Employing a local-first storage architecture for privacy protection, it supports seamless synchronization across web and desktop platforms. Fates directly addresses common pain points: disorganized time management, inefficient workflows, and the tedious process of weekly reporting, making it an ideal tool for self-improvement and career development.

items.d: 🐸 Read Frog | Open Source Immersive Translate - unofficial userscript port / 🐸 陪读蛙 | 开源沉浸式翻译 - 非官方油猴脚本
items.z: rong6/read-frog 是 Read Frog 项目的非官方用户脚本移植仓库，将浏览器扩展适配为 Tampermonkey/Violentmonkey 脚本，支持移动浏览器运行。核心功能包括 AI 驱动的沉浸式翻译、文章分析及多模型支持，助力浏览器语言学习。技术亮点在于保留上游代码，仅替换平台实现，兼容移动端。适用于网页阅读翻译和深度语言掌握，尤其适合扩展不可用的移动场景。
items.e: This repository provides an unofficial userscript port of the Read Frog AI-powered language learning browser extension. It adapts the original extension for Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey userscripts, enabling use on mobile browsers where extensions are not supported. Features include immersive translation, article analysis, and compatibility with multiple AI models. The port keeps the core application logic intact while replacing extension platform components. It serves language learners by facilitating seamless web content translation and analysis directly in the browser, with particular value for mobile users.

items.z: 本项目提供半自动 NVIDIA BUILD 账号注册工具，使用 Playwright 浏览器自动化完成邮箱创建、注册表单、验证码填写及 NGC API Key 生成，仅手动处理 hCaptcha。集成自建临时邮箱服务，实现端到端流程自动化。核心价值在于简化开发者获取 NVIDIA AI Playground 密钥的流程，节省重复操作时间。技术亮点包括 Playwright 端到端控制、邮件轮询验证与 API 调用集成。仅限学习交流用途。
items.e: This repository provides a semi-automated tool for registering NVIDIA BUILD accounts and generating AI Playground API keys. It uses Playwright for browser automation to handle email creation via a self-hosted temp mail service, form submissions, verification code polling, and NGC API key creation, requiring only manual hCaptcha solving. Core value lies in streamlining access to NVIDIA AI tools for developers. Technical highlights include end-to-end browser control, email integration, and automated API interactions. Intended solely for educational purposes.

items.z: 暂无描述。

items.d: Hermes Agent proficiencies: shareable operating-attribute skills for human SOPs/playbooks, agent skill/tool-SOP building, safe publishing, and tidy workspace hygiene.
items.z: 该仓库为Hermes AI代理提供可共享熟练度技能，聚焦操作纪律。核心包括人类SOP与playbook创建、代理技能与工具SOP构建（含契约与防护）、安全发布审查及工作区卫生管理。强调运行时行为、审查循环和制品区分，提升代理在真实压力下的可靠性和安全性，避免数据泄露与文件混乱。适用于AI代理开发与自动化场景。
items.e: Hermes Proficiencies is a collection of shareable skills designed for the Hermes AI agent to instill operational discipline. It includes proficiencies for crafting human-facing SOPs and playbooks, building agent skills and Tool SOPs with invocation contracts and guardrails, conducting thorough publishing reviews to prevent private data leaks, and enforcing workspace hygiene to keep files organized. These skills promote runtime behavior, review loops, and clear distinctions between human and agent artifacts, making the agent more reliable, safe, and effective in real-world development and automation scenarios.

items.d: 一键从 GitHub 跳转到 CodeWiki & DeepWiki & Zread 的油猴脚本 |  A one-click Tampermonkey script for jumping from GitHub to CodeWiki & DeepWiki & Zread
items.z: 该油猴脚本为 GitHub 仓库页面添加一键跳转至 CodeWiki、DeepWiki 和 Zread 的快捷入口，无缝集成原生 UI。核心价值在于打通代码托管平台与 AI 增强的代码知识图谱服务，显著提升开发者查阅开源项目时的理解效率，无需手动复制链接即可获取智能生成的代码文档与架构分析。
items.e: This Tampermonkey script adds one-click jump links to CodeWiki, DeepWiki, and Zread directly on GitHub repository pages. It seamlessly integrates with the native UI, bridging code hosting platforms with AI-powered code intelligence services. The tool dramatically improves developer productivity by enabling instant access to AI-generated documentation and architecture analysis without manual link copying.

items.d: Panel.NA1 持续赚取金币
items.z: 该项目利用 HuggingFace Spaces 免费托管服务，实现 Panel.NA1 平台的 24/7 自动化挂机赚金币。核心特性包括每分钟自动签到、Cookie 自动刷新、Web 监控面板及抗休眠保活机制，支持 Telegram 通知。零成本部署，适用于个人资源获取与无服务器自动化技术实践，通过反代解决网络限制。
items.e: This project leverages HuggingFace Spaces free hosting to automate 24/7 coin farming on Panel.NA1 platform. Key features include automatic check-in every minute, cookie auto-refresh, web monitoring dashboard, anti-idle keep-alive mechanism, and Telegram notifications via reverse proxy. Zero-cost deployment suits personal resource acquisition and serverless automation learning, effectively overcoming network restrictions while maintaining persistent operation through external health checks.

items.d: TypeScript SDK for the NitroPing audit log — batching client, error capture, Hono/Express/Nitro adapters, and GenAI cost tracing.
items.z: nitroping-sdk 是 nitroping.dev 平台的官方多语言客户端库，支持 TypeScript、Swift、Python、Go、Kotlin、PHP 等语言，封装 REST API 实现设备令牌注册（APNs/FCM/Web Push）、多渠道通知发送（推送、邮件、SMS、Slack）、定向/定时/循环推送、Web Push 订阅与 UI 组件、内置收件箱及 Webhook 验证。适用于移动/Web 应用与服务器端通知集成，提供统一 API、公私钥认证和幂等性支持，实现跨平台一致体验。
items.e: nitroping-sdk offers official client libraries for the nitroping.dev platform across TypeScript, Swift, Python, Go, Kotlin, and PHP. It wraps the REST API for device token registration (APNs/FCM/Web Push), multi-channel notifications (push, email, SMS, Slack), targeted/scheduled/recurring sends, Web Push subscriptions with UI widgets, in-app inbox, and webhook verification. Ideal for mobile/web apps and servers needing unified, secure cross-platform notification delivery with public/secret key auth and idempotency.

items.z: 暂无描述。
BookAlign 利用 embedding 与动态规划算法，精准对齐外语原著与正式译本的句段结构，重建成可直接对照阅读的双语 EPUB。支持段落级与句子级回写，完整保留原书目录、脚注等元素，特别适合日语小说配中文译本。可输出 JSON 对齐结果供调试，避免机翻质量风险，提升沉浸式阅读体验。
items.e: BookAlign aligns foreign language EPUB originals with official translations using embedding-based semantic matching and dynamic programming algorithms to create bilingual ebooks for comparative reading. It supports both paragraph-level and inline sentence-level writeback modes, preserving original spine order, table of contents, footnotes, and other structural elements. Optimized for Japanese-to-Chinese novel alignment, it exports alignment results as JSON for debugging, eliminating machine translation risks and the hassle of switching between multiple reading applications.

items.d: 批量查询 eu.org 域名是否被注册，在茫茫域名中，寻找自己心仪的那一枚。
items.z: ScanDomainEuorg 是一款专注于 eu.org 域名批量查询的自动化工具。通过高效扫描技术，快速检测海量域名注册状态，已注册域名显示关联用户名，未注册显示 None。适用于域名投资者、个人开发者及企业品牌保护，帮助用户从海量域名中精准定位可注册的心仪域名，提升筛选效率。
items.e: ScanDomainEuorg is a specialized automation tool designed for batch querying eu.org domain registration status. Leveraging efficient scanning technology, it rapidly checks massive domain lists, clearly displaying usernames for registered domains and None for unregistered ones. This tool is essential for domain investors, individual developers, and enterprises conducting brand protection, enabling users to precisely identify desirable available domains from vast candidates and dramatically improving domain research efficiency while saving significant time and effort.

items.d: AI MVP应用的通用template
items.z: fast-mvp是专为AI应用打造的全栈开发模板，基于Next.js App Router实现前后端一体化。集成tRPC与Zod提供全链路类型安全，配合Drizzle ORM管理SQLite数据库。通过TokenRoll插件深度对接Claude Code，为AI初创项目提供开箱即用的MVP验证方案，显著缩短从概念到产品的开发周期。
items.e: fast-mvp is a full-stack template designed for AI applications, unifying frontend and backend via Next.js App Router. It ensures end-to-end type safety with tRPC and Zod, while Drizzle ORM manages SQLite databases. Deeply integrated with Claude Code through TokenRoll plugin, it provides an out-of-the-box MVP validation solution for AI startups, dramatically accelerating development cycles.

items.d: Knowledge layer for building language-learning apps: knowledge points for English, Japanese and Chinese, pedagogical primitives, building blocks and a blueprint planner. CC BY-NC 4.0.
items.z: OpenLanguageKit为语言学习应用提供标准化知识层，覆盖英日中三语，含950个知识点、56种练习类型、96个现成页面及14条课程轨道。纯JSON/HTML/JS无依赖，可被教师、开发者或AI直接复用，解决“教什么、按何顺序、如何练”的核心难题。
items.e: OpenLanguageKit provides a standardized knowledge layer for language-learning apps, covering English, Japanese, and Chinese with 950 knowledge points, 56 practice types, 96 ready-made pages, and 14 course tracks. Built as dependency-free JSON/HTML/JS, it enables teachers, developers, or coding AIs to reuse content and solve the core challenge of what to teach, in what order, and how to practice.

items.d: Unofficial tracker for Ollama cloud models that work on the Free tier.
items.z: 该仓库是非官方的 Ollama 云模型免费 tier 追踪器。通过自动化脚本定期探测模型可用性，维护动态表格标注✅（免费可用）或🔒（需订阅），并显示使用量级别。最新检查于 2026-08-03，涵盖 Gemma、Qwen、DeepSeek 等众多大模型。帮助开发者、研究人员和 AI 爱好者免费实验高级 LLM，最大化利用免费云资源，优化成本与工作流。
items.e: This repository is an unofficial tracker for Ollama cloud models accessible on the free tier. It uses automated scripts for periodic probing to maintain a dynamic table marking ✅ for free access or 🔒 for subscription-required models, along with usage intensity levels. Last updated 2026-08-03, it covers models like Gemma, Qwen, and DeepSeek. It helps developers, researchers, and AI enthusiasts experiment with advanced LLMs cost-free, optimizing free cloud resources and workflows.

items.d: Static File Browser by Astro
items.z: 基于Astro的静态文件浏览器，专为Cloudflare Pages设计。构建时扫描public目录生成预渲染HTML，提供现代化目录列表界面，支持MDX内容注入、SEO优化及自定义错误页。解决静态托管平台缺乏autoindex功能的问题，适合需要美观、可浏览文件索引的场景。
items.e: A static file browser built with Astro for Cloudflare Pages. Pre-renders directory listings at build time with modern UI, MDX support, SEO optimization, and custom error pages. Solves the lack of autoindex on static hosting platforms, ideal for creating browsable file indexes with zero server-side logic.

items.d: SubSonic 是一款兼具桌面级体验与服务器级性能的高性能子域名扫描器。它采用 Go 和 Vue 构建，通过自适应并发算法和两阶段扫描机制确保了扫描的速度与准度，并最终编译为单一可执行文件，实现真正的“开箱即用”.
items.z: SubSonic是一款高性能子域名扫描平台，采用Go与Vue构建，编译为单一可执行文件实现开箱即用。核心亮点包括自适应并发调度算法、两阶段扫描机制（主扫描+错误重试）、分层DNS解析及WebSocket实时Web UI，支持低内存运行与可视化监控。适用于网络安全渗透测试、子域名枚举与漏洞侦察场景，兼顾速度、稳定性和准确性。
items.e: SubSonic is a high-performance subdomain scanner combining desktop-grade UX with server-level performance. Built with Go and Vue, it compiles into a single executable for out-of-the-box use. Key features include an adaptive concurrency algorithm, two-phase scanning (main scan plus error retry), layered DNS resolution, and real-time WebSocket-powered web UI with live updates and low memory footprint. Ideal for cybersecurity penetration testing, subdomain enumeration, and reconnaissance, balancing speed, stability, and accuracy.

items.z: llm-tap是一款本地透明代理工具，专为采集真实LLM API交互并构建训练数据集设计。用户将客户端URL重定向至代理，即可透明转发请求至上游服务商，同时原样保存完整调用为JSON文件。支持多协议自动识别、流式响应合并及多服务商。提供Web UI筛选检查，通过导出脚本生成OpenAI、ShareGPT等多种格式数据集，适用于LLM微调与agent训练。亮点为零配置保真存储和按host分类。
items.e: llm-tap is a local transparent proxy tool designed to capture authentic LLM API interactions for building training datasets. By redirecting client URLs to the local proxy, it transparently forwards requests to upstream providers while saving each complete call as a raw JSON file. It supports automatic protocol detection for OpenAI, Anthropic, and others, merges streaming responses, and handles multiple providers seamlessly. A web UI enables filtering and inspection, while export scripts convert data to formats like OpenAI, ShareGPT, tool_sft, or canonical JSONL for fine-tuning and agent training. Key features include zero upstream configuration, faithful protocol preservation, and host-organized storage.

items.z: 这个Python工具用于自动化破解阿里云滑动验证码。核心价值：通过OpenCV图像识别精准定位缺口位置，结合Selenium浏览器自动化模拟人类滑动轨迹，有效绕过阿里云验证码防护。应用场景：网络爬虫数据采集、自动化测试。技术亮点：集成ddddocr识别、undetected-chromedriver防检测、人类行为模拟算法，支持跨平台运行。
items.e: This Python tool automates bypassing Alibaba Cloud slider captchas. Its core value lies in using OpenCV for precise gap detection and Selenium for human-like drag simulation to effectively circumvent Aliyun captcha protection. It is ideal for web scraping data collection and automated testing scenarios. Key technical highlights include integration with ddddocr for recognition, undetected-chromedriver for anti-detection, sophisticated human behavior simulation algorithms, and full cross-platform compatibility across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

items.z: jdapi 是一个非官方的京东 API Python 封装库，为开发者提供便捷的京东账号自动化操作能力。项目核心价值在于简化京东登录态管理、签到任务、优惠券领取等常见场景的 API 调用，通过 Python 函数式接口屏蔽底层 HTTP 请求细节。技术亮点包括自动 Cookie 管理、请求加密处理以及反反爬机制，适用于京东生态的自动化脚本开发与轻量级应用集成。
items.e: jdapi is an unofficial Python wrapper for JD.com APIs, enabling automated account operations with minimal code. It simplifies common scenarios like check-ins, coupon claiming, and order queries by abstracting HTTP complexities into Python functions. Key features include automated cookie management, request encryption, and anti-anti-crawling mechanisms, ideal for building JD ecosystem automation scripts and lightweight integrations.

items.d: Turn a private Hugging Face repo into your own cloud storage service.
items.z: Hugging Cloud 将私有 Hugging Face 仓库转化为自托管云存储服务，专为 AI 团队管理模型与数据集设计。基于 FastAPI+Next.js 全栈架构，提供 RBAC 权限控制、可恢复上传和签名链接安全访问。Docker 容器化部署，支持 SQLite/Postgres 和 Redis，兼顾轻量便捷与生产级扩展能力。
items.e: Hugging Cloud transforms private Hugging Face repositories into self-hosted cloud storage services, purpose-built for AI teams managing models and datasets. Built on a modern FastAPI+Next.js stack, it delivers enterprise-grade features including RBAC access control, resumable uploads, and cryptographically signed download links. Docker containerized deployment supports both SQLite for lightweight use and Postgres/Redis for production scalability, enabling seamless integration into existing AI infrastructure while maintaining data privacy and access governance.
